papers.title: Quantum statistics in an extended collider coupled to a qubit
papers.abstract: Mesoscopic colliders provide an effective platform for probing the mutual statistics of quantum particles. Recent experiments have successfully extracted the mutual statistics of fermions, and more exotic anyons using quantum point contacts (QPCs). Coupling a point-like collider, such as a quantum point contact, to a two-level impurity or qubit can induce statistical transmutation of fermions, causing them to display boson-like bunching tendencies. Here, we extend the analysis to an extended collider. We investigate the scattering of two incoming fermionic and bosonic wave packets in the presence of post-selection on the impurity state, and systematically analyze the possible benchmarks used to characterize bunching and infer the underlying mutual statistics. We show that only a specific benchmark faithfully captures the mutual statistics of the colliding particles, while alternative choices can produce spurious statistical signatures. Hence, the correct benchmark for probing the quantum statistics depends on the intricate details of the mesoscopic collider.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate、analyze、show（理论分析，无实验或计算细节）。；研究对象：介观对撞机（extended collider）中量子粒子（费米子和玻色子）的统计性质，以及耦合到量子比特（qubit）的散射过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 只有特定的基准（benchmark）能忠实反映碰撞粒子的互统计（mutual statistics），而其他基准可能产生虚假的统计特征；正确探测量子统计的基准取决于介观对撞机的具体细节。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：只有特定的基准（benchmark）能忠实反映碰撞粒子的互统计（mutual statistics），而其他基准可能产生虚假的统计特征；正确探测量子统计的基准取决于介观对撞机的具体细节。；创新点：将之前针对点状对撞机（如量子点接触）的统计嬗变分析扩展到扩展型对撞机（extended collider），并揭示了不同基准在提取互统计时的可靠性差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：研究两个入射费米子和玻色子波包在杂质态后选择（post-selection）条件下的散射，系统分析用于表征聚束（bunching）和推断互统计的多种基准。

papers.title: Roughness-robust surface altermagnetism in $PT$ antiferromagnets
papers.abstract: Surface altermagnetism extends spin splitting beyond bulk altermagnets through symmetry reduction at surfaces and interfaces. An existing classification applies to the local symmetry of atomically flat surface terraces. The present paper addresses the symmetry of macroscopic spin-momentum correlations that survive averaging over compensated rough surfaces. These correlations are governed by the surface antisymmetry Laue point group. Rough-surface altermagnetism is forbidden at any surface of a magnet whose antisymmetry space group contains antitranslations, and the classification therefore reduces to $PT$-symmetric antiferromagnets. By restoring all symmetries leaving the surface normal invariant, roughness can generate compensated surface altermagnets from uncompensated flat terminations, increase the surface symmetry, or suppress spin splitting. By combining bulk switchability with altermagnetic surface transport properties, roughness-robust surface altermagnetism in $PT$-symmetric antiferromagnets provides a route toward spintronic functionality.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中多次出现“symmetry”“classification”“group”等理论分析关键词，未提及实验或计算手段。；研究对象：PT对称反铁磁体中的粗糙表面交变磁（surface altermagnetism）现象，特别是宏观自旋-动量关联在补偿性粗糙表面上的对称性行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在PT对称反铁磁体中，粗糙表面交变磁是允许存在的，且其宏观自旋-动量关联由表面反称Laue点群决定；粗糙表面可以从非补偿的平坦端面产生补偿性表面交变磁，或增加表面对称性、抑制自旋分裂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在PT对称反铁磁体中，粗糙表面交变磁是允许存在的，且其宏观自旋-动量关联由表面反称Laue点群决定；粗糙表面可以从非补偿的平坦端面产生补偿性表面交变磁，或增加表面对称性、抑制自旋分裂。；创新点：将表面交变磁的研究从原子级平坦表面扩展到宏观粗糙表面，揭示了粗糙表面下自旋-动量关联的对称性规则，并指出在PT对称反铁磁体中粗糙表面交变磁具有鲁棒性，为自旋电子学功能提供了新路径。
papers.method_zh: 基于晶体对称性分析，特别是反称空间群和表面反称Laue点群的理论分类，结合表面粗糙度对对称性影响的群论推导。

papers.title: Flower-like WO3-modified Vulcan carbon GDEs for photoelectro-Fenton process: Efficient ciprofloxacin degradation and mechanistic insights
papers.abstract: Electrochemical H2O2 synthesis was investigated using a 3 percent WO3 C gas diffusion electrode GDE. The catalyst outperformed bare Vulcan carbon, generating H2O2 concentrations of 423, 586, and 916 mg L at 50, 75, and 100 mA cm2, respectively, maintaining around 70 percent current efficiency. This performance and lower energy consumption are attributed to the WO3 carbon synergistic effect. In electro Fenton EF applications, the WO3 C GDE achieved rapid initial ciprofloxacin CIP degradation of around 70 percent in 30 min, though limited later by slow Fe2 regeneration. Incorporating UV light photoelectro Fenton overcame this constraint, yielding complete CIP removal within 90 min, while a boron doped diamond BDD anode enhanced total organic carbon TOC mineralization to 66 percent. The proposed degradation mechanism proceeds via hydroxyl radical attack on the piperazine ring with or without defluorination and quinolone ring oxidation, with theoretical analysis confirming reduced environmental toxicity of the transformation products. Overall, WO3 C GDEs represent a highly efficient strategy for H2O2 generation and wastewater remediation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验制备（WO₃/C气体扩散电极）、性能测试（H₂O₂浓度、电流效率、降解实验）和表征结果。；研究对象：WO₃修饰的Vulcan碳气体扩散电极（WO₃/C GDE），用于光电芬顿（photoelectro-Fenton）过程降解环丙沙星（ciprofloxacin）废水。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: WO₃/C GDE在电化学合成H₂O₂中性能优于纯碳电极，在光电芬顿条件下90分钟内实现环丙沙星完全降解，总有机碳矿化率达66%，且降解产物环境毒性降低。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：WO₃/C GDE在电化学合成H₂O₂中性能优于纯碳电极，在光电芬顿条件下90分钟内实现环丙沙星完全降解，总有机碳矿化率达66%，且降解产物环境毒性降低。；创新点：利用WO₃与碳的协同效应提升H₂O₂生成效率，并通过引入紫外光克服电芬顿过程中Fe²⁺再生缓慢的瓶颈，实现环丙沙星快速完全降解及高矿化率。
papers.method_zh: 电化学H₂O₂合成实验（不同电流密度下浓度与电流效率测试）、电芬顿（EF）降解实验、紫外光辅助光电芬顿（PEF）降解实验、硼掺杂金刚石（BDD）阳极对比实验、理论分析（降解路径与毒性评估）。

papers.title: Hybrid Hamiltonian-diagrammatic quantum impurity solver
papers.abstract: Quantum impurity models, which describe the coupling between interacting orbitals and a non-interacting bath, play a central role in the physics of strongly correlated electron systems. Solving a quantum impurity model in general requires the use of non-perturbative numerical methods. Hamiltonian-based approaches, which rely on an explicit bath discretization, are typically limited to a small number of bath sites or small entanglement, and diagrammatic methods suffer from sign problems, slow convergence, or diagram truncation approximations. Here we show that these two classes of methods can be combined: augmenting diagrammatic methods with a small auxiliary bath can reduce the residual problem to a regime where low-order perturbation theory is highly accurate and rapidly converging. In a simple benchmark, the precision of the hybrid approach surpasses bold-line calculations by several orders of magnitude; for a strongly interacting two-orbital model with a severe sign problem, convergence is achieved at three orders of magnitude lower computational cost than competing methods; and convergence to the unknown exact result is rapidly accelerated in a difficult realistic problem. Our results establish a practical route to high-precision quantum impurity solutions in correlated quantum systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：hybrid Hamiltonian-diagrammatic quantum impurity solver（混合哈密顿量-图解量子杂质求解器）、non-perturbative numerical methods（非微扰数值方法）、diagrammatic methods（图解方法）。；研究对象：量子杂质模型（quantum impurity models），即描述相互作用轨道与非相互作用库耦合的模型，用于强关联电子系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将哈密顿量方法（基于显式浴离散化）与图解方法（如微扰展开）相结合，通过引入一个小型辅助浴，可将剩余问题简化到低阶微扰论高度精确且快速收敛的区域，从而大幅提升计算精度和效率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将哈密顿量方法（基于显式浴离散化）与图解方法（如微扰展开）相结合，通过引入一个小型辅助浴，可将剩余问题简化到低阶微扰论高度精确且快速收敛的区域，从而大幅提升计算精度和效率。；创新点：首次展示了哈密顿量方法与图解方法这两类传统上独立的量子杂质求解方法可以互补结合，通过辅助浴将问题映射到低阶微扰论高度有效的区域，从而在精度（超越bold-line计算数个数量级）、计算成本（在严重符号问题下降低三个数量级）和收敛速度（对困难实际问题快速收敛到未知精确结果）上均取得显著优势。
papers.method_zh: 提出一种混合哈密顿量-图解量子杂质求解器（hybrid Hamiltonian-diagrammatic quantum impurity solver）。该方法将哈密顿量方法中的小型辅助浴与图解方法（如bold-line计算）结合，利用辅助浴降低图解方法所需的微扰阶数，实现快速收敛。

papers.title: How to grow a straight filament
papers.abstract: How can a growing biological filament remain straight despite stochastic fluctuations in growth? Motivated by filamentary structures that develop reproducibly across biological systems, we study the stability of a noisy, growing elastic filament regulated by feedback. We formulate a minimal model in which growth responds to the filament's strain, curvature, and orientation through local or nonlocal spatiotemporal feedback laws. Linear stability analysis identifies the conditions under which these feedback mechanisms stabilize a straight configuration. In the presence of noise, we show that purely local feedback requires orientation sensing to suppress long-wavelength instabilities, whereas nonlocal feedback allows stabilization through proprioceptive (curvature) sensing alone. Coupling to an elastic substrate further suppresses large-scale fluctuations. Our results establish minimal control strategies that ensure robust straight growth and suggest experimental signatures for identifying the feedback mechanisms underlying morphogenesis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：formulate a minimal model（构建最小模型）、linear stability analysis（线性稳定性分析）。；研究对象：受生物系统启发的、在随机波动中生长的弹性细丝（filament）的直线生长稳定性问题。具体关注生长过程中由反馈机制调控的噪声与形变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文发现，要确保一根有噪声的弹性细丝保持直线生长，需要特定的反馈控制策略：纯局域反馈必须依赖方向感知来抑制长波不稳定性，而非局域反馈仅凭本体感知（曲率感知）即可实现稳定；将细丝耦合到弹性基底上能进一步抑制大尺度涨落。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文发现，要确保一根有噪声的弹性细丝保持直线生长，需要特定的反馈控制策略：纯局域反馈必须依赖方向感知来抑制长波不稳定性，而非局域反馈仅凭本体感知（曲率感知）即可实现稳定；将细丝耦合到弹性基底上能进一步抑制大尺度涨落。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体差异，但核心创新在于系统性地识别并对比了局域与非局域反馈机制在抑制生长噪声、确保直线生长中的不同作用，并提出了区分这些反馈机制的实验特征。
papers.method_zh: 构建了一个最小理论模型，其中细丝的生长响应于其应变、曲率和方向，通过局域或非局域的时空反馈律实现调控。采用线性稳定性分析方法，识别了不同反馈机制下直线构型保持稳定的条件，并分析了噪声的影响。

papers.title: Approaching the Limit of Intrinsic Crystalline Thermal Insulation
papers.abstract: Crystalline materials with ultralow thermal conductivity ($κ$) are potential thermal barrier coatings or thermoelectrics, yet the discovery of ultralow-$κ$ materials remains inefficient due to the limitations of trial-and-error approaches. Herein, we propose a state-of-the-art high-throughput workflow that integrates universal machine learning interatomic potentials with high-fidelity phonon transport theories to accelerate the exploration of thermal insulators. Applying this approach, we identify dozens of crystalline materials with intrinsic room-temperature $κ$ values below 0.2 $\rm W m^{-1} K^{-1}$. Among them, we report and experimentally validate CsTlI$_4$, a record-breaking material with an ultralow $κ$ of 0.14 $\rm W m^{-1} K^{-1}$ at 300 K. Structural and bond analyses reveal that a hierarchical bonding framework, consisting of multi-coordinated Cs-I and antibonding Tl-I interactions, leads to weak chemical bonding and a soft lattice. These features reduce phonon group velocities, enhance phonon scattering, and induce strong vibrational mismatch between sublattices, collectively suppressing both particle-like phonon propagation and wave-like tunneling. Beyond this specific system, we establish physically interpretable descriptors based on interatomic force constants that correlate strongly with ultralow $κ$ and capture the role of bonding hierarchy and coordination environments in governing thermal transport. This work demonstrates a robust data-driven strategy for accelerating the discovery of thermal insulators and provides microscopic insight into how hierarchical bonding and strong anharmonicity cooperate to impede heat-carrying vibrations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算+实验）。关键词：high-throughput workflow、machine learning interatomic potentials、phonon transport theories、experimentally validate。；研究对象：超低热导率晶体材料，特别是CsTlI₄，以及具有本征室温热导率低于0.2 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹的数十种晶体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现并实验验证了CsTlI₄在300 K下具有0.14 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹的创纪录超低热导率，并揭示了层级键合框架（多配位Cs-I和反键Tl-I相互作用）导致弱化学键和软晶格，从而抑制热传导的微观机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现并实验验证了CsTlI₄在300 K下具有0.14 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹的创纪录超低热导率，并揭示了层级键合框架（多配位Cs-I和反键Tl-I相互作用）导致弱化学键和软晶格，从而抑制热传导的微观机制。；创新点：提出了一个数据驱动的、结合机器学习势与声子输运理论的高通量筛选策略，显著加速了超低热导率晶体的发现，并建立了与超低热导率强相关的基于原子间力常数的物理描述符。
papers.method_zh: 高通量计算工作流（整合通用机器学习原子间势能与高保真声子输运理论）、实验合成与热导率测量、结构及键合分析、基于原子间力常数的物理可解释描述符建立。

papers.title: Interplay between photon condensation and electron-electron interactions in molecular systems
papers.abstract: We investigate a minimal molecular model consisting of square planar plaquettes hosting multiple electrons, whose dynamics is governed by a tight-binding Hamiltonian supplemented by on-site Hubbard repulsion. By coupling this system to a spatially nonuniform cavity mode, we analyze the emergence of a magnetostatic instability, namely photon condensation, originating from the paramagnetic Van Vleck mechanism. The global behavior of the system is analyzed for different electronic filling factors, and we find that, except for the special cases of half-filling and single electron, where the transition, if it occurs, is necessarily a second order phase transition, the global system may also undergo a first order transition because of the action of the electron-electron interaction. The polaritonic excitation energies are analyzed, providing clear spectroscopic signatures of the magnetostatic instability and of its order.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate、minimal molecular model、tight-binding Hamiltonian、analyze。；研究对象：分子系统中光子凝聚（磁静态不稳定性）与电子-电子相互作用的竞争关系。具体体系为包含多个电子的方形平面晶格（square planar plaquettes），其动力学由紧束缚模型加局域Hubbard排斥项描述，并与空间非均匀腔模耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 除半填充和单电子填充的特殊情况外（此时若发生相变必为二级相变），由于电子-电子相互作用，系统可能经历一级相变。通过分析极化激元激发能谱，可提供磁静态不稳定性及其相变级数的清晰光谱特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：除半填充和单电子填充的特殊情况外（此时若发生相变必为二级相变），由于电子-电子相互作用，系统可能经历一级相变。通过分析极化激元激发能谱，可提供磁静态不稳定性及其相变级数的清晰光谱特征。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用最小分子模型：紧束缚哈密顿量 + 局域Hubbard排斥项，耦合空间非均匀腔模。基于顺磁Van Vleck机制分析光子凝聚（磁静态不稳定性）的出现，并针对不同电子填充因子分析系统全局行为，同时计算极化激元激发能。

papers.title: In-situ total scattering investigation of crystalline ordering in amorphous ion-beam sputtered thin films for interferometric gravitational wave detectors
papers.abstract: Amorphous tantala is an important optical material used in a number of high-precision optical applications, including gravitational wave interferometry. In this paper, we study in-situ the structural changes that occur in amorphous ion-beam sputtered coatings during an annealing treatment by means of a synchrotron radiation scattering experiment. The scattering signal is measured as a function of time on a large range of the Q-space. X-Ray diffraction and Rietveld analysis are used to study crystallization during the annealing treatment, whereas pair distribution function analysis allows to inspect the structural changes occurring during the amorphous to crystalline transition. Our findings indicate that several structural rearrangements occur in parallel, namely a first quick establishment of a backbone structure in the cationic substructure appearing on a rather extended range (up to 100 Angstrom), followed by a progressive rearrangement of the oxygen atoms environment which gradually increases the crystallinity of the structure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：synchrotron radiation scattering experiment（同步辐射散射实验）、X-Ray diffraction（X射线衍射）、Rietveld analysis（Rietveld分析）、pair distribution function analysis（对分布函数分析）。；研究对象：非晶态氧化钽（amorphous tantala）薄膜，具体为离子束溅射沉积的非晶涂层，用于干涉引力波探测器等精密光学应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 退火过程中，非晶态氧化钽薄膜的结构变化是分步进行的：首先在阳离子亚结构中快速建立长达100埃的骨架结构，随后氧原子环境逐步重排，逐渐提高结构的结晶度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：退火过程中，非晶态氧化钽薄膜的结构变化是分步进行的：首先在阳离子亚结构中快速建立长达100埃的骨架结构，随后氧原子环境逐步重排，逐渐提高结构的结晶度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 原位同步辐射散射实验（in-situ synchrotron radiation scattering），在退火过程中实时测量大范围Q空间的散射信号；采用X射线衍射结合Rietveld分析研究结晶过程；利用对分布函数（PDF）分析考察非晶到晶体转变过程中的结构变化。

papers.title: On pseudogap phase as precursor to a superconducting dome in high-Tc cuprates: Non-analytic T* as a function of doping
papers.abstract: We generalize the condition under which a quantum material exhibiting a pseudogap phase is a precursor to a superconducting (SC) dome. The result reveals the non-analytic T* as a function of doping. A well-known example is the high-Tc cuprates. Essentially, the SC dome is generated under two conditions: (1) that the pseudogap T* is a decreasing function of doping, due to the decrease in size of extended pairing of doped holes with doping, and most importantly, (2) that the rate of configurational-ordering parameter is an increasing function of doping as a result of the decrease in extended length of the disordered pairs. These two conditions are provided by the new entanglement and confinement pairing mechanism of high-Tc cuprates. This is a theory that has recently been discussed in the literature by Buot et al. It hinges on a novel strong entanglement and confinement hole pairing (ECHP) mechanism that unravels the microscopic features of the entire phase diagram of both electron and hole-doped high-Tc cuprates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“generalize the condition”“new entanglement and confinement pairing mechanism”“theory”。；研究对象：高温铜氧化物超导体（high-Tc cuprates）中的赝能隙相（pseudogap phase）及其与超导穹顶（superconducting dome）的关系，具体关注赝能隙温度T*随掺杂（doping）的非解析行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 赝能隙相作为超导穹顶的前驱体，其T*随掺杂的变化是非解析的；超导穹顶的产生需满足两个条件：T*随掺杂递减，以及构型有序参数速率随掺杂递增。这两个条件由纠缠与束缚空穴配对（ECHP）机制提供。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：赝能隙相作为超导穹顶的前驱体，其T*随掺杂的变化是非解析的；超导穹顶的产生需满足两个条件：T*随掺杂递减，以及构型有序参数速率随掺杂递增。这两个条件由纠缠与束缚空穴配对（ECHP）机制提供。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与机制分析，基于Buot等人近期提出的强纠缠与束缚空穴配对（ECHP）机制，该机制通过扩展配对与无序对长度随掺杂的变化来刻画相图。

papers.title: Extensible links in a broad class of single polymer chain models
papers.abstract: The physics of polymer chains is often probed using molecular stretching experiments and various idealized single-chain models. The majority of these models consist of a discrete sequence of links, which may be treated as rigid or extensible. Although such models are well established and many specific extensible variants have been proposed, no generally applicable theory has been presented. Moreover, most existing treatments are heuristic rather than systematically and rigorously derived. This critical gap is closed here through the development of a generally applicable asymptotic theory for including link extensibility in a broad class of discrete models for single-chain thermodynamics. The theory is verified analytically using the freely jointed chain and validated numerically using the freely rotating chain. The resulting approximation is first-order accurate in inverse link stiffness, with quadratically decreasing error, and recovers extensible behavior across all link stiffnesses from a single rigid-link reference calculation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“发展了一种普遍适用的渐近理论”“理论推导”“解析验证”和“数值验证”。；研究对象：单链高分子模型的链节可扩展性（link extensibility），具体针对一类广泛的离散单链热力学模型，如自由连接链（freely jointed chain）和自由旋转链（freely rotating chain）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种普遍适用的渐近理论，能够将链节可扩展性纳入广泛的离散单链高分子模型中，该近似在逆链节刚度上具有一阶精度，误差呈二次方递减，且仅需一次刚性链节参考计算即可恢复所有链节刚度下的可扩展行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种普遍适用的渐近理论，能够将链节可扩展性纳入广泛的离散单链高分子模型中，该近似在逆链节刚度上具有一阶精度，误差呈二次方递减，且仅需一次刚性链节参考计算即可恢复所有链节刚度下的可扩展行为。；创新点：首次为离散单链高分子模型中的链节可扩展性提供了系统、严格推导的普遍适用理论，填补了此前缺乏一般性理论且多数处理为启发式方法的空白。
papers.method_zh: 采用渐近分析（asymptotic theory）进行理论推导，并通过自由连接链的解析验证和自由旋转链的数值验证来确认理论的正确性。

papers.title: Synthetic pre-training of graph-network models for predicting solid-state NMR parameters
papers.abstract: Nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) is a powerful probe of atomic structure, but accurate quantum-mechanical predictions of tensorial NMR parameters are computationally demanding. This creates a bottleneck both for direct quantum-mechanical studies and for collecting high-quality training data for machine-learning (ML) models. Here, we introduce a synthetic pre-training and fine-tuning protocol for graph-based ML models of solid-state NMR parameters. We first pre-train models on synthetic tensorial data, as obtained using an existing ML model, and subsequently fine-tune those models on new ground-truth data. We observe a pronounced improvement in data efficiency when pre-training and fine-tuning span the same compositional and configurational space, and we carry out initial experiments regarding chemical transferability. Our work outlines a route toward future data-efficient training workflows for tensorial ML models for solid-state NMR, combining inexpensive synthetic supervision with targeted first-principles refinement.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：machine-learning models, synthetic pre-training, first-principles refinement）；研究对象：固态核磁共振（NMR）参数（张量性质）的预测，具体涉及基于图网络的机器学习模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过合成预训练（synthetic pre-training）与微调（fine-tuning）协议，可显著提升图网络模型在固态NMR参数预测中的数据效率；当预训练与微调覆盖相同的组成和构型空间时，数据效率提升尤为明显。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过合成预训练（synthetic pre-training）与微调（fine-tuning）协议，可显著提升图网络模型在固态NMR参数预测中的数据效率；当预训练与微调覆盖相同的组成和构型空间时，数据效率提升尤为明显。；创新点：提出了一种结合低成本合成监督数据与针对性第一性原理精修的数据高效训练流程，用于固态NMR张量机器学习模型，并初步探索了化学迁移性（chemical transferability）。
papers.method_zh: 采用合成预训练与微调协议：先利用现有机器学习模型生成的合成张量数据对图网络模型进行预训练，再使用新的真实（ground-truth）数据对模型进行微调。

papers.title: Influence of CeO$_2$MnO$_x$ heterostructure on Hydrogen Peroxide Electrogeneration on Carbon-Based Catalysts
papers.abstract: The sustainable electrogeneration of hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) via the two-electron oxygen reduction reaction (2e$^-$ ORR) represents a promising alternative to conventional production methods. In this study, CeO2 and CeO2MnOx nanoparticles were synthesized and supported on Vulcan XC-72 carbon at varying loadings (1, 3, and 5%), aiming to assess the lowest metal loading and high H2O2 electrosynthesis. Physicochemical characterizations confirmed the successful formation of CeO2 nanowires and the effectiveness of the MnOx surface modification. XRD, TEM, XPS, EPR, and contact angle analyses revealed that CeO2 loading increased surface hydrophilicity through the presence of oxygenated functional groups, thereby favoring electrochemical activity. On the other hand, all CeO2MnOx loadings were statistically equivalent to Vulcan XC-72 in terms of contact angle. Electrochemical evaluations using a rotating ring-disk electrode (RRDE) demonstrated enhanced ORR activity and high H2O2 selectivity for the 1% CeO2MnOx/C and 3% CeO2/C catalysts, achieving up to 90% selectivity and elevated ring currents. The results suggest that low metal loading and surface modification via MnOx improve the balance between active site exposure, oxygen adsorption, and intermediate stabilization, thus favoring the selective 2e$^-$ pathway. These findings support the development of cost-effective, non-noble-metal catalysts for green H2O2 production via electrosynthesis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了纳米颗粒合成、物理化学表征（XRD、TEM、XPS、EPR、接触角分析）以及电化学测试（旋转环盘电极RRDE）等实验手段。；研究对象：CeO₂/C 和 CeO₂MnOₓ/C 复合催化剂，具体为负载在 Vulcan XC-72 碳上的 CeO₂ 纳米线及 MnOₓ 表面修饰的异质结构，用于电化学生产过氧化氢（H₂O₂）的两电子氧还原反应（2e⁻ ORR）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 低金属负载量（1% CeO₂MnOₓ/C 和 3% CeO₂/C）的催化剂可实现高达90%的H₂O₂选择性，表明通过低负载量和MnOₓ表面修饰可优化活性位点暴露、氧吸附与中间体稳定化之间的平衡，从而促进选择性2e⁻ ORR路径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：低金属负载量（1% CeO₂MnOₓ/C 和 3% CeO₂/C）的催化剂可实现高达90%的H₂O₂选择性，表明通过低负载量和MnOₓ表面修饰可优化活性位点暴露、氧吸附与中间体稳定化之间的平衡，从而促进选择性2e⁻ ORR路径。；创新点：系统研究了极低金属负载量（1%和3%）下CeO₂及MnOₓ修饰对碳基催化剂表面亲水性、电化学活性及H₂O₂选择性的影响，揭示了低负载量下活性位点暴露与中间体稳定化的协同优化机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用纳米颗粒合成（CeO₂ 和 CeO₂MnOₓ 纳米颗粒负载于 Vulcan XC-72 碳上）、物理化学表征（XRD、TEM、XPS、EPR、接触角分析）以及电化学评估（旋转环盘电极RRDE）来测试ORR活性和H₂O₂选择性。

papers.title: Direction-Dependent Quantum Transport Properties of MoS$_2$ Integrated into Biphenylene Configuration
papers.abstract: Motivated by the experimental realization of the two-dimensional (2D) carbon biphenylene network (BPN), the theoretical extension of the BPN topology to various groups of elements was successfully implemented. In this work, we conducted first principles and quantum transport calculations to reveal the electronic, thermal, thermoelectric performance and current-voltage (\textit{I-V}) behavior of the pristine MoS$_2$-BPN by using density functional theory (DFT) combined with Non-Equilibrium Green's Function (NEGF) formalism. At room temperature, the phonon thermal conductance is remarkably low along both the armchair and zigzag orientations, with values of 0.28 nW/K and 0.23 nW/K, respectively. The directional dependence of the electronic and thermal transport properties is clearly reflected in the thermoelectric figure of merit ($zT$) values, which reach first peaks at 0.27 and 0.19 along the armchair and zigzag directions, respectively. The current-voltage ($I-V$) characteristics demonstrate an exceptionally strong transport anisotropy, characterized by a substantial current ratio of $I_{\text{armchair}}/I_{\text{zigzag}} \approx 7 \times 10^4$. Furthermore, while the current along the armchair direction increases steadily with the applied bias, transport along the zigzag direction is characterized by a pronounced intrinsic negative differential conductance (NDC). This contrast highlights fundamentally distinct charge transport mechanisms along the two orthogonal axes. Consequently, different directions of this BPN phase of MoS$_2$ can be tailored for distinct nanoelectronic applications, where the armchair and zigzag axes serve as a reliable current switch and an active NDC device, respectively.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“first principles and quantum transport calculations”、“density functional theory (DFT)”、“Non-Equilibrium Green's Function (NEGF) formalism”。；研究对象：将MoS₂集成到联苯网络（Biphenylene Network, BPN）构型中的二维材料体系，具体研究其电子、热、热电输运性质以及电流-电压特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: MoS₂-BPN沿扶手椅和锯齿方向表现出极强的输运各向异性：扶手椅方向电流与锯齿方向电流比值高达约7×10⁴，且锯齿方向呈现显著的本征负微分电导（NDC）效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：MoS₂-BPN沿扶手椅和锯齿方向表现出极强的输运各向异性：扶手椅方向电流与锯齿方向电流比值高达约7×10⁴，且锯齿方向呈现显著的本征负微分电导（NDC）效应。；创新点：将BPN拓扑结构拓展至MoS₂体系，并系统揭示了该材料在正交方向上的截然不同的电荷输运机制（电流开关 vs. NDC器件），为定向设计纳米电子器件提供了依据。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理（密度泛函理论，DFT）结合非平衡格林函数（NEGF）方法进行量子输运计算。

papers.title: Optical fingerprints across the strain-driven semi-Dirac transition in Kekulé-O graphene
papers.abstract: We show that the strain-driven semi-Dirac transition in Kekulé-O graphene gives rise to a sequence of anisotropic optical fingerprints associated with band structure reconstruction. Across the transition, optical spectral weight is continuously redistributed among the dominant interband transitions, leading to a pronounced enhancement of the optical anisotropy. Combining numerical four-band calculations with analytical low-energy results, we identify three low-energy fingerprints that emerge with increasing strain: gapped absorption peaks, semi-Dirac critical scaling, and a pronounced van Hove optical resonance. At the semi-Dirac critical point, where the Kekulé gap closes at the $Γ$ point, the low-energy optical conductivity is characterized by $σ_{xx}(Ω)\proptoΩ^{1/2}$ and $σ_{yy}(Ω)\proptoΩ^{-1/2}$. Beyond the transition, the semi-Dirac point splits into two anisotropic Dirac cones, accompanied by the emergence of saddle points near the $Γ$ point. The resulting saddle-point excitations produce a pronounced van Hove optical resonance at energies well below those of graphene, while the split Dirac cones give rise to an anisotropic constant optical conductivity. We further show that the low-energy optical fingerprints can be traced to the continuous evolution of a dominant optical transition channel driven by strain-induced band reconstruction. Moreover, the fingerprints remain identifiable in the presence of moderate disorder broadening and finite-temperature effects, indicating their potential observability under experimentally realistic conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“combining numerical four-band calculations with analytical low-energy results”，即结合数值四带计算与解析低能结果，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：Kekulé-O 石墨烯中应变驱动的半狄拉克（semi-Dirac）相变及其光学指纹。具体体系为具有Kekulé-O有序的石墨烯，在应变作用下发生从能隙态到半狄拉克临界点再到各向异性狄拉克锥的转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在应变驱动的半狄拉克相变过程中，低能光学电导率呈现三种特征指纹：带隙吸收峰、半狄拉克临界标度（σ_xx ∝ Ω^{1/2}，σ_yy ∝ Ω^{-1/2}）以及显著的范霍夫光学共振。这些指纹在中等无序展宽和有限温度下仍可辨识，具有实验可观测性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在应变驱动的半狄拉克相变过程中，低能光学电导率呈现三种特征指纹：带隙吸收峰、半狄拉克临界标度（σ_xx ∝ Ω^{1/2}，σ_yy ∝ Ω^{-1/2}）以及显著的范霍夫光学共振。这些指纹在中等无序展宽和有限温度下仍可辨识，具有实验可观测性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体差异，但核心新意在于系统揭示了Kekulé-O石墨烯中半狄拉克相变的全套光学指纹，包括临界标率行为和各向异性范霍夫共振，并论证了其在实验条件下的可观测性。
papers.method_zh: 数值四带计算（numerical four-band calculations）结合解析低能模型（analytical low-energy results）。通过计算光学电导率随频率和应变的变化，分析能带重构对光学谱权重分布的影响。

papers.title: Ab initio study of magnetism in pristine and defective MnBi2Te4
papers.abstract: The magnetic material MnBi2Te4 (MBT) has garnered significant attention due to its unique combination of long-range antiferromagnetism and nontrivial topological electronic properties. However, experimental measurements report inconsistent magnetizations, which could be attributed to a variety of intrinsic defects. To date, a comprehensive investigation of defect-engineered MBT systems has not yet been established. Employing state-of-the-art $ab~initio$ techniques, this work systematically investigates the influence of various experimentally reported defects on the magnetic properties of bulk and monolayer MBT at different concentrations. Mn-vacancy and Mn-rich defects are found to enhance the ferromagnetism of bulk MBT. The investigation of Mn-rich and intermixing defects in the monolayer reveals that subtle structural and electronic modifications can alter the magnetic coupling. Projection onto a Heisenberg Hamiltonian demonstrates that defects modify exchange interactions, thereby giving rise to distinct magnetic ground states. This work sheds light on magnetic coupling mechanisms and provides guidelines for the experimental control of magnetism in MnBi2Te4.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“ab initio techniques”（第一性原理计算）、“projection onto a Heisenberg Hamiltonian”（投影到海森伯哈密顿量）。；研究对象：磁性材料MnBi₂Te₄（MBT）的本征及缺陷态磁性，具体包括体相和单层MBT中不同浓度缺陷（如Mn空位、Mn富集、混合缺陷）对磁性的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Mn空位和Mn富集缺陷会增强体相MBT的铁磁性；在单层MBT中，Mn富集和混合缺陷通过改变结构及电子结构来调控磁耦合，导致不同的磁性基态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Mn空位和Mn富集缺陷会增强体相MBT的铁磁性；在单层MBT中，Mn富集和混合缺陷通过改变结构及电子结构来调控磁耦合，导致不同的磁性基态。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理计算（ab initio techniques），并结合海森伯哈密顿量投影分析交换相互作用。

papers.title: Geometry still matters in quasi-one-dimensional single-file transport
papers.abstract: Single-file transport means no overtaking: particles move in a narrow channel while preserving their longitudinal order. This simple constraint has profound dynamical consequences, most notably tracer subdiffusion, and has made single-file transport a paradigmatic form of confined many-body motion, observed from molecular transport in zeolites to single-file diffusion of colloids in narrow channels. The standard view is that, once overtaking is suppressed, collective transport reduces to that of a strictly one-dimensional file. Here we show that this reduction fails in experimentally relevant finite-width channels: even when exchange is forbidden, the transverse equilibrium structure controls the transport laws and can qualitatively reshape them. Starting from the Brownian dynamics in the full confined geometry, we derive an exact large-scale one-dimensional fluctuating hydrodynamics for the longitudinal density, whose coefficients are fixed by the confined equilibrium equation of state. In the minimal hard-core setting, this yields a collective diffusivity that can become non-monotonic in density. This geometric anomaly propagates to exact large-scale predictions for integrated-current fluctuations, tracer displacement fluctuations and the associated density profiles. The effect is robust to the interaction potential, channel geometry, initial preparation and microscopic dynamics. Quasi-one-dimensional single-file transport therefore defines a distinct regime in which forbidding overtaking does not erase geometry from collective transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“derive an exact large-scale one-dimensional fluctuating hydrodynamics”（推导精确的大尺度一维涨落流体动力学），属于理论推导。；研究对象：准一维单列输运（quasi-one-dimensional single-file transport）现象，即粒子在窄通道中保持纵向顺序、禁止超车的受限多体运动。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在有限宽度的准一维通道中，即使禁止粒子交换（超车），横向平衡结构仍会通过状态方程决定并定性改变集体输运规律，导致集体扩散系数随密度非单调变化等几何异常，因此准一维单列输运不能简化为严格一维情况。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在有限宽度的准一维通道中，即使禁止粒子交换（超车），横向平衡结构仍会通过状态方程决定并定性改变集体输运规律，导致集体扩散系数随密度非单调变化等几何异常，因此准一维单列输运不能简化为严格一维情况。；创新点：推翻了“一旦禁止超车，集体输运就简化为严格一维”的标准观点，首次揭示有限宽度通道中横向平衡结构对输运定律的定性重塑作用，并建立了精确的理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 从完整受限几何中的布朗动力学出发，推导出纵向密度的精确大尺度一维涨落流体动力学方程，其系数由受限平衡状态方程确定。分析包括硬核势、不同相互作用势、通道几何、初始制备和微观动力学下的积分电流涨落、示踪粒子位移涨落及相关密度分布。

papers.title: Field-Induced Up-Up-Down State and Frustrated Magnetism in a Non-Kramers Triangular Antiferromagnet
papers.abstract: A previously unreported triangular lattice (TL) antiferromagnet, TmZnGaO4, was synthesized as single crystals, and its crystal structure, magnetic susceptibilities, and specific heat were reported. Its crystal structure is isomorphic to that of the transverse-field Ising antiferromagnet TmMgGaO4, with Tm3+ ions located in the TLs, separated by a nonmagnetic bilayer composed mainly of Ga3+ and Zn2+ ions. The magnetic susceptibilities indicate the dominating antiferromagnetic interactions. The magnetization curves (M-H) exhibit strong easy-c-axis anisotropy, with a clear one-third magnetic plateau emerging, consistent with a field-induced up-up-down spin configuration. Instead of forming a conventional long-range magnetic order, the system exhibits two broad anomalies at 0.11 K and 2.81 K in zero-field specific heat measurements, highlighting the persistence of strong spin fluctuations and the potential for exotic quantum spin states. The above results reveal its future interest in exploring exotic quantum spin states in TmZnGaO4.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到合成了单晶样品，并报告了晶体结构、磁化率、比热等实验测量结果。；研究对象：一种此前未被报道的三角晶格反铁磁体 TmZnGaO₄，其中 Tm³⁺ 离子位于三角晶格上，体系表现出强易c轴各向异性与阻挫磁性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 TmZnGaO₄ 中观测到磁场诱导的三分之一磁化平台，对应 up-up-down 自旋构型；零场比热测量显示两个宽峰（0.11 K 和 2.81 K），表明系统未形成传统长程磁有序，而是存在强自旋涨落，可能孕育新奇量子自旋态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 TmZnGaO₄ 中观测到磁场诱导的三分之一磁化平台，对应 up-up-down 自旋构型；零场比热测量显示两个宽峰（0.11 K 和 2.81 K），表明系统未形成传统长程磁有序，而是存在强自旋涨落，可能孕育新奇量子自旋态。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 单晶合成、晶体结构解析、磁化率测量、磁化曲线（M-H）测量、比热测量。

papers.title: Thermal Signatures of the Slater-Mott Crossover in the Hubbard Model: From Double Occupancy to Antiferromagnetic Correlation Length
papers.abstract: The interaction-driven crossover from a Slater insulator to a Mott insulator in the Néel-ordered ground state of the Hubbard model is a fundamental paradigm of strongly correlated electrons, yet its quantitative characterization has remained elusive. Here we establish a clear and experimentally accessible thermal criterion for this crossover via the sign change of the temperature derivative of double occupancy, $(\partial D/\partial T)_U$, near zero temperature. In the Slater regime, $(\partial D/\partial T)_U>0$ reflects the major role of charge fluctuations; in the Mott regime, the anomalous $(\partial D/\partial T)_U<0$, a manifestation of the Pomeranchuk effect, signals the dominance of low-energy spin superexchange physics. Using exact diagonalization and {\it numerically exact} quantum Monte Carlo simulations, we demonstrate that this criterion determines the crossover boundary at $U_{\rm cross}/t=4.0(2)$ for the half-filled two-dimensional Hubbard model. Furthermore, we obtain a consistent boundary independently from the maximum in the antiferromagnetic correlation length, which also arises from the superexchange physics. These two thermal signatures are theoretically unified through the local minimum of thermal entropy versus interaction $U$ at low temperatures. Our results offer a direct, measurable, and physically intuitive framework to identify the Slater-Mott crossover in optical lattice experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。依据：使用了 exact diagonalization（精确对角化）和 numerically exact quantum Monte Carlo simulations（数值精确量子蒙特卡洛模拟）进行计算，并提出了理论判据。；研究对象：Hubbard 模型中从 Slater 绝缘体到 Mott 绝缘体的交叉（Slater-Mott crossover）现象，具体针对半填充二维 Hubbard 模型，并关注其热力学特征（如双占据数、反铁磁关联长度）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了通过双占据数温度导数（∂D/∂T）_U 的符号变化来判定 Slater-Mott 交叉的热力学判据，并确定了半填充二维 Hubbard 模型中交叉边界为 U_cross/t = 4.0(2)。该边界与反铁磁关联长度最大值给出的边界一致，两者在理论上通过低温下热熵随相互作用 U 的局部极小值统一起来。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了通过双占据数温度导数（∂D/∂T）_U 的符号变化来判定 Slater-Mott 交叉的热力学判据，并确定了半填充二维 Hubbard 模型中交叉边界为 U_cross/t = 4.0(2)。该边界与反铁磁关联长度最大值给出的边界一致，两者在理论上通过低温下热熵随相互作用 U 的局部极小值统一起来。；创新点：提出了一个可直接测量、物理直观的热力学判据（基于双占据数温度导数的符号变化）来定量刻画 Slater-Mott 交叉，并将该判据与反铁磁关联长度的热学特征在熵的框架下统一起来，为光学晶格实验提供了可操作的识别方案。
papers.method_zh: 采用精确对角化（exact diagonalization）和数值精确量子蒙特卡洛模拟（numerically exact quantum Monte Carlo simulations）对半填充二维 Hubbard 模型进行计算分析。

papers.title: Local density of states distribution and multifractal eigenvectors of weighted random networks via the cavity approach
papers.abstract: We study the local density of states (LDoS) distribution of a general class of weighted Erdős-Rényi graphs. Using the cavity method, we obtain a good approximation to the full LDoS distribution and compact expressions for its power-law tails, which we show to have exponent $3$ in the extended phase. We deduce that the eigenvectors in the continuous part of the spectrum are extended but (weakly) multifractal, and we extract expressions for the associated fractal dimensions and the singularity spectrum. We also demonstrate that the inverse participation ratio in this multifractal phase exhibits an unusual logarithmic scaling with system size, which is neither fully-extended nor localised by the usual definitions. Finally, we verify that some symmetry properties (derived from the non-linear sigma model), which have been shown to hold for many systems exhibiting multifractality, also hold in our case, both for the LDoS distribution and the singularity spectrum.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：cavity method（空腔方法）、non-linear sigma model（非线性sigma模型）、理论推导。；研究对象：加权Erdős-Rényi随机图（一类加权随机网络）中的局域态密度（LDoS）分布及本征矢的多分形性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在扩展相中，局域态密度分布具有幂律尾巴（指数为3），对应的本征矢是扩展但弱多分形的；该多分形相中的逆参与率（IPR）随系统尺寸呈现对数标度行为，既非完全扩展也非局域化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在扩展相中，局域态密度分布具有幂律尾巴（指数为3），对应的本征矢是扩展但弱多分形的；该多分形相中的逆参与率（IPR）随系统尺寸呈现对数标度行为，既非完全扩展也非局域化。；创新点：首次通过空腔方法系统解析了加权随机图在连续谱中的LDoS分布及本征矢多分形性，并揭示了IPR的非标准对数标度行为。摘要未突出说明与具体物理系统（如安德森局域化模型）的对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用空腔方法（cavity method）近似计算完整的LDoS分布，并推导其幂律尾巴的紧凑表达式；同时利用非线性sigma模型推导的对称性进行验证。

papers.title: Degeneracy and trajectory control of spin eigenmodes excited by fs-optical pulses in a nearly compensated ferrimagnet
papers.abstract: We investigate optically excited spin dynamics in a uniaxial ferrimagnet near the magnetization compensation point under a magnetic field applied along the magnetic anisotropy axis. Experiment and numerical modeling reveal an unusual regime where the frequencies of two spin eigenmodes approach each other and become highly field sensitive. The modes, corresponding to opposite rotations of the Neel vector, simultaneously reverse their handedness at a critical field where their frequencies become degenerate. At this point, the two-frequency precessional dynamics collapses into a linear oscillations directed along the inverse-Faraday-effect excitation induced by a single pump pulse. We further show that a double-pulse excitation scheme enables control of the spin trajectory. These results uncover an unconventional dynamical regime in ferrimagnets and establish new opportunities for manipulating spin motion in magnonic systems and devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与数值建模结合）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Experiment and numerical modeling reveal...”。；研究对象：近补偿点的单轴亚铁磁体，在外加磁场沿磁各向异性轴方向时的自旋动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在临界磁场下，两个自旋本征模的频率趋于简并，并同时反转其手性，导致双频率进动动力学坍缩为沿单泵浦脉冲激发方向的线性振荡。双脉冲激发方案可实现对自旋轨迹的控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在临界磁场下，两个自旋本征模的频率趋于简并，并同时反转其手性，导致双频率进动动力学坍缩为沿单泵浦脉冲激发方向的线性振荡。双脉冲激发方案可实现对自旋轨迹的控制。；创新点：揭示了亚铁磁体中一种非常规动力学 regime，其中自旋本征模的简并、手性反转与线性振荡行为耦合，并展示了通过双脉冲方案操控自旋轨迹的新可能性。
papers.method_zh: 飞秒光学脉冲激发实验，结合数值建模（具体计算框架摘要未明确说明）。

papers.title: Thermodynamic Approach to Momentum Transport in Dense Fluids
papers.abstract: We present a new framework for extending Chapman-Enskog theory beyond the hard-sphere fluid model. Rather than relying on effective hard sphere diameters, the approach makes use of on an exchange function which can be related to the thermodynamic properties of the system. We show that two existing extensions, including modified Enskog theory (MET), fit into this new framework. Based on our approach, we propose an alternative to MET that takes into account the potential interaction energy associated with the inter-particle interactions in the fluid. The proposed expression is applied to predicting the shear viscosity of several different simulated fluid models across a wide set of densities $0.05 \leq ρ^* \leq 0.8$ and temperatures $1.5 \leq T^* \leq 4.0$ in Lennard-Jones units. The fluid models considered include both the Weeks-Chandler-Anderson (WCA) fluid and the Lennard-Jones (LJ) fluid. At low and intermediate density, here taken to be $ρ^* \leq 0.3$, we report mean relative prediction errors between $2\%$ and $4\%$ for both these. Across all densities considered, the largest mean relative errors reported are $4.4\%$ and $8.1\%$ for the WCA fluid and LJ fluid respectively. We also investigate other interaction models, including a diatomic molecular model, in order to better understand the limitations of our approach.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：new framework、extending Chapman-Enskog theory、thermodynamic approach）；研究对象：稠密流体中的动量输运（具体涉及硬球流体、Weeks-Chandler-Anderson (WCA) 流体、Lennard-Jones (LJ) 流体以及双原子分子流体模型的剪切粘度预测）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于交换函数（exchange function）的新理论框架，该函数可与体系热力学性质关联，从而将Chapman-Enskog理论推广至非硬球流体模型；基于该框架提出的替代修正Enskog理论（MET）的表达式，在低至中等密度下对WCA和LJ流体的剪切粘度预测误差仅为2%-4%，在所有考察密度下最大误差分别为4.4%（WCA）和8.1%（LJ）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于交换函数（exchange function）的新理论框架，该函数可与体系热力学性质关联，从而将Chapman-Enskog理论推广至非硬球流体模型；基于该框架提出的替代修正Enskog理论（MET）的表达式，在低至中等密度下对WCA和LJ流体的剪切粘度预测误差仅为2%-4%，在所有考察密度下最大误差分别为4.4%（WCA）和8.1%（LJ）。；创新点：提出了一种不依赖有效硬球直径、而是通过交换函数与热力学性质直接关联的新理论框架，并基于该框架给出了一个考虑粒子间势能相互作用的MET替代方案。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：利用交换函数替代传统有效硬球直径，将Chapman-Enskog理论扩展至稠密流体；数值验证：将所提表达式应用于模拟流体模型（WCA、LJ及双原子分子模型）的剪切粘度预测，并与模拟数据对比误差。

papers.title: Magnetism and Topology from Circularly Polarized Phonon Floquet Engineering
papers.abstract: We theoretically show that circularly polarized phonons induce electronic magnetization and drive a topological phase transition via phonon Floquet engineering. Considering the electronic states modulated by circularly polarized phonons on a honeycomb lattice, we show that such lattice dynamics generates an effective next-nearest-neighbor electron hopping, leading to a Haldane-type mass term. Circularly polarized phonon breaks time-reversal symmetry (TRS) and opens a gap at valley points, undergoing phase transition from a trivial insulator to a Chern insulator. Moreover, the orbital and spin magnetizations emerge due to the breaking of TRS. Our results show that circularly polarized phonons serve as an effective magnetic field to engineer magnetism and topology, offering new opportunities for phonon Floquet approaches.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“theoretically show”、“Floquet engineering”、“effective next-nearest-neighbor electron hopping”、“Haldane-type mass term”。；研究对象：受圆偏振声子调制的蜂窝晶格（honeycomb lattice）电子系统，具体研究声子Floquet工程诱导的磁性（轨道磁化与自旋磁化）和拓扑相变（从平庸绝缘体到陈绝缘体）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 圆偏振声子通过打破时间反演对称性，在蜂窝晶格中产生等效的次近邻电子跳跃，从而引入Haldane型质量项，在谷点打开能隙并驱动从平庸绝缘体到陈绝缘体的拓扑相变，同时诱导出轨道磁化和自旋磁化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：圆偏振声子通过打破时间反演对称性，在蜂窝晶格中产生等效的次近邻电子跳跃，从而引入Haldane型质量项，在谷点打开能隙并驱动从平庸绝缘体到陈绝缘体的拓扑相变，同时诱导出轨道磁化和自旋磁化。；创新点：首次提出圆偏振声子本身可作为等效磁场，通过Floquet工程同时实现磁性和拓扑的调控，为声子Floquet方法提供了新的物理机制和应用方向。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于Floquet工程框架，考虑圆偏振声子对蜂窝晶格电子态的调制，推导出有效哈密顿量中的次近邻跳跃项，并分析其导致的Haldane质量项、能隙打开、拓扑相变以及磁化强度。

papers.title: Efficient analytic continuation approach to Bethe-Salpeter excitation spectra in selected energy windows
papers.abstract: We explore the merits of building the Bethe-Salpeter absorption spectrum in a specific energy range using analytic continuation techniques. Specifically, we calculate iteratively a few $\bar{\bar α}(z_k)$ polarizability tensors for a coarse set of $(z_k)$ frequencies in the complex-plane. These data allow constructing a continued-fraction representation for $\bar{\barα}(z)$ that is used to calculate the absorption spectrum close to the real energy axis in the desired energy range. The number and location of these sampling complex frequencies are discussed. The importance of building a continued-fraction representation of the full polarizability tensor with matrix-valued coefficients is emphasized. We show how to extract the poles of the continued fraction as a tool for analyzing the resulting spectra. We study as examples the valence excitations of a paradigmatic dipeptide, the C$_{60}$ fullerene and its PCBM derivative, together with the description of the surface plasmon resonance of the Ag$_{20}$ silver cluster. Further, the high-energy C$_{60}$ X-ray absorption spectrum is explored.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“analytic continuation techniques”、“continued-fraction representation”、“polarizability tensors”，属于理论计算方法开发与应用。；研究对象：Bethe-Salpeter方程描述的激发态吸收光谱，具体体系包括：二肽分子（dipeptide）的价电子激发、C60富勒烯及其PCBM衍生物、Ag20银团簇的表面等离激元共振，以及C60的高能X射线吸收谱。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过解析延拓技术，仅需在复平面上计算少量粗网格频率点的极化率张量，即可构建连续分数表示，从而高效、准确地获得特定能量窗口内的Bethe-Salpeter吸收光谱。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过解析延拓技术，仅需在复平面上计算少量粗网格频率点的极化率张量，即可构建连续分数表示，从而高效、准确地获得特定能量窗口内的Bethe-Salpeter吸收光谱。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用解析延拓技术，在复平面上迭代计算少量采样频率点的极化率张量，构建具有矩阵值系数的连续分数表示，进而沿实能量轴计算目标能量范围内的吸收谱。同时提取连续分数的极点用于光谱分析。

papers.title: Continuous and discontinuous transitions in the Ising-Heisenberg model on the extended Lieb lattice in a magnetic field
papers.abstract: The spin-1/2 Ising-Heisenberg model on the extended Lieb lattice in a magnetic field is exactly mapped onto an effective spin-1/2 Ising model on the square lattice. The ground-state phase diagram comprises the quantum antiferromagnetic (QAF), quantum monomer-dimer (MD), classical ferrimagnetic (FRI), and classical ferromagnetic phase. The MD-FRI ground-state phase boundary extends to finite temperatures as a dome-shaped surface of discontinuous thermal transitions bounded by a line of Ising critical points. The QAF phase is enclosed by a surface of continuous thermal transitions evolving from the QAF-MD and QAF-FRI ground-state phase boundaries. Monte Carlo simulations fully confirm the existence and nature of both continuous and discontinuous thermal phase transitions obtained by exact and approximate analytical calculations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值计算）。判断依据：exactly mapped onto（精确映射）、ground-state phase diagram（基态相图）、Monte Carlo simulations（蒙特卡洛模拟）。；研究对象：扩展Lieb晶格上的自旋-1/2 Ising-Heisenberg模型在外磁场中的相变行为，包括量子反铁磁相（QAF）、量子单体-二聚体相（MD）、经典亚铁磁相（FRI）和经典铁磁相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型在磁场中展现出连续和间断两类热相变：MD-FRI基态相边界在有限温度下延伸为间断热相变的穹顶状曲面，其边界由Ising临界点线界定；QAF相则被连续热相变曲面所包围，该曲面从QAF-MD和QAF-FRI基态相边界演化而来。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型在磁场中展现出连续和间断两类热相变：MD-FRI基态相边界在有限温度下延伸为间断热相变的穹顶状曲面，其边界由Ising临界点线界定；QAF相则被连续热相变曲面所包围，该曲面从QAF-MD和QAF-FRI基态相边界演化而来。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过精确映射将原模型转化为正方晶格上的有效自旋-1/2 Ising模型；结合精确解析计算与近似解析计算，并辅以蒙特卡洛模拟验证。

papers.title: Fractional shot noise of an SU(N) Kondo system
papers.abstract: We consider transport through a multi-level interacting quantum dot (N-QD) in Kondo regime. Using the Kotliar-Ruckentein slave boson approach (SBMFA) for N-level Anderson model we define effectively noninteracting quasiparticles of the SU(N) Kondo system ($N=2,3,4,5,6$). Kondo resonance transmission coefficients determine linear noise describing quasiparticle partitioning. To discuss nonlinear conductance, susceptibilities and shot noise in the strong coupling regime, we apply Fermi liquid theory with parameters expressed by susceptibilities of pseudofermions determined within SBMFA. Nonlinear shot noise is dominated by two-quasiparticle scattering. However, we demonstrate that for occupation regions distant from the electron-hole symmetry point, the role of three-body correlations must be revealed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Kotliar-Ruckenstein slave boson approach (SBMFA)、Fermi liquid theory、理论模型分析。；研究对象：SU(N) Kondo 体系中的多能级相互作用量子点（N-QD）在强耦合区间的非线性散粒噪声（shot noise）行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非线性散粒噪声主要由两准粒子散射主导；但在远离电子-空穴对称点的占据数区域，必须考虑三体关联的贡献。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非线性散粒噪声主要由两准粒子散射主导；但在远离电子-空穴对称点的占据数区域，必须考虑三体关联的贡献。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用 Kotliar-Ruckenstein 奴隶玻色子平均场方法（SBMFA）处理 N 能级安德森模型，定义有效非相互作用准粒子；利用费米液体理论，以 SBMFA 确定的赝费米子磁化率参数化强耦合区间的非线性电导、磁化率和散粒噪声。

papers.title: Majorana fermions at self-generated interfaces
papers.abstract: The Kitaev model describing a one-dimensional topological superconducting chain is known to support two Majorana fermions localized at the systems endpoints when the parameters are tuned to the topological phase. In this work, we investigate the possibility that Majorana fermions may also emerge away from the physical boundaries of the chain. To this purpose, we generalize the Kitaev model by incorporating a local coupling between the electronic density and a classical elastic (lattice) field. This electron-lattice interaction can induce phase separation between superconducting regions characterized by distinct topological invariants, thereby generating internal interfaces that host Majorana bound states. Under these conditions, a dilute gas of Majorana fermions can be realized in the bulk of the system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate、generalize the Kitaev model、incorporating、induce phase separation。；研究对象：一维Kitaev拓扑超导链中，由电子-晶格耦合诱导的自生成界面所束缚的马约拉纳费米子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入电子密度与经典弹性（晶格）场的局域耦合，可在Kitaev链内部产生具有不同拓扑不变量的超导区域之间的界面，从而在系统体内部而非端点处束缚马约拉纳费米子，实现体相中的稀薄马约拉纳费米子气体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入电子密度与经典弹性（晶格）场的局域耦合，可在Kitaev链内部产生具有不同拓扑不变量的超导区域之间的界面，从而在系统体内部而非端点处束缚马约拉纳费米子，实现体相中的稀薄马约拉纳费米子气体。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 推广Kitaev模型，加入电子-晶格耦合项，通过分析该耦合导致的相分离现象，研究内部界面处马约拉纳束缚态的形成条件。

papers.title: Interplay between Aharonov-Bohm and Altshuler-Aronov-Spivak oscillations in phase-pure GaAs/InAs core/shell nanowires of different lengths
papers.abstract: In GaAs/InAs core/shell nanowires, comprising a tubular conducting shell, interference phenomena observed under an axial field and originating from closed-loop states encircling the insulating core, provide an ideal platform for superconducting quantum devices that utilize effects such as Aharonov--Bohm or Altshuler--Aronov--Spivak-type conductance oscillations. Both effects are different in nature with respect to phase rigidity because of interference of non-time-reversed or time-reversed paths, respectively. Since their occurrence is largely governed by averaging effects, which depend on sample dimensions and the transport regime, we present a systematic study of flux-periodic oscillations of phase-pure zinc-blende GaAs/InAs core/shell nanowires as a function of gate voltage for samples with different contact separation lengths. Our analysis shows that with increasing contact separation length, averaging effects result in gradual reduction of $h/e$-periodic Aharonov--Bohm-type oscillations, while the $h/2e$-periodic Altshuler--Aronov--Spivak oscillations and its $h/4e$-periodic higher harmonics are enhanced. The additional phase rigidity seen in the $h/3e$-periodic oscillations is attributed to phase rigidity propagating from the neighbouring lower harmonics. Our tight-binding transport simulations on nanowires of different lengths which contain only a few scattering centers confirm the experimental observations regarding the different harmonics and their phase rigidity. Together, our experimental and simulation findings indicate quasi-ballistic transport with persistent Aharonov--Bohm-, and phase-rigid Altshuler--Aronov--Spivak-type oscillations despite few scattering centers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。关键词：systematic study、tight-binding transport simulations、experimental observations。；研究对象：GaAs/InAs核/壳纳米线中的Aharonov-Bohm（AB）与Altshuler-Aronov-Spivak（AAS）型磁导振荡现象，特别是不同接触间距样品中两种振荡的竞争与相位刚性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着接触间距增大，平均效应导致h/e周期的AB型振荡逐渐减弱，而h/2e周期的AAS型振荡及其h/4e高次谐波增强；h/3e周期振荡的额外相位刚性来源于邻近低次谐波的相位刚性传播。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着接触间距增大，平均效应导致h/e周期的AB型振荡逐渐减弱，而h/2e周期的AAS型振荡及其h/4e高次谐波增强；h/3e周期振荡的额外相位刚性来源于邻近低次谐波的相位刚性传播。；创新点：系统揭示了在准弹道输运且仅含少量散射中心的核/壳纳米线中，AB与AAS振荡随样品长度变化的演化规律，并首次指出h/3e振荡的相位刚性源于低次谐波的传播效应。
papers.method_zh: 实验上：对相纯闪锌矿GaAs/InAs核/壳纳米线进行不同接触间距的栅压依赖磁导振荡测量。理论上：采用紧束缚输运模拟，在仅含少量散射中心的纳米线中复现不同谐波及其相位刚性行为。

papers.title: NANOG assembles into self-limiting aging micelles that drive a sol-gel transition and modulate DNA dynamics
papers.abstract: Proteins and nucleic acids form non-Newtonian liquids with complex rheological properties that contribute to their function in vivo. Here we investigate the rheology of the transcription factor NANOG, a key protein to maintain embryonic stem cell pluripotency. We find that at high concentrations, NANOG forms macroscopic aging gels that are dependent on its intrinsically disordered domain. By combining molecular dynamics simulations, mass photometry and Cryo-EM, we also discover that -- in contrast with unbounded condensates formed by other intrinsically disordered proteins -- NANOG forms self-limiting micelles with exposed DNA-binding domains. We show that these micelles can stabilize DNA entanglements and in turn modulate DNA dynamics. Based on our findings, we conjecture that NANOG may contribute to regulate gene expression by creating local gel-like environments that restrict genome dynamics and that its aging may ingrain mechanical memory in gene regulatory networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“结合分子动力学模拟、质量光度法和冷冻电镜”，同时包含实验表征和计算模拟。；研究对象：转录因子NANOG蛋白及其形成的自限性胶束，以及由此引发的溶胶-凝胶转变和DNA动力学调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: NANOG在高浓度下通过其内在无序结构域形成宏观老化凝胶，并自组装成具有暴露DNA结合结构域的自限性胶束，这些胶束能稳定DNA缠结并调控DNA动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：NANOG在高浓度下通过其内在无序结构域形成宏观老化凝胶，并自组装成具有暴露DNA结合结构域的自限性胶束，这些胶束能稳定DNA缠结并调控DNA动力学。；创新点：发现NANOG形成的是自限性胶束而非其他无序蛋白常见的无界凝聚体，且这些胶束能通过稳定DNA缠结来调控DNA动力学，并提出了NANOG可能通过创造局部凝胶环境限制基因组动力学、其老化过程可能将机械记忆印入基因调控网络的猜想。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学模拟、质量光度法、冷冻电镜（Cryo-EM），以及流变学测量（用于表征非牛顿液体和凝胶行为）。

papers.title: Nonequilibrium Green Functions Simulations for Large Correlated Systems
papers.abstract: Correlated real-time dynamics in large, spatially inhomogeneous quantum systems remain difficult to access with nonequilibrium many-body methods. Two-time nonequilibrium Green functions (NEGF) retain dynamical correlations but their computational runtime grows cubically with the number of time steps $N_\mathrm{t}$. This scaling bottleneck could recently be overcome by introducing the G1--G2 scheme that is linear in $N_\mathrm{t}$, but requires propagation of a two-particle correlation function and may suffer from numerical instabilities. This has restricted simulations to small systems with $N_\mathrm{b} \sim 10^2$ basis states. Here we introduce a quantum-fluctuation formulation of nonequilibrium Green functions, denoted $δ$NEGF, that represents dynamical two-particle correlations through fluctuations of field-operator products, $δ\hat G$. This guarantees stable dynamics by preserving the positivity of the reduced density matrices, avoids the explicit storage of the two-particle Green function, and reduces the propagation to a finite ensemble of Hartree-Fock-like trajectories. Combined with a stochastic low-rank decomposition of the correlation functions, the method retains time-linear scaling while extending dynamical $GW$ and particle-particle and particle-hole $T$-matrix simulations to basis sizes of order $N_\mathrm{b}\sim 10^4$. We benchmark $δ$NEGF against exact and HF-GKBA results for lattice systems, finding stable correlated dynamics also at strong coupling. We further demonstrate large-scale simulations of diffusion in two-dimensional Hubbard lattices and ultrafast relaxation in graphene nanoribbon heterostructures with long-range Coulomb interactions. These results establish $δ$NEGF as a scalable route to dynamical self-energy simulations of large, spatially inhomogeneous correlated quantum systems beyond the reach of existing NEGF implementations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：Nonequilibrium Green Functions simulations, numerical simulations, benchmark。；研究对象：大尺度、空间非均匀的强关联量子系统。具体包括：二维Hubbard晶格模型中的扩散过程，以及具有长程库仑相互作用的石墨烯纳米带异质结中的超快弛豫现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 本文提出的δNEGF方法通过量子涨落表述，在保持时间线性标度的同时，成功将动力学GW和T矩阵模拟的基态规模从约10^2提升至约10^4，实现了对现有NEGF方法无法触及的大尺度关联量子系统的稳定模拟。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：本文提出的δNEGF方法通过量子涨落表述，在保持时间线性标度的同时，成功将动力学GW和T矩阵模拟的基态规模从约10^2提升至约10^4，实现了对现有NEGF方法无法触及的大尺度关联量子系统的稳定模拟。；创新点：1. 提出了δNEGF表述，通过保持约化密度矩阵的正定性，从根本上解决了此前G1-G2方案中存在的数值不稳定性问题。2. 将大尺度关联量子系统的非平衡动力学模拟能力从约10^2个基态扩展到约10^4个基态，显著提升了可模拟系统的规模。
papers.method_zh: 本文提出了一种名为δNEGF的非平衡格林函数量子涨落表述。该方法通过场算符乘积的涨落（δĜ）来表示动力学双粒子关联，避免了显式存储双粒子格林函数，并将传播简化为有限系综的Hartree-Fock-like轨迹。结合关联函数的随机低秩分解，该方法保持了时间线性标度。文中通过与精确解和HF-GKBA结果的对比来验证方法的准确性。

papers.title: Dynamical Partition Functions of Stochastic Dynamics via Variational Flows
papers.abstract: Nonequilibrium thermodynamics is governed by the dynamical partition function, and its computation in high-dimensional continuous-state dynamics is a longstanding challenge. The Feynman-Kac formalism provides a rigorous representation for generating functions of arbitrary path observables; however, practical evaluation beyond low dimensions or the weak-noise limit is hindered by the curse of dimensionality and the exponentially growing replica demands of trajectory-based methods. Here we develop a mesh-free neural variational framework that realizes the Feynman-Kac theorem with generative flow models, recasting tilted stochastic evolution as a time-dependent optimization problem. This approach enables the direct computation of both finite-time and asymptotic trajectory thermodynamics in a unified manner. The method applies to general observables, enabling the evaluation of work, entropy production, and current fluctuations. We demonstrate the accuracy and scalability of this method in various nonequilibrium systems including high-dimensional cases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：variational flows、Feynman-Kac formalism、neural variational framework、optimization problem。；研究对象：非平衡随机动力学中的热力学，具体为高维连续状态随机过程中动力学配分函数的计算。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于生成流模型的无网格神经变分框架，能够统一计算有限时间和渐近轨迹热力学，并适用于高维非平衡系统。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于生成流模型的无网格神经变分框架，能够统一计算有限时间和渐近轨迹热力学，并适用于高维非平衡系统。；创新点：将Feynman-Kac定理与生成流模型结合，克服了传统轨迹方法在高维系统中的维度灾难和指数增长的副本需求，实现了对任意路径可观测量（如功、熵产生、电流涨落）的直接计算。
papers.method_zh: 基于Feynman-Kac定理，利用生成流模型（generative flow models）将倾斜随机演化转化为时间依赖的优化问题，实现无网格的神经变分计算。

papers.title: Spontaneous translation of charged droplets during evaporation on dry surfaces
papers.abstract: Evaporating sessile droplets are usually treated as capillary objects, but droplets generated by routine handling can carry tens to hundreds of picocoulombs of electric charge. Here we combine Faraday-cup charge measurements with optical imaging to determine how such charge evolves as water droplets evaporate on dry polymer substrates. A zero-time protocol shows that a reproducible initial charge is preserved on poly(methylpentene) (PMP), whereas PDMS, SOCAL-coated surfaces, and polystyrene either exchange, dissipate, or inject charge on contact. On PMP, ensemble-resolved measurements reveal two regimes: the charge remains nearly constant during early evaporation and then decreases abruptly once the droplet reaches a small-volume state. This charge collapse coincides with spontaneous lateral translation rather than jetting or breakup. A Rayleigh-normalized analysis, including a spherical-cap stress correction and measured contact-angle retention scale, shows that motion occurs only after evaporation drives the droplet into a high electro-pinning state. High-speed imaging and kinematic analysis support a picture in which the subsequent motion is governed by repeated contact-line depinning and re-pinning: the total distance traveled is strongly affected by dry-surface pinning, whereas the peak translational velocity serves as a more robust indicator of the discharge strength. These results identify a dry-substrate mode of evaporation-driven electrostatic relaxation, distinct from Coulomb fission on lubricated surfaces, in which substrate electrostatic passivity enables charge retention, droplet geometry selects the instability onset, and whole-droplet translation provides the charge-release pathway.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“Faraday-cup charge measurements with optical imaging”、“high-speed imaging and kinematic analysis”等实验手段。；研究对象：带电液滴在干燥聚合物基底上蒸发时的自发平移现象。具体材料包括聚甲基戊烯（PMP）、聚二甲基硅氧烷（PDMS）、SOCAL涂层表面和聚苯乙烯。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在干燥聚合物基底（如PMP）上，蒸发液滴的电荷在早期几乎保持不变，当液滴体积减小到小体积状态后电荷突然下降，这一电荷崩塌伴随液滴的自发横向平移（而非喷射或破碎），且平移速度是放电强度的更稳健指标。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在干燥聚合物基底（如PMP）上，蒸发液滴的电荷在早期几乎保持不变，当液滴体积减小到小体积状态后电荷突然下降，这一电荷崩塌伴随液滴的自发横向平移（而非喷射或破碎），且平移速度是放电强度的更稳健指标。；创新点：识别出一种干燥基底上的蒸发驱动静电弛豫模式，与润滑表面上的库仑裂变不同：基底静电惰性使电荷得以保留，液滴几何形状决定不稳定性触发，而整个液滴的平移提供了电荷释放途径。
papers.method_zh: 法拉第杯电荷测量结合光学成像；零时间协议（zero-time protocol）确定初始电荷；高速成像与运动学分析；瑞利归一化分析（Rayleigh-normalized analysis），包括球冠应力修正和接触角保持标度。

papers.title: Spin polarisation signatures of Fractionally Charged Skyrmions in Fractional Quantum Hall states
papers.abstract: We investigate spin polarisation and low-energy excitations in fractional quantum Hall (FQH) states using cavity-polariton spectroscopy of high-mobility GaAs quantum wells. By measuring the optical coupling strength of interband Landau-level excitations over the range $1/3 \le ν\le 1$, we extract the spin polarisation of the electron system as a function of filling factor. Complete suppression of the oscillator strength of the lowest energy excitation, characteristic of singlet trion formation in fully polarised systems, is reported for the first time in this regime. At large magnetic fields, fully polarised FQH states exhibit symmetric depolarisation away from their quantised fillings, analogous to Skyrmionic behaviour near $ν=1$. The depolarisation follows an empirical law $S=ν^*$, where $S$ is the number of spin flips per added magnetic flux quantum and $ν^*$ the effective Composite Fermion filling factor. We interpret this behaviour as evidence for Minimal Fractionally Charged Skyrmions (MFCS) formed from bound spin-flip and quasiparticle excitations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“使用腔-极化子光谱学（cavity-polariton spectroscopy）对高迁移率GaAs量子阱进行测量”，并报告了光学耦合强度、自旋极化等实验数据。；研究对象：分数量子霍尔态（FQH states）中的自旋极化行为，特别是分数电荷斯格明子（Fractionally Charged Skyrmions）的激发特征。具体体系为高迁移率GaAs量子阱中的二维电子气。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在填充因子1/3 ≤ ν ≤ 1范围内，首次观察到完全极化系统中最低能量激发的振荡器强度被完全抑制（对应单重态三子形成）。在强磁场下，完全极化的FQH态在偏离其量子化填充时表现出对称的去极化行为，类似于ν=1附近的斯格明子行为，且去极化遵循经验规律S=ν*（S为每添加一个磁通量子对应的自旋翻转数，ν*为有效复合费米子填充因子）。该行为被解释为束缚自旋翻转与准粒子激发形成的最小分数电荷斯格明子（MFCS）的证据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在填充因子1/3 ≤ ν ≤ 1范围内，首次观察到完全极化系统中最低能量激发的振荡器强度被完全抑制（对应单重态三子形成）。在强磁场下，完全极化的FQH态在偏离其量子化填充时表现出对称的去极化行为，类似于ν=1附近的斯格明子行为，且去极化遵循经验规律S=ν*（S为每添加一个磁通量子对应的自旋翻转数，ν*为有效复合费米子填充因子）。该行为被解释为束缚自旋翻转与准粒子激发形成的最小分数电荷斯格明子（MFCS）的证据。；创新点：首次在分数量子霍尔态（1/3 ≤ ν ≤ 1）中报告了完全极化系统下最低能量激发的振荡器强度完全抑制现象，并提出了最小分数电荷斯格明子（MFCS）作为自旋去极化行为的物理解释。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 腔-极化子光谱学（cavity-polariton spectroscopy），用于测量GaAs量子阱中带间朗道能级激发的光学耦合强度，并从中提取电子系统的自旋极化随填充因子的变化。

papers.title: Layer-parity-dependent interfacial coupling in Nb$_3$Cl$_8$/graphene van der Waals heterostructures
papers.abstract: Strongly correlated two-dimensional systems provide compelling platforms for investigating exotic quantum phenomena. Niobium chloride (Nb$_3$Cl$_8$), a single-band Mott insulator, exhibits a remarkable out-of-plane polarization in its topmost layer that oscillates with layer parity, manifesting as an odd-even effect. Using atomic force microscopy (AFM) and Kelvin probe force microscopy (KPFM), this layer-parity-dependent polarization can be effectively characterized through surface morphology and potential mapping, enabling the unambiguous identification of different surface phases. We then fabricated dual-gate Hall devices by coupling different surface phases of Nb$_3$Cl$_8$ with monolayer graphene to investigate how the topmost-layer out-of-plane polarization influences interfacial coupling and the resulting transport behavior. Our results reveal significant phase-dependent variations in charge transfer, carrier densities, and hybridization gaps (25.2 meV for Phase 1 and 30.0 meV for Phase 2). Density functional theory calculations corroborate these experimental findings, showing that distinct out-of-plane polarizations in the topmost layer lead to different orbital overlaps and interfacial coupling strengths. These findings highlight the critical importance of surface polarization and orbital orientation in engineering the properties of strongly correlated van der Waals heterostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了使用原子力显微镜（AFM）、开尔文探针力显微镜（KPFM）等实验手段，并制备了双栅霍尔器件进行输运测量；同时，也提及了密度泛函理论（DFT）计算作为佐证。；研究对象：Nb₃Cl₈/石墨烯范德华异质结。具体研究了Nb₃Cl₈（一种单带莫特绝缘体）顶层中依赖于层数奇偶性的面外极化对异质结界面的耦合效应及其对输运行为的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Nb₃Cl₈顶层依赖于层数奇偶性的面外极化（奇偶效应）会显著影响其与石墨烯的界面耦合强度，导致电荷转移、载流子密度和杂化能隙（Phase 1为25.2 meV，Phase 2为30.0 meV）出现明显的相依赖性变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Nb₃Cl₈顶层依赖于层数奇偶性的面外极化（奇偶效应）会显著影响其与石墨烯的界面耦合强度，导致电荷转移、载流子密度和杂化能隙（Phase 1为25.2 meV，Phase 2为30.0 meV）出现明显的相依赖性变化。；创新点：揭示了强关联范德华异质结中，顶层表面极化（而非体相性质）及其奇偶性对界面耦合和输运性质的调控作用，强调了表面极化和轨道取向在工程化异质结特性中的关键重要性。
papers.method_zh: 实验上：原子力显微镜（AFM）和开尔文探针力显微镜（KPFM）用于表征表面形貌和电势，以识别不同表面相；制备了双栅极霍尔器件用于测量输运行为。理论上：密度泛函理论（DFT）计算用于解释实验现象，分析轨道重叠和界面耦合强度。

papers.title: The Two Dimensional Dynamical Bulk Boundary Correspondence: Beyond Two Band Models
papers.abstract: A dynamical equivalent of the bulk-boundary correspondence has been suggested to occur in one and two dimensional topological models following sudden quenches. Depending on the topological invariant of the time evolving and initial phases involved large boundary contributions to a dynamical free energy occur. Moreover they occur periodically between the critical times at which this dynamical free energy becomes non-analytic, \emph{i.e.}~at dynamical quantum phase transitions. At these critical times the eigenvalue spectrum of the Loschmidt matrix which underlies the dynamical free energy closes its gap. The boundary contributions are understood to be due to zero-modes or in-gap bands of this matrix, forming a close analogy with equilibrium topological models and their edge modes. The exact cause of this phenomena and its generality remain unknown. In this article we test the dynamical bulk-boundary correspondence for a complicated two dimensional topological superconductor with a rich phase diagram, allowing quenches between many different Chern numbers. We show that there is no straightforward correspondence between the equilibrium phases quenched between and the dynamical bulk boundary correspondence. Furthermore the correspondence can depend on the orientation of the edges, suggesting a possible weak topological variant.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：dynamical bulk-boundary correspondence、topological models、sudden quenches、dynamical quantum phase transitions。；研究对象：二维拓扑超导体中的动力学体-边对应关系，特别是涉及多能带模型和不同陈数之间的淬火过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二维拓扑超导体中，动力学体-边对应关系并不简单地依赖于淬火前后平衡相的拓扑不变量，且该对应关系可能依赖于边界取向，暗示存在弱拓扑变体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二维拓扑超导体中，动力学体-边对应关系并不简单地依赖于淬火前后平衡相的拓扑不变量，且该对应关系可能依赖于边界取向，暗示存在弱拓扑变体。；创新点：首次在复杂二维多能带拓扑超导体中系统检验动力学体-边对应关系，发现其与平衡相拓扑不变量之间不存在简单对应，并揭示边界取向对对应关系的影响。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，通过构造具有丰富相图的二维拓扑超导体模型，研究不同陈数之间的突然淬火（sudden quenches）后动力学自由能中的边界贡献、Loschmidt矩阵的能谱闭合以及动力学量子相变。

papers.title: Ultra-Soft Ferrimagnetism in a High-Entropy Spinel Oxide Driven by Site-Selective Cation Disorder
papers.abstract: High-entropy materials are complex, multifunctional materials that have reshaped the design of advanced functional materials. Their chemically diverse compositions enable access to a broader compositional space than conventional solid solutions, while simultaneously posing significant challenges for fundamental structure property understanding. In this study, we introduce a new highentropy spinel oxide with an exceptionally low coercivity of 1.8 Oe at room temperature, among the lowest reported for bulk spinel oxides, and a high electrical resistivity (1560 ohm-cm). Neutron powder diffraction (NPD) and magnetic measurements reveal long-range collinear ferrimagnetic ordering (k = 0,0,0) with a transition temperature at 420 K. This rare combination of ultra-soft magnetic behavior, robust ferrimagnetic ordering well above room temperature, and high resistivity highlights its strong potential as an advanced soft-magnetic oxide for low-loss, high-frequency applications. Furthermore, X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS), Mossbauer spectroscopy, and NPD analyses were combined to determine the cation distribution and site selectivity across the tetrahedral and octahedral sites of the complex structure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及多种实验手段（中子粉末衍射、磁测量、X射线吸收谱、穆斯堡尔谱等）以及具体实验数据（矫顽力1.8 Oe、电阻率1560 ohm-cm等）。；研究对象：一种新型高熵尖晶石氧化物，具体研究其亚铁磁有序、超软磁特性及阳离子位序选择性无序行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该高熵尖晶石氧化物在室温下具有极低的矫顽力（1.8 Oe），同时保持高于室温的长程共线亚铁磁有序（转变温度420 K）和高电阻率（1560 ohm-cm），实现了超软磁性与高电阻率的罕见组合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该高熵尖晶石氧化物在室温下具有极低的矫顽力（1.8 Oe），同时保持高于室温的长程共线亚铁磁有序（转变温度420 K）和高电阻率（1560 ohm-cm），实现了超软磁性与高电阻率的罕见组合。；创新点：首次在高熵尖晶石氧化物中实现极低矫顽力（1.8 Oe，为块体尖晶石氧化物中最低之一）与高电阻率、高温亚铁磁有序的协同，为低损耗高频软磁氧化物提供了新材料平台。摘要未突出说明与传统尖晶石相比的具体机制差异。
papers.method_zh: 中子粉末衍射（NPD）确定磁结构（k=0,0,0）与磁转变温度；磁测量表征磁性能；X射线吸收光谱（XAS）、穆斯堡尔谱（Mössbauer spectroscopy）与NPD联合分析四面体和八面体位置的阳离子分布与位序选择性。

papers.title: Propagation and localization of spin excitations at altermagnetic domain walls
papers.abstract: Altermagnets (A$\ell$Ms) are spin-compensated materials in which opposite-spin sublattices are connected by a symmetry that causes a spin splitting in their elementary excitations. As there is a strong effect of altermagnetism on domain wall properties, it is quite natural to also expect an enrichment of the physics of magnetic excitations at A$\ell$M domain walls. Here, we consider the propagation of spin eigen-excitations along domain walls in easy-axial $d$-wave A$\ell$Ms. Investigating the presence of bound states localized on a domain wall, we find that the effect of the A$\ell$M on the bound states strongly depends on the orientation of the domain wall relative to the crystallographic directions. If the domain wall is oriented along a nodal direction [100] or [010], A$\ell$M does not change the number of bound states; however, it leads to a nonlinear dispersion and a tilt of the wavefront. The effect of A$\ell$M is strongest when the domain wall is oriented along the directions [110] or [$\bar{1}$10], i.e., along the directions of the strongest A$\ell$M splitting in the magnon spectrum. In this case, (i) the additional gapped bound states appear, (ii) degeneracy of the eigenstates with respect to their polarization (right-handed or left-handed precession of the N{é}el vector) is removed, and (iii) the localization area of the bound states strongly depends on the eigenfrequency. The latter may lead to strong localization of the bound state at the domain wall. We further consider the influence of a static magnetic field that is applied along the easy axis, and find that the magnetic field induces an asymmetry between the localization regions on opposite sides of the domain wall and sets an upper limit on the absolute value of the propagating eigenstate's wave vector.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：consider、investigating、find、theoretical analysis（基于对称性分析和模型计算）。；研究对象：易轴d波交变磁体（altermagnet）中畴壁上的自旋激发（自旋波/磁振子）的传播与局域化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 交变磁体对畴壁束缚态的影响强烈依赖于畴壁相对于晶格的方向：沿[100]/[010]方向时仅导致非线性色散和波前倾斜；沿[110]/[1-10]方向时则会产生新的有能隙束缚态、解除极化简并，并使束缚态局域区域强烈依赖于频率，甚至导致强局域化。外加静磁场会诱导畴壁两侧局域区域的不对称性，并限制传播态波矢的上限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：交变磁体对畴壁束缚态的影响强烈依赖于畴壁相对于晶格的方向：沿[100]/[010]方向时仅导致非线性色散和波前倾斜；沿[110]/[1-10]方向时则会产生新的有能隙束缚态、解除极化简并，并使束缚态局域区域强烈依赖于频率，甚至导致强局域化。外加静磁场会诱导畴壁两侧局域区域的不对称性，并限制传播态波矢的上限。；创新点：首次系统研究了交变磁体中畴壁方向对自旋波束缚态性质（包括束缚态数量、能隙、极化简并、局域化程度）的调控作用，并揭示了外加磁场对畴壁两侧局域区域不对称性的诱导效应。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于易轴d波交变磁体的自旋波模型，研究畴壁上的自旋本征激发，分析束缚态的存在条件、色散关系、极化特性及局域化长度，并考虑沿易轴方向外加静磁场的影响。

papers.title: Extending Field Limits in Nanoscale Magnetic Imaging with Metamaterial-inspired Magnetic Flux Concentrators
papers.abstract: Many nanoscale magnetic imaging techniques are constrained by the maximum magnetic field that can be applied during measurements, due to geometrical limitations or interactions with the probe or the detected signal (e.g., electrons). Here, it is demonstrated that sample-integrated metamaterial-inspired magnetic flux concentrators (MFCs) locally amplify magnetic fields, allowing observation of magnetization processes beyond instrumental limits. Micrometer-sized MFCs fabricated directly on the samples are tested in photoemission electron microscopy experiments employing X-ray magnetic circular dichroism as magnetic contrast mechanism. At low applied fields, substantial amplification factors enable observation of magnetization reversal in a chain of magnetite nanoparticles synthesized by magnetotactic bacteria at an applied field of 8 mT, substantially smaller than the 50 mT predicted by simulations in absence of MFCs. At higher fields, the field enhancement extends the accessible field range by a factor of five, enabling for the first time, imaging of the field-dependent magnetic domain structure evolution of an isolated giant magnetofossil. Finally, we show how MFC geometry and material parameters can be tuned to optimize performance considering sample and experimental constraints, providing a tunable and broadly applicable strategy for extending the accessible field range in a wide variety of nanoscale magnetic imaging techniques.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：demonstrated、tested、experiments、fabricated、imaging。；研究对象：纳米尺度磁性成像技术中的磁场限制问题，以及利用超材料启发磁通集中器（MFCs）局部放大磁场，研究磁铁矿纳米颗粒链和孤立巨型磁化石的磁化反转与磁畴结构演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将MFCs集成到样品上，可在低外加磁场下实现磁化反转观测（8 mT vs 无MFC时的50 mT），并在高场下将可访问的磁场范围扩展五倍，首次实现对孤立巨型磁化石的场依赖磁畴结构演化成像。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将MFCs集成到样品上，可在低外加磁场下实现磁化反转观测（8 mT vs 无MFC时的50 mT），并在高场下将可访问的磁场范围扩展五倍，首次实现对孤立巨型磁化石的场依赖磁畴结构演化成像。；创新点：提出并实验验证了一种可调谐、广泛适用的策略，通过样品集成的超材料启发MFCs，突破仪器磁场限制，适用于多种纳米尺度磁性成像技术。
papers.method_zh: 在样品上直接制备微米尺寸的MFCs，结合光发射电子显微镜（PEEM）和X射线磁圆二色性（XMCD）作为磁衬度机制进行成像实验。

papers.title: Dichotomous electronic system in a bilayer Ni$^{1+}$ nickelate
papers.abstract: ``Infinite layer'' nickelates (ILNs) ${\cal R}$NiO$_2$ (${\cal R}$=rare earth elements), having empty apical O sites, become superconducting upon hole doping. They display a secondary electron Fermi surface (FS), giving hole doping, arising not from atomic orbitals but from a band based on interstitial density. Newly reported La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_5$F, formally Ni$^{1+}$, provides an unexpected example of ILN with essentially ideal two dimensional character. A partially occupied single band $E^*$, based on interstitial density, has distinct properties, as its strongly anisotropic shape extends over the three ``apical'' layers and leads to a cylindrical electron FS giving self-doping. This interstitial density is associated with a {\it network of valence bands}, including a Ni $d_{xz},d_{yz}$ pair that partners with $E^*$ to provide an incipient non-analytic Dirac point, leading to an unusual type of interstitial density--$d$ band coupling. The $E^*$ electron band and the conventional Ni $dpσ$ band will display a dichotomy of hole and electron quasiparticle behavior in normal state transport and far-IR properties, and likely resulting in unconventional superconducting state properties even for nickelates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中主要讨论电子结构、能带特征、费米面、狄拉克点等理论概念，未提及具体实验手段或计算模拟方法。；研究对象：双层镍氧化物 La₃Ni₂O₅F（名义价态 Ni¹⁺），属于“无限层”镍酸盐（ILN）体系，研究其电子结构中的间隙态能带及其与常规 Ni d 带的耦合行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 La₃Ni₂O₅F 中，基于间隙电子密度的部分占据单能带 E* 具有强各向异性，跨越三个“顶角”层，形成柱状电子费米面，实现自掺杂；该间隙态与 Ni d_{xz}, d_{yz} 能带耦合，产生非解析狄拉克点，导致电子与空穴准粒子行为的二分性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 La₃Ni₂O₅F 中，基于间隙电子密度的部分占据单能带 E* 具有强各向异性，跨越三个“顶角”层，形成柱状电子费米面，实现自掺杂；该间隙态与 Ni d_{xz}, d_{yz} 能带耦合，产生非解析狄拉克点，导致电子与空穴准粒子行为的二分性。；创新点：发现了一种具有理想二维特征的 Ni¹⁺ 无限层镍酸盐，其中间隙态能带 E* 与常规 Ni d 带形成独特的二分性电子系统，并预言了非常规超导态的可能性。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体计算方法或理论框架（如 DFT、模型哈密顿量等），仅基于能带分析和费米面结构进行理论讨论。

papers.title: Optical-like interference control polar-phonons dispersions in 2D materials
papers.abstract: It has been argued that the polar phonon modes of two-dimensional (2D) materials should show a linear dependence close to the Brillouin zone center due to the reduced problem dimensionality compared to a three-dimensional crystal, leading to a vanishing LO-TO splitting. Revisiting this question using a mirror-charge framework derived from classical electrostatics, we show that it is not always true: with perfectly-reflective dielectric interfaces, it is possible to recover a LO-TO splitting, or an equivalent phenomenon for the out-of-plane modes. Effectively, the dispersion of polar phonon modes is governed by optical-like constructive and destructive interferences of the source potential with its reflection at the dielectric interfaces. This work highlights the critical role of dielectric boundary conditions to understand phonon-related properties in 2D materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：使用“mirror-charge framework derived from classical electrostatics”进行理论推导，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：二维材料中的极性声子（polar phonon modes）及其色散关系，特别是布里渊区中心附近的线性色散行为与LO-TO分裂现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 二维材料极性声子模式在布里渊区中心是否呈现线性色散并导致LO-TO分裂消失，取决于介电边界条件：当存在完美反射的介电界面时，可以恢复LO-TO分裂或面外模式的等效现象。声子色散受源势与其在介电界面反射之间的光学类相长/相消干涉控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：二维材料极性声子模式在布里渊区中心是否呈现线性色散并导致LO-TO分裂消失，取决于介电边界条件：当存在完美反射的介电界面时，可以恢复LO-TO分裂或面外模式的等效现象。声子色散受源势与其在介电界面反射之间的光学类相长/相消干涉控制。；创新点：推翻了此前认为二维材料极性声子模式在布里渊区中心必然呈现线性色散且LO-TO分裂消失的普遍观点，揭示了介电边界条件（而非仅维度降低）对声子色散的关键调控作用，并建立了与光学干涉现象的类比。
papers.method_zh: 基于经典静电学的镜像电荷（mirror-charge）理论框架，分析介电边界条件对二维材料极性声子色散的影响。

papers.title: Interaction-driven dynamics in graphene flakes as a benchmark for quantum simulation
papers.abstract: We study interaction-driven ultrafast dynamics in finite graphene flakes following an optical pump quench in an interacting tight-binding model. By comparing exact real-time evolution with simulations restricted to particle-hole excitation subspaces, we assess when relaxation can be captured by low-order many-body processes and when this is not sufficient. The single-particle orbital entropy provides a compact diagnostic for dynamic correlation growth. For the systems studied here, periodic graphene flakes are well described by low-order excitations, whereas confined geometries require substantial higher-order contributions even for relatively small interaction strengths. The quench protocol combines simple initial-state preparation with strongly correlated dynamics, identifying a promising benchmark problem for future quantum-computing simulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：exact real-time evolution、simulations、tight-binding model、quantum simulation。；研究对象：有限石墨烯薄片（finite graphene flakes）在光学泵浦猝灭（optical pump quench）后的相互作用驱动超快动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 周期性石墨烯薄片中的弛豫动力学可由低阶多体过程很好地描述，而受限几何结构即使在较小相互作用强度下也需要显著的高阶贡献；单粒子轨道熵可作为动态关联增长的紧凑诊断工具。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：周期性石墨烯薄片中的弛豫动力学可由低阶多体过程很好地描述，而受限几何结构即使在较小相互作用强度下也需要显著的高阶贡献；单粒子轨道熵可作为动态关联增长的紧凑诊断工具。；创新点：提出了一个结合简单初始态制备与强关联动力学的猝灭方案，为未来量子计算模拟提供了一个有前景的基准问题。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用相互作用紧束缚模型，通过精确实时演化与限制在粒子-空穴激发子空间中的模拟进行对比分析；使用单粒子轨道熵作为动态关联增长的诊断量。

papers.title: Probing Spin Configurations in Exchange-Coupled Magnetic Bilayers with Orthogonal Anisotropies via Anomalous Hall and Nernst Effects
papers.abstract: When two ferromagnetic thin films with different magnetic easy axes are coupled via the exchange interaction, the magnetization process becomes nontrivial. In this paper, we demonstrate that three-dimensional magnetization information in such a bilayer system can be accessed electrically by combining measurements of the anomalous Hall effect (AHE) and anomalous Nernst effect (ANE).
