Specifically, we investigate a CoFe$_2$O$_4$(001)/Fe bilayer, where the insulating nature of CoFe$_2$O$_4$ ensures that these transport measurements selectively probe only the conductive Fe layer. By combining the AHE and ANE results and comparing them with a simple micromagnetic simulation, we probe the magnetic configuration of antiferromagnetically coupled Fe layer and suggest the emergence of a twisted magnetic structure near the interface.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：measurements（测量）、investigate（研究）、transport measurements（输运测量）、micromagnetic simulation（微磁模拟）。；研究对象：交换耦合的磁性双层膜体系，具体为 CoFe₂O₄(001)/Fe 双层膜，其中两个铁磁薄膜具有正交磁各向异性，并通过交换相互作用耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过联合测量反常霍尔效应（AHE）和反常能斯特效应（ANE），可以电学方式获取该双层膜体系的三维磁化信息，并揭示界面附近可能存在扭曲磁结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过联合测量反常霍尔效应（AHE）和反常能斯特效应（ANE），可以电学方式获取该双层膜体系的三维磁化信息，并揭示界面附近可能存在扭曲磁结构。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上结合了反常霍尔效应（AHE）和反常能斯特效应（ANE）的电输运测量；理论上辅以简单的微磁模拟（micromagnetic simulation）进行对比分析。利用 CoFe₂O₄ 的绝缘性确保测量仅探测导电的 Fe 层。

papers.title: SANS and magnetometry study of the magnetic phase diagram of the B20 helimagnet FeRhSi
papers.abstract: This manuscript reports the first direct neutron-scattering evidence for long-period helimagnetism in the newly identified 4d-substituted B20 compound Fe0.5Rh0.5Si. By combining SANS with low-field magnetometry, we establish the magnetic modulation, construct a field-temperature phase diagram, and identify a candidate A-phase region supported by an independent structural signature. The work is important beyond this single compound because it expands the family of chiral B20 helimagnets into Rh-substituted materials, where spin-orbit coupling, disorder, and Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions can be tuned. It will interest researchers in chiral magnetism, topological spin textures, magnetic neutron scattering, and quantum materials, and provides a foundation for future studies of emergent magnetic phases and topology-driven phenomena in chemically tuned chiral magnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“direct neutron-scattering evidence”、“SANS”、“low-field magnetometry”。；研究对象：B20型手性螺旋磁体FeRhSi，具体为4d元素取代的化合物Fe0.5Rh0.5Si的磁相图。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次通过中子散射直接证实了Fe0.5Rh0.5Si中存在长周期螺旋磁性，并结合SANS与低场磁强计构建了其磁场-温度相图，识别出一个候选A相区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次通过中子散射直接证实了Fe0.5Rh0.5Si中存在长周期螺旋磁性，并结合SANS与低场磁强计构建了其磁场-温度相图，识别出一个候选A相区域。；创新点：将B20手性螺旋磁体家族扩展至Rh取代材料，为通过化学调控自旋-轨道耦合、无序度和Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用提供了新平台。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 小角中子散射（SANS）和低场磁强计（low-field magnetometry）。

papers.title: Moving backward to go faster: Diatom-inspired sliding reveals efficient modes of locomotion
papers.abstract: Across biological scales, from sperm cells to whales, locomotion commonly relies on undulatory gaits, in which traveling deformation waves interact with the surrounding fluid to generate thrust opposite to the direction of wave propagation. In viscous environments, microorganism locomotion is classically understood in terms of undulatory bending of slender filaments such as flagella, with optimal propulsion achieved when the deformation wavelength is comparable to the swimmer length. Inspired by diatom colonies, we identify a fundamentally different swimming mechanism based on sliding between neighboring elements within a chain. We show that sliding between stacked elongated cells generates internal shear that drives propulsion opposite to classical undulatory swimming, while achieving higher speeds and greater energetic efficiency. Remarkably, optimal performance occurs at wavelengths much larger than the chain length and at cell aspect ratios consistent with those observed in natural diatom colonies, suggesting that hydrodynamic efficiency may constitute an evolutionary selective pressure in diatom chains. Together, these results identify sliding as a previously overlooked mode of locomotion in multicellular assemblies and suggest new design principles for efficient bio-inspired microswimmers and swarm robotic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（判断依据：摘要中未提及实验或计算，主要基于理论分析和生物启发模型，关键词包括“identify a mechanism”、“suggest design principles”）。；研究对象：基于硅藻群体（diatom colonies）启发的多细胞链状结构在粘性流体中的滑动推进运动模式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现一种与经典波动推进方向相反的滑动推进机制：相邻细胞之间的内部剪切可产生推力，且该机制在速度与能量效率上均优于传统波动推进；最优性能出现在波长远大于链长、细胞长宽比与自然硅藻群体一致的情况下。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现一种与经典波动推进方向相反的滑动推进机制：相邻细胞之间的内部剪切可产生推力，且该机制在速度与能量效率上均优于传统波动推进；最优性能出现在波长远大于链长、细胞长宽比与自然硅藻群体一致的情况下。；创新点：识别出“滑动”（sliding）作为一种此前被忽视的多细胞组装体运动模式，并指出其可能构成硅藻链演化中的流体动力学选择压力，为仿生微型游泳器和群体机器人系统提供新设计原理。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与生物启发分析（摘要未明确说明具体数值方法或模拟手段，仅提及基于“sliding between neighboring elements”的力学模型）。

papers.title: Microscopic evidence for a Zhang-Rice triplet state in the van der Waals antiferromagnet, NiPS$_3$
papers.abstract: Quantum-entangled states underpin many emergent phenomena in quantum materials, yet their direct experimental identification remains a challenge. NiPS$_3$, a van der Waals antiferromagnet exhibiting a resolution-limited magnetic exciton in its ordered phase, has been proposed to host a many-body entangled Zhang-Rice triplet state. Here, using $^{33}$S nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) on $^{33}$S-enriched NiPS$_3$ single crystals, we provide microscopic evidence for this charge-transfer state. The $^{33}$S and $^{31}$P Knight shifts as a function of temperature reveal a unified spin-triplet configuration arising from strong hybridization between a self-doped hole in the S $3p$ orbitals and a hole in Ni $3d$ orbitals. Furthermore, the $^{33}$S nuclear spin-lattice relaxation rate exhibits a power-law divergence as it approaches the Néel temperature $T_N=155$ K, indicating critical slowing down of collective charge fluctuations consistent with spin-nematic correlations. These results reveal a spin-charge-intertwined ground state and establish the microscopic foundation for the exceptional coherence of the magnetic exciton in NiPS$_3$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用核磁共振（NMR）实验手段，关键词为“nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR)”、“Knight shifts”、“nuclear spin-lattice relaxation rate”。；研究对象：范德瓦尔斯反铁磁体NiPS₃，具体研究其磁激子（magnetic exciton）中可能存在的张-瑞奇三重态（Zhang-Rice triplet state）以及相关的自旋-电荷纠缠基态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过³³S和³¹P核磁共振测量，提供了NiPS₃中存在张-瑞奇三重态（即自掺杂空穴在S 3p轨道与Ni 3d轨道之间强杂化形成的自旋三重态构型）的微观证据；同时发现³³S核自旋-晶格弛豫率在奈尔温度附近呈幂律发散，表明存在与向列自旋关联一致的集体电荷涨落临界慢化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过³³S和³¹P核磁共振测量，提供了NiPS₃中存在张-瑞奇三重态（即自掺杂空穴在S 3p轨道与Ni 3d轨道之间强杂化形成的自旋三重态构型）的微观证据；同时发现³³S核自旋-晶格弛豫率在奈尔温度附近呈幂律发散，表明存在与向列自旋关联一致的集体电荷涨落临界慢化。；创新点：首次通过核磁共振（NMR）提供NiPS₃中张-瑞奇三重态（Zhang-Rice triplet state）的微观实验证据，并揭示了该体系中自旋与电荷涨落相互交织的基态性质。
papers.method_zh: 使用³³S同位素富集的NiPS₃单晶，进行³³S和³¹P核磁共振（NMR）实验，测量了随温度变化的Knight位移（Knight shifts）以及³³S核自旋-晶格弛豫率（nuclear spin-lattice relaxation rate）。

papers.title: Virial stress in systems of active Brownian particles in the presence of translational and rotational inertia
papers.abstract: We elucidate the stress in a system of active Brownian particles augmented with translational and rotational inertia (ABP+TRI). Stress tensors are derived for periodic systems as well as systems confined between walls by employing Lagrange's equations of motion of the first kind for the rotational motion. Using Langevin simulations of an ideal active gas in two dimensions, we confirm the existence of an equation of state for periodic systems that depends on translational and rotational inertia in general. Confinement implies a strong polarization of the propulsion direction near a wall and an enhanced density, both of which increase with increasing rotational inertia. This affects the local stress tensor normal to the confining walls, leading to a breakdown of the equation of state. Yet the local stress in the bulk part of the confined systems is identical with that of the periodic system. Importantly, for both kinds of boundary conditions, the so-called swim stress is not included in the local stress tensor; thus, in general, the swim stress is not representative of the stress in systems of ABP+TRIs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：Lagrange’s equations of motion、Langevin simulations、stress tensor derivation）；研究对象：具有平动和转动惯性的活性布朗粒子（ABP+TRI）体系中的应力行为，包括周期性系统和受限系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在周期性系统中存在依赖于平动和转动惯性的状态方程；在受限系统中，壁附近推进方向强烈极化且密度增大，导致状态方程失效，但体相局部应力与周期性系统一致；此外，泳动应力（swim stress）并不包含在局部应力张量中，因此不能代表ABP+TRI体系的应力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在周期性系统中存在依赖于平动和转动惯性的状态方程；在受限系统中，壁附近推进方向强烈极化且密度增大，导致状态方程失效，但体相局部应力与周期性系统一致；此外，泳动应力（swim stress）并不包含在局部应力张量中，因此不能代表ABP+TRI体系的应力。；创新点：首次系统阐明了平动和转动惯性对活性布朗粒子体系应力的影响，并明确指出泳动应力不适用于描述此类体系的局部应力。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一类拉格朗日运动方程推导应力张量，并结合二维理想活性气体的朗之万模拟进行验证。

papers.title: Strain-programmable exciton diffusion in moiré heterostructures
papers.abstract: Moiré superlattices in van der Waals heterostructures have recently gained significant attention as an intriguing platform for studying correlated electronic systems and exotic excitonic properties. Previous reports, however, focused on creating and modulating moiré heterostructures through interlayer twisting or lattice constant mismatches, limiting controls on symmetry of heterostructures. In this work, we show that strain significantly alters the geometry of moiré superlattices by breaking the C3 rotational symmetry. We realize strain-induced moiré superlattices by intentionally regulating interlayer strain in WSe2-MoSe2 heterostructures, which is manifested by linearly polarized interlayer exciton emission coupled to the strain direction. Furthermore, interlayer exciton diffusion was preferentially guided along the stretched moiré superlattice orientations over a wide spatial range, reflecting the strain-modified moiré potentials. Our work highlights strain tuning as a versatile tool for designing moiré superlattices and programming excitonic transport, which opens pathways for van der Waals logic and information processing devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“realize strain-induced moiré superlattices”、“manifested by linearly polarized interlayer exciton emission”等实验观测和调控手段。；研究对象：WSe₂-MoSe₂异质结中的莫尔超晶格，以及应变调控下的激子扩散行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调控层间应变可以打破莫尔超晶格的C₃旋转对称性，并引导层间激子沿拉伸的莫尔超晶格方向优先扩散，实现激子输运的可编程控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调控层间应变可以打破莫尔超晶格的C₃旋转对称性，并引导层间激子沿拉伸的莫尔超晶格方向优先扩散，实现激子输运的可编程控制。；创新点：不同于以往通过层间扭转或晶格失配来构建莫尔超晶格，本工作利用应变作为调控手段，打破了莫尔超晶格的对称性，并实现了对激子扩散方向的大范围编程控制。
papers.method_zh: 通过有意调控WSe₂-MoSe₂异质结中的层间应变来构建应变诱导的莫尔超晶格；利用线性偏振的层间激子发光来表征应变方向；通过观测激子扩散的空间分布来反映应变修饰的莫尔势。

papers.title: Finite-Time Orientational Relaxation Restructures Collective Motion in Polar Active Matter
papers.abstract: We introduce a Langevin formulation of Vicsek-like active particles in which orientations evolve through finite-rate relaxation toward the local mean direction, with alignment strength $J$ and rotational diffusivity $D_r$, thereby combining Vicsek-type local consensus with XY-like orientational dynamics. Using large-scale numerical simulations, we determine the nonequilibrium phase diagram as a function of activity and alignment rate. Increasing the alignment rate drives a sequence of transitions from a homogeneous isotropic state to polar bands, a cross-sea phase of intersecting bands, a homogeneous polar state, and ultimately a micro-clustered regime. The isotropic-to-polar transition is strongly first order, as evidenced by Binder cumulants and bimodal distributions of local polarization and density, indicating coexistence of gas-like and liquid-like regions. Near the onset of collective motion, band size increases with activity but depends non-monotonically on alignment rate. Further increasing the alignment rate drives the system through the cross-sea and homogeneous polar phases before enhanced density fluctuations lead to micro-clustering. Our results demonstrate that finite-time orientational relaxation acts as a control parameter that qualitatively restructures collective behavior in polar active matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：Langevin formulation、large-scale numerical simulations、nonequilibrium phase diagram。；研究对象：极性活性物质（polar active matter）中粒子的集体运动，具体为Vicsek类活性粒子在有限时间取向弛豫下的动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 有限时间的取向弛豫（通过取向对齐率调控）可作为控制参数，定性重构极性活性物质的集体运动相图，包括从各向同性态到极性带、交叉海相、均匀极性态及微团簇态的系列转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：有限时间的取向弛豫（通过取向对齐率调控）可作为控制参数，定性重构极性活性物质的集体运动相图，包括从各向同性态到极性带、交叉海相、均匀极性态及微团簇态的系列转变。；创新点：将Vicsek型局部共识与XY型取向动力学（有限速率弛豫）相结合，揭示了取向弛豫速率作为独立控制参数对集体运动相结构的定性重构作用，而非仅依赖活动性。
papers.method_zh: 基于Langevin方程构建Vicsek类活性粒子模型，其中粒子取向通过有限速率弛豫向局部平均方向演化（含对齐强度J和旋转扩散系数Dr），并采用大规模数值模拟确定非平衡相图。

papers.title: Electrical Spectroscopy of Intervalley Relaxation in WSe$_2$ Transistors
papers.abstract: We show that the transconductance of multilayer WSe$_2$ field-effect transistors serves as a direct electrical spectrometer of the intervalley relaxation time $τ_{\rm iv}$, previously accessible only by ultrafast optical techniques. Extending an equilibrium valley-thermodynamics framework with a single relaxation equation for the $Γ$-valley carrier fraction $f_Γ(t)$, we predict three signatures: (i)~a Lorentzian transconductance $g_m(ω)=g_{m,0}+g_{m,v}^0/(1+iωτ_{\rm iv})$, whose imaginary part peaks at $ω_c=τ_{\rm iv}^{-1}$ with opposite signs for bilayer and trilayer; (ii)~a two-stage current transient after a gate step, exhibiting bilayer overshoot or trilayer undershoot; and (iii)~sweep-rate-proportional hysteresis whose gate-voltage profile and layer-number sign reversal distinguish valley from trap-induced dynamics. All three signatures provide quantitative electrical access to $τ_{\rm iv}$ with standard rf and dc instrumentation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论+实验混合类型。判断依据：摘要中既有理论框架的扩展（“extending an equilibrium valley-thermodynamics framework”），又有实验预测（“predict three signatures”）和测量手段（“standard rf and dc instrumentation”）。；研究对象：多层WSe₂场效应晶体管中的谷间弛豫过程，具体研究Γ谷载流子分数f_Γ(t)的弛豫时间τ_iv。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 多层WSe₂晶体管的跨导可直接作为谷间弛豫时间τ_iv的电学谱仪，通过三种特征信号（洛伦兹型跨导、栅阶跃后的两阶段电流瞬态、与扫描速率成正比的磁滞）实现定量电学测量，此前仅能通过超快光学技术获取。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：多层WSe₂晶体管的跨导可直接作为谷间弛豫时间τ_iv的电学谱仪，通过三种特征信号（洛伦兹型跨导、栅阶跃后的两阶段电流瞬态、与扫描速率成正比的磁滞）实现定量电学测量，此前仅能通过超快光学技术获取。；创新点：首次提出利用场效应晶体管的跨导作为直接电学谱仪来测量谷间弛豫时间，替代了传统超快光学技术，并预测了双层与三层WSe₂中符号相反的实验特征。
papers.method_zh: 扩展平衡态谷热力学框架，引入Γ谷载流子分数f_Γ(t)的单弛豫方程；采用标准射频和直流仪器进行电学测量。

papers.title: One-Step Self-Organized Multifunctional Micromotors via Evaporative Liquid-Liquid Phase Separation
papers.abstract: Active microcarriers capable of transporting multiple functional components and navigating complex environments are highly desirable for biomedical applications, yet their fabrication typically requires complex multistep processes. Here we show that evaporation-induced liquid-liquid phase separation in all aqueous polymer and protein mixtures provides a simple one-step route to multifunctional micromotors. During droplet evaporation, micron-sized condensates spontaneously form and encapsulate enzymes, nanoparticles, and drugs. Evaporation-induced Marangoni flows and interfacial adsorption generate asymmetric internal self-organization of nanoparticles, producing Janus-like architectures and spontaneously emergent shape anisotropy without the need for patterned fabrication. Dual functionality with internal magnetic anisotropy allowed catalytic propulsion steered by magnetic torque, enabling directional motion even in homogeneous environments. Thus, we present a versatile platform for the one-step construction of biocompatible, multifunctional micromotors with internally asymmetric architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：one-step route、fabrication、self-organization、experimental demonstration。；研究对象：基于蒸发诱导液-液相分离（liquid-liquid phase separation）自组装形成的多功能微马达（micromotors），具体体系为全水相聚合物与蛋白质混合物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过简单的蒸发诱导液-液相分离，可一步自组织形成具有Janus-like不对称结构的多功能微马达，该微马达兼具催化推进与磁控导向的双重功能，能在均匀环境中实现定向运动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过简单的蒸发诱导液-液相分离，可一步自组织形成具有Janus-like不对称结构的多功能微马达，该微马达兼具催化推进与磁控导向的双重功能，能在均匀环境中实现定向运动。；创新点：提出一种无需复杂多步加工、无需图案化制备的一步法自组装策略，直接构建具有内部不对称结构的生物相容性多功能微马达，并实现催化与磁控双功能协同。
papers.method_zh: 利用液滴蒸发过程中的Marangoni流与界面吸附效应，实现纳米颗粒、酶和药物的自发封装与内部不对称自组织；通过引入磁性纳米颗粒赋予内部磁各向异性，结合催化反应实现磁力矩导向的定向运动。

papers.title: Energetics of Nucleation in Finitely Deformed, Phase-Transforming Soft Solids
papers.abstract: Classical nucleation theory describes the rate at which stable nuclei form within a metastable parent phase by crossing a free-energy barrier set by competing bulk and interfacial energies. In an elastic material, a pre-existing stress state modifies this barrier through an elastic contribution to the bulk driving force. This contribution is well characterized for linear elastic materials, but the corresponding finite-deformation result for soft solids remains less developed. The gap is computationally significant: in simulations that sample candidate nuclei throughout a stressed body, direct evaluation of the elastic contribution to free-energy change would require solving a new nonlinear elasticity boundary-value problem for each possible nucleus. Here, we derive an asymptotic expansion of the equilibrium elastic potential energy change for a hyperelastic body before and after formation of a small transformed region. The expansion is with respect to the amplitude of an isotropic transformation strain, while the pre-existing deformation and stress may be finite. At leading order, the elastic contribution to the formation energy is determined entirely by the known untransformed equilibrium fields, with additional terms accounting for stiffness contrast between the parent and transformed phases. Incorporating this into classical nucleation theory yields the stress-shifted transformation temperature, critical radius, and nucleation barrier. Representative results are shown for a compressible neo-Hookean solid under hydrostatic, uniaxial, and equibiaxial loading; tensile stresses promote nucleation and compressive stresses suppress it when transformation strain is expansive. Comparison with the corresponding linear-elastic result shows that finite-deformation effects can substantially change the predicted energy barrier at moderate stretches.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“derive an asymptotic expansion”“classical nucleation theory”等理论推导和建模方法，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：有限变形下发生相变的软固体（soft solids）中的成核过程（nucleation），具体为超弹性材料（hyperelastic body）在有限预变形和应力下形成小转变区域（small transformed region）的成核能垒。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导了有限变形超弹性体中形成小转变区域时弹性势能变化的渐近展开式，发现有限变形效应在中等拉伸下可显著改变线性弹性理论预测的成核能垒；拉伸应力促进成核，压缩应力抑制成核（当转变应变为膨胀性时）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导了有限变形超弹性体中形成小转变区域时弹性势能变化的渐近展开式，发现有限变形效应在中等拉伸下可显著改变线性弹性理论预测的成核能垒；拉伸应力促进成核，压缩应力抑制成核（当转变应变为膨胀性时）。；创新点：将经典成核理论中弹性贡献的处理从线性弹性推广到有限变形情形，推导出仅依赖已知未转变平衡场的渐近表达式，避免了为每个候选核求解非线性弹性边值问题的计算开销。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 基于经典成核理论（classical nucleation theory），结合非线性弹性力学，对超弹性体在有限预变形和应力下形成小转变区域前后的平衡弹性势能变化进行渐近展开（asymptotic expansion），展开参数为各向同性转变应变（isotropic transformation strain）的振幅。考虑了母相与转变相之间的刚度对比（stiffness contrast），并应用于可压缩neo-Hookean固体在静水、单轴和等双轴加载下的成核分析。

papers.title: Edge slip stabilizes confined active vortices by suppressing localized instabilities
papers.abstract: Confined active systems can sustain persistent vortical flows whose stability is strongly influenced by boundary conditions. At the individual level, active units generate internal stresses that drive spontaneous flows, which in turn advect and reorient the particles. This nonlinear coupling between active flow and orientational order is significantly mediated by the system's boundaries, where the specific slip condition governs how these internal stresses generate active flow then rearrange the local orientations. However, a quantitative understanding of how boundary slip dictates their dynamical stability remains lacking. Here, we study how the slip boundary condition controls the stability of a steady vortex state in a circularly confined active nematic system. Using a continuum model in a flow-dominated regime, we perform a linear stability analysis and derive an explicit criterion incorporating the slip velocity and flow-alignment coupling. We find that increasing slip velocity suppresses localized linear instabilities, thereby promoting the persistence of the steady vortex state. This reveals a relaxing the boundary friction actually stabilizes the macroscopic coherent structure by depressing flow induced reorientation that typically destroys single-vortex states. Our findings establish boundary slip as a nontrivial hydrodynamic control parameter for engineering stable active flows.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“continuum model”（连续模型）、“linear stability analysis”（线性稳定性分析）、“derive an explicit criterion”（推导显式判据）。；研究对象：受限活性向列相体系中的稳态涡旋，具体为圆环形边界约束下的活性向列系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 增大边界滑移速度可以抑制局域线性不稳定性，从而促进稳态涡旋的持续存在；放松边界摩擦实际上通过抑制流动诱导的重新取向来稳定宏观相干结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：增大边界滑移速度可以抑制局域线性不稳定性，从而促进稳态涡旋的持续存在；放松边界摩擦实际上通过抑制流动诱导的重新取向来稳定宏观相干结构。；创新点：将边界滑移确立为一种非平庸的流体动力学控制参数，用于工程化稳定活性流动。摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用流主导区域的连续介质模型，进行线性稳定性分析，推导出包含滑移速度与流动-取向耦合的显式稳定性判据。

papers.title: Supermoiré Chern mosaic in helical trilayer WSe2
papers.abstract: Helically twisted multilayers offer access to moiré physics beyond the single-superlattice paradigm, yet their correlated and topological transport properties remain largely unexplored in semiconductor moiré materials. Here we report magnetotransport measurements of helical trilayer WSe2, in which two coupled moiré patterns relax into a supermoiré landscape composed of inequivalent local topological domains with distinct electronic structures and unequal spatial areas. By electrostatic tuning, we identify a trilayer-hybridized regime where interactions and real-space reconstruction combine to generate a plethora of magnetic and topological states absent in the twisted bilayers. At moiré filling factor $ν$ = -1, we observe a ferromagnetic insulating state that is robust against magnetic field and accompanied by a non-quantized anomalous Hall response ~-4 kOhms. This behaviour is consistent with a time-reversal-symmetry-breaking supermoiré Chern mosaic, in which the Hall response arises from the non-cancelling contributions of local domains with opposite Chern character arranged by the relaxed structure. Under strong magnetic fields, a symmetry-broken Chern insulating state (C = 1) emerges near $ν$ = -2/3, displaying a much larger positive Hall response together with strongly enhanced longitudinal resistance, suggestive of field-reconstructed topological minibands and domain-boundary scattering. These results establish relaxed supermoiré semiconductor trilayers as a platform for spatially organized magnetism and topology beyond the bilayer limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：magnetotransport measurements、报告（report）磁输运测量结果。；研究对象：螺旋三层WSe2（helical trilayer WSe2）中的超莫尔条纹（supermoiré）拓扑与磁性输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在螺旋三层WSe2中，通过静电调控进入三层杂化区域，在莫尔填充因子ν=-1处观察到铁磁绝缘态及非量子化的反常霍尔响应（~-4 kOhms），符合时间反演对称性破缺的超莫尔Chern镶嵌（supermoiré Chern mosaic）图像；在强磁场下，ν=-2/3附近出现对称性破缺的Chern绝缘态（C=1），伴随增强的正霍尔响应和纵向电阻。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在螺旋三层WSe2中，通过静电调控进入三层杂化区域，在莫尔填充因子ν=-1处观察到铁磁绝缘态及非量子化的反常霍尔响应（~-4 kOhms），符合时间反演对称性破缺的超莫尔Chern镶嵌（supermoiré Chern mosaic）图像；在强磁场下，ν=-2/3附近出现对称性破缺的Chern绝缘态（C=1），伴随增强的正霍尔响应和纵向电阻。；创新点：首次在半导体莫尔材料中实验探索螺旋扭转多层体系（helically twisted multilayers）的关联与拓扑输运性质，揭示了超越双层极限的、由结构弛豫产生的超莫尔景观（supermoiré landscape）中局域拓扑畴的不等价贡献，以及由此产生的丰富磁性和拓扑态。
papers.method_zh: 磁输运测量（magnetotransport measurements），结合静电调控（electrostatic tuning）改变莫尔填充因子。

papers.title: Superheating field of clean superconductors near the type-I--type-II boundary: the low-temperature Meissner stability limit of niobium
papers.abstract: We calculate the low-temperature superheating field $B_{\rm sh}$ of clean superconductors near the boundary between type-I and type-II superconductivity, with particular emphasis on Nb. The calculation is based on the self-consistent nonlinear nonlocal Eilenberger theory and the linear stability analysis of the Meissner state. For a Nb-like material with $κ_{\rm GL}=0.7$, we obtain $B_{\rm sh}\simeq 290\,{\rm mT}$ at $T/T_c=0.2$, using $B_{c0}\simeq 200\,{\rm mT}$. This value is substantially higher than the value obtained by naively extrapolating the Ginzburg--Landau result near $T_c$ to $T\ll T_c$. For a TESLA-shaped Nb accelerator cavity, it corresponds to an intrinsic Meissner-stability limit of about $67\,{\rm MV/m}$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：calculate, self-consistent nonlinear nonlocal Eilenberger theory, linear stability analysis）；研究对象：清洁超导体在I型与II型超导边界附近的过热场，特别关注铌（Nb）材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于类铌材料（κ_GL=0.7），在T/T_c=0.2时，过热场B_sh约为290 mT，显著高于从Ginzburg-Landau理论在T_c附近结果直接外推到低温所得到的值；对于TESLA形状的铌加速腔，这对应约67 MV/m的内禀Meissner稳定性极限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于类铌材料（κ_GL=0.7），在T/T_c=0.2时，过热场B_sh约为290 mT，显著高于从Ginzburg-Landau理论在T_c附近结果直接外推到低温所得到的值；对于TESLA形状的铌加速腔，这对应约67 MV/m的内禀Meissner稳定性极限。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于自洽非线性非局域Eilenberger理论，结合Meissner态的线性稳定性分析进行计算。

papers.title: Antiferromagnetic order and magnetic polarons in lightly doped Li$_x$CoO$_2$ (x $\sim$ 0.9)
papers.abstract: We investigate the magnetic properties of Li$_x$CoO$_2$ (x$\sim$0.9) using bulk magnetization, specific heat, nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) and electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) spectroscopy measurements. The dc magnetization, specific heat and NMR measurements, which probe the macroscopic response, indeed show that this compound partially undergoes an antiferromagnetic transition below $T_N \sim$ 10 K. In addition, we observed a weak ferromagnetic response, which gives rise to the history dependence in magnetization measurements at low fields and is observed at temperatures above room temperature. We propose that there are ferromagnetic clusters at high temperatures due to the formation of magnetic polarons out of doped holes. In EPR measurements performed at the $X$-band frequency, only a fraction of the total spins contribute and show Curie-like paramagnetic behavior as reflected in the temperature dependence of the EPR intensity. The temperature variation of the EPR spectra can be understood in the framework of the diffusion of magnetic polarons.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到了使用多种实验测量手段（bulk magnetization, specific heat, NMR, EPR）。；研究对象：轻度掺杂的锂钴氧化物 LiₓCoO₂ (x ~ 0.9) 的磁性质，具体包括其反铁磁序和磁极化子行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该化合物在约10 K以下部分发生反铁磁转变，同时存在由掺杂空穴形成的磁极化子导致的弱铁磁响应，该响应在室温以上仍可观测到。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该化合物在约10 K以下部分发生反铁磁转变，同时存在由掺杂空穴形成的磁极化子导致的弱铁磁响应，该响应在室温以上仍可观测到。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 体磁化率测量、比热测量、核磁共振（NMR）和电子顺磁共振（EPR）光谱测量。

papers.title: Higher-winding phases in one-dimensional non-Hermitian topological superconductors
papers.abstract: Non-Hermitian topological superconductors provide a setting in which point-gap topology, non-Hermitian skin effects, and Majorana zero modes are strongly intertwined. In this work, we adopt a coefficient-based approach for computing winding numbers and deriving analytical expressions for phase boundaries in one-dimensional non-Hermitian topological superconductors characterized by point-gap topology with $\mathbb{Z}$ invariants. We apply this approach to two non-Hermitian topological superconducting lattice models, with and without sublattice degrees of freedom, including longer-range hoppings, thereby accessing a much broader parameter space. These extensions generate higher-order polynomials and support phases with higher winding numbers, reflecting the underlying $\mathbb{Z}$ topology. We further clarify how a weak perturbation suppresses the non-Hermitian skin effect while preserving the sublattice-symmetry-protected invariant associated with Majorana zero modes. The predicted winding numbers are verified by open-boundary spectra, where one or multiple pairs of zero-energy boundary modes appear consistently with the bulk invariant. We also examine the stability of these modes against onsite disorder through the inverse participation ratio. Our results provide a systematic and efficient route to constructing topological phase diagrams for higher-winding non-Hermitian topological superconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：计算 winding numbers、推导解析表达式、构建相图。；研究对象：一维非厄米拓扑超导体，特别是具有点隙拓扑（point-gap topology）和 $\mathbb{Z}$ 拓扑不变量、支持高缠绕数（higher-winding）相位的系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过一种基于系数的方法，在包含长程跃迁的一维非厄米拓扑超导晶格模型中，发现了支持更高缠绕数的拓扑相，并揭示了弱扰动如何抑制非厄米趋肤效应，同时保持与马约拉纳零模相关的子晶格对称性保护不变量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过一种基于系数的方法，在包含长程跃迁的一维非厄米拓扑超导晶格模型中，发现了支持更高缠绕数的拓扑相，并揭示了弱扰动如何抑制非厄米趋肤效应，同时保持与马约拉纳零模相关的子晶格对称性保护不变量。；创新点：提出了一种系统且高效的方法来构建具有高缠绕数的非厄米拓扑超导体的拓扑相图，该方法能够处理包含长程跃迁的更大参数空间，从而揭示出更高阶的 $\mathbb{Z}$ 拓扑相。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于多项式系数的解析方法计算缠绕数并推导相边界解析表达式。应用于两个具体的非厄米拓扑超导晶格模型（含或不含子晶格自由度，并包含长程跃迁）。通过开边界能谱验证体边对应关系，并利用逆参与率（inverse participation ratio）检验零能边界模对无序的稳定性。

papers.title: Improved selector behavior in ultrathin chromium-doped V$_2$O$_3$ films
papers.abstract: Devices based on the negative differential resistance effect in chromium doped V$_2$O$_3$ are considered to be promising as selector elements for use in emerging memory technologies, as well as for neuromorphic applications. It is shown by electrical measurements, that the switching effect is maintained for very thin films down to 5 nm, and even improved properties such as a low leakage current and an abrupt transition are observed. For these thicknesses, the behavior of crystalline and amorphous films becomes very similar; most strikingly, a forming step is required in both. Transmission electron microscopy reveals this to be likely due to a thin amorphous layer that forms at the interface to the TiN electrode. Elemental mapping further shows a complex distribution of the chromium dopants, as well as a diffusion of Ti into the layer from the electrode, which might be responsible for the improved properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“electrical measurements”、“Transmission electron microscopy”、“Elemental mapping”等实验手段。；研究对象：铬掺杂V₂O₃（Cr-doped V₂O₃）超薄膜中的负微分电阻效应及其在选通器件中的应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在厚度低至5 nm的铬掺杂V₂O₃薄膜中，开关效应得以保持，且表现出更低的漏电流和更陡峭的转变特性；同时，晶体和非晶薄膜在该厚度下行为趋于一致，均需要形成步骤。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在厚度低至5 nm的铬掺杂V₂O₃薄膜中，开关效应得以保持，且表现出更低的漏电流和更陡峭的转变特性；同时，晶体和非晶薄膜在该厚度下行为趋于一致，均需要形成步骤。；创新点：首次系统研究了超薄（5 nm）铬掺杂V₂O₃薄膜的选通性能，发现其性能反而优于较厚薄膜，并揭示了界面非晶层形成和Ti扩散可能是性能改善的原因。摘要未突出说明与更厚薄膜或未掺杂体系的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 电学测量（I-V特性测试）、透射电子显微镜（TEM）、元素映射（Elemental mapping）分析薄膜微观结构与元素分布。

papers.title: Neural electron backscatter diffraction
papers.abstract: In a polycrystalline microstructure, orientation and dislocation content vary smoothly within grains, and the grain boundaries between them are continuous curves. Electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD) records this continuum on a discrete grid with every subsequent analysis (from indexing to advanced pattern processing) confined to that grid. We introduce neural EBSD, which treats an EBSD scan as a continuous, differentiable four-dimensional field of Kikuchi diffraction intensity (in specimen--detector domain) and then represents it with a coordinate-based neural network. We develop and compare two formulations: a joint formulation that maps all four coordinates to intensity, and a factorized formulation that combines continuous specimen-domain coefficient fields with learned detector-domain basis patterns. Tested on recrystallized and additively manufactured Inconel 718, the factorized formulation shows better accuracy in reconstructing Kikuchi patterns that have map-averaged errors below 1% of the maximum intensity. Beyond reconstruction, it provides full-pattern super-resolution in the specimen frame, continuous querying along arbitrary off-grid paths, as well as spatially continuous boundary and heterogeneity localization from analytical spatial derivatives. Storing the network weights and learned bases in place of the raw patterns in a large dataset offers a 700-fold compression while preserving on-demand access to the full patterns for downstream analyses.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/方法文章。关键词：coordinate-based neural network、representation、reconstruction、compression。；研究对象：多晶微结构中的电子背散射衍射（EBSD）数据，具体材料为再结晶和增材制造的Inconel 718镍基高温合金。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于坐标神经网络的“神经EBSD”方法，将离散的EBSD扫描数据表示为连续可微的四维菊池衍射强度场，其中分解式公式在重建菊池图案时精度最高（全图平均误差低于最大强度的1%），并实现700倍的数据压缩。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于坐标神经网络的“神经EBSD”方法，将离散的EBSD扫描数据表示为连续可微的四维菊池衍射强度场，其中分解式公式在重建菊池图案时精度最高（全图平均误差低于最大强度的1%），并实现700倍的数据压缩。；创新点：首次将EBSD扫描数据从离散网格表示转化为连续可微的神经场表示，从而支持全图案超分辨率、任意离网格路径的连续查询、以及基于解析空间导数的连续边界和异质性定位，同时实现大幅数据压缩。
papers.method_zh: 采用坐标神经网络（coordinate-based neural network）对EBSD数据进行连续表示。开发并比较了两种公式：联合公式（joint formulation）将全部四个坐标（样品域二维+探测器域二维）直接映射到强度；分解式公式（factorized formulation）将连续的样品域系数场与学习到的探测器域基函数模式相结合。

papers.title: Magnetic HIP-NN for spin dynamics in disordered itinerant magnets
papers.abstract: We present a magnetic extension of the Hierarchically Interacting Particle Neural Network (HIP-NN) that enables large-scale simulations of electron-mediated spin dynamics in disordered itinerant magnets. The resulting magnetic HIP-NN (mHIP-NN) incorporates rotationally invariant spin correlations directly into hierarchical message-passing layers, enabling the network to learn emergent magnetic energy landscapes and effective local fields from coupled geometric-spin environments while preserving spin-rotation symmetry. As a benchmark application, we consider structurally disordered itinerant $s$-$d$ exchange models in which the effective magnetic forces arise dynamically from the instantaneous electronic structure and are computationally prohibitive to evaluate using conventional exact-diagonalization-based approaches. We show that mHIP-NN accurately reproduces the local torques governing Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert dynamics and faithfully captures the nonequilibrium evolution of spatial spin correlations following thermal quenches. Our results establish symmetry-aware hierarchical message-passing networks as an efficient and scalable framework for large-scale simulations of frustrated itinerant spin systems and nonequilibrium magnetic dynamics. More broadly, because the learned energy functional remains fully differentiable with respect to both atomic coordinates and spin variables, the framework also provides a natural foundation for spin-dependent interatomic potentials and coupled atom-spin dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据关键词：neural network、simulations、computationally prohibitive、conventional exact-diagonalization-based approaches。；研究对象：无序巡游磁体中的电子介导自旋动力学，具体以结构无序的巡游 s-d 交换模型为基准应用体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出的磁性层级相互作用粒子神经网络（mHIP-NN）能够准确再现控制朗道-利夫希茨-吉尔伯特（LLG）动力学的局域力矩，并忠实捕捉热淬火后空间自旋关联的非平衡演化，为大规模模拟受挫巡游自旋系统和非平衡磁动力学提供了高效可扩展框架。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出的磁性层级相互作用粒子神经网络（mHIP-NN）能够准确再现控制朗道-利夫希茨-吉尔伯特（LLG）动力学的局域力矩，并忠实捕捉热淬火后空间自旋关联的非平衡演化，为大规模模拟受挫巡游自旋系统和非平衡磁动力学提供了高效可扩展框架。；创新点：将旋转对称性感知的层级消息传递网络首次应用于巡游磁体的自旋动力学模拟，使得学习到的能量泛函对原子坐标和自旋变量完全可微，为自旋依赖的原子间势和耦合原子-自旋动力学提供了自然基础。
papers.method_zh: 采用层级相互作用粒子神经网络（HIP-NN）的磁性扩展版本（mHIP-NN），在层级消息传递层中直接融入旋转不变的自旋关联，学习耦合几何-自旋环境中的涌现磁能量景观和有效局域场，并保持自旋旋转对称性。

papers.title: Vortex pinning of Ba$_{0.62}$K$_{0.38}$BiO$_3$ investigated by magneto-optical Kerr-effect and magnetization measurements
papers.abstract: Vortex pinning plays a crucial role in determining properties of type-II superconductors. For example, it governs the irreversible magnetic response as well as dissipation caused by vortex motion. Here, we study vortex pinning in the three-dimensional oxide superconductor Ba1-xKxBiO3 using ultra-high-resolution magneto-optical Kerr effect (MOKE) and detailed magnetization measurements. We find that the zero-field MOKE signal in the superconducting state exhibits a pronounced magnetic-history dependence. This behavior closely resembles the remanent magnetization caused by trapped vortices. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the observed evolution of the MOKE signals is well described by Bean's critical-state model for trapped vortices. Our results establish MOKE as a viable optical and mesoscopic probe of vortex pinning in type-II superconductors, providing a new complementary approach to investigate mixed-state phenomena. We also find that the training-field dependence of the MOKE is linear near zero training field, without any anomalies indicative of spontaneous time-reversal-symmetry breaking in an unconventional superconducting state. Our study defines a clear protocol to distinguish vortex-induced MOKE responses from those associated with a time-reversal-symmetry broken superconducting order parameter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：magneto-optical Kerr-effect (MOKE) measurements, magnetization measurements。；研究对象：三维氧化物超导体 Ba₁₋ₓKₓBiO₃（具体成分为 Ba₀.₆₂K₀.₃₈BiO₃）中的涡旋钉扎（vortex pinning）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 零场下的磁光克尔效应（MOKE）信号在超导态中表现出显著的磁历史依赖性，该行为与俘获涡旋引起的剩磁高度相似，且可用 Bean 临界态模型很好地描述。此外，训练场依赖关系在零场附近呈线性，未发现任何表明非常规超导态中自发时间反演对称性破缺的异常。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：零场下的磁光克尔效应（MOKE）信号在超导态中表现出显著的磁历史依赖性，该行为与俘获涡旋引起的剩磁高度相似，且可用 Bean 临界态模型很好地描述。此外，训练场依赖关系在零场附近呈线性，未发现任何表明非常规超导态中自发时间反演对称性破缺的异常。；创新点：建立了 MOKE 作为一种可行的光学和介观尺度探针来研究第二类超导体的涡旋钉扎，提供了一种新的互补方法。同时，明确区分了涡旋诱导的 MOKE 响应与时间反演对称性破缺超导序参量引起的 MOKE 响应的实验判据。
papers.method_zh: 超高分辨率磁光克尔效应（MOKE）测量和详细的磁化强度（magnetization）测量，并结合 Bean 临界态模型进行理论描述。

papers.title: Coherent manipulation of Kondo Majoranas in two-channel Kondo setups
papers.abstract: We study coherent manipulation of Majorana zero modes emerging in overscreened two-channel Kondo systems. Using compactified lattice models, we show that these interacting Kondo Majoranas support non-local qubits and admit teleportation, fusion, and braiding operations. In particular, we identify a distinction between non-topological and genuinely topological Y-junction geometries, the latter realizing a non-Abelian geometric holonomy. Our results establish a proof-of-principle route toward coherent control of non-Abelian anyons beyond conventional free-fermion platforms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：overscreened two-channel Kondo systems、compactified lattice models、non-Abelian geometric holonomy。；研究对象：过屏蔽双通道近藤体系中涌现的马约拉纳零模，以及基于这些相互作用马约拉纳零模的非局域量子比特、隐形传态、融合和编织操作。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了在过屏蔽双通道近藤体系中，可以通过紧凑化格点模型实现对马约拉纳零模的相干操控，并区分了非拓扑与真正拓扑的Y型结几何结构，后者可实现非阿贝尔几何相位。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了在过屏蔽双通道近藤体系中，可以通过紧凑化格点模型实现对马约拉纳零模的相干操控，并区分了非拓扑与真正拓扑的Y型结几何结构，后者可实现非阿贝尔几何相位。；创新点：在相互作用近藤体系中实现了对非阿贝尔任意子的相干控制，超越了传统的自由费米子平台，并首次区分了非拓扑与拓扑Y型结几何结构在实现非阿贝尔几何相位上的本质差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用紧凑化格点模型（compactified lattice models）进行理论分析，研究马约拉纳零模的量子比特构造、隐形传态、融合和编织操作。

papers.title: Robust AI-Driven Discovery of Electronic Metal Phosphide Semiconductors
papers.abstract: Metal phosphides have diverse bonding motifs and coordination environments, making them promising for optoelectronic and thermoelectric applications, but their chemical space remains underexplored. Here we report an AI-driven high-throughput discovery workflow that combines generative materials design, machine-learning interatomic potentials, and targeted density functional theory (DFT) calculations. ICSD-derived Wyckoff-site substitution and MatterGen-based conditional structure generation are used to expand the candidate space beyond existing phosphide databases. A domain-finetuned DPA3 machine-learning potential then enables efficient prescreening of thermodynamic and dynamical stability before DFT validation. This workflow identifies 3,574 previously unreported stable phosphide structures, including 196 semiconductors with HSE06 band gaps of 0-3.0 eV. By screening these new semiconductors together with experimentally known phosphide semiconductors, we identify 30 promising optoelectronic candidates and 26 promising thermoelectric candidates, including seven newly discovered optoelectronic materials and eight newly discovered thermoelectric materials. These results provide a candidate pool for experimental synthesis and show that combining generative AI with machine-learning interatomic potentials can accelerate the discovery of functional semiconductor materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：AI-driven high-throughput discovery, machine-learning interatomic potentials, density functional theory (DFT) calculations）；研究对象：电子金属磷化物半导体（Electronic Metal Phosphide Semiconductors），具体为通过AI方法预测的新型稳定磷化物结构及其在光电和热电领域的候选材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过结合生成式AI和机器学习势能的高通量工作流，发现了3,574种此前未报道的稳定磷化物结构，并从中筛选出196种带隙在0-3.0 eV的半导体，最终识别出30种有前景的光电候选材料和26种热电候选材料，其中包括7种新发现的光电材料和8种新发现的热电材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过结合生成式AI和机器学习势能的高通量工作流，发现了3,574种此前未报道的稳定磷化物结构，并从中筛选出196种带隙在0-3.0 eV的半导体，最终识别出30种有前景的光电候选材料和26种热电候选材料，其中包括7种新发现的光电材料和8种新发现的热电材料。；创新点：该工作首次将生成式AI（MatterGen）与领域微调的机器学习势能（DPA3）相结合，构建了一个完整的高通量工作流，用于系统性地探索此前未被充分研究的金属磷化物化学空间，并成功预测了大量此前未知的稳定半导体结构。
papers.method_zh: 采用了一种结合生成式材料设计、机器学习原子间势能和目标密度泛函理论（DFT）计算的高通量发现工作流。具体包括：1）基于ICSD的Wyckoff位点替换和MatterGen的条件结构生成来扩展候选空间；2）使用领域微调的DPA3机器学习势能进行热力学和动力学稳定性的高效预筛选；3）通过DFT（HSE06）进行最终验证并计算带隙。

papers.title: Finite-temperature Fe K-edge X-ray absorption simulations reveal local structural dynamics of an iron(II) photosensitizer in solution and the crystalline phase
papers.abstract: Interpreting metal K-edge spectra of flexible photosensitizers requires a structural model that separates electronic signatures from thermal motion, solvent disorder, and crystal-packing effects. We combine Fe K-edge X-ray absorption measurements with second-generation Car--Parrinello ab initio molecular dynamics and all-electron Gaussian and augmented-plane-wave simulations for an iron(II) N-heterocyclic carbene photosensitizer in acetonitrile solution and in the crystalline phase. Ensemble-averaged spectra reproduce the main near-edge features in both environments and preserve the experimentally observed similarity of the first Fe coordination shell upon dissolution. Comparison with radial distributions extracted from extended fine-structure measurements validates the Fe--N and Fe--C coordination shells sampled by the trajectories, while element-resolved pair distributions explain why higher-shell experimental contrast is rapidly lost. The same dynamical ensembles reveal a broad out-of-plane distribution of the terpyridine nitrogen atom and a nearly octahedral distribution of the Fe-centered coordination planes. The results show that finite-temperature X-ray absorption simulations can provide a compact structural-dynamics picture of molecular transition metal photosensitizers by linking local spectra, solvent-phase ligand motion, and medium-range structural disorder within one trajectory-based description.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。关键词：X-ray absorption measurements、Car–Parrinello ab initio molecular dynamics、all-electron Gaussian and augmented-plane-wave simulations。；研究对象：一种铁(II) N-杂环卡宾光敏剂在乙腈溶液和晶相中的局域结构动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 有限温度下的系综平均X射线吸收谱能同时再现溶液和晶相中近边特征，并保留第一Fe配位壳层在溶解前后的相似性；轨迹揭示了terpyridine氮原子的宽面外分布和Fe中心配位平面的近八面体分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：有限温度下的系综平均X射线吸收谱能同时再现溶液和晶相中近边特征，并保留第一Fe配位壳层在溶解前后的相似性；轨迹揭示了terpyridine氮原子的宽面外分布和Fe中心配位平面的近八面体分布。；创新点：将有限温度X射线吸收模拟与单一轨迹描述相结合，同时关联局域谱学、溶剂相配体运动和中程结构无序，为分子过渡金属光敏剂提供紧凑的结构动力学图像。
papers.method_zh: Fe K边X射线吸收实验测量；第二代Car–Parrinello从头算分子动力学；全电子高斯与增广平面波模拟。

papers.title: Graphlet Histogram Representation Database of Inorganic Crystals
papers.abstract: Machine learning models for materials property prediction increasingly rely on representations learned end-to-end from large density-functional-theory databases, limiting their applicability when only scarce experimental data are available. Domain-knowledge-driven representations precomputed from crystal structures alone offer a data-efficient, interpretable alternative, but existing approaches capture at most composition or bonding connectivity and discard local structural geometry. Here, we present Graphlet-MP, a database of graphlet histogram representations for 149,082 inorganic crystals from the Materials Project (MP). Seventy-nine distributions describe each material over three hierarchical graphlet orders: atomic sites, bonded pairs, and bond-angle triplets, extracted via screened Voronoi tessellation from the crystallographic information file. We provide a complete technical specification of the representation, an Earth Mover's Distance metric for comparing materials in this space, and the full precomputed database. An accompanying open-source codebase enables users to generate graphlet histograms for arbitrary crystal structures, including experimentally determined ones, and to extend the database to new materials or target properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/数据驱动文章。判断依据：关键词“machine learning models”、“density-functional-theory databases”、“precomputed database”、“open-source codebase”。；研究对象：无机晶体材料的结构表示方法。具体为来自Materials Project数据库的149,082种无机晶体，以及任意晶体结构的图元直方图表示。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于图元直方图的晶体结构表示方法（Graphlet-MP），通过三个层次（原子位点、成键对、键角三元组）的79种分布描述材料，为数据稀缺条件下的材料性质预测提供了一种数据高效、可解释的替代方案。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于图元直方图的晶体结构表示方法（Graphlet-MP），通过三个层次（原子位点、成键对、键角三元组）的79种分布描述材料，为数据稀缺条件下的材料性质预测提供了一种数据高效、可解释的替代方案。；创新点：现有方法最多只捕捉组成或键合连通性，忽略了局部结构几何信息。本工作首次将图元直方图表示系统应用于大量无机晶体，并提供了完整的数据库和可扩展工具。
papers.method_zh: 采用筛选后的Voronoi镶嵌方法从晶体学信息文件中提取结构信息，构建图元直方图表示；使用推土机距离（Earth Mover's Distance）作为材料间相似性度量；提供完整预计算数据库及开源代码库。

papers.title: Pressure-Driven Structural Phase Competition and Functional Response in Layered LiInP2S6
papers.abstract: Understanding how hydrostatic pressure modifies interlayer interactions and competing ionic configurations is essential for controlling the emergent functional properties of layered quantum materials. Here, using first-principles density-functional theory calculations, we investigate the pressure-dependent structural, mechanical, electronic, and optical properties of three competing LiInP2S6 polymorphs: the monoclinic C2/c phase and the trigonal P-31c phase in both in-layer and in-gap configurations. Our results reveal a pressure-induced structural phase transition from the monoclinic ground-state C2/c phase to a trigonal P-31c in-layer phase at ~0.38 GPa, driven by enhanced interlayer coupling and anisotropic lattice compression. In contrast, the trigonal P-31c in-gap phase remains energetically unfavorable due to its stronger interlayer ionic interactions and reduced compressibility. All phases remain mechanically stable under compression (0-26 GPa) and exhibit enhanced mechanical rigidity, elastic wave velocities, and Debye temperatures with increasing pressure. Remarkably, the electronic and optical properties within each phase remain highly robust under pressure, with only moderate changes in the band gap and optical absorption edge (UV-Visible range) under pressure; however, substantial modifications emerge across the pressure-induced structural phase transition. These findings establish LiInP2S6 as a pressure sensitive ionic-vdW material in which subtle changes in interlayer interactions govern structural stability and functional properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：first-principles density-functional theory calculations（第一性原理密度泛函理论计算）。；研究对象：层状材料LiInP2S6的三种竞争多型（polymorphs）：单斜C2/c相、三角P-31c相（层内构型与层间构型），以及压力诱导的结构相变与功能响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在约0.38 GPa压力下，LiInP2S6从单斜C2/c基态相转变为三角P-31c层内相，该相变由增强的层间耦合和各向异性晶格压缩驱动；各相在0-26 GPa范围内保持力学稳定，电子和光学性质在相变前后发生显著变化，但在同一相内对压力高度鲁棒。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在约0.38 GPa压力下，LiInP2S6从单斜C2/c基态相转变为三角P-31c层内相，该相变由增强的层间耦合和各向异性晶格压缩驱动；各相在0-26 GPa范围内保持力学稳定，电子和光学性质在相变前后发生显著变化，但在同一相内对压力高度鲁棒。；创新点：揭示了LiInP2S6作为压力敏感的离子-范德瓦尔斯（ionic-vdW）材料，其层间相互作用的微小变化即可调控结构稳定性与功能性质，并首次明确了低压下（~0.38 GPa）的竞争相变路径。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，具体为基于平面波赝势方法的计算，用于研究压力依赖的结构、力学、电子和光学性质。

papers.title: Microscopic Investigation of the Superconducting State in CuCo$_{2}$S$_{4}$: Evidence for an Intermediate-Coupling Fully Gapped Superconductor
papers.abstract: The thiospinel compound CuCo$_2$S$_4$ provides an attractive platform for exploring superconductivity in transition-metal chalcogenide spinels. Here, we report the first microscopic investigation of the superconducting state in CuCo$_2$S$_4$ using muon spin rotation and relaxation ($μ$SR) measurements, complemented by magnetization and heat-capacity experiments. The temperature dependence of the superconducting depolarization rate obtained from transverse-field $μ$SR measurements indicates a fully gapped superconducting order parameter. The extracted gap ratio $2Δ(0)/(k_{\mathrm{B}}T_\mathrm{SC}) = 3.95(2)$ exceeds the BCS weak-coupling value of 3.53, placing CuCo$_2$S$_4$ in the intermediate electron-phonon coupling regime. Zero-field $μ$SR measurements were performed to probe possible time-reversal symmetry breaking (TRSB) in the superconducting state. Within the experimental resolution, no additional spontaneous internal magnetic fields are observed below $T_c$. However, due to the presence of a ferromagnetic impurity phase and the associated fast-relaxing signal component, the sensitivity of the present measurements to weak spontaneous fields is reduced. Consequently, while no evidence for TRSB is detected, its existence cannot be definitively ruled out. Overall, our combined thermodynamic and $μ$SR results demonstrate that CuCo$_2$S$_4$ exhibits a fully gapped superconducting state with intermediate coupling strength, consistent with conventional $s$-wave superconductivity in this cobalt-based thiospinel system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：muon spin rotation and relaxation (μSR) measurements, magnetization and heat-capacity experiments。；研究对象：硫尖晶石化合物 CuCo₂S₄ 的超导态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CuCo₂S₄ 是一个完全能隙的超导体，其能隙比 2Δ(0)/(k_B T_SC) = 3.95(2) 超过 BCS 弱耦合值，属于中等电子-声子耦合强度；零场 μSR 未探测到超导态中时间反演对称性破缺的证据，但由于铁磁杂质相的存在，无法完全排除其可能性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CuCo₂S₄ 是一个完全能隙的超导体，其能隙比 2Δ(0)/(k_B T_SC) = 3.95(2) 超过 BCS 弱耦合值，属于中等电子-声子耦合强度；零场 μSR 未探测到超导态中时间反演对称性破缺的证据，但由于铁磁杂质相的存在，无法完全排除其可能性。；创新点：首次对 CuCo₂S₄ 超导态进行微观尺度的 μSR 研究，揭示了其完全能隙和中等耦合特性，并初步探测了时间反演对称性破缺的可能性。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用 μSR（包括横向场和零场测量），辅以磁化率和比热实验。

papers.title: Beyond the Markovian limit: Exact solutions for active motion in a power-law viscoelastic bath
papers.abstract: Active particles from bacteria to synthetic microswimmers often navigate viscoelastic media with complex relaxation dynamics. The classical active Brownian model that assumes instantaneous friction is clearly not applicable to describe such motility, while the non-Markovian processes combined with viscoelasticity are relatively unexplored. Here, we develop an analytical theory for an active particle in a power-law viscoelastic medium by solving coupled non-Markovian generalized Langevin equations for translational and rotational degrees of freedom. The viscoelastic memory results in novel phenomena such as fractional short-time transport, enhanced long-time persistence, and de-correlation of the instantaneous force and the swimmer orientation. We demonstrate that the memory kernel controls the anomalous scaling exponents, while the activity determines the crossover between sub-diffusive, ballistic and diffusive regimes. Our work provides a framework for theoretical description of biological and synthetic micro swimmers in complex biological and polymeric environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytical theory、solving coupled non-Markovian generalized Langevin equations。；研究对象：在幂律粘弹性介质中运动的活性粒子（如细菌、合成微游动器），具体研究其非马尔可夫动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 粘弹性记忆效应导致分数阶短时输运、增强的长时持久性以及瞬时力与游动方向之间的去关联；记忆核控制反常标度指数，活性决定亚扩散、弹道扩散与正常扩散之间的交叉。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：粘弹性记忆效应导致分数阶短时输运、增强的长时持久性以及瞬时力与游动方向之间的去关联；记忆核控制反常标度指数，活性决定亚扩散、弹道扩散与正常扩散之间的交叉。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过求解平动和转动自由度的耦合非马尔可夫广义朗之万方程，建立活性粒子在幂律粘弹性介质中的解析理论。

papers.title: Synthesis and Characterization of Atomically-Sharp Superconductor-Dielectric Interface
papers.abstract: Modification of superconductor-dielectric interfaces is known to strongly impact coherence times of superconducting quantum devices. This relationship is thought to arise from differences in the concentration of "two-level system" defects in the disordered dielectrics and superconductor-dielectric interfaces; these defects couple to electromagnetic modes in the device and cause dissipation. Zirconium oxide barrier layers on niobium have emerged as a promising pathway to low-loss interfaces in recent years, evidently due to the crystalline nature of these layers in comparison to the amorphous niobium native oxide. We explain the unique ability of zirconium oxide to form a crystalline layer, to maintain a sharp interface with metallic niobium, and to prevent niobium oxide re-growth in terms of the chemical properties of ZrO$_2$ and the Nb-Zr-O ternary system. We demonstrate a new method to grow air-stable zirconium oxide layers on niobium with a higher level of crystallinity and a sharper oxide-metal interface than previously shown, and provide the first comprehensive microscopic analysis of ZrO$_2$ capping layer properties. These developments pave the way toward vital performance advances in superconducting quantum devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到了“demonstrate a new method to grow...”、“provide the first comprehensive microscopic analysis”，表明进行了材料生长和表征实验。；研究对象：超导体-介电质界面，具体为铌（Nb）上生长的氧化锆（ZrO₂）覆盖层及其形成的原子级尖锐界面。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 氧化锆能够在铌上形成结晶层并维持尖锐界面，且能阻止铌的氧化层再生，其化学性质（ZrO₂及Nb-Zr-O三元体系）是这一独特能力的关键。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：氧化锆能够在铌上形成结晶层并维持尖锐界面，且能阻止铌的氧化层再生，其化学性质（ZrO₂及Nb-Zr-O三元体系）是这一独特能力的关键。；创新点：展示了一种在铌上生长氧化锆的新方法，该方法相比以往工作能获得更高结晶度的氧化锆层和更尖锐的氧化物-金属界面，并首次提供了对该覆盖层性质的全面微观分析。
papers.method_zh: 材料生长（一种新的、可生长出空气稳定的氧化锆层的方法）与微观表征（首次全面的微观分析，具体手段摘要未明确说明，但暗示使用了高分辨显微技术）。

papers.title: Predicting Defect States: A Quick Screening Protocol for Substitutional Point Defect Engineering
papers.abstract: Point defects in crystalline materials play a central role in determining electronic, optical, and magnetic properties. However, systematic exploration of defect configurations remains computationally expensive because large supercell calculations are required to approximate isolated defects under periodic boundary conditions. We present a unit-cell-based tight-binding protocol that enables rapid pre-screening of substitutional defects. The protocol extracts Wannier tight-binding Hamiltonians from small, fully relaxed unit cells of the host and defect-like systems, replicates the host Hamiltonian to construct a supercell model, and introduces the defect by modifying only the on-site energies at the substitution site while leaving the hopping parameters unchanged. We validate the protocol across three diverse systems: isostructural substitutional defects in transition-metal dichalcogenides (M$_\mathrm{Mo}$ MoS$_2$, M = Ce, Zr, Nb, Tc, and Ru), symmetry-breaking carbon substitutions in hexagonal boron nitride (C$_\mathrm{B}$C$_\mathrm{N}$ h-BN), and nitrogen-vacancy (NV$^-$) centers in diamond. These case studies span two-dimensional and three-dimensional hosts, simple substitutions, and substitution-vacancy complexes. In all cases, the protocol successfully captures the number of in-gap states, their degeneracies, and their shallow or deep character relative to host band edges, despite some quantitative deviations in absolute energy positions. We further identify limitations for vacancies of highly electronegative atoms and for charge-state or spin-polarization effects, both of which involve self-consistent charge redistribution not captured by the protocol.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：tight-binding protocol、Wannier tight-binding Hamiltonians、supercell model。；研究对象：晶体材料中的替代式点缺陷，具体包括过渡金属二硫族化物（M$_\mathrm{Mo}$ MoS₂，M = Ce, Zr, Nb, Tc, Ru）、六方氮化硼中的碳替代缺陷（C$_\mathrm{B}$C$_\mathrm{N}$ h-BN）以及金刚石中的氮-空位中心（NV⁻）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于单胞的紧束缚快速预筛选协议，能够成功捕获替代式缺陷的带隙内态数量、简并度以及浅/深能级特征，尽管在绝对能量位置上存在定量偏差。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于单胞的紧束缚快速预筛选协议，能够成功捕获替代式缺陷的带隙内态数量、简并度以及浅/深能级特征，尽管在绝对能量位置上存在定量偏差。；创新点：提出了一种无需大超胞计算即可快速预筛选替代式点缺陷的协议，显著降低了计算成本，并在多种二维和三维宿主材料中验证了其有效性。摘要未突出说明与现有方法（如DFT超胞法）的具体计算效率对比。
papers.method_zh: 从完全弛豫的小型单胞（宿主及类缺陷系统）中提取Wannier紧束缚哈密顿量，复制宿主哈密顿量构建超胞模型，仅修改替代位点的在位能（on-site energies）而不改变跳跃参数（hopping parameters）来引入缺陷。

papers.title: Correlation-driven phonon renormalisation and the equation of state of $γ$-cerium
papers.abstract: We investigate the thermodynamic properties of elemental cerium by assessing the crucial role of phonon free energy within the framework of dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT). While conventional density functional theory (DFT) often fails to capture the intricate energy landscape of $f$-electron materials, our approach integrates many-body electronic correlations with lattice dynamics to achieve a more rigorous description of the equation of state. We calculate the total energy as a function of the lattice constant at both the DFT and DFT+DMFT levels, subsequently incorporating the vibrational free energy derived from the phonon density of states. Our findings reveal that electronic renormalisation of the force constants significantly alters the phonon spectra, particularly in the strongly correlated $γ$-phase. By applying these phonon corrections to the energy profiles, we observe a substantial refinement in the predicted equilibrium volumes. Using principal-component-based machine learning, we interpolate phonon dispersions continuously from a finite set of first-principles calculations and compare them to experiment, finding significantly closer agreement compared to conventional DFT and DFT+U calculations that neglect dynamical many-body correlations. This study underlines the necessity of accounting for both electronic and vibrational entropy when evaluating the phase stability and structural transitions of lanthanide systems under varying pressures and temperatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT)、density functional theory (DFT)、first-principles calculations、machine learning。；研究对象：元素铈（cerium）的γ相（γ-phase），具体研究其热力学性质、声子谱的电子关联修正以及状态方程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电子关联效应显著重整了γ-铈的力常数和声子谱，将由此得到的声子自由能修正加入总能曲线后，能大幅改善对平衡体积的预测，且基于主成分分析的机器学习插值得到的声子色散与实验吻合度远高于传统DFT和DFT+U计算。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电子关联效应显著重整了γ-铈的力常数和声子谱，将由此得到的声子自由能修正加入总能曲线后，能大幅改善对平衡体积的预测，且基于主成分分析的机器学习插值得到的声子色散与实验吻合度远高于传统DFT和DFT+U计算。；创新点：在DMFT框架下同时考虑电子多体关联与晶格动力学，揭示了电子关联对声子谱的显著重整效应，并借助机器学习方法实现了声子色散的连续插值，从而更精确地描述γ-铈的状态方程。
papers.method_zh: 采用DFT和DFT+DMFT两种层次计算总能随晶格常数的变化，再结合从声子态密度导出的振动自由能；利用基于主成分分析的机器学习方法从有限的第一性原理计算数据中连续插值声子色散，并与实验对比。

papers.title: Atomic-scale visualization of the toroidal order in a trimeric Dy(III) single-molecule toroic
papers.abstract: Single-molecule toroics (SMTs) offer a unique platform for next-generation quantum devices utilizing head-to-tail spin alignments in the compounds. Presence of toroidal moments in SMTs has been essentially based on magnetometry and ab initio calculations. Here, we report observation and probe of the toroidal moment in [Dy3(OH)(teaH2)3(paa)3]Cl(OMe) [teaH3: triethanolamine; paaH: N-(2-pyridyl)-acetoacetamide] from mapping of Dy3+ magnetic susceptibility tensors by polarized neutron diffraction (PND). Neutron diffraction under variable magnetic fields demonstrates field-induced magnetization along the c-axis with toroidal moments anti-parallelly stacked, providing definite proof of the toroidal moment. Magnetometry studies confirm the toroidal ground state. For the first time, the combined use of PND, variable-field neutron diffraction, ab initio calculations, and magnetometry is introduced as a robust and quantitative methodology to probe molecular-scale toroidal magnetism. This integrated approach overcomes limitations of earlier indirect methods, establishes a benchmark framework for investigating SMTs, and provides valuable insights for the design of molecular quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：polarized neutron diffraction, variable-field neutron diffraction, magnetometry, ab initio calculations）；研究对象：三核镝(III)单分子环磁体（[Dy₃(OH)(teaH₂)₃(paa)₃]Cl(OMe)）中的环状磁有序（toroidal order）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过极化中子衍射直接观测到Dy³⁺离子磁化率张量映射出的环状磁矩，并利用变场中子衍射证实了沿c轴方向场致磁化与反平行堆叠的环状磁矩，首次为单分子环磁体中的环状磁矩提供了确凿实验证据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过极化中子衍射直接观测到Dy³⁺离子磁化率张量映射出的环状磁矩，并利用变场中子衍射证实了沿c轴方向场致磁化与反平行堆叠的环状磁矩，首次为单分子环磁体中的环状磁矩提供了确凿实验证据。；创新点：首次将极化中子衍射、变场中子衍射、从头计算和磁测量整合为一种定量、稳健的方法学，用于探测分子尺度的环状磁性，克服了此前间接方法的局限性，为研究单分子环磁体建立了基准框架。
papers.method_zh: 极化中子衍射（PND）用于映射Dy³⁺磁化率张量；变场中子衍射用于观测场致磁化行为；结合磁测量（magnetometry）和从头计算（ab initio calculations）进行交叉验证。

papers.title: Jittery Quantum Boomerang Effect
papers.abstract: We study the dynamics of a spin-polarized wave packet in a disordered Rashba two-dimensional electron gas and identify a jittery quantum boomerang effect in which longitudinal and transverse motion return to the origin through fundamentally distinct mechanisms. Starting from an initial state with finite momentum along $x$ and spin polarized along $z$, we calculate the time evolution by combining a Chebyshev expansion of the time-evolution operator with a disorder ensemble average. In the weak-scattering regime, equations of motion derived from the quantum kinetic equation reproduce the numerical trends and show that impurity scattering acts as a viscous damping mechanism that suppresses the transient Zitterbewegung and drives the transverse displacement back to $y=0$ at long times. In contrast, the longitudinal dynamics show a Drude-like saturation at weak disorder. These results are consistent with the vanishing intrinsic spin Hall conductivity in the disordered Rashba model and with experimental observations of a transient intrinsic spin Hall effect in the time-domain. As disorder increases, the longitudinal dynamics evolve to a partial return toward the origin, which signals a transition from weak antilocalization to Anderson localization in 2D.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。依据：摘要中明确提到“计算时间演化”、“结合切比雪夫展开与无序系综平均”、“从量子动力学方程推导运动方程”。；研究对象：无序Rashba二维电子气中自旋极化波包的动力学行为，具体研究一种“抖动量子回旋镖效应”。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无序Rashba二维电子气中，初始沿x方向运动、自旋沿z方向极化的波包，其纵向（x方向）和横向（y方向）运动通过根本不同的机制回到原点。横向运动在长时间尺度上通过杂质散射的粘滞阻尼作用回到y=0，而纵向运动在弱无序下呈现类似Drude模型的饱和行为，在强无序下则演变为部分回返，标志着从弱反局域化到安德森局域化的转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无序Rashba二维电子气中，初始沿x方向运动、自旋沿z方向极化的波包，其纵向（x方向）和横向（y方向）运动通过根本不同的机制回到原点。横向运动在长时间尺度上通过杂质散射的粘滞阻尼作用回到y=0，而纵向运动在弱无序下呈现类似Drude模型的饱和行为，在强无序下则演变为部分回返，标志着从弱反局域化到安德森局域化的转变。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 结合切比雪夫多项式展开时间演化算符与无序系综平均的数值计算方法；在弱散射极限下，使用量子动力学方程推导运动方程进行理论分析。

papers.title: Dominant in-plane anomalous Hall effect in a monoclinic room-temperature ferromagnet
papers.abstract: Ferromagnetic metals are characterized by enhanced dissipationless transverse transport responses via the anomalous Hall effect, offering a route towards magnetic sensing and spintronic readout functionalities. In most ferromagnets, the anomalous Hall current is constrained to lie in the plane perpendicular to the magnetization (or applied magnetic field). Recently, it has been recognized that selected symmetries can also permit a Hall response in a traditionally forbidden configuration, where the Hall current lies in the same plane as the magnetization, realizing an in-plane anomalous Hall effect. Reported realizations of this effect, however, are typically much weaker than the conventional Hall response in the same material. Here, through engineering specific crystallographic mirror symmetry-breaking, we realize a strongly enhanced in-plane anomalous Hall response in monoclinic Cr3Te4 with room-temperature ferromagnetism. Remarkably, the in-plane anomalous Hall signal exceeds the out-of-plane response by a factor of five, with which we demonstrate a unique in-plane field and current sensing functionality. Combined with density functional theory calculations, our results establish low-crystalline-symmetry ferromagnets with near-Fermi-level Weyl points as a practical platform for symmetry-engineered Hall responses, and point to a route towards room-temperature, geometry-flexible sensing devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章，辅以理论计算。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验实现（“we realize a strongly enhanced in-plane anomalous Hall response”），并提及结合了密度泛函理论计算（“Combined with density functional theory calculations”）。；研究对象：单斜晶系室温铁磁体 Cr₃Te₄ 中的面内反常霍尔效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过工程化破坏特定的晶体镜面对称性，在室温铁磁体 Cr₃Te₄ 中实现了显著增强的面内反常霍尔效应，其信号强度是传统面外反常霍尔效应的五倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过工程化破坏特定的晶体镜面对称性，在室温铁磁体 Cr₃Te₄ 中实现了显著增强的面内反常霍尔效应，其信号强度是传统面外反常霍尔效应的五倍。；创新点：首次在室温铁磁体中实现了远超传统面外响应的强面内反常霍尔效应（信号强度为面外响应的五倍），并基于此展示了独特的面内磁场与电流传感功能。此前报道的面内反常霍尔效应通常远弱于同材料中的常规霍尔响应。
papers.method_zh: 实验上通过材料合成与输运测量实现并表征了面内反常霍尔效应；理论上结合了密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，揭示了近费米能级的Weyl点与低晶体对称性铁磁体是实现对称性工程化霍尔效应的平台。

papers.title: Distribution of Majorana modes in the extended-range Kitaev chain
papers.abstract: The topological properties of the Kitaev chain model with extended-range interactions are investigated, focusing on cases where the topological winding number is preserved. We assume that the pairing and hopping terms decay algebraically in space with exponents $α$ and $β$, respectively. We show that in the truncated-range scenario, there are as many distinct topological phases as the number of coupled neighboring sites. In addition, an explicit analytical formulation is provided to evaluate the topological invariant and the phase transitions that emerge in these systems. Besides the analytical description, we introduce a new physical insight into the topological excitations of the ground-state by measuring the spatial distribution of the edge modes with the Majorana average position. Taking the next-nearest neighbor Kitaev chains as a probe, various numerical calculations of Majorana edge states were performed in finite-size clusters to determine the sensitivity of the topological zero energy modes to the parameters of interest. The occupation of edge-to-edge non-local fermion states is computed and defined as an effective parity. Such an effective parity exhibits new interesting features beyond the energetic exchange from the ground-state fermion parity switches, which are related to the distribution of the respective edge modes. Our calculations show a direct correlation between the ground-state fermion parity and the edge occupation numbers, which are translated into localization and delocalization of the Majorana average position.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：拓扑性质、解析公式、数值计算、拓扑不变量）；研究对象：扩展范围Kitaev链模型，具体研究配对和跳跃项呈代数衰减（指数α和β）时，拓扑边缘态（Majorana模）的分布与性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在截断范围情形下，拓扑相的数量等于耦合近邻格点数；基态费米子宇称与边缘占据数直接相关，并影响Majorana平均位置的局域化与退局域化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在截断范围情形下，拓扑相的数量等于耦合近邻格点数；基态费米子宇称与边缘占据数直接相关，并影响Majorana平均位置的局域化与退局域化。；创新点：引入Majorana平均位置作为刻画基态拓扑激发空间分布的新物理量，并发现有效宇称在基态费米子宇称切换之外展现出新的特征，与边缘模的分布直接相关。
papers.method_zh: 解析推导拓扑不变量与相变条件；通过Majorana平均位置测量边缘模的空间分布；在有限尺寸团簇中对次近邻Kitaev链进行数值计算，分析边缘态对参数的敏感性；计算边缘-边缘非局域费米子态的占据数并定义为有效宇称。

papers.title: Exactly solvable non-planar $\mathbb{Z}_{2}$ dimer liquids on checkerboard and ruby lattices
papers.abstract: We generalize an influential framework for exactly solvable quantum dimer models with dual Ising gauge theory descriptions realizing the $\mathbb{Z}_{2}$ topological phase from trivalent to tetravalent parent lattices. The resulting quantum dimer models live on crossed-medial lattices and possess the remarkable feature of having crossed plaquettes, leading to transition graphs with generically intersecting loops. This non-planar structure runs counter to established templates for analytically tractable dimer liquids. As the simplest realization of the construction, we introduce an exactly solvable quantum dimer model on the checkerboard lattice that allows an exact mapping to the toric code, thus providing a particularly direct connection between the latter and Anderson's short range resonating valence bond paradigm. We further show that a corresponding crossed ruby lattice construction, dual to an Ising gauge theory on the kagome lattice, naturally falls within the same framework. More generally, the construction gives rise to a broad class of exactly solvable crossed-medial quantum dimer models and admits natural iteration, generating cascades of solvable $\mathbb{Z}_{2}$ topological dimer liquids beyond the standard planar setting. We furthermore extend Kasteleyn methods to the relevant non-planar graphs, enabling controlled wave-function deformations away from the commuting-projector points while retaining efficient evaluation of correlation functions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：exactly solvable、dual Ising gauge theory、generalize framework、analytically tractable。；研究对象：量子二聚体模型（quantum dimer models），具体在棋盘晶格（checkerboard lattice）和红宝石晶格（ruby lattice）上实现的非平面 \(\mathbb{Z}_2\) 二聚体液滴（non-planar \(\mathbb{Z}_2\) dimer liquids）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作将可精确求解的量子二聚体模型从三配位母晶格推广到四配位母晶格，构建了具有交叉plaquette的非平面结构模型，并首次在棋盘晶格上实现了与toric code的直接精确映射，建立了与Anderson短程共振价键（RVB）图像的直接联系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作将可精确求解的量子二聚体模型从三配位母晶格推广到四配位母晶格，构建了具有交叉plaquette的非平面结构模型，并首次在棋盘晶格上实现了与toric code的直接精确映射，建立了与Anderson短程共振价键（RVB）图像的直接联系。；创新点：突破了传统可解二聚体液滴模型必须基于平面结构的限制，首次在非平面（交叉）晶格上构建了可精确求解的 \(\mathbb{Z}_2\) 拓扑二聚体液滴模型，并展示了该构造可通过迭代生成级联的可解模型。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于对偶伊辛规范场论（dual Ising gauge theory）描述的可解量子二聚体模型框架的推广；数学方法：将Kasteleyn方法扩展到相关的非平面图，用于在远离对易投影点（commuting-projector points）时控制波函数形变并高效计算关联函数。

papers.title: Fabry-Perot Interference, g-factor Anisotropy, and Gate-Tunable Quantum dot in Chiral Tellurium Nanowires
papers.abstract: Chiral materials with strong spin-orbit coupling offer a unique platform for exploring the interplay between topology, chirality, and quantum transport yet the quantum coherent regime in elemental tellurium nanostructures remains largely unexplored. Here we demonstrate phase-coherent quasi-ballistic transport, anisotropic Zeeman spectroscopy, and gate-tunable quantum dot formation in hydrothermally grown t-tellurium nanowires. Single nanowire field-effect transistors exhibit p-type transport with hole mobilities rising from approx. 80 cm2 V-1 s-1 at 210 K to approx. 190 cm2 V-1 s-1 at 1 K, consistent with a crossover from phonon-limited to Coulomb scattering dominated regimes near 50 K. Notably, devices segregate into two distinct regimes based on their room temperature two-terminal resistance : low-resistance devices (< 30 kOhm) exhibit Fabry-Perot interference, whereas high resistance devices (> 30 kOhm) display Coulomb-blockade behavior revealing a two-terminal resistance-driven transition between quasi-ballistic and strongly localized transport regimes. Zeeman spectroscopy in in-plane and out-of-plane magnetic fields yields highly anisotropic Lande g-factors (an in-plane gparallel = 1.18 and an out-of-plane gperp = 18.41) and directly resolves a spin-orbit energy gap DeltaSO = 0.864 meV from an avoided crossing. These results establish chiral tellurium nanowires as a versatile platform for gate-defined spin qubits exploiting large, tunable g-factors and for hybrid tellurium-superconductor architectures targeting Majorana zero modes in an elemental vdW system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：demonstrate、exhibit、measurements、devices segregate、Zeeman spectroscopy。；研究对象：手性碲（t-tellurium）纳米线中的准弹道输运、各向异性塞曼谱、以及栅极可调量子点。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在碲纳米线中观测到由两端电阻驱动的准弹道输运与强局域化输运之间的转变，并解析出高度各向异性的朗德g因子（面内g∥=1.18，面外g⊥=18.41）以及自旋轨道能隙ΔSO=0.864 meV。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在碲纳米线中观测到由两端电阻驱动的准弹道输运与强局域化输运之间的转变，并解析出高度各向异性的朗德g因子（面内g∥=1.18，面外g⊥=18.41）以及自旋轨道能隙ΔSO=0.864 meV。；创新点：首次在元素碲纳米线中实现相位相干准弹道输运，并揭示出由室温两端电阻决定的输运机制转变（法布里-珀罗干涉 vs. 库仑阻塞），同时直接解析出高度各向异性的g因子和自旋轨道能隙，为基于碲的栅控自旋量子比特和超导-碲混合体系（如马约拉纳零模）提供了实验基础。
papers.method_zh: 水热法生长碲纳米线，制备单纳米线场效应晶体管，进行变温（1 K至210 K）电输运测量、法布里-珀罗干涉分析、库仑阻塞谱测量、以及面内/面外磁场下的塞曼谱学。

papers.title: Quantum-geometric origin of superfluid weight in quasicrystals with critical states
papers.abstract: A distinctive feature of many quasiperiodic systems is the presence of critical states that are neither extended nor exponentially localized. We investigate the geometric effect on the superfluid weight in quasiperiodic systems with critical states at zero temperature. We employ both real-space and momentum-space approaches to superfluid weight in quasicrystals, which allows us to separate the conventional and quantum geometric contributions. We find that the superfluid weight is dominated by the geometric contribution in quasiperiodic systems with critical states. This finding reveals a fundamental interplay between superconductivity and critical states in quasicrystals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“investigate”“employ...approaches”“find”等理论分析用语，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：准晶中具有临界态（critical states）的准周期体系，具体研究超流重量（superfluid weight）的量子几何起源。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在具有临界态的准周期体系中，超流重量主要由量子几何贡献主导，揭示了准晶中超导与临界态之间的基本相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在具有临界态的准周期体系中，超流重量主要由量子几何贡献主导，揭示了准晶中超导与临界态之间的基本相互作用。；创新点：首次在准晶临界态体系中明确区分并指出超流重量的量子几何贡献占主导地位，揭示了超导与临界态之间的新关联。
papers.method_zh: 采用实空间和动量空间两种方法计算准晶中的超流重量，并分离出常规贡献与量子几何贡献。

papers.title: Anatomy of fast current-induced skyrmion motion in synthetic antiferromagnets
papers.abstract: The high mobility of current-driven skyrmions in synthetic antiferromagnets (SAFs) is widely explained by the macroscopic suppression of the skyrmion Hall effect through gyrotropic force compensation. This established view, however, overlooks a concurrent and significant reduction in the Gilbert damping parameter α, a key factor in the Thiele equation governing skyrmion velocity. Here, we show that this damping attenuation originates from a reconfigured magnon-electron scattering landscape. Using a microscopic s-d model, we demonstrate that the strong antiferromagnetic interlayer Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida (RKKY) exchange coupling in SAFs increases the magnonic gap of skyrmion collective modes, thereby suppressing the thermal magnon population and, consequently, the magnon-electron scattering rate that dominates damping in metallic ferromagnets. Our work establishes a dual-mechanism framework to fully explain the superior kinetics of SAF skyrmions: the macroscopic topological effect rectifies the motion direction, while the microscopic dissipation mechanism reduces the drag. This synergy enables high-speed and efficient motion, providing a fundamental elucidation of the enhanced mobility reported in recent studies such as the work by Pham et al. [Science 384, 307-312 (2024)].
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“使用微观s-d模型”、“建立双机制框架”，属于理论建模与机制分析，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：合成反铁磁体（SAF）中电流驱动的斯格明子（skyrmion）的高速运动机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: SAF中斯格明子高速运动不仅源于宏观上斯格明子霍尔效应的抑制（陀螺力补偿），还源于微观上吉尔伯特阻尼参数α的显著降低，后者由反铁磁层间RKKY交换耦合增大斯格明子集体模的磁振子能隙、抑制热磁振子-电子散射率所致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：SAF中斯格明子高速运动不仅源于宏观上斯格明子霍尔效应的抑制（陀螺力补偿），还源于微观上吉尔伯特阻尼参数α的显著降低，后者由反铁磁层间RKKY交换耦合增大斯格明子集体模的磁振子能隙、抑制热磁振子-电子散射率所致。；创新点：揭示了SAF中斯格明子高速运动的双重机制：宏观拓扑效应（运动方向矫正）与微观耗散机制（阻尼降低）的协同作用，弥补了以往仅关注斯格明子霍尔效应抑制的片面理解。
papers.method_zh: 采用微观s-d模型，分析反铁磁层间RKKY交换耦合对磁振子-电子散射景观的重构，并结合Thiele方程讨论斯格明子速度的调控因素。

papers.title: Computing phase diagrams using a convex hull algorithm
papers.abstract: We present a simple universal computational algorithm for computing compositional phase diagrams of rocks and their melts at given temperature and pressure. It makes use of the mathematical concept of the convex hull of a set of points in the space spanned by the composition and the Gibbs free energy. All the complexities of determining the stability or separation of phases, the localization and orientation of tie lines, as well as the determination of characteristic points, curves and surfaces such as the solidus, liquidus, solvus, and the eutectic/peritectic points etc, are taken care of by the algorithm that computes the convex hull, supplemented with an algorithm to physically classify the resulting simplices. For the convex hull computation, the publicly available Qhull package can be used, which is available in SciPy. This makes this method accessible and intuitive for a broad set of scientific and educational applications. Although the method is not practical for systems of a large number of components, it is remarkably stable and efficient for systems of up to four. We present our implementation of the method as a publicly available Python package.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：computational algorithm、convex hull、Python package。；研究对象：岩石及其熔体的成分相图（compositional phase diagrams），即在给定温度和压力下，多组分体系的相平衡与相分离行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于凸包（convex hull）算法的通用计算方法，能够自动确定相图中固相线、液相线、溶线、共晶/包晶点等特征，无需手动处理相稳定性或相分离的复杂判断。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于凸包（convex hull）算法的通用计算方法，能够自动确定相图中固相线、液相线、溶线、共晶/包晶点等特征，无需手动处理相稳定性或相分离的复杂判断。；创新点：将凸包算法系统性地应用于岩石及其熔体的成分相图计算，使相图构建过程自动化、直观化，适用于最多四组分体系，且对教育和科研应用具有较好的可访问性。
papers.method_zh: 利用成分与吉布斯自由能张成空间中的凸包数学概念，结合公开的Qhull包（集成于SciPy）进行凸包计算，并辅以物理分类算法对所得单纯形（simplices）进行物理解释。作者将实现方法以公开Python包形式发布。

papers.title: Quantum Otto and Carnot Cycles via Skew Ising Model
papers.abstract: We investigate the thermodynamic performance of quantum heat engines and refrigerators based on a two-spin system subject to a skew magnetic field. The working substance is described by an interacting spin model that incorporates both spin--spin coupling and anisotropy induced by a tilted magnetic field. We analyze and compare quantum Carnot and Otto cycles, showing that the Carnot cycle exhibits a universal, entropy-driven behavior with smooth phase boundaries, while the Otto cycle displays a much richer structure governed by the interplay between the energy spectrum and nonequilibrium population differences. In particular, we identify a crossover in both efficiency and coefficient of performance as a function of the interaction strength, which arises from the competition between the interaction energy scale and the magnetic field. We further demonstrate that the skew angle induces state hybridization, modifying both the energy levels and occupation probabilities. Our results highlight that interactions and anisotropy, when properly tuned, can enhance thermodynamic performance, and emphasize the importance of multi-level effects in the design of quantum thermal machines.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“investigate”“analyze”“demonstrate”等理论分析词汇，未提及实验手段或计算模拟方法。；研究对象：基于倾斜磁场下两自旋系统（skew Ising model）的量子热机和制冷机，具体为量子奥托循环和卡诺循环的热力学性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 卡诺循环表现出由熵驱动的普适行为和平滑的相边界，而奥托循环则展现出由能谱与非平衡布居差相互作用导致的更丰富结构；相互作用强度与磁场之间的竞争导致效率和性能系数出现交叉，倾斜角引起的态杂化可调节能级和占据概率，从而优化热力学性能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：卡诺循环表现出由熵驱动的普适行为和平滑的相边界，而奥托循环则展现出由能谱与非平衡布居差相互作用导致的更丰富结构；相互作用强度与磁场之间的竞争导致效率和性能系数出现交叉，倾斜角引起的态杂化可调节能级和占据概率，从而优化热力学性能。；创新点：揭示了相互作用和磁各向异性（倾斜角）在量子热机中可被调控以增强热力学性能，强调了多能级效应在量子热机设计中的重要性；首次在倾斜伊辛模型中系统比较了卡诺与奥托循环的差异，并识别出由相互作用能标与磁场竞争导致的效率/性能系数交叉行为。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架：基于倾斜磁场下两自旋相互作用的伊辛模型（skew Ising model），通过分析能谱、非平衡布居差、熵驱动行为等，对比量子卡诺循环与奥托循环的热力学性能。

papers.title: Algorithmic and Minimax Complexities in Kernel Bandits
papers.abstract: Gaussian-process upper confidence bound (GP-UCB) and decision-estimation-coefficient (DEC) methods may appear, at first sight, to belong to different theories. This paper places the two viewpoints in a common algorithmic-information language for frequentist RKHS bandits. GP-UCB fixes an algorithmic, rather than true, Gaussian-process prior and exploits realized-trajectory complexity together with computational tractability, whereas MAMS optimizes a robust class-wide MAIR/DEC envelope. Through the unified MAIR framework and heterogeneous positive-semidefinite algorithmic priors, we generalize both the GP-UCB analysis and the MAMS algorithm, propose a safeguarded master that combines their advantages, and provide a kernel-bandit construction showing that algorithmic complexity can be more informative than class-wide minimax or DEC certificates in overparameterized models. The resulting message is that algorithmic information and class-wide minimax coefficients answer different questions and can lead to different gaps; kernel bandits provide a clean setting in which this distinction becomes mathematically visible.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：算法分析、信息论、复杂度理论。；研究对象：核函数赌博机（Kernel Bandits）问题，具体为再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）下的频域（frequentist）模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文揭示了高斯过程上置信界（GP-UCB）算法与决策估计系数（DEC）方法在算法信息论视角下的统一性，并证明在过参数化模型中，算法复杂度（如GP-UCB的轨迹复杂度）比类最坏情况下的极小极大复杂度或DEC证书更具信息量。
