papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文揭示了高斯过程上置信界（GP-UCB）算法与决策估计系数（DEC）方法在算法信息论视角下的统一性，并证明在过参数化模型中，算法复杂度（如GP-UCB的轨迹复杂度）比类最坏情况下的极小极大复杂度或DEC证书更具信息量。；创新点：摘要未突出说明具体创新点，但核心在于：1）将GP-UCB和DEC两种看似不同的理论置于共同的算法信息语言下；2）通过引入异质算法先验，统一并推广了现有分析；3）明确指出算法复杂度与类最坏情况复杂度回答不同的问题，并在核函数赌博机这一干净模型中使这种区别在数学上变得可见。
papers.method_zh: 采用统一的MAIR（最大算法信息比）框架和异质半正定算法先验，对GP-UCB分析和MAMS（极小极大自适应策略）算法进行了推广，并提出了一种结合两者优势的“带保护的主算法”（safeguarded master）。

papers.title: The Yang-Baxter Equation for the Chiral Potts Model and Integrable Parafermions
papers.abstract: A new type of Yang-Baxter equation (YBE) for $R$-matrices parameterized by three spectral parameters is constructed from the star-triangle and star-star relations for the chiral Potts model. As the $Z_N$ symmetric generalization to the Ising model, its Boltzmann weights are known to depend on two variables describing a curve with genus larger than one for $N>2$, except for the self-dual point corresponding to the Fateev-Zamolodchikov chain. This combined with the fact that the quantum Hamiltonians of edge models like Ising contain both nearest neighbor interaction and onsite potential terms results in the extra spectral parameter of the $R$-operator. My construction extends the recent unification of solvable edge and vertex models which recasts Onsager's star-triangle relation from a mere alternative form of the YBE for edge models to its underlying ingredient.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“构造”（constructed）、“扩展”（extends）等理论推导性关键词，且讨论的是Yang-Baxter方程、R-矩阵等纯数学物理结构，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：手征Potts模型（chiral Potts model）及其对应的可积parafermion系统。该模型是Ising模型的Z_N对称推广，其Boltzmann权重依赖于描述高亏格曲线的两个变量（N>2时）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 从手征Potts模型的星-三角关系和星-星关系出发，构造了一种由三个谱参数参数化的新型Yang-Baxter方程（YBE），从而统一了可积边模型与顶点模型，并将Onsager的星-三角关系重新解释为边模型YBE的基础要素而非其替代形式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：从手征Potts模型的星-三角关系和星-星关系出发，构造了一种由三个谱参数参数化的新型Yang-Baxter方程（YBE），从而统一了可积边模型与顶点模型，并将Onsager的星-三角关系重新解释为边模型YBE的基础要素而非其替代形式。；创新点：摘要未突出说明具体创新点，但可推断：首次将手征Potts模型的星-三角关系系统性地转化为三谱参数YBE，并以此扩展了近期关于可积边模型与顶点模型统一的理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于统计力学中可积模型的Yang-Baxter方程构造，具体利用手征Potts模型的星-三角关系（star-triangle relation）和星-星关系（star-star relation）推导出三谱参数R-矩阵所满足的YBE。涉及对边模型（如Ising模型）量子哈密顿量中最近邻相互作用与在位势项的分析。

papers.title: The UZH protocol: Separating errors and constructing improved CP2K basis sets and pseudopotentials
papers.abstract: Reliable density-functional simulations require numerical settings whose residual errors are smaller than the chemical and materials trends being interpreted. In CP2K/Quickstep, this requirement is complicated by the joint use of atom-centered Gaussian basis sets and norm-conserving pseudopotentials: a code-to-code discrepancy usually contains both contributions. We present the UZH protocol, a closed-loop CP2K workflow that calibrates molecularly optimized Gaussian basis sets on small molecules, validates the resulting settings in unary-crystal equation-of-state benchmarks, identifies whether the limiting approximation is the Gaussian basis or the pseudopotential. The diagnosis is then used to revise the parameter files. The central diagnostic is a three-way comparison between production CP2K-GTH-UZH calculations, SIRIUS calculations using the same Goedecker--Teter--Hutter pseudopotential in a systematic plane-wave representation, and all-electron full-potential linearized augmented-plane-wave SIRIUS references. This construction decomposes the practical CP2K error into a Gaussian-basis component and a pseudopotential component. The protocol distinguishes basis-limited noble-gas and heavy-element cases from pseudopotential-limited transition-metal cases, guides targeted revisions with the CP2K basis and pseudopotential optimizers, and produces improved MOLOPT basis sets and GTH pseudopotentials as explicit outputs of the workflow. The UZH protocol is therefore constructive: it does not merely measure or reduce errors a posteriori, but allows turning verification outliers into validated CP2K parameter files for simulations across molecules and condensed phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：density-functional simulations（密度泛函模拟）、CP2K/Quickstep、SIRIUS、plane-wave representation（平面波表示）、all-electron full-potential linearized augmented-plane-wave（全势线性缀加平面波）。；研究对象：CP2K软件中联合使用的原子中心高斯基组和模守恒赝势的误差分离与参数优化，具体针对小分子、单质晶体（unary crystals）的基组和赝势校准。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了UZH协议，通过三路对比（CP2K-GTH-UZH计算、SIRIUS平面波计算、全势线性缀加平面波参考）将CP2K的实际误差分解为高斯基组误差和赝势误差，并据此定向改进基组和赝势参数文件。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了UZH协议，通过三路对比（CP2K-GTH-UZH计算、SIRIUS平面波计算、全势线性缀加平面波参考）将CP2K的实际误差分解为高斯基组误差和赝势误差，并据此定向改进基组和赝势参数文件。；创新点：该协议不是事后测量或减少误差，而是通过闭环工作流将验证中的异常值转化为经过验证的CP2K参数文件，实现了对基组限制（如惰性气体、重元素）和赝势限制（如过渡金属）的区分与定向改进。
papers.method_zh: 采用闭环CP2K工作流：1）在小分子上校准分子优化的高斯基组（MOLOPT）；2）在单质晶体状态方程基准测试中验证参数；3）通过三路对比诊断误差来源（基组限制 vs 赝势限制）；4）利用CP2K基组和赝势优化器进行定向修订。对比方法包括SIRIUS的平面波表示和全势线性缀加平面波参考。

papers.title: Revealing the topology of quantum states via Kirkwood-Dirac quasiprobabilities
papers.abstract: We discuss a theoretical approach to discriminate whether two states of a many-body quantum system belong or not to different topology classes. This approach is based on expressing a strange correlator - a recently established tool for quantum topology discrimination - between the states as a function of Kirkwood-Dirac quasiprobabilities (KDQs). KDQs provide a first-principles representation of two-time quantum correlators. The link between strange correlators and KDQs allows to establish that strange correlators are weak values of an observable converting an initial trivial state into a topologically non-trivial one. We thus propose a quantum topology witness that is achievable measuring the prior and subsequent effects on a many-body system of a sudden quench transformation that realizes the transition between trivial and topological phases. The witness is evaluated on a probe quantum state whose main features are detailed within the paper. Finally, directly exploiting schemes that allows for the complete reconstruction of KDQs, we address an interferometric protocol for topology discrimination, along with a general discussion of the main lines and challenges towards its implementation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“theoretical approach”、“propose”、“address a protocol”，以及全文未提及实验数据或计算模拟。；研究对象：多体量子系统的拓扑态，具体为通过Kirkwood-Dirac准概率（KDQs）区分两个量子态是否属于不同拓扑类。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了“奇怪关联子”（strange correlator）与Kirkwood-Dirac准概率之间的数学联系，证明奇怪关联子可视为将初始平庸态转化为拓扑非平庸态的观测量的弱值，并据此提出一种基于突然淬火变换的量子拓扑见证。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了“奇怪关联子”（strange correlator）与Kirkwood-Dirac准概率之间的数学联系，证明奇怪关联子可视为将初始平庸态转化为拓扑非平庸态的观测量的弱值，并据此提出一种基于突然淬火变换的量子拓扑见证。；创新点：首次将Kirkwood-Dirac准概率与奇怪关联子直接关联，从而将拓扑区分问题转化为可测量的弱值问题，并提出了基于淬火变换的拓扑见证方案。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：Kirkwood-Dirac准概率（KDQs）表示两时量子关联函数；弱值理论；奇怪关联子方法。提出基于干涉测量的协议用于拓扑区分，并讨论了实现的主要路线与挑战。

papers.title: Revisiting Cherenkov radiation in anisotropic chiral matter: exact calculation reveals threshold-free emission
papers.abstract: We explore Cherenkov radiation in anisotropic chiral matter within the framework of Carroll-Field-Jackiw electrodynamics, where the axion angle exhibits a linear dependence on position. By deriving closed-form expressions for the polarization modes of electromagnetic fields in cylindrical coordinates and the space-frequency domain, we solve the modified Maxwell's equations. To enforce causality, we impose outgoing wave boundary conditions at a cylindrical surface at infinity, which yields the dispersion relations. Our analysis uncovers the specific angles and frequency ranges that allow for zero, one, or two Cherenkov cones. We also obtain the spectral energy distribution of the radiation in all cases. Notably, one sector of the model exhibits a novel phenomenon: Cherenkov radiation can be generated by slowly moving charges without a threshold, but only within a specific frequency range. This behavior is not observed in standard materials. Using our exact calculations, we also investigate the reliability of an approximate method previously proposed based on the calculation of the Green's function for the system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Carroll-Field-Jackiw电动力学、解析推导、色散关系、格林函数近似方法检验。；研究对象：各向异性手性物质中的切伦科夫辐射，具体采用Carroll-Field-Jackiw电动力学框架，其中轴子角随位置线性变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在该模型的一个扇区中，慢速移动的电荷可以在无阈值条件下产生切伦科夫辐射，但仅局限于特定频率范围。这一现象在标准材料中不存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在该模型的一个扇区中，慢速移动的电荷可以在无阈值条件下产生切伦科夫辐射，但仅局限于特定频率范围。这一现象在标准材料中不存在。；创新点：首次通过精确解析计算揭示了各向异性手性物质中无阈值切伦科夫辐射的存在，并系统分析了零个、一个或两个切伦科夫锥出现的特定角度和频率范围。
papers.method_zh: 采用Carroll-Field-Jackiw电动力学理论框架，在柱坐标和空间-频率域中推导电磁场极化模式的闭合形式解，通过无穷远柱面上的出射波边界条件强制因果性，从而得到色散关系，并解析计算辐射的频谱能量分布。同时，基于精确解检验了此前基于格林函数近似方法的可靠性。

papers.title: Inherent flux crosstalk and coupler-driven single-qubit gates in superconducting circuits
papers.abstract: Crosstalk refers to unwanted qubit addressing. This is particularly detrimental when scaling up quantum information systems because unintended interactions limit their overall performance. For superconducting qubits, tunable couplings and frequency tunability achieved through externally applied magnetic fluxes enable high-fidelity entangling gates; however, they also introduce crosstalk through unintended flux coupling. In this work, we investigate the impact of time-dependent external magnetic fluxes in quantized circuits on superconducting qubit couplings. We find that non-trivial cross-voltage driving emerges between capacitively linked qubits when the magnetic flux threading the SQUID loop of a qubit varies in time, in a manner analogous to Faraday's law of induction. Crucially, we show that this effect enables fast single qubit control through the coupler element in standard tunable-coupler architectures, potentially eliminating the need for individual microwave $XY$ control lines.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“investigate the impact”、“we find”、“we show”，属于理论分析与推导，未提及实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：超导量子比特电路中，由时变外部磁通引起的固有串扰，以及通过耦合器实现单量子比特门控的物理机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当量子比特SQUID环中的磁通随时间变化时，电容耦合的量子比特之间会产生非平凡的交叉电压驱动（类似法拉第感应定律），这一效应可在标准可调耦合器架构中实现快速单量子比特控制，可能消除对独立微波XY控制线的需求。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当量子比特SQUID环中的磁通随时间变化时，电容耦合的量子比特之间会产生非平凡的交叉电压驱动（类似法拉第感应定律），这一效应可在标准可调耦合器架构中实现快速单量子比特控制，可能消除对独立微波XY控制线的需求。；创新点：揭示了时变磁通在电容耦合量子比特间产生交叉电压驱动的新机制，并指出该机制可被利用于通过耦合器实现单量子比特门，从而简化超导量子芯片的布线结构。
papers.method_zh: 基于量子化电路的理论分析，利用法拉第电磁感应定律类比，研究时变外部磁通对超导量子比特耦合的影响。

papers.title: A kinetic model of shear-induced rupture of short dsDNA
papers.abstract: Force-induced dissociation of short double-stranded DNA (dsDNA) is central to single-molecule biophysics and DNA nanotechnology, yet a physically grounded kinetic description of shear-induced rupture for finite-length constructs remains lacking. Here we develop a master equation framework built on a force-dependent nucleation-zipper pathway with single-base transitions, enabling direct calculation of dissociation rates and transition state distances over a broad force range. Applied to a DNA-gold nanoparticle-DNA construct under constant shear force, the model accurately reproduces the experimental room-temperature data in the covered force regime and provides a unified interpretation of prior measurements on similarly sheared duplexes across all force regimes. A central result is that the three-dimensional helical geometry of dsDNA is essential for correctly defining the end to end distance under shear in the rod-like polymer model of short dsDNA. We further show that the extracted transition state distances are robust to variations in ssDNA polymer parameters within the experimentally relevant regime. Finally, we analyze the temperature dependence of the transition state distance and discuss how our framework captures globally-heated rupture while identifying the additional complications introduced by localized plasmonic heating in gold nanoparticle-coupled constructs. These results provide a predictive kinetic foundation for interpreting force-rupture experiments and for designing force- and temperature-actuated DNA nanostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：kinetic model（动力学模型）、master equation framework（主方程框架）、direct calculation（直接计算）。；研究对象：短双链DNA（short dsDNA）在剪切力诱导下的断裂动力学，具体涉及DNA-金纳米颗粒-DNA复合结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于力依赖的成核-拉链路径的主方程框架能准确重现实验数据，并揭示短dsDNA的三维螺旋几何结构对正确定义剪切下末端距至关重要；提取的过渡态距离对ssDNA聚合物参数变化具有鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于力依赖的成核-拉链路径的主方程框架能准确重现实验数据，并揭示短dsDNA的三维螺旋几何结构对正确定义剪切下末端距至关重要；提取的过渡态距离对ssDNA聚合物参数变化具有鲁棒性。；创新点：首次为有限长度短dsDNA在剪切力诱导下的断裂提供了有物理基础的动力学描述，并明确指出了三维螺旋几何结构在定义末端距中的关键作用。
papers.method_zh: 采用主方程框架，构建基于单碱基步进的力依赖成核-拉链路径模型，直接计算解离速率和过渡态距离，并与恒定剪切力下的实验数据对比。

papers.title: Topological origin of flow distributions in disordered porous media
papers.abstract: We investigate steady Stokes flow through porous media composed of two-dimensional disordered arrays of circular obstacles. We develop a theory for the statistics of flow rates based on a pore-network model that captures local flow correlations. We show that the flow rate distribution across the ensemble of pore bodies follows a Gamma distribution, and that the flow rate distribution through pore throats is fully determined in terms of it. Furthermore, this Gamma distribution can be directly linked to simple geometrical properties such as the coefficient of variation of pore throat widths, rendering the model parameterisable from minimal medium information. The resulting predictions agree closely with computational fluid dynamics simulations and show markedly better agreement than prior mean-field models that neglect local flow-rate correlations, clarifying how local splitting and merging shape flow in disordered porous networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：develop a theory、pore-network model、predictions）；研究对象：无序多孔介质中的稳态斯托克斯流（具体为二维无序圆形障碍物阵列）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 流率分布服从伽马分布，且该分布可直接由孔喉宽度的变异系数等简单几何性质参数化，比忽略局部流率关联的平均场模型更准确。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：流率分布服从伽马分布，且该分布可直接由孔喉宽度的变异系数等简单几何性质参数化，比忽略局部流率关联的平均场模型更准确。；创新点：揭示了局部流率分裂与合并如何塑造无序多孔网络中的流动，并建立了流率分布与介质几何参数之间的直接联系，使模型可从最小介质信息参数化。
papers.method_zh: 基于孔隙网络模型（pore-network model）建立理论，结合计算流体动力学（CFD）模拟进行验证。

papers.title: Low-Dose 3D Bonding Mapping Through "Soft" Core-Loss EELS Tomography and Unsupervised Deep Learning
papers.abstract: Resolving the 3D chemical configuration of beam-sensitive nanomaterials at high spatial resolution remains a persistent frontier in scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM). The main limitation lies in the trade-off between high electron dose required for analytical signals and the large number of projections needed for tomographic reconstruction. Here, we achieve dose-efficient 3D bonding mapping of FeO/Fe$_3$O$_4$ core-shell nanocubes with high resolution via electron energy loss spectroscopy (EELS). Our approach relies on two developments. First, a standardless "soft" core-loss EELS methodology exploiting Fe-M$_{2,3}$ edges provides ${\sim}50\times$ higher dose efficiency than conventional Fe-L$_{2,3}$ edges, using the latter only as a source of FeO and Fe$_3$O$_4$ standards. Second, we introduce multi-channel deep image prior with total variation regularization (DIPm-TV), an unsupervised method for spectroscopic tomography that jointly reconstructs multiple channels by exploiting spatial correlations under sparse-view and low-dose conditions. Using simulated datasets, high-quality reconstructions are obtained from as few as nine projections over $-70^\circ$ to $+70^\circ$, without HAADF-STEM signal or symmetry constraints. Applied to FeO/Fe$_3$O$_4$ nanocubes, Fe-M$_{2,3}$ EELS maps show improved SNR and spatial resolution, revealing a thin outer FeO shell surrounding the magnetite shell. DIPm-TV yields ${\sim}1$ nm isotropic resolution oxidation-state volumes preserving cubic morphology, recovering the outer FeO shell, and revealing a small internal void, features not accessible with conventional reconstruction methods. This work establishes a pathway for low-dose 2D and 3D analytical mapping of beam-sensitive materials using shallow core-loss edges, enabling orders-of-magnitude dose reduction while maintaining spectral fidelity and reliable 3D information.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM)、electron energy loss spectroscopy (EELS)、tomographic reconstruction）；研究对象：FeO/Fe₃O₄核壳纳米立方体（core-shell nanocubes）的三维化学构型与键合分布。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用“软”芯损失Fe-M₂,₃边结合无监督深度学习重建方法，实现了对束流敏感材料的高分辨率三维键合图谱，仅需9个投影即可获得约1 nm各向同性分辨率的氧化态体积图像，并揭示了外层FeO壳层和内部微小空洞。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用“软”芯损失Fe-M₂,₃边结合无监督深度学习重建方法，实现了对束流敏感材料的高分辨率三维键合图谱，仅需9个投影即可获得约1 nm各向同性分辨率的氧化态体积图像，并揭示了外层FeO壳层和内部微小空洞。；创新点：首次将“软”芯损失EELS（Fe-M₂,₃边）用于三维键合图谱，并结合无监督深度学习（DIPm-TV）实现低剂量、稀疏投影下的高分辨率三维化学成像，无需HAADF-STEM信号或对称性约束。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）中的电子能量损失谱（EELS），利用Fe-M₂,₃边（“软”芯损失）替代传统Fe-L₂,₃边，实现约50倍剂量效率提升；重建方法上引入多通道深度图像先验结合全变分正则化（DIPm-TV），一种无监督光谱层析成像方法，在稀疏投影和低剂量条件下联合重建多个通道。

papers.title: Generating functions for aggregation and fragmentation: review
papers.abstract: In this work, we review and revisit the generating function techniques that provide exact analytical solutions for aggregation and fragmentation equations across several physical regimes including spontaneous and collisonal shattering. For discrete coagulation-fragmentation equations with size-independent rates under monodisperse initial conditions, we show the derivation of sevaral explicit closed-form solutions. We also briefly report the exact solutions for continuous, three-particle, $D$-particle collisions and two-component generalizations. Source-driven aggregation yields steady distributions featuring a universal $s^{-3/2}$ power-law decay and a cutoff mass scaling $s_{*} \sim t^{2}$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：review, generating function techniques, exact analytical solutions, derivation。；研究对象：聚集与碎裂方程（aggregation and fragmentation equations），涵盖自发碎裂、碰撞碎裂、源驱动聚集等物理过程，以及离散、连续、三粒子、D粒子碰撞和两组分推广等体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用生成函数技术，可在多种物理条件下获得聚集-碎裂方程的精确解析解；源驱动聚集产生稳态分布，具有普适的 \( s^{-3/2} \) 幂律衰减和 \( s_{*} \sim t^{2} \) 的截止质量标度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用生成函数技术，可在多种物理条件下获得聚集-碎裂方程的精确解析解；源驱动聚集产生稳态分布，具有普适的 \( s^{-3/2} \) 幂律衰减和 \( s_{*} \sim t^{2} \) 的截止质量标度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 生成函数方法（generating function techniques），用于推导离散和连续形式的聚集-碎裂方程的精确解析解。

papers.title: UnReal-B : Real-Space DFT Solver for Matter in Extreme Magnetic Fields
papers.abstract: As new observational technologies reveal increasingly detailed properties of neutron star surfaces, the demand for accessible and extensible theoretical modeling tools continues to grow. We present UnReal-B, a real-space Density Functional Theory solver for one-dimensional chains of matter in extreme magnetic fields $B \approx 10^{12} - 10^{15},\mathrm{G}$. By employing the adiabatic approximation, UnReal-B, provides a streamlined numerical framework for calculating the electronic structure of strongly magnetized condensed matter. The solver is benchmarked against published results for several astrophysically relevant elements, demonstrating excellent agreement while maintaining a comparatively simple and transparent implementation. Released as open-source software, UnReal-B facilitates reproducible and community-driven investigations of neutron-star surface matter and provides a foundation for future developments motivated by emerging observational constraints.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：real-space Density Functional Theory solver、numerical framework、benchmarked。；研究对象：中子星表面物质在极端磁场（B ≈ 10¹²–10¹⁵ G）下的一维原子链的电子结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: UnReal-B 软件能够高效、准确地计算强磁场下凝聚态物质的电子结构，与已发表的若干天体物理相关元素的计算结果吻合良好。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：UnReal-B 软件能够高效、准确地计算强磁场下凝聚态物质的电子结构，与已发表的若干天体物理相关元素的计算结果吻合良好。；创新点：提供了一个开源、实现相对简单且透明的数值框架，便于可重复研究和社区驱动的中子星表面物质探索，并为未来基于观测约束的发展奠定基础。摘要未突出说明与已有DFT求解器在算法或效率上的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用绝热近似的实空间密度泛函理论（real-space DFT）求解器，针对一维原子链体系进行数值计算。

papers.title: Chiral Plasma under Strong Magnetic Fields: A Holographic Analysis of Transport Phenomena
papers.abstract: Chiral plasma appears in several areas of physics, historically starting from primordial plasma in the early Universe, then in quark-gluon plasma produced in heavy ion collisions, and, more recently, in Dirac and Weyl semimetals. The major signature of the plasma is the non-conservation of the axial current due to the chiral anomaly and the emergence of new, anomaly-induced transport phenomena. In this paper, we study the plasma exposed to arbitrarily strong constant magnetic and weak electric fields. Employing all-order gradient resummation, we write down constitutive relations for electric and axial currents parameterized by thirteen momentum- and magnetic- field-dependent transport coefficient functions. The latter are computed utilizing a theoretical lab for a realistic plasma, namely a holographic $U(1)_V \times U(1)_A$ Maxwell--Chern--Simons theory in Schwarzschild--AdS$_5$, in the probe limit. As an application, we revisit the phenomena of negative magnetoresistance and chiral magnetic waves, beyond the naive hydrodynamic limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：holographic analysis、constitutive relations、transport coefficient functions、hydrodynamic limit。；研究对象：手征等离子体（chiral plasma）在强磁场下的输运现象，具体涉及早期宇宙原初等离子体、重离子碰撞产生的夸克-胶子等离子体，以及狄拉克/外尔半金属中的手征等离子体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过全息方法计算了在任意强恒定磁场和弱电场下，手征等离子体的电导率和轴电流输运系数函数，并重新审视了负磁电阻和手征磁波现象，超越了传统流体力学极限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过全息方法计算了在任意强恒定磁场和弱电场下，手征等离子体的电导率和轴电流输运系数函数，并重新审视了负磁电阻和手征磁波现象，超越了传统流体力学极限。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用全息对偶方法，具体构建了Schwarzschild–AdS₅背景下的U(1)_V × U(1)_A Maxwell–Chern–Simons理论（探针极限），并运用全阶梯度重求和（all-order gradient resummation）技术推导出由13个依赖于动量和磁场的输运系数函数参数化的本构关系。

papers.title: Hawking--Page Universality, Thermodynamic Dipoles and Categorical Defects
papers.abstract: We reconsider the Hawking--Page transition using the common thermodynamic vector field whose zeros include the Davies and Hawking--Page points. In the elementary AdS branch their winding numbers are $w_{\rm D}=-1$ and $w_{\rm HP}=+1$, so the pair has zero total charge but a non-zero signed first moment. After normalization by the Davies scales this moment gives the familiar universal ratios $C_S$ and $C_T$; in four dimensions $C_S=2$ and $C_T=2/\sqrt{3}-1$. We check the construction for Schwarzschild--AdS, grand-canonical Reissner--Nordström--AdS, charged non-rotating black holes in arbitrary dimension, and Kerr--AdS at fixed angular velocity. The same reduced geometry gives a barrier $B=1/3$ in four dimensions and $B(d)=1/[(d-1)(d-3)]$. Finally we propose a formulation involving a defect-resolved version for categorical or non-invertible symmetry sectors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：thermodynamic vector field、winding numbers、Hawking–Page transition、AdS/CFT对应。；研究对象：黑洞热力学中的Hawking–Page相变，具体涉及Schwarzschild–AdS、Reissner–Nordström–AdS、Kerr–AdS等黑洞体系，以及范畴性缺陷（categorical defects）与非可逆对称性扇区。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过公共热力学矢量场重新审视Hawking–Page相变，发现Davies点和Hawking–Page点的绕数分别为-1和+1，构成总电荷为零但一阶矩非零的“热力学偶极子”。归一化后该矩给出普适比值C_S和C_T（四维下C_S=2，C_T=2/√3-1），并得到四维势垒B=1/3及一般维度下的表达式B(d)=1/[(d-1)(d-3)]。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过公共热力学矢量场重新审视Hawking–Page相变，发现Davies点和Hawking–Page点的绕数分别为-1和+1，构成总电荷为零但一阶矩非零的“热力学偶极子”。归一化后该矩给出普适比值C_S和C_T（四维下C_S=2，C_T=2/√3-1），并得到四维势垒B=1/3及一般维度下的表达式B(d)=1/[(d-1)(d-3)]。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用热力学矢量场方法，通过计算矢量场零点（Davies点和Hawking–Page点）的绕数（winding numbers）来刻画相变拓扑性质，并推广到带缺陷的范畴性对称扇区。

papers.title: Anomalous mobility edges and extended-localized transition in a quasiperiodic emitter-cavity array
papers.abstract: The manipulation of localization in quasiperiodic systems by mobility edges or localization transition holds significant physical importance. In this letter, we demonstrated that the dissipation can induce the emergence of anomalous mobility edges and extended-localized transition in emitter-cavity arrays controlled by quasiperiodic potentials. Specifically, we observe that the localization properties of emitters is governed by the nature of quantum bound states, either discrete or embedded in continuum, providing a unified mechanism linking the emitter-photon bound physics to quasiperiodic criticality. Depending on the bound state discrete or continuumlike, the induced effective excitation hopping exhibits either exponentially decaying or sinusoidally oscillating, giving rise to the formation of localized or critical states, respectively. Through a generalized duality transformation, we analytically determine the anomalous mobility edges and the critical strength of potential, enabling the construction of a full phase diagram. The study reveals that the physical characteristics of cavity exert a significant influence on excitation localization. Therefore, the manipulation of excitation localization can be achieved solely by adjusting the cavity fields.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“demonstrated”、“analytically determine”、“generalized duality transformation”等关键词，表明主要采用理论推导和分析方法。；研究对象：准周期势调控的发射器-腔阵列（emitter-cavity array）中的局域化现象，特别是反常迁移率边（anomalous mobility edges）和扩展-局域转变（extended-localized transition）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 耗散（dissipation）可以诱导准周期发射器-腔阵列中出现反常迁移率边和扩展-局域转变。发射器的局域化性质由量子束缚态（离散或嵌入连续谱）的性质决定，这为发射器-光子束缚物理与准周期临界性提供了统一机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：耗散（dissipation）可以诱导准周期发射器-腔阵列中出现反常迁移率边和扩展-局域转变。发射器的局域化性质由量子束缚态（离散或嵌入连续谱）的性质决定，这为发射器-光子束缚物理与准周期临界性提供了统一机制。；创新点：揭示了耗散可以诱导反常迁移率边，并建立了发射器-光子束缚态物理与准周期系统中局域化转变之间的统一联系。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 通过广义对偶变换（generalized duality transformation）解析地确定了反常迁移率边和临界势强度，并构建了完整的相图。研究基于对束缚态性质（离散或连续谱状）的分析，以及由此诱导的有效激发跳跃（指数衰减或正弦振荡）的物理图像。

papers.title: Unsupervised Deep Learning for Limited-Angle STEM-EDX Tomography -- Application to 3D Chemical Analysis of Phase-Change Memory Devices
papers.abstract: Energy Dispersive X-ray (EDX) tomography in Scanning Transmission Electron Microscopy (STEM) enables 3D compositional and elemental mapping at the nanoscale, but its use is limited by restricted tilt ranges and low-dose conditions required to avoid beam damage. Limited-angle acquisition introduces missing-wedge artefacts such as elongation and anisotropic resolution, while noisy low-dose data further degrade reconstruction quality and quantitative reliability. Here, we introduce an unsupervised deep learning framework based on Deep Image Prior with total variation regularization (DIP-TV) for limited-angle STEM-EDX tomography. We extend it to a multi-channel formulation (DIPm-TV) that jointly reconstructs multiple elemental maps by exploiting spatial correlations. Using a synthetic 3-channel phantom, we show that the method compensates for severe missing-wedge artefacts corresponding to approximately $100^\circ$ of missing angular range under moderate noise, outperforming simultaneous iterative reconstruction technique and compressed sensing approaches. We apply the method to 3D chemical analysis of Ge-Sb-Te (GST) memory devices in virgin (as-fabricated) and SET (crystalline) operational states. Samples were prepared as cross-sectional focused ion beam lamellae and acquired under a limited-angle tilt range from $-40^\circ$ to $+40^\circ$ with $5^\circ$ steps and a dose of $2.0\times10^5$ $e^-/Ang^2$. The multi-channel approach enables voxel-by-voxel elemental reconstruction using only EDX signals without external structural priors such as high-angle annular dark-field imaging. The reconstructed volumes show near-isotropic spatial resolution and reveal compositional heterogeneities associated with device operation. This approach enables 3D chemical characterization in experimentally accessible sample geometries where conventional methods fail due to severe angular limitations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/方法文章。关键词：unsupervised deep learning framework, Deep Image Prior, multi-channel formulation, synthetic phantom验证。；研究对象：相变存储器（Phase-Change Memory Devices）中的Ge-Sb-Te（GST）材料，具体分析其原始（virgin）和SET（结晶）两种工作状态下的三维化学成分分布。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于多通道深度图像先验（DIPm-TV）的无监督深度学习框架，能够在严重有限角度（约100°缺失）和低剂量条件下，实现近各向同性空间分辨率的STEM-EDX三维元素重构，并揭示与器件操作相关的成分不均匀性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于多通道深度图像先验（DIPm-TV）的无监督深度学习框架，能够在严重有限角度（约100°缺失）和低剂量条件下，实现近各向同性空间分辨率的STEM-EDX三维元素重构，并揭示与器件操作相关的成分不均匀性。；创新点：首次将多通道深度图像先验（DIPm-TV）应用于有限角度STEM-EDX断层扫描，仅利用EDX信号（无需高角环形暗场像等外部结构先验）即可实现体素级元素重构，有效补偿严重缺失楔形伪影。
papers.method_zh: 采用无监督深度学习框架Deep Image Prior结合全变分正则化（DIP-TV），并扩展为多通道版本（DIPm-TV）以联合重构多个元素图。使用合成三通道体模进行方法验证，并与同步迭代重构技术（SIRT）和压缩感知方法对比。实验数据来自扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）中的能量色散X射线（EDX）断层扫描，样品为聚焦离子束（FIB）制备的截面薄片，在-40°至+40°的有限角度范围内以5°步长采集，剂量为2.0×10⁵ e⁻/Å²。

papers.title: Precision measurements at the interface between unitary and non-unitary encoding
papers.abstract: We investigate precision scaling at the interface between unitary and non-unitary encoding under generalized noise including single-particle and collective dephasing and decay. Using linear response theory and the error propagation formula, we derive analytic precision expressions for both the unitary parameter $Ω$ and the dissipation strength $γ$. For unitary encoding, when the observable commutes with a Hermitian noise operator, the optimal encoding time is independent of $N$, yielding the Heisenberg limit $ΔΩ\propto 1 / N$; otherwise the precision degrades to the standard quantum limit or ceases to improve with $N$. For non-unitary encoding, when $[\hat{A}, \hat{O}] = 0$, the precision is insensitive to intrinsic dynamics and encoding time, scaling as $Δγ\propto \sqrt{γ/ \expval*{\hat{L}^\dagger \hat{L}}}$. Notably, for collective decay, the Dicke state reaches the Heisenberg limit $Δγ\propto 1 / N$, demonstrating that entanglement can enhance non-unitary estimation. Our results provide a unified framework and practical guidance for designing quantum metrology protocols in noisy environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：linear response theory, error propagation formula, analytic precision expressions。；研究对象：量子计量学中，在广义噪声（包括单粒子和集体退相位、衰减）影响下，幺正编码与非幺正编码界面处的精度标度行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于幺正编码，当可观测量与厄米噪声算符对易时，最优编码时间与粒子数N无关，可实现海森堡极限（ΔΩ∝1/N）；否则精度退化为标准量子极限或不再随N改善。对于非幺正编码，当算符对易时，精度对内在动力学和编码时间不敏感；在集体衰减情形下，Dicke态可达到海森堡极限（Δγ∝1/N），表明纠缠可增强非幺正估计。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于幺正编码，当可观测量与厄米噪声算符对易时，最优编码时间与粒子数N无关，可实现海森堡极限（ΔΩ∝1/N）；否则精度退化为标准量子极限或不再随N改善。对于非幺正编码，当算符对易时，精度对内在动力学和编码时间不敏感；在集体衰减情形下，Dicke态可达到海森堡极限（Δγ∝1/N），表明纠缠可增强非幺正估计。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用线性响应理论和误差传播公式，推导了幺正参数Ω和耗散强度γ的解析精度表达式。

papers.title: Rank Collapse, Fixed Points, and the Renormalization Group Structure of MLP Residual Networks
papers.abstract: The analogy between deep neural network forward passes and renormalization group (RG) flows has been repeatedly noted in the literature, but existing treatments remain qualitative: depth is described as a coarse-graining scale, attention is likened to a partition function, and representations are said to flow toward fixed points. No existing work has defined a measurable RG order parameter, tested it under controlled variation of the input distribution, or made quantitative predictions that are empirically verified. We study the simplest architecture for which the analogy is tractable: a pure MLP residual stack trained on masked token prediction over synthetic Markov chain sequences with known spectral properties. We report three findings. (i) The effective rank of the residual stream decreases monotonically with depth after training, consistent with progressive integration of irrelevant degrees of freedom. (ii) This rank collapse is selective: it occurs for chains with short correlation length approximately 1 but is absent for chains with long correlation length approximately 7, measured at the position level to control for mean-pooling artifacts. The network preserves exactly the degrees of freedom relevant to the prediction task, the content of the RG relevance criterion. (iii) Inter-layer kernel drift is concentrated at one or two specific transitions, with the remainder of the network near a fixed point, consistent with a discrete fixed-point plateau. Together these findings constitute the first quantitative, position-level evidence that MLP residual networks implement a selective coarse-graining procedure governed by the spectral structure of the input distribution.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值实验验证）。判断依据：关键词“quantitative predictions that are empirically verified”、“trained on...”、“report three findings”，表明该工作基于理论框架（重正化群类比）并通过神经网络训练实验进行定量验证。；研究对象：纯MLP残差网络（Residual Networks）在合成马尔可夫链序列上的掩码标记预测任务。具体体系为具有已知谱性质的合成马尔可夫链序列，用于研究神经网络深度方向上的重正化群结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: MLP残差网络在训练后，残差流的有效秩随深度单调下降（秩坍缩），且该坍缩具有选择性：仅当输入序列相关长度短（约1）时发生，长相关长度（约7）时消失。此外，层间核漂移集中在少数特定过渡层，其余部分接近不动点，表明网络实现了离散的不动点平台结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：MLP残差网络在训练后，残差流的有效秩随深度单调下降（秩坍缩），且该坍缩具有选择性：仅当输入序列相关长度短（约1）时发生，长相关长度（约7）时消失。此外，层间核漂移集中在少数特定过渡层，其余部分接近不动点，表明网络实现了离散的不动点平台结构。；创新点：首次定义了可测量的重正化群序参量（有效秩），并在受控输入分布变化下进行定量验证，提供了位置级（position-level）证据，证明MLP残差网络实现了由输入分布谱结构主导的选择性粗粒化过程。此前相关工作仅停留在定性类比层面。
papers.method_zh: 通过训练纯MLP残差网络执行合成马尔可夫链序列的掩码标记预测任务，测量残差流的有效秩随深度的变化，并控制输入分布（不同相关长度）进行对比。同时分析层间核的漂移行为，以识别不动点平台。

papers.title: Unidirectional-like Edge Transport Induced by Non-Hermitian Skin Effects
papers.abstract: Non-Hermitian skin effects (NHSEs) enable dramatic boundary accumulation of waves, yet their experimental realization typically demands engineered nonreciprocity or spatially patterned loss. Here we demonstrate theoretically and experimentally that uniform loss provides a simple and previously overlooked mechanism for enforcing unidirectional-like edge transport in photonic crystals (PhCs) that breaks time-reversal symmetry in the presence of nonchiral edge states. Using a core cladding geometry where domains share identical Chern numbers but possess distinct bulk polarizations, we show that uniform loss activates NHSEs that reshape the spectral topology of edge bands, giving rise to point gap windings that dictate a one way propagation. Near field measurements confirm that loss converts intrinsically bidirectional interface states into a unidirectional-like circulation around the entire domain wall, showing excellent agreement with theory. Our results establish uniform loss as a universal and structurally simple route for achieving unidirectional-like wave transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论+实验）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“demonstrate theoretically and experimentally”，并包含“Near field measurements confirm”等实验验证描述。；研究对象：光子晶体（PhCs）中的边缘输运现象，具体为利用非厄米趋肤效应（NHSEs）在非手性边缘态中实现类单向边缘输运。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 均匀损耗（uniform loss）可以激活非厄米趋肤效应，重塑边缘带的谱拓扑，产生点隙缠绕（point gap windings），从而将原本双向传播的界面态转变为围绕整个畴壁的类单向循环输运。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：均匀损耗（uniform loss）可以激活非厄米趋肤效应，重塑边缘带的谱拓扑，产生点隙缠绕（point gap windings），从而将原本双向传播的界面态转变为围绕整个畴壁的类单向循环输运。；创新点：发现均匀损耗（而非工程化的非互易性或空间图案化损耗）是一种此前被忽视的、简单且通用的机制，可在非手性边缘态存在时打破时间反演对称性，实现类单向边缘输运。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析结合近场测量实验。理论部分基于核心-包层（core cladding）几何结构，其中两个区域具有相同的陈数但不同的体极化（bulk polarizations），通过引入均匀损耗激活NHSE；实验部分采用近场测量技术验证输运方向转变。

papers.title: Filamentary Transport and Thermoelectric Effects in Mushroom Phase Change Memory Cells
papers.abstract: We performed a 2D finite-element electrothermal computational study of thermoelectric effects and filamentary electronic transport in Ge$_2$Sb$_2$Te$_5$ mushroom phase change memory cells during Reset and Set operations, accounting for spatial activation energy variations in amorphous Ge$_2$Sb$_2$Te$_5$ and phase-change dynamics. Reset operations with current going from the top electrode to the narrow 4 nm bottom electrode require $\sim$3x less energy and power, and $\sim$2x lower current to achieve the same Reset resistance, compared to the opposite polarity, due to thermoelectric effects. Filamentary conduction, electrical breakdown, thermal runaway, and local crystallization of amorphous Ge$_2$Sb$_2$Te$_5$ depend on current polarity and thermal boundary conditions, and determine the location, shape, and volume of the programming region, which may be significantly smaller than the semi-cylindrical mushroom region. The programming volume does not scale with contact dimensions larger than 10 nm. Larger contact areas introduce increased device-to-device and cycle-to-cycle variability due to filamentary conduction but are expected to lead to higher reliability and endurance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“2D finite-element electrothermal computational study”（二维有限元电热计算研究）。；研究对象：Ge₂Sb₂Te₅（GST）蘑菇型相变存储单元中的丝状输运和热电效应，具体涉及Reset和Set操作过程中的电热行为、丝状导电、电击穿、热失控及局部结晶。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Reset操作中，电流从顶部电极流向窄的4 nm底部电极时，由于热电效应，相比相反极性，能耗和功率降低约3倍，电流降低约2倍，且能达到相同的Reset电阻。编程区域的位置、形状和体积由电流极性和热边界条件决定，可能显著小于半圆柱形蘑菇区域，且当接触尺寸大于10 nm时，编程体积不再随接触尺寸缩放。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Reset操作中，电流从顶部电极流向窄的4 nm底部电极时，由于热电效应，相比相反极性，能耗和功率降低约3倍，电流降低约2倍，且能达到相同的Reset电阻。编程区域的位置、形状和体积由电流极性和热边界条件决定，可能显著小于半圆柱形蘑菇区域，且当接触尺寸大于10 nm时，编程体积不再随接触尺寸缩放。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用二维有限元电热计算模拟，考虑了非晶Ge₂Sb₂Te₅中空间激活能变化以及相变动力学。

papers.title: Multifractal Signatures of Ageing and Dementia Development: A Multifractal Space-Filling Curve Analysis
papers.abstract: Multifractality is an effective formalism for quantifying the nonlinear, scale-free properties of complex data. In this study, we propose a novel and efficient methodology, termed Multifractal Space-filling Curve Analysis (MFSCA), for quantifying the correlation structure of multidimensional data. Within this framework, the original multidimensional data - while preserving both local and long-range organisational properties - are projected onto a one-dimensional representation using a fractal space-filling curve. The resulting one-dimensional signal is then analysed using multifractal algorithms. We demonstrate the utility of the method using both artificially generated multifractal structures and real data. In particular, we apply MFSCA to analyse magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) data from Alzheimer patients at different stages of dementia. Based on the results, we estimate the multifractal profiles of the brain for healthy subjects of different ages as well as for dementia patients. The analysis reveals that the spatial organization of brain structures, as measured by the degree of multifractality, progressively weakens with age and the development of dementia. A transition from multifractality to monofractality is observed both in control groups, when comparing the Young Control and Elderly Control groups, and among dementia subjects of similar age but at different stages of the disease, namely early dementia and mild cognitive impairment. Thus, from the perspective of multiscaling properties, the heterogeneous characteristics of spatial brain organization deteriorate under worsening conditions, leading to a homogeneous and weakly correlated structure. These findings not only effectively capture key aspects of brain organisation, but also demonstrate that the multifractality of MRI data can serve as a marker of structural brain changes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：提出新方法（Multifractal Space-filling Curve Analysis）、分析人工生成数据和真实数据、未提及实验操作。；研究对象：脑部磁共振成像（MRI）数据，具体为阿尔茨海默病不同阶段患者及不同年龄健康对照者的脑结构空间组织。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 脑结构的空间组织异质性（用多重分形程度衡量）随年龄增长和痴呆发展而逐渐减弱，出现从多重分形向单分形的转变，表明脑组织从异质、强相关结构退化为均质、弱相关结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：脑结构的空间组织异质性（用多重分形程度衡量）随年龄增长和痴呆发展而逐渐减弱，出现从多重分形向单分形的转变，表明脑组织从异质、强相关结构退化为均质、弱相关结构。；创新点：提出了一种将多维数据通过分形空间填充曲线降维后再进行多重分形分析的高效新框架，并首次将其应用于阿尔茨海默病不同阶段及不同年龄健康对照的MRI数据，揭示脑结构多重分形特征随衰老和痴呆发展的退化规律。
papers.method_zh: 提出一种名为“多重分形空间填充曲线分析”（MFSCA）的新方法：先用分形空间填充曲线将多维数据（如MRI图像）投影为一维信号（保留局部和长程组织特性），再用多重分形算法分析该一维信号。

papers.title: Determining universal spectra from probability distributions
papers.abstract: The probability distribution of a two-particle correlation function computed over background auxiliary field configurations, used to generate the interactions, has been shown to inform about the spectra of universal $n$-body clusters [1]. Here, we utilize two approaches, a numerical lattice computation and an analytic expansion in the limit of large numbers of identical species, in an attempt to refine the initial predictions. Exploratory calculations in these directions are presented, and future investigations laid out.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值计算）。关键词：analytic expansion、numerical lattice computation。；研究对象：通用n体团簇的能谱，以及如何从背景辅助场构型中计算的双粒子关联函数的概率分布中提取该能谱。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明最终物理结论，仅指出通过数值格点计算和大数量相同物种极限下的解析展开，试图改进对通用能谱的初始预测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明最终物理结论，仅指出通过数值格点计算和大数量相同物种极限下的解析展开，试图改进对通用能谱的初始预测。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 数值格点计算（numerical lattice computation）和解析展开（analytic expansion in the limit of large numbers of identical species）。

papers.title: Collective drift and pinning in active rotator networks with Kuramoto coupling and mixed-sign feedback disorder
papers.abstract: Active rotator models provide a minimal phase description of excitable and oscillatory systems, and have long been used to study mutual entrainment, synchronization, and collective transitions. Here, we investigate fully connected active rotator networks with Kuramoto coupling, where a common intrinsic drive competes with local feedback amplitudes drawn from a zero-mean Gaussian distribution. This produces a competition between local pinning and collective phase alignment. Using mean absolute late-time drift and the fractions of positive and negative drifting oscillators, we construct numerical regime maps in the feedback-disorder-coupling plane. At weak coupling, increasing the feedback disorder strength suppresses drift, while stronger coupling can restore positive late-time drift when feedback disorder is not too strong. We interpret these regimes using analytical limits for the uncoupled and coherent strong-coupling cases. We also examine finite-size effects and zero-mean distributed intrinsic frequencies. Together, these results show that mixed-sign local feedback alone can reshape the balance between pinning and drifting in coupled active rotator networks, even when the intrinsic drive is homogeneous.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：active rotator models、numerical regime maps、analytical limits。；研究对象：具有Kuramoto耦合的全连接活性转子网络，其中共同内禀驱动与来自零均值高斯分布的局域反馈振幅竞争，导致局域钉扎与集体相位对齐之间的竞争。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 混合符号的局域反馈本身即可重塑耦合活性转子网络中钉扎与漂移之间的平衡，即使内禀驱动是均匀的；弱耦合下增强反馈无序强度抑制漂移，而强耦合可在反馈无序不太强时恢复正漂移。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：混合符号的局域反馈本身即可重塑耦合活性转子网络中钉扎与漂移之间的平衡，即使内禀驱动是均匀的；弱耦合下增强反馈无序强度抑制漂移，而强耦合可在反馈无序不太强时恢复正漂移。；创新点：揭示了仅通过混合符号局域反馈（而非传统上依赖内禀频率分布）即可调控活性转子网络中的集体漂移行为，为理解钉扎-漂移竞争提供了新的机制。
papers.method_zh: 数值构建反馈无序-耦合强度平面上的相图，使用平均绝对晚期漂移以及正、负漂移转子比例作为序参量；同时采用无耦合和相干强耦合极限的解析分析，并考察有限尺寸效应和零均值分布的内禀频率。

papers.title: Absence of poor local minima in matrix product states
papers.abstract: Quantum circuits suffer from severe trainability issues: even shallow circuits are swamped with poor local minima. Yet matrix product states (MPS), which can be prepared by sequential circuits, are remarkably trainable in practice -- as demonstrated by decades of successful density matrix renormalization group calculations. In this work, we resolve this apparent paradox by proving that the energy landscapes of MPS are free from poor local minima, under the same setting where brickwork circuits are not. The key insight is that the gauge freedom of MPS creates an effective local overparametrization that causes local minima to concentrate near the global minimum, analogous to overparametrized classical neural networks. We rigorously prove that the local minimum distribution of the MPS energy landscape is invariant under moves of the orthogonality center. Numerical experiments further confirm that the optimization of sequential circuits converges to near-optimal solutions even for random Hamiltonians, in stark contrast to brickwork circuits. Our findings highlight the pivotal role of effective local overparametrization in determining trainability, providing a valuable guide for overcoming the trainability bottleneck of variational quantum algorithms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：prove、rigorously prove、theoretical framework、energy landscapes）；研究对象：矩阵乘积态（MPS）的能量景观，以及与之相关的变分量子算法的可训练性问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了在砖墙电路存在大量不良局部极小值的相同条件下，矩阵乘积态的能量景观中不存在不良局部极小值，其局部极小值分布集中在全局最小值附近。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了在砖墙电路存在大量不良局部极小值的相同条件下，矩阵乘积态的能量景观中不存在不良局部极小值，其局部极小值分布集中在全局最小值附近。；创新点：揭示了MPS中有效局部过参数化（由规范自由度引起）是决定其可训练性的关键机制，解释了MPS在密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）计算中表现优异而量子电路却存在严重可训练性问题的矛盾。
papers.method_zh: 理论证明（利用MPS的规范自由度导致有效局部过参数化，证明能量景观局部极小值分布关于正交中心移动不变性）与数值实验（对比顺序电路与砖墙电路在随机哈密顿量下的优化收敛性）。

papers.title: Bootstrap Cone of the Multicritical Deconfined Quantum Critical Point
papers.abstract: The deconfined quantum critical point (DQCP) provides a prominent example of the unconventional phase transitions beyond the Landau-Ginzburg-Wilson paradigm and its nature has been controversial for decades. The DQCP has been extensively studied and the results lead to two opposite scenarios with pseudo-criticality or multicriticality. The pseudo-criticality is a prevailing scenario of DQCP which interprets the approximately scale invariant numerical results with the walking behavior near complex fixed points. In contrast, the multicriticality scenario conjectures the DQCP is a unitary fixed point with a relevant $SO(5)$ singlet scalar. In this work we provide substantial evidence for the multicriticality scenario using conformal bootstrap. We start with the observation that the large scale Quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) results nearly saturate the bootstrap bounds. After imposing suitable sparseness condition the bootstrap bound forms a sharp cone in the three-dimensional parameter space. The bootstrap cone is close to the QMC data. We use the navigator algorithm to locate the apex of the cone and extract the extremal solutions. We find striking consistencies between the bootstrap solutions and the fuzzy sphere data of DQCP, including the coefficients in the operator product expansions (OPEs) and the higher spectrum! The bootstrap cone unifies the QMC and the fuzzy sphere data into a unitary conformal field theory with a relevant $SO(5)$ singlet scalar, thus strongly supporting the multicriticality scenario of DQCP. The agreement between the conformal bootstrap, QMC and fuzzy sphere results is a surprise towards solving DQCP and decoding the profound phase diagram of the two-dimensional quantum magnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“conformal bootstrap”（共形自举）、“navigator algorithm”（导航算法）、“operator product expansions”（算符乘积展开），属于解析与数值结合的理论研究。；研究对象：去禁闭量子临界点（DQCP），特别是其多临界性（multicriticality）场景，涉及二维量子磁体的相图。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过共形自举分析，发现量子蒙特卡洛（QMC）和模糊球（fuzzy sphere）数据均落在自举锥（bootstrap cone）内，且自举解与模糊球数据在算符乘积展开系数及高能谱上高度一致，强有力地支持DQCP是一个具有相关SO(5)单态标量场的幺正固定点（多临界性场景）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过共形自举分析，发现量子蒙特卡洛（QMC）和模糊球（fuzzy sphere）数据均落在自举锥（bootstrap cone）内，且自举解与模糊球数据在算符乘积展开系数及高能谱上高度一致，强有力地支持DQCP是一个具有相关SO(5)单态标量场的幺正固定点（多临界性场景）。；创新点：首次将共形自举、量子蒙特卡洛和模糊球三种独立方法的结果统一到同一个幺正共形场论框架中，为DQCP的多临界性场景提供了决定性证据，解决了长期存在的伪临界性与多临界性之争。
papers.method_zh: 采用共形自举（conformal bootstrap）方法，结合稀疏性条件（sparseness condition）构建三维参数空间中的自举锥，并使用导航算法（navigator algorithm）定位锥顶并提取极值解。

papers.title: Tame the Umklapp Processes in Real-Time Lattice Simulation for Hydrodynamics: An Ising Field Theory Study
papers.abstract: We calculate the real-time symmetric correlation function of the stress-energy tensor for a non-integrable Ising field theory consisting of three stable scalar particles via lattice Hamiltonian simulation. Using classical exact diagonalization and the matrix product state tensor network methods, we find that in the scaling region of the lattice theory, Umklapp processes are suppressed and the sound modes of relativistic hydrodynamics emerge at long wavelength and late time. The extracted ratio of bulk viscosity to entropy density is $ζ/s=14.19\pm 0.90$ and the speed of sound is $c_s/c=0.76 \pm 0.02$ at the temperature $T\approx 7.14$ in units of the lowest stable particle's mass. Our study demonstrates the utility of real-time lattice Hamiltonian simulation for describing hydrodynamization and calculating transport coefficients nonperturbatively.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：lattice Hamiltonian simulation、classical exact diagonalization、matrix product state tensor network methods）；研究对象：非可积Ising场论中的流体动力学行为，具体研究由三种稳定标量粒子构成的非可积Ising场论体系中的应力-能量张量关联函数与声波模式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在晶格理论的标度区中，Umklapp过程被抑制，长波长、晚时间下出现相对论性流体力学的声波模式；提取的体粘滞系数与熵密度之比为ζ/s=14.19±0.90，声速为c_s/c=0.76±0.02（温度T≈7.14，以最轻稳定粒子质量为单位）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在晶格理论的标度区中，Umklapp过程被抑制，长波长、晚时间下出现相对论性流体力学的声波模式；提取的体粘滞系数与熵密度之比为ζ/s=14.19±0.90，声速为c_s/c=0.76±0.02（温度T≈7.14，以最轻稳定粒子质量为单位）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用实时间晶格哈密顿量模拟，结合经典精确对角化与矩阵乘积态张量网络方法，计算非可积Ising场论中应力-能量张量的实时间对称关联函数。

papers.title: Topological Triplons in the Pinwheel Valence Bond Solid on the Kagome Lattice
papers.abstract: We investigate the triplon excitations of the pinwheel valence-bond-solid phase on the deformed kagome lattice compound Rb2Cu3SnF12. Using bond-operator mean-field theory, we compute the triplon band structure, dynamical structure factor, Berry curvatures and the associated thermal Hall response. We show that the presence of Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions and an external magnetic field are key for endowing triplon bands with nontrivial Chern numbers. We find good qualitative agreement of the low-energy dynamical structure factor with neutron-scattering experiments. An applied magnetic field can isolate the lowest triplon Chern band leading to a tunable thermal Hall conductivity for accessible temperature and field regimes. Our results establish the deformed kagome pinwheel valence-bond solid as a promising platform for topological triplon physics and for observing the associated thermal Hall effect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。判断依据：使用 bond-operator mean-field theory（键算符平均场理论）进行计算，并涉及 Berry 曲率、热霍尔效应等理论分析。；研究对象：变形 kagome 晶格化合物 Rb2Cu3SnF12 中的“pinwheel 价键固体”相（pinwheel valence-bond-solid phase）及其 triplon 激发。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用和外磁场是赋予 triplon 能带非平庸 Chern 数的关键；通过外加磁场可隔离最低的 triplon Chern 能带，从而在可达到的温度和磁场范围内实现可调的热霍尔电导率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用和外磁场是赋予 triplon 能带非平庸 Chern 数的关键；通过外加磁场可隔离最低的 triplon Chern 能带，从而在可达到的温度和磁场范围内实现可调的热霍尔电导率。；创新点：首次在变形 kagome 晶格的 pinwheel 价键固体相中系统研究拓扑 triplon 激发及其热霍尔效应，并与中子散射实验的低能动力学结构因子取得良好定性一致。
papers.method_zh: 键算符平均场理论（bond-operator mean-field theory），用于计算 triplon 能带结构、动力学结构因子、Berry 曲率及热霍尔响应。

papers.title: Persistent currents, whirlpools, and local Chern markers in twisted TMD Chern insulators
papers.abstract: Recent materials advances have made it possible to fabricate twisted transition metal dichalcogenide homobilayers. These systems have been shown to host integer and fractional Chern insulating states. Because of spontaneous time reversal symmetry breaking, their ground state harbors intriguing spin-polarized currents with whirlpools on the moiré length scale that can be measured by scanning probe methods. We first provide a quantitative analysis of these persistent currents and then show that the maximum of the amplitude of the current density in the bulk of the sample is an accurate tracker of topological order. We conclude by calculating how the quantization of the Hall conductance is affected by finite-size effects.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要提到“提供定量分析”“计算霍尔电导的量子化受有限尺寸效应影响”，未提及实验数据或合成方法。；研究对象：扭曲过渡金属二硫族化物（TMD）同质双层体系中的陈绝缘体态，具体关注其自旋极化持续电流、涡旋结构以及局域陈数标记。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在扭曲TMD陈绝缘体中，由于自发时间反演对称性破缺，基态存在莫尔尺度上的自旋极化持续电流和涡旋结构；样品体相中电流密度幅值的最大值可准确追踪拓扑序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在扭曲TMD陈绝缘体中，由于自发时间反演对称性破缺，基态存在莫尔尺度上的自旋极化持续电流和涡旋结构；样品体相中电流密度幅值的最大值可准确追踪拓扑序。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 定量分析持续电流的分布与幅值，并通过计算有限尺寸效应对霍尔电导量子化的影响来验证拓扑性质。摘要未明确指定具体计算方法（如紧束缚模型、连续模型或第一性原理），但属于理论建模与数值计算。

papers.title: Proximity-induced orbital antiferromagnetism in Ising superconductors
papers.abstract: We predict a fundamentally new superconducting state in superconductor/antiferromagnet heterostructures with Ising spin--orbit coupling: proximity-induced orbital antiferromagnetism. In this state, the order parameter acquires a periodic phase modulation locked to the magnetic lattice, generating atomic-scale loop currents with opposite orbital moments on neighboring unit cells. Its emergence requires at least three nonequivalent magnetic sublattices per unit cell and finite spin--orbit coupling. Using NbSe$_2$/MnPS$_3$ as a concrete example, we combine first-principles and Bogoliubov--de Gennes calculations to demonstrate that the proximity-induced exchange field leads to robust phase modulation. Unlike FFLO and helical states, the phase gradient is atomic-scale, the state is current-carrying, and it remains uniquely stable over the full parameter range. The state manifests as characteristic finite-energy dips in the local density of states, accessible by STM.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。判断依据：关键词“predict”（预测）、“first-principles and Bogoliubov–de Gennes calculations”（第一性原理和BdG计算）。；研究对象：超导体/反铁磁体异质结，具体以具有伊辛自旋-轨道耦合的NbSe₂/MnPS₃体系为例。研究的物理现象是“邻近效应诱导的轨道反铁磁性”。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 预言了一种全新的超导态：在具有伊辛自旋-轨道耦合的超导/反铁磁异质结中，邻近效应会诱导出轨道反铁磁性。该态下，超导序参量具有锁定在磁晶格上的周期性相位调制，从而在相邻原胞中产生具有相反轨道磁矩的原子尺度环流。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：预言了一种全新的超导态：在具有伊辛自旋-轨道耦合的超导/反铁磁异质结中，邻近效应会诱导出轨道反铁磁性。该态下，超导序参量具有锁定在磁晶格上的周期性相位调制，从而在相邻原胞中产生具有相反轨道磁矩的原子尺度环流。；创新点：预言了一种不同于FFLO态和螺旋态的全新超导态。其关键新意在于：1）相位梯度是原子尺度的，而非长程调制；2）该态是载流态；3）在全部参数范围内保持独特的稳定性。摘要未突出说明与具体实验技术的对比创新点。
papers.method_zh: 结合了第一性原理计算（First-principles calculations）和博戈留波夫-德热纳（Bogoliubov–de Gennes, BdG）方程计算。

papers.title: Radiowave-induced Resistance Oscillations
papers.abstract: Microwave-induced resistance oscillations (MIROs) \cite{zudov:2001a} occur when a 2D electron gas is subjected to radiation of frequency $ω= 2 πf$ and varying magnetic field $B$. MIROs are periodic in $1/B$, with the period determined by the radiation frequency $ω$, and their amplitude scales with the radiation power. Stepping from single-photon transitions between Landau levels, MIROs are found on the lower-field side of the cyclotron resonance, $ω_c \lesssim ω$, where $ω_c$ is the cyclotron frequency. Here, we report on experimental observation of another class of magneto resistance oscillations, which are also induced by radiation, but in the radio frequency (UHF band) range. These oscillations are distinct from MIROs in the following aspects: (i) they occur at $ω_c \gg ω$, (ii) their amplitude is independent of radiation power, (iii) their period is controlled by the radiation electric field, rather than by $ω$, and (iv) they can be either $1/B$ or $1/B^2$-periodic, depending on $B$. We further show that these oscillations can be explained by a displacement model in the limit of short-range disorder.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“experimental observation”，并描述了实验现象与对比分析。；研究对象：二维电子气（2D electron gas）在射频（UHF频段）辐射下的磁电阻振荡现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二维电子气中观测到一种新型的射频诱导磁电阻振荡，其特性与已知的微波诱导电阻振荡（MIROs）完全不同：振荡发生在回旋频率远大于辐射频率的区域，振幅与辐射功率无关，周期由辐射电场而非频率控制，且可呈现1/B或1/B²周期性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二维电子气中观测到一种新型的射频诱导磁电阻振荡，其特性与已知的微波诱导电阻振荡（MIROs）完全不同：振荡发生在回旋频率远大于辐射频率的区域，振幅与辐射功率无关，周期由辐射电场而非频率控制，且可呈现1/B或1/B²周期性。；创新点：首次报道了在回旋频率远大于辐射频率（ω_c ≫ ω）条件下由射频辐射诱导的磁电阻振荡，并揭示了其与MIROs在周期控制机制、功率依赖性和周期性类型上的本质区别。
papers.method_zh: 实验测量了二维电子气在射频辐射（UHF频段）和变化磁场下的磁电阻响应，并与微波诱导电阻振荡（MIROs）进行对比。理论解释采用短程无序极限下的位移模型（displacement model）。

papers.title: Frequency-resolved decoherence spectroscopy of a semiconductor charge qubit coupled to a high-impedance resonator
papers.abstract: Superconducting resonators coupled to semiconductor quantum dots provide a powerful platform to investigate light-matter interaction and decoherence mechanisms in solid-state quantum systems. Here we study a hybrid circuit quantum electrodynamics architecture consisting of a GaAs double-quantum-dot charge qubit capacitively coupled to a high-impedance, frequency-tunable SQUID-array resonator. By tuning the qubit transition frequency over the range $ω_\mathrm{q}/2π\sim 3$-$6$ GHz, we perform frequency-resolved decoherence spectroscopy of the charge qubit across a broad energy window. Time-resolved measurements enable us to disentangle relaxation and pure dephasing processes and to identify distinct decoherence regimes as a function of qubit frequency. We find that at lower frequencies ($\leq 4.5$ GHz) dephasing dominates the qubit linewidth, whereas at higher frequencies energy relaxation becomes the leading contribution. The measured frequency dependence of the relaxation rate exhibits a cubic scaling, consistent with charge-qubit decay dominated by coupling to a piezoelectric phonon bath and providing frequency-resolved access to the corresponding phonon-induced spectral density. Our results show that hybrid semiconductor--superconducting circuits can serve as sensitive spectroscopic tools to probe microscopic decoherence mechanisms relevant for a wide range of hybrid quantum devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：hybrid circuit quantum electrodynamics architecture、measurements、spectroscopic tools。；研究对象：GaAs双量子点电荷量子比特，与高阻抗、频率可调SQUID阵列谐振器电容耦合构成的混合电路量子电动力学体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过频率分辨退相干光谱，发现电荷量子比特在低频（≤4.5 GHz）时退相位主导线宽，在高频时能量弛豫成为主要贡献；弛豫率随频率呈立方标度，与压电声子库耦合导致的电荷量子比特衰变一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过频率分辨退相干光谱，发现电荷量子比特在低频（≤4.5 GHz）时退相位主导线宽，在高频时能量弛豫成为主要贡献；弛豫率随频率呈立方标度，与压电声子库耦合导致的电荷量子比特衰变一致。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用频率可调SQUID阵列谐振器与GaAs双量子点电荷量子比特电容耦合，通过调谐量子比特跃迁频率（3-6 GHz）进行频率分辨退相干光谱测量，并结合时间分辨测量区分弛豫和纯退相位过程。

papers.title: Analog quantum simulation of chiral magnetic dynamics using optical superlattices
papers.abstract: We propose an analog quantum simulation of chiral magnetic dynamics using ultracold atoms in an optical superlattice. The massive Schwinger model in the zero gauge coupling limit maps onto the Rice-Mele model, with the fermion mass and topological angle encoded in the superlattice parameters. We study the real-time dynamics of the vector current following two quench protocols that drive continuous chirality injection and chirality relaxation. Simulations with realistic superlattice parameters and experimental noise demonstrates clear mass dependence of the current dynamics in both protocols, robust against experimental imperfections. The vector current may be directly measurable via single-bond-resolved detection, establishing cold atom superlattices as a viable platform for probing non-equilibrium chiral phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值模拟）。判断依据：propose（提出方案）、map onto（映射）、study the real-time dynamics（研究实时动力学）、simulations（模拟）。；研究对象：手征磁动力学（chiral magnetic dynamics），具体为利用光学超晶格中的超冷原子模拟零规范耦合极限下的大质量施温格模型（massive Schwinger model）中的矢量流实时动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过两种淬火协议（连续手征注入与手征弛豫）驱动矢量流，发现其动力学行为具有清晰的质量依赖性，且对实验噪声具有鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过两种淬火协议（连续手征注入与手征弛豫）驱动矢量流，发现其动力学行为具有清晰的质量依赖性，且对实验噪声具有鲁棒性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论映射（将零规范耦合极限下的大质量施温格模型映射为Rice-Mele模型），数值模拟（使用实际超晶格参数并加入实验噪声），单键分辨探测（single-bond-resolved detection）方案用于直接测量矢量流。

papers.title: Bi-S network origin of cation-disorder stability and dispersive band edges in AgBiS2
papers.abstract: Cation-disordered AgBiS2 is a promising lead-free optoelectronic material, but both its ordered structure and the microscopic origin of its favorable electronic properties remain debated. Theory has proposed a mixed-coordination tendency with tetrahedral AgS4 and octahedral BiS6 units, whereas experiments mainly report octahedrally coordinated ordered and cation-disordered phases, together with local cation off-centering. Here, we combine a machine-learning interatomic potential with a deep-learning Hamiltonian to resolve the coupled structural and electronic evolution of AgBiS2 at large length scales. We identify the three-dimensional Bi-S network as the central structural motif governing both disorder stability and band-edge electronic states. At weak disorder, Ag/Bi exchange competes with the off-centering tendency of the Ag sublattice, producing strongly distorted local environments and convoluted diffraction signatures that hinder the identification of the ordered phase. With increasing disorder, BiS6-like units connect into a continuous Bi-S network, which stabilizes the rocksalt-like disordered phase. Despite strong cation disorder, AgBiS2 retains clear semiconductor-like band dispersion and develops a direct band gap. The connected Bi:p-S:p states supported by the Bi-S network preserve a dispersive conduction-band edge and a small electron effective mass. In contrast, mobile Ag disrupts the long-range periodicity of Ag-S bonding, leading to strongly localized valence states. These results clarify the structural controversy in ordered AgBiS2 and establish a unified physical picture of disorder stability and optoelectronic response in nonisovalent semiconductor alloys.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“machine-learning interatomic potential”、“deep-learning Hamiltonian”等计算方法，并强调“resolve the coupled structural and electronic evolution at large length scales”。；研究对象：非等价半导体合金AgBiS₂，特别是其阳离子无序相的结构稳定性与电子性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 三维Bi-S网络是决定AgBiS₂阳离子无序稳定性和带边电子态的核心结构基元：该网络维持了导带边的色散性和小电子有效质量，而Ag的移动性则导致价带态强烈局域化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：三维Bi-S网络是决定AgBiS₂阳离子无序稳定性和带边电子态的核心结构基元：该网络维持了导带边的色散性和小电子有效质量，而Ag的移动性则导致价带态强烈局域化。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新在于：首次通过大尺度模拟揭示了Bi-S网络在阳离子无序相中的关键作用，并统一解释了有序相的结构争议与无序相的光电响应机制。
papers.method_zh: 结合机器学习原子间势（machine-learning interatomic potential）与深度学习哈密顿量（deep-learning Hamiltonian）的大尺度模拟。

papers.title: Elastoinertial effects govern dynamic response of soft hair beds
papers.abstract: Fluid-immersed hair beds are ubiquitous in biology-from the endothelial glycocalyx and primary cilia to intestinal microvilli-where they serve as mechanosensors that transduce dynamic flow signals into biochemical regulatory responses. Despite the inherently dynamic nature of physiological flows, the dynamic mechanical properties of fluid-immersed hair beds under time-varying conditions remain poorly characterized. Here we investigate the transient rheological response of elastic hair beds to large-amplitude oscillatory shear flows at low to intermediate Reynolds number. While the hairs and fluid themselves obey linear constitutive laws, their coupled interaction produces a dynamic nonlinear response that depends sensitively on driving frequency and amplitude. We identify a crossover from a stress-lagging regime to a stress-leading regime, which is governed by an interplay between fluid viscosity, fluid inertia, and hair elasticity. A simplified rigid-beam model qualitatively captures the crossover behavior. Characterizing the dynamic flow response of soft hair beds has direct biological implications, since the lag time sensitively determines the stability of mechanosensory signaling in the feedback loops underlying essential biological processes such as vasodilation, ciliary remodeling, and tubular reabsorption. Our results establish a framework for understanding how the physical properties of biological hair beds optimize dynamic information transmission during mechanotransduction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“简化刚性梁模型”（simplified rigid-beam model）以及“建立框架”（establish a framework），属于理论建模与分析。；研究对象：流体浸没的软毛刷（soft hair beds）在振荡剪切流中的动态力学响应，具体涉及内皮糖萼、初级纤毛、肠道微绒毛等生物机械传感体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在低到中等雷诺数的大振幅振荡剪切流中，软毛刷与流体的耦合相互作用产生动态非线性响应，并存在从应力滞后区到应力领先区的交叉行为，该交叉由流体黏性、流体惯性与毛发弹性共同决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在低到中等雷诺数的大振幅振荡剪切流中，软毛刷与流体的耦合相互作用产生动态非线性响应，并存在从应力滞后区到应力领先区的交叉行为，该交叉由流体黏性、流体惯性与毛发弹性共同决定。；创新点：揭示了在时变流动条件下，即使毛发与流体各自遵循线性本构关系，其耦合作用仍能产生依赖于驱动频率和振幅的动态非线性响应，并首次识别出应力滞后与应力领先的交叉行为及其物理机制。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与分析：采用连续介质力学方法，结合简化刚性梁模型（rigid-beam model）对弹性毛刷在振荡剪切流中的瞬态流变响应进行定性描述。

papers.title: Crystallography of periodic nanotextures in a strained Mott insulator
papers.abstract: Here we investigate stripes of alternating structural phases spontaneously forming in epitaxially strained $Ca_2RuO_4$ thin films below the metal-insulator transition. Using large-volume X-ray reciprocal-space mapping, we show that satellite-pattern intensities across 24 symmetry-inequivalent Bragg reflections collapse onto a single parameter-free curve. The collapse identifies a coherent martensitic laminate of few-nm-wide domains separated by ${012}$ interfaces, with displacements along $\left\langle01\bar{2}\right\rangle$. Satellite-extinction analysis demonstrates that both coexisting phases retain the bulk orthorhombic space group despite the pseudocubic $LaAlO_3$ substrate, biaxial epitaxial strain, and intrinsic strain at the interfaces. Classical invariant-plane-strain crystallography thus governs the nanoscale domain geometry of a Mott insulator with intertwined magnetic, electronic, and lattice order.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“X-ray reciprocal-space mapping”、“satellite-pattern intensities”、“satellite-extinction analysis”。；研究对象：外延应变下Ca₂RuO₄薄膜中自发形成的周期性纳米结构（条纹状交替结构相），以及该体系在金属-绝缘体相变以下的晶体学特征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在应变Ca₂RuO₄薄膜中，纳米尺度的马氏体层状结构（由{012}界面分隔、位移沿⟨01\bar{2}⟩方向）决定了周期性纳米织构的几何构型，且两共存相均保持正交晶系空间群，受经典不变平面应变晶体学支配。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在应变Ca₂RuO₄薄膜中，纳米尺度的马氏体层状结构（由{012}界面分隔、位移沿⟨01\bar{2}⟩方向）决定了周期性纳米织构的几何构型，且两共存相均保持正交晶系空间群，受经典不变平面应变晶体学支配。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 大体积X射线倒易空间映射（large-volume X-ray reciprocal-space mapping），结合卫星消光分析（satellite-extinction analysis），对24个对称不等价布拉格反射的卫星图案强度进行参数无关曲线拟合。

papers.title: Geometric Dissipation Constraints in Stochastic Reaction Dynamics: A Variational Observable for Hidden Kinetic Structure in Energy Landscapes
papers.abstract: We propose a geometric framework for characterizing hidden kinetic constraints in stochastic reaction dynamics. While free-energy barriers and entropy production provide global descriptors of thermodynamic behavior, they are largely insensitive to local geometric structure in configuration space that governs pathway selection. Starting from overdamped Langevin dynamics formulated as a gradient flow in Wasserstein space, we derive a variational functional whose leading-order asymptotic structure defines a local dissipation-geometry coupling observable. This quantity combines force-drift alignment with phase-space contraction induced by the divergence of the drift field, yielding a scalar field that reflects second-order geometric features of the underlying energy landscape. We demonstrate that this observable distinguishes kinetically distinct reaction channels that are degenerate under conventional free-energy analysis, as shown through numerical experiments on benchmark systems including the Muller-Brown potential, corrugated periodic landscapes, and the conformational transitions of Alanine Dipeptide. These experiments demonstrate robust separation of pathways and are consistent with a quadratic scaling behavior in the high-frequency homogenization regime. Our results suggest that stochastic reaction dynamics contain an additional geometric layer of kinetic control in molecular motion not captured by standard thermodynamic or reaction-coordinate descriptions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：几何框架、变分泛函、渐近分析、数值实验）；研究对象：随机反应动力学中的隐藏动力学约束，具体包括Müller-Brown势、波纹周期势以及丙氨酸二肽的构象转变等基准系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一个结合力-漂移对齐与相空间压缩的标量场可观测量，能够区分在传统自由能分析下简并的动力学反应通道，揭示了能量景观中二阶几何特征对路径选择的控制作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一个结合力-漂移对齐与相空间压缩的标量场可观测量，能够区分在传统自由能分析下简并的动力学反应通道，揭示了能量景观中二阶几何特征对路径选择的控制作用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但核心创新在于将随机反应动力学中的耗散约束与能量景观的局部几何结构（而非全局热力学量）直接关联，并构造出可区分动力学简并通道的标量场可观测量。
papers.method_zh: 基于过阻尼朗之万动力学在Wasserstein空间中的梯度流表述，推导出一个变分泛函，其主导阶渐近结构定义了局域耗散-几何耦合可观测量；通过数值实验在多个基准系统上验证。

papers.title: Ab initio parametrization of distributed polarizable force fields
papers.abstract: Polarizable force fields offer superior transferability and accuracy compared to classical force fields, enabling access to electronic response properties such as refractive index and electronic density of states. Here, we demonstrate two key improvements that significantly enhance their accuracy: (1) assigning atomic polarizability to individual atoms rather than atom types, and (2) employing atomic polarizability tensors instead of scalar values. These modifications extend the applicability of polarizable force fields to cations, anions, and excited states, while also providing more accurate descriptions of neutral molecules. We propose a first-principles-based parameterization procedure for atomic polarizability tensors and scalars, validated on a set of small organic molecules with conjugated building blocks. To overcome the computational cost of ab initio calculations, we train a message-passing graph neural network to predict polarizability parameters, enabling efficient and scalable parameterization. Crucially, this approach imposes no additional computational cost during simulations and provides a clear diagnostic criterion for identifying cases where polarizable force field models fail to accurately describe molecular polarizability.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：ab initio parametrization, first-principles-based parameterization, message-passing graph neural network）；研究对象：可极化力场（polarizable force fields）的参数化方法，具体应用于小有机分子（small organic molecules with conjugated building blocks）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将原子极化率分配给单个原子（而非原子类型）并使用原子极化率张量（而非标量），可以显著提升可极化力场的准确性，使其能够适用于阳离子、阴离子和激发态，并更准确地描述中性分子。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将原子极化率分配给单个原子（而非原子类型）并使用原子极化率张量（而非标量），可以显著提升可极化力场的准确性，使其能够适用于阳离子、阴离子和激发态，并更准确地描述中性分子。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容推断，创新点在于：(1) 提出了将原子极化率分配至单个原子并使用张量形式的改进策略；(2) 开发了基于第一性原理且可扩展的参数化流程，并利用图神经网络解决了计算成本问题，且该方法在模拟过程中不增加额外计算开销。
papers.method_zh: 提出了一种基于第一性原理（first-principles-based）的参数化流程，用于确定原子极化率张量和标量。为了克服从头算的高计算成本，训练了一个消息传递图神经网络（message-passing graph neural network）来预测极化率参数。

papers.title: The Map of Parameter Space in Double Microwave Shielding
papers.abstract: Double microwave shielding employs $σ^{+}$- and $π$-polarized microwave fields, tuned close to the lowest rotational transition, to engineer a long-range repulsive barrier between polar molecules. By preventing molecules from reaching the short range, this technique suppresses detrimental two-body losses and recently enabled the realization of molecular Bose-Einstein condensates and self-bound droplets. Yet, the optimal operating regimes of the shielding mechanism remain largely unexplored. Here, by leveraging the underlying universality of the scattering problem, we systematically map the four-dimensional microwave parameter space-spanned by the detunings and intensities of the two fields-to identify configurations that maximize both shielding efficiency and interaction tunability. We define optimal operating regimes as configurations that are strictly free of field-linked bound states while sufficiently suppressing two-body losses to exceed typical lifetimes of ultracold samples. In these regimes, we evaluate the elastic-to-inelastic collision ratios required for efficient evaporative cooling and explore the accessible tuning range of the effective dipolar interactions. Finally, to identify the best platforms for future quantum simulation experiments, we conduct a global survey of candidate molecular species under realistic field constraints. We identify heavy, strongly dipolar molecules as the most promising candidates, demonstrating that they can achieve extreme loss suppression alongside robust interaction tunability using only moderate field strengths.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：universality of the scattering problem、systematically map、identify configurations、evaluate ratios、conduct a global survey。；研究对象：双微波屏蔽技术中的参数空间，具体涉及极性分子在σ⁺和π偏振微波场作用下的散射行为与相互作用调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过系统映射四维微波参数空间，定义了无场关联束缚态且充分抑制两体损耗的最优工作区间，并指出重、强偶极分子在中等场强下可实现极低损耗与强相互作用可调性，是未来量子模拟的最佳候选平台。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过系统映射四维微波参数空间，定义了无场关联束缚态且充分抑制两体损耗的最优工作区间，并指出重、强偶极分子在中等场强下可实现极低损耗与强相互作用可调性，是未来量子模拟的最佳候选平台。；创新点：首次系统性地绘制了双微波屏蔽的四维参数空间图谱，并基于无束缚态和损耗抑制条件明确定义了最优工作区间，同时针对多种分子物种进行了实际场约束下的全局比较。
papers.method_zh: 基于散射问题的普适性理论，系统扫描由两个微波场的失谐量和强度构成的四维参数空间，计算弹性与非弹性碰撞比率，评估有效偶极相互作用的可调范围，并对候选分子种类进行全局调查。

papers.title: Uniaxial-Stress-Induced Magnetic Transitions in the Triangular-Lattice Antiferromagnet PdCrO2
papers.abstract: Uniaxial stress is a promising method to tune magnetic frustration, allowing its effects to be studied in a precise way. In this work, uniaxial stress is applied to the triangular-lattice antiferromagnet PdCrO2. The Cr-Cr magnetic interaction is very sensitive to interatomic separation, so laboratory-achievable stress can induce substantial changes in magnetic structure. Results from three types of measurement are presented: X-ray diffraction, the stress-strain relationship, and neutron diffraction. The combined data show that the elastic moduli of PdCrO2 are strongly affected by stress-induced changes in magnetic structure. A new, first-order stress-induced magnetic transition is observed, at which the lattice constant shrinks by 0.21%. The lattice stiffens dramatically across this transition: the Young's modulus increases by about 80 GPa, and the Poisson ratio falls from about 1 to about 0.4. This stiffening indicates that the magnetic order "locks," that is, becomes insensitive to lattice strain. This locking might occur because the new stress-induced magnetic order nests the Fermi surface of the Pd sheets. Other frustrated magnets, including candidate spin liquids, may show similarly strong coupling between magnetic and elastic degrees of freedom.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提及X射线衍射、应力-应变关系、中子衍射三种测量手段，属于实验研究。；研究对象：三角晶格反铁磁体PdCrO₂，以及单轴应力诱导的磁结构转变现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在PdCrO₂中观察到一种新的、一级应力诱导磁相变，伴随晶格常数收缩0.21%，且磁有序在相变后“锁定”，对晶格应变不再敏感，导致杨氏模量增加约80 GPa，泊松比从约1降至约0.4。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在PdCrO₂中观察到一种新的、一级应力诱导磁相变，伴随晶格常数收缩0.21%，且磁有序在相变后“锁定”，对晶格应变不再敏感，导致杨氏模量增加约80 GPa，泊松比从约1降至约0.4。；创新点：首次在PdCrO₂中观察到单轴应力诱导的一级磁相变，并发现该相变导致磁弹性耦合显著增强，磁有序“锁定”晶格应变。摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 单轴应力施加、X射线衍射、应力-应变关系测量、中子衍射。

papers.title: Evolution of terahertz third harmonic response across rare-earth nickelate phase-diagram
papers.abstract: High harmonic generation (HHG) is a sensitive probe for investigating electronic structures and dynamics of materials and a source for attosecond pulses. In particular, HHG with terahertz (THz) light can enable probing of nonlinear responses in correlated materials arising from low-energy many-body interactions. However, THz HHG studies have so far largely focused on topological materials and superconductors, leaving out other potential material systems which could also become efficient THz HHG sources. Here, we report THz third harmonic generation (THG) in rare-earth nickelates -- a prototype material for exploring the Mott insulator-metal transition and related technological applications. We find that the THG amplitude is highly sensitive to the strengths of electronic and magnetic phases of nickelates. In films with sharp phase-transitions, the local maximum and minimum in the temperature-dependent THG amplitude coincide with insulator-metal and magnetic transition temperatures, respectively. While in films with weaker transitions, these features shift toward lower temperatures or even monotonous THG enhancement is observed down to low temperatures. We developed a generalized theory for THz harmonic generation in negative charge-transfer insulators and outlined strategies to enhance the THz nonlinearities further. Our study broadens the scope of THz HHG studies and related applications to strongly correlated materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以理论模型）。判断依据：报告了“THz third harmonic generation (THG)”的实验观测，并“developed a generalized theory”进行解释。；研究对象：稀土镍酸盐（rare-earth nickelates）薄膜，具体研究其从莫特绝缘体到金属的相变（Mott insulator-metal transition）过程中的太赫兹三次谐波响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 太赫兹三次谐波（THG）的振幅对稀土镍酸盐的电子相和磁相的强度高度敏感。在具有尖锐相变的薄膜中，THG振幅随温度变化的局部极大值和极小值分别与绝缘体-金属相变温度和磁相变温度相对应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：太赫兹三次谐波（THG）的振幅对稀土镍酸盐的电子相和磁相的强度高度敏感。在具有尖锐相变的薄膜中，THG振幅随温度变化的局部极大值和极小值分别与绝缘体-金属相变温度和磁相变温度相对应。；创新点：将太赫兹高次谐波（THz HHG）的研究范围从拓扑材料和超导体拓展到了强关联材料（稀土镍酸盐），并揭示了THG信号与材料电子相和磁相之间的关联。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用太赫兹（THz）光驱动产生三次谐波（THG）进行测量；理论上发展了一个针对负电荷转移绝缘体（negative charge-transfer insulators）的太赫兹谐波产生的广义理论。

papers.title: Lattice genome: representation and analysis of heterogeneous crystalline microstructures
papers.abstract: Inspired by the concept of a generalized materials genome, we introduce the notions of lattice gene and lattice genome for crystalline materials. A lattice gene is a compact representation of the local crystalline structure obtained by encoding the Kikuchi diffraction patterns with a variational autoencoder. We show that this representation satisfies key criteria for a materials gene: compactness, experimental accessibility, existence of a distance metric reflecting structural similarity, and sufficient information content for reconstructing the original diffraction patterns. The lattice genome is the spatially resolved collection of lattice genes across a representative area mapped by electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD), which captures mesoscale heterogeneity that ultimately controls properties. We demonstrate three applications of the lattice genome: (i) latent component maps that visualize grain-scale and intra-grain heterogeneities, (ii) domain segmentation based on distance and angle metrics in the latent space, and (iii) kernel and domain latent vector spreads that quantify intragranular heterogeneity as high-dimensional analogs of kernel average misorientation and grain orientation spread. All three tools are validated on microstructures of additively manufactured and wrought Ni-base superalloys in as-built and recrystallized conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：实验上使用电子背散射衍射（EBSD）采集菊池衍射图案，计算上使用变分自编码器（VAE）进行编码和重构。；研究对象：多晶材料的微观结构，具体为镍基高温合金（增材制造和锻造态，以及再结晶状态）中的异质性晶体微结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了“晶格基因”和“晶格基因组”的概念，通过变分自编码器对菊池衍射图案进行编码，实现了对局部晶体结构的紧凑表示，并验证了该表示满足材料基因的关键标准。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了“晶格基因”和“晶格基因组”的概念，通过变分自编码器对菊池衍射图案进行编码，实现了对局部晶体结构的紧凑表示，并验证了该表示满足材料基因的关键标准。；创新点：将“材料基因组”概念具体化为“晶格基因组”，通过潜空间表示实现了对介观尺度异质性的可视化（潜成分图）、域分割（基于潜空间距离和角度）以及晶粒内异质性的高维量化（核和域潜向量展宽），为传统EBSD分析（如KAM、GOS）提供了高维类比。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：电子背散射衍射（EBSD）获取菊池衍射图案。计算方法：变分自编码器（VAE）用于编码菊池图案为低维“晶格基因”，并在潜空间中进行距离度量、域分割和异质性量化分析。

papers.title: ARTGEL: A temperature-regulated electrophoresis platform for quantitative studies of reversible association in gels
papers.abstract: Here we present ARTGEL, an actively regulated-temperature gel electrophoresis platform designed for long-duration experiments under independently controlled thermal and electrical conditions. ARTGEL combines thermoelectric regulation of the gel temperature, a large heated and circulated buffer reservoir, and an automated electrode-wiping mechanism that stabilizes the voltage across the gel during runs exceeding 24 h. The platform was developed to address a limitation of conventional electrophoretic mobility shift assays, which are commonly used to analyze reversible biomolecular association but usually aim to suppress reaction during electrophoresis by dilution, competitors, or reduced temperature so that the gel reports a pre-equilibrated bulk solution. For temperature-sensitive systems, these strategies can alter the chemical state during loading and migration and obscure whether the measured band pattern reflects the original bulk sample or a re-equilibrated state inside the porous gel. Rather than attempting to quench reactions, ARTGEL enables electrophoresis to be performed at the same temperature as complementary bulk measurements, so that reversible association can be quantified directly in the gel and compared with matched measurements in solution. Using DNA origami assemblies, we show that ARTGEL preserves distinct temperature-dependent association states, resolves reaction-dependent distortions of migrating bands, and supports extraction of in-gel kinetic and thermodynamic parameters from reaction-diffusion-advection modeling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了ARTGEL平台的构建、功能验证，以及使用DNA折纸组装体进行的实验演示。；研究对象：论文研究的具体体系是：在凝胶中进行的可逆生物分子结合反应，特别是温度敏感的DNA折纸组装体的结合-解离平衡。物理现象是：温度调控下的可逆分子结合与凝胶电泳迁移行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: ARTGEL平台能够在长时间（>24小时）内独立控制凝胶的温度和电场，使得凝胶电泳可以在与互补的溶液测量相同的温度下进行，从而直接量化凝胶内的可逆结合反应，并提取其动力学和热力学参数。
