papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：ARTGEL平台能够在长时间（>24小时）内独立控制凝胶的温度和电场，使得凝胶电泳可以在与互补的溶液测量相同的温度下进行，从而直接量化凝胶内的可逆结合反应，并提取其动力学和热力学参数。；创新点：该工作的主要新意在于：摒弃了传统电泳迁移率变动分析（EMSA）中通过稀释、竞争剂或降温来“淬灭”反应的做法，转而主动控制凝胶温度使其与溶液测量条件一致，从而能够直接、定量地研究凝胶内的可逆结合过程，避免了因温度变化导致的化学状态改变和测量结果混淆。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：主动控温凝胶电泳平台（ARTGEL）。该平台集成了热电温度调节、大容量加热循环缓冲液槽以及自动擦拭电极机制。分析方法：结合反应-扩散-平流模型对电泳条带进行建模，以提取凝胶内的动力学和热力学参数。

papers.title: k-Means Clustering in Fingerprint-Based Configuration Selection for Fitting Interatomic Potentials
papers.abstract: In this study, we present a method for selecting an arbitrary number of distinct configurations from a larger data set by applying k-means clustering to atomistic configuration fingerprints based on the CrystalNN model and radial distribution function (RDF). This approach improves the accuracy of fitting classical molecular dynamics interatomic potentials to density functional theory (DFT) data for both energies and forces while requiring fewer configurations than random selection. We demonstrate this improvement by fitting an embedded-atom method (EAM) potential for titanium, using various configurational sizes from an initial set of 1800 configurations. The k-means clustering consistently achieves better precision and lower standard deviations for a smaller number of configurations than random selection. The results also suggest that only about 30 configurations are sufficient to obtain an EAM model that describes well the full set of 1800 configurations in terms of energies and forces. Additionally, t-distributed stochastic neighbor embedding (t-SNE) method was used to reduce the configuration fingerprints into 2D space, and it revealed an overlap between two configuration subsets with and without Ti vacancy, indicating similar atomic environments. This similarity is captured by k-means clustering but not by random selection. Furthermore, when the overlapping configurations with vacancies were excluded from the k-means algorithm and used only as a test set, their energy and force predictions showed similar precision to those when they were included. This indicates that the overlapping configurations in the 2D t-SNE space indeed imply potential information redundancy among the atomistic configurations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：k-means clustering、fitting interatomic potentials、density functional theory (DFT)、embedded-atom method (EAM)。；研究对象：钛（titanium）的原子间势函数拟合，具体为嵌入原子方法（EAM）势的构建。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于CrystalNN模型和径向分布函数（RDF）的原子构型指纹，通过k-means聚类选择少量构型（约30个）即可获得与使用全部1800个构型相当的EAM势精度，且优于随机选择方法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于CrystalNN模型和径向分布函数（RDF）的原子构型指纹，通过k-means聚类选择少量构型（约30个）即可获得与使用全部1800个构型相当的EAM势精度，且优于随机选择方法。；创新点：提出了一种基于k-means聚类的构型选择策略，能够从大数据集中自动选取具有代表性的少量构型用于势函数拟合，显著提升拟合效率并保持精度，同时揭示了构型间的信息冗余性。
papers.method_zh: 采用k-means聚类算法对原子构型指纹进行聚类选择，指纹基于CrystalNN模型和径向分布函数（RDF）；使用t-SNE方法将构型指纹降维至二维空间进行可视化分析；势函数拟合采用嵌入原子方法（EAM），训练数据来自密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。

papers.title: Stoichiometric Epitaxial Strontium Titanate Thin Films on Silicon by High-Temperature Sr Segregation
papers.abstract: Thin-film strontium titanate (SrTiO$_3$, STO) layers grown on silicon require accurate stoichiometry and single-crystalline order to exploit their functional properties optimally. Oxide molecular beam epitaxy can provide an epitaxial interface, but suffers from source oxidation and resulting flux instabilities, yielding only a narrow growth process window for cationic stoichiometry control. Here, we investigate post-growth annealing in oxygen as a pathway to drive the STO layer toward stoichiometry in intentionally Sr-rich epitaxial STO films on silicon (001). Annealing over a broad temperature range revealed two distinct Sr-segregation mechanisms. Below 800 °C, excess Sr segregates toward the surface, forming SrO outgrowths that progressively sublimate at elevated temperatures. Above 800 °C, a second mechanism dominates: Sr accumulates within the interfacial SiO$_2$ layer formed by oxygen diffusion at the STO/Si interface. Together, these mechanisms effectively remove excess Sr from the STO lattice, yielding a more stoichiometric perovskite layer. Our results demonstrate that growing slightly Sr-rich STO templates followed by controlled annealing provides a practical route to improve crystalline quality, offering a scalable strategy for high-quality STO integration on silicon.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：oxide molecular beam epitaxy（氧化物分子束外延）、post-growth annealing（生长后退火）、Sr segregation（Sr偏析）。；研究对象：在硅（001）衬底上外延生长的钛酸锶（SrTiO₃, STO）薄膜，特别是富Sr的STO薄膜在退火过程中的化学计量比调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过高温退火，富Sr的STO薄膜中过量的Sr可通过两种机制被有效移除：低温下（<800°C）Sr在表面形成SrO并升华，高温下（>800°C）Sr在STO/Si界面的SiO₂层中积累，从而获得更接近化学计量比的钙钛矿层，提升晶体质量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过高温退火，富Sr的STO薄膜中过量的Sr可通过两种机制被有效移除：低温下（<800°C）Sr在表面形成SrO并升华，高温下（>800°C）Sr在STO/Si界面的SiO₂层中积累，从而获得更接近化学计量比的钙钛矿层，提升晶体质量。；创新点：提出了一种通过生长略富Sr的STO模板并辅以可控退火来改善晶体质量的实用策略，为在硅衬底上高质量集成STO提供了可规模化路径。摘要未突出说明与已有退火方法的具体性能对比。
papers.method_zh: 氧化物分子束外延（oxide MBE）生长富Sr的STO薄膜，随后在氧气中进行不同温度范围的退火处理，通过分析Sr偏析行为研究化学计量比的调控机制。

papers.title: Deviations from Debye's specific heat due to excess energy fluctuations
papers.abstract: Measured specific heats often exceed Debye's T^3-law, even in high-purity single crystals. Analogous excess energy fluctuations in molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of crystals with no defects come from fast energy modulations involving next-nearest-neighbor atoms. Here, a theory is developed for these modulations, based on time- and phase-averaging followed by thermal averaging. This order of averaging is guided by evidence from the simulations and various experimental techniques showing that localized excitations are decoupled from the heat bath. Emergent nonextensivity is interpreted by analogy with anomalous diffusion. The theory modifies the standard relation between energy fluctuations and specific heat, giving good agreement with the simulations and new insight into many measurements. The theory may also provide a basis for understanding excess specific heat in amorphous materials and anomalous noise in quantum devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：theory is developed、analogy with anomalous diffusion、modifies the standard relation）；研究对象：晶体中偏离德拜T³定律的比热异常，以及由过剩能量涨落引起的非广延性行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于时间平均、相位平均和热平均顺序的理论，修正了能量涨落与比热之间的标准关系，成功解释了无缺陷晶体中比热超出德拜T³定律的现象，并与分子动力学模拟及多种实验测量结果吻合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于时间平均、相位平均和热平均顺序的理论，修正了能量涨落与比热之间的标准关系，成功解释了无缺陷晶体中比热超出德拜T³定律的现象，并与分子动力学模拟及多种实验测量结果吻合。；创新点：通过引入新的平均次序（时间-相位平均先于热平均）来刻画局域激发与热库的解耦，从而修正了能量涨落与比热的标准关系，为理解晶体及非晶材料中的过剩比热和量子器件中的反常噪声提供了新基础。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导，结合分子动力学（MD）模拟证据和实验技术（如多种测量技术）的观察结果，采用时间平均、相位平均后再进行热平均的次序，并类比反常扩散理论。

papers.title: Predicting Physical and Physical-Chemical Properties of Molecular-Based Materials Using Computational Neural Networks
papers.abstract: A computational scheme, which utilizes neural networks, was developed to predict properties of molecular-based materials from chemical structures. The method uses a set of simple algorithms to encode the structure and composition of organic molecules directly into numerical vectors, which is used as input for neural networks. Backpropagation type neural networks are then used to correlate these numeric inputs with a set of desired properties. Calculated results for a series of hydrocarbons, hydrofluorocarbons, and crown ethers demonstrate average accuracies of 0.2-8.1% with maximum deviations of 16-20% for a broad range of thermodynamic, physical, and physical-chemical characteristics (heat capacity, enthalpy, heat of evaporation, boiling point, density, refractive index, stability constants, etc.). In addition, a number of physical and mechanical properties were estimated for polymeric materials and compared with regression analysis. Based on the neural network capabilities of formulating accurate quantitative structure property relationships, a technique called computational synthesis is suggested for performing materials design.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“computational scheme”、“neural networks”、“calculated results”。；研究对象：分子基材料（molecular-based materials），具体包括碳氢化合物、氢氟碳化合物、冠醚以及聚合物材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用神经网络建立的定量结构-性质关系（QSPR）模型，能够以平均误差0.2-8.1%、最大偏差16-20%的精度，预测分子基材料的热力学、物理及物理化学性质（如热容、沸点、折射率等）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用神经网络建立的定量结构-性质关系（QSPR）模型，能够以平均误差0.2-8.1%、最大偏差16-20%的精度，预测分子基材料的热力学、物理及物理化学性质（如热容、沸点、折射率等）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用反向传播型神经网络（backpropagation type neural networks），通过一组简单算法将有机分子的结构与组成直接编码为数值向量作为网络输入，用于关联并预测目标性质。

papers.title: Scaling Behaviors of Work Cumulants in Slow Isothermal Processes
papers.abstract: We study the cumulants of work in a slow isothermal process for gapped systems. Using the Martin-Siggia-Rose-De Dominicis-Janssen (MSRDJ) formalism and the properties of connected correlation functions, we show that in this process, the $n$-th cumulant of work scales as $1/T^{n-1}$ , where $T$ is the time duration. This result holds generally for arbitrary smooth protocols. Furthermore, we derive the coefficients of the cumulants from equilibrium properties. These coefficients are found to be relevant to thermodynamic geometric tensors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：使用MSRDJ形式论和关联函数性质进行推导，属于理论分析框架。；研究对象：有能隙系统在慢等温过程中的功累积量（work cumulants）的标度行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在慢等温过程中，第n阶功累积量随过程持续时间T的标度关系为1/T^{n-1}，且该标度系数可由平衡态性质导出，并与热力学几何张量相关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在慢等温过程中，第n阶功累积量随过程持续时间T的标度关系为1/T^{n-1}，且该标度系数可由平衡态性质导出，并与热力学几何张量相关。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用Martin-Siggia-Rose-De Dominicis-Janssen（MSRDJ）形式论，结合连通关联函数的性质，对任意光滑协议下的功累积量进行解析推导。

papers.title: Controlled component segregation in vapor-deposited organic semiconductor glass mixtures
papers.abstract: Multicomponent vapor-deposited organic glasses are essential in organic electronic applications, but achieving controlled component segregation at the nano- and mesoscale remains a challenge, hindering the rational development of high-performance devices. In this study, we investigate binary organic semiconductor mixtures of TPD (N,N'-Bis(3-methylphenyl)-N,N'-diphenylbenzidine) and TCTA (Tris(4-carbazoyl-9-ylphenyl)amine). Despite being miscible in the bulk liquid state, the co-deposited glassy films of these two organic semiconductors exhibit a range of segregation behaviors, from homogenous to clearly phase-separated structures. We employed differential scanning calorimetry and resonant soft X-ray scattering (RSoXS) to study the component segregation behavior and used the National Institute of Standards and Technology RSoXS Simulation Suite, paired with Atomic Force Microscopy, to interpret the energy-dependent RSoXS spectra. Our results indicate that component segregation in co-deposited TPD-TCTA films is due to a kinetically-arrested nucleation-and-growth mechanism, in contrast to the segregation mechanism of a previously reported TPD-DO37 (disperse orange 37) mixture which is strongly immiscible in bulk. This work provides a demonstration of tunable molecular aggregation in organic semiconductor glasses, enabling access to a continuum of morphologies from homogeneously mixed to segregated phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到使用了“differential scanning calorimetry”和“resonant soft X-ray scattering (RSoXS)”等实验手段，并结合“Atomic Force Microscopy”进行表征。；研究对象：二元有机半导体混合物薄膜，具体为TPD（N,N'-Bis(3-methylphenyl)-N,N'-diphenylbenzidine）和TCTA（Tris(4-carbazoyl-9-ylphenyl)amine）共沉积形成的玻璃态薄膜中的组分分离行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在共沉积的TPD-TCTA玻璃薄膜中，组分分离是由动力学受阻的成核与生长机制驱动的，这与之前报道的体相中强烈不混溶的TPD-DO37混合物的分离机制不同。通过调控，可以实现从均匀混合到相分离的连续形态变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在共沉积的TPD-TCTA玻璃薄膜中，组分分离是由动力学受阻的成核与生长机制驱动的，这与之前报道的体相中强烈不混溶的TPD-DO37混合物的分离机制不同。通过调控，可以实现从均匀混合到相分离的连续形态变化。；创新点：揭示了在体相液态可混溶的有机半导体混合物中，通过共沉积制备玻璃薄膜时，仍可实现可控的纳米至介观尺度的组分分离，并阐明了其与体相不混溶体系不同的动力学成核生长机制，展示了可调谐的分子聚集行为。
papers.method_zh: 差示扫描量热法（DSC）、共振软X射线散射（RSoXS），并结合美国国家标准与技术研究院（NIST）的RSoXS模拟套件以及原子力显微镜（AFM）对能量依赖的RSoXS光谱进行解析。

papers.title: Planar Hall effect in single and bilayer Rashba systems
papers.abstract: The planar Hall effect (PHE) is an anisotropic magnetotransport response generated by coplanar electric and magnetic fields. We investigate the PHE in single- and bilayer two-dimensional electron gases (2DEGs) with Rashba spin-orbit coupling and identify two distinct mechanisms: Zeeman coupling and a band geometric channel. In the Zeeman channel, an in-plane magnetic field distorts the Rashba spin-orbit-coupled band dispersion and generates anisotropic carrier velocities, producing a finite PHE. In an asymmetric Rashba bilayer, interlayer electronic delocalization generates finite planar Berry curvature and orbital magnetic moment components, giving rise to a band geometric PHE channel. Using semiclassical Boltzmann transport theory, we calculate the chemical potential and angular dependence of the planar Hall conductivity for both mechanisms. Symmetry analysis shows that the leading response is quadratic in the magnetic field and exhibits the characteristic $π$-periodic angular dependence. For the parameter regime considered here, the Zeeman-induced contribution dominates, while the band geometric channel provides a distinct symmetry-allowed contribution unique to asymmetric Rashba bilayers. Our results reveal microscopic origins of anisotropic magnetotransport in spin-orbit-coupled two-dimensional materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“semiclassical Boltzmann transport theory”（半经典玻尔兹曼输运理论）进行理论计算，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：单层和双层二维电子气（2DEGs）中的平面霍尔效应（PHE），具体关注具有Rashba自旋-轨道耦合的系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 识别出平面霍尔效应的两种微观机制：Zeeman耦合通道（由面内磁场畸变Rashba能带产生各向异性载流子速度）和能带几何通道（由非对称Rashba双层中的层间电子离域产生有限平面贝里曲率和轨道磁矩）。在研究的参数范围内，Zeeman诱导贡献占主导，而能带几何通道是非对称Rashba双层特有的对称性允许贡献。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：识别出平面霍尔效应的两种微观机制：Zeeman耦合通道（由面内磁场畸变Rashba能带产生各向异性载流子速度）和能带几何通道（由非对称Rashba双层中的层间电子离域产生有限平面贝里曲率和轨道磁矩）。在研究的参数范围内，Zeeman诱导贡献占主导，而能带几何通道是非对称Rashba双层特有的对称性允许贡献。；创新点：首次在Rashba体系中明确区分并定量比较了Zeeman耦合与能带几何（贝里曲率/轨道磁矩）两种平面霍尔效应机制，揭示了非对称Rashba双层中独有的能带几何通道。
papers.method_zh: 采用半经典玻尔兹曼输运理论，计算了平面霍尔电导率随化学势和角度的依赖关系，并结合对称性分析。

papers.title: Free fermions in disguise without exponential degeneracies
papers.abstract: Recently, a number of spin chain models have been discovered that are solvable via hidden free-fermionic structures, going beyond the Jordan-Wigner paradigm. However, all examples in the literature displayed degeneracies that grow exponentially with the volume and that are homogeneous in the spectrum (identical degeneracies for all energy levels). In this note we present a model that can be solved by ``free fermions in disguise'' (FFD), such that the spectrum is free from exponential degeneracies for generic coupling constants. The model can be seen as a particular perturbation of two Ising chains. Alternatively, it can be realized as an interpolation between a standard Jordan-Wigner solvable chain and the original FFD model of Fendley. We used ChatGPT Pro 5.4 and 5.5 as a research assistant; in the Supplemental Material we provide details about the collaboration between the AI and the human author.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：solvable via hidden free-fermionic structures、model、spectrum。；研究对象：一类具有隐藏自由费米子结构的自旋链模型，特别是能避免指数简并的“伪装自由费米子”（FFD）模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种新的自旋链模型，其可通过“伪装自由费米子”方法求解，且在一般耦合常数下，能谱中不存在随系统体积指数增长的简并度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种新的自旋链模型，其可通过“伪装自由费米子”方法求解，且在一般耦合常数下，能谱中不存在随系统体积指数增长的简并度。；创新点：该模型首次在FFD框架下实现了无指数简并的能谱，突破了此前所有FFD例子中能谱均匀且指数简并的限制。
papers.method_zh: 理论构造与解析求解：通过将两个伊辛链进行特定微扰，或作为标准Jordan-Wigner可解链与Fendley原始FFD模型之间的插值来实现。

papers.title: \textit{\textbf{First-principles}} description of pumped inelastic X-ray scattering: example of K-edge RIXS in graphite
papers.abstract: We present an \textit{ab initio} framework for predicting resonant inelastic X-ray scattering (RIXS) in optically pumped materials. Our methodology is based on the Kramers-Heisenberg formula for the double-differential cross section formulated using the results of the Bethe-Salpeter equation (BSE) from many-body perturbation theory. To extend this approach to the time domain, we incorporate non-equilibrium charge-carrier distributions obtained from real-time, time-dependent density-functional theory (RT-TDDFT). Generalizing the RIXS implementation with respect to arbitrary polarizations, allows us to consider different orientations of incoming and outgoing light. We demonstrate our method's capabilities by studying RIXS at the K-edge of graphite for various non-equilibrium charge-carrier distributions, representing different delay times after optical pumping. Our results reveal angular dependencies in $π$- and $σ$-orbital-derived spectral regions, in good agreement with experiment.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：*ab initio* framework、Bethe-Salpeter equation (BSE)、real-time time-dependent density-functional theory (RT-TDDFT)、Kramers-Heisenberg formula。；研究对象：光学泵浦下石墨的K边共振非弹性X射线散射（RIXS）过程，具体研究不同非平衡载流子分布下的π和σ轨道谱区。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在光学泵浦后的不同延迟时间下，石墨K边RIXS的π和σ轨道谱区表现出角度依赖性，且计算结果与实验吻合良好。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在光学泵浦后的不同延迟时间下，石墨K边RIXS的π和σ轨道谱区表现出角度依赖性，且计算结果与实验吻合良好。；创新点：首次提出了一个能够预测光学泵浦材料中RIXS的第一性原理框架，将非平衡载流子分布（来自RT-TDDFT）与BSE方法结合，并实现了对任意入射/出射光偏振方向的通用处理。
papers.method_zh: 基于多体微扰理论中的Bethe-Salpeter方程（BSE）结果，结合Kramers-Heisenberg公式构建双微分截面的第一性原理框架；通过实时含时密度泛函理论（RT-TDDFT）获得非平衡载流子分布，并将该分布纳入时间域RIXS计算；同时推广了RIXS实现中对任意偏振方向的描述。

papers.title: A Robust Agentic Framework for Expert-Level Automation of Atomistic Simulations
papers.abstract: Traditionally, atomistic simulation has been constrained by the computational scaling limits of ab initio methods and the parameterization overhead of empirical force fields. The recent emergence of universal machine learning interatomic potentials has significantly mitigated these bottlenecks, offering near-quantum accuracy and generalizability across diverse chemical spaces at a fraction of the computational cost. However, this shift has relocated the bottleneck to the human dimension: time-consuming mechanical processes, such as input preparation and data analysis, now dominate the research lifecycle. We introduce Paimon, a Platform for Agentic Integration in Materials Optimization and Nanoscale-simulations. Through hundreds of trials on an expert-level liquid electrolyte simulation, we show that Paimon substantially improves the reliability of agentic workflows by suppressing silent errors: plausible yet physically incorrect results. We further demonstrate that Paimon can cooperate with an external scientific agent and autonomously reproduce simulation methodologies from the literature. As an agent harness for atomistic simulations, Paimon affords researchers a continuous, science-centric workflow throughout the entire simulation lifecycle.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：atomistic simulation（原子模拟）、machine learning interatomic potentials（机器学习原子间势）、agentic framework（智能体框架）。；研究对象：原子模拟（atomistic simulation），具体以专家级液态电解质模拟（expert-level liquid electrolyte simulation）为测试案例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Paimon平台通过抑制“静默错误”（即看似合理但物理上不正确的结果），显著提升了原子模拟智能体工作流的可靠性，并能自主复现文献中的模拟方法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Paimon平台通过抑制“静默错误”（即看似合理但物理上不正确的结果），显著提升了原子模拟智能体工作流的可靠性，并能自主复现文献中的模拟方法。；创新点：将原子模拟的瓶颈从计算开销转移到人类操作环节后，通过智能体框架自动化处理机械性任务（如输入准备和数据分析），并重点解决智能体工作流中“静默错误”的可靠性问题。摘要未明确说明与已有智能体框架的具体技术差异。
papers.method_zh: 提出名为Paimon的智能体集成平台（Platform for Agentic Integration in Materials Optimization and Nanoscale-simulations），结合通用机器学习原子间势（universal machine learning interatomic potentials）与自动化工作流，用于输入准备、数据分析等环节。

papers.title: Context-Aware Deep Learning for Defect Classification in Atomic-Resolution STEM
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence is rapidly advancing materials characterization, yet most applications in electron microscopy rely solely on image contrast, overlooking the chemical and experimental context that shapes image formation. This limitation makes defect classification inherently ambiguous, as similar contrasts can arise from different materials or imaging conditions. Here we develop a context-aware learning framework that integrates image-derived contrast with metadata describing composition, beam energy, and detector geometry. Using a systematically constructed dataset of ~55 million simulated patches spanning 576 cases across 96 doped monolayer transition-metal dichalcogenides, we show that conditioning on contextual variables transforms defect classification from an ill-posed image-only task into a well-posed, physically grounded problem. The framework achieves over 98% accuracy on simulations and near-human agreement on experimental data, with a 94% reduction in posterior entropy. By emphasizing contextual grounding over architectural complexity, this approach links experimental image contrast to the underlying chemical and imaging conditions, supporting physically grounded defect assignments and a general pathway toward multimodal AI models for autonomous materials characterization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章（关键词：simulated patches、framework、classification、model）；研究对象：原子分辨率扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）中掺杂单层过渡金属二硫属化物（TMDs）的缺陷分类问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将图像对比度与描述成分、束能量和探测器几何结构的元数据相结合，条件化上下文变量可将缺陷分类从仅依赖图像的不适定问题转化为物理上有依据的适定问题，在模拟数据上实现超过98%的准确率，在实验数据上接近人类水平，后验熵降低94%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将图像对比度与描述成分、束能量和探测器几何结构的元数据相结合，条件化上下文变量可将缺陷分类从仅依赖图像的不适定问题转化为物理上有依据的适定问题，在模拟数据上实现超过98%的准确率，在实验数据上接近人类水平，后验熵降低94%。；创新点：提出将实验上下文（化学与成像条件）作为条件变量融入深度学习模型，而非仅依赖图像对比度，从而解决传统图像-only方法中相似对比度来自不同材料或成像条件导致的歧义问题，为多模态自主材料表征提供通用路径。
papers.method_zh: 构建上下文感知学习框架，整合图像衍生的对比度与元数据（成分、束能量、探测器几何结构）；系统构建包含约5500万模拟图像块的数据库，覆盖96种掺杂单层TMDs的576种情况；使用该框架进行缺陷分类训练与验证。

papers.title: Hydride formation and phase separation in palladium nanoparticles from a transferable atomic cluster expansion potential
papers.abstract: The palladium-hydrogen system is a prototype for hydrogen-metal interactions and underpins technologies such as hydrogen storage, catalysis and purification. Yet its nanoscale behaviour -- where surface and interface energetics, elastic coherency strain and size-dependent thermodynamics govern phase separation -- has eluded accurate atomistic simulation. Empirical potentials misrepresent the energetics of interstitial hydrogen, while existing machine-learning models are restricted to bulk phases at low-hydrogen environments. Here we introduce an atomic cluster expansion (ACE) for Pd-H that reproduces formation energies, phonon spectra, elastic constants, hydrogen migration barriers and surface adsorption with near-DFT accuracy, benchmarked directly against neutron-scattering, high-pressure and lattice-expansion experiments. Its near-linear scaling and CPU efficiency make molecular dynamics of PdH$_x$ nanoparticles exceeding 28,000 atoms ($\sim$12 nm in diameter) tractable over nanosecond timescales. These simulations resolve, at the atomic scale, the kinetic separation of $α$- and $β$-PdH$_x$ into a core-shell architecture, reproduce the experimentally observed size dependence of the lattice parameter, and uncover a pronounced hydrogen-induced lowering of the nanoparticle melting temperature. The potential brings experimentally relevant scales of metal-hydride dynamics within quantitative reach.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“atomic cluster expansion (ACE)”、“molecular dynamics”、“near-DFT accuracy”、“atomistic simulation”。；研究对象：钯-氢（Pd-H）体系，具体研究钯纳米颗粒中的氢化物形成与相分离行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过原子团簇展开势（ACE）的大规模分子动力学模拟，首次在原子尺度上揭示了α-PdHₓ与β-PdHₓ在纳米颗粒中发生动力学相分离并形成核-壳结构，同时发现氢的引入会显著降低纳米颗粒的熔化温度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过原子团簇展开势（ACE）的大规模分子动力学模拟，首次在原子尺度上揭示了α-PdHₓ与β-PdHₓ在纳米颗粒中发生动力学相分离并形成核-壳结构，同时发现氢的引入会显著降低纳米颗粒的熔化温度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 原子团簇展开（ACE）势方法，结合密度泛函理论（DFT）基准数据训练，用于分子动力学模拟。模拟体系尺寸超过28,000个原子（直径约12 nm），时间尺度达纳秒级。模型通过与中子散射、高压实验和晶格膨胀实验数据对比进行验证。

papers.title: The group theory of Raman effect in magnetic materials
papers.abstract: Although Raman scattering in magnetic materials exhibits rich experimental phenomena, the symmetry constraints on Raman tensors have not been fully elucidated. In this work, we use Onsager reciprocity relation, other than the conventional corepresentation method, to deal with the mathematical structures of Raman tensors in magnetic groups. Using this approach, we generate Raman tensor tables for all magnetic point groups, and present a comprehensive understanding of the Raman selection rules in magnetic materials with direct product representations method. Our theoretical and numerical results match previous experiments well, and resolve a puzzle in the Raman spectroscopy of CrSBr. Moreover, we identify a common but overlooked phenomenon: the magneto-Raman vector can be orthogonal to the magnetic moment direction. Our method and associated Raman tensor tables will be helpful for the Raman studies in both experimental and theoretical domains.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：Onsager reciprocity relation、direct product representations method、group theory）；研究对象：磁性材料中的拉曼散射效应，具体涉及所有磁点群的拉曼张量对称性约束及选择定则。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用昂萨格互易关系替代传统共表示方法，系统推导了所有磁点群的拉曼张量表，并发现磁拉曼矢量可与磁矩方向正交这一被忽视的普遍现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用昂萨格互易关系替代传统共表示方法，系统推导了所有磁点群的拉曼张量表，并发现磁拉曼矢量可与磁矩方向正交这一被忽视的普遍现象。；创新点：首次用昂萨格互易关系处理磁群拉曼张量的数学结构，替代了传统的共表示方法；解决了CrSBr拉曼光谱中存在的疑难问题，并揭示了磁拉曼矢量与磁矩方向正交的普遍现象。
papers.method_zh: 基于昂萨格互易关系的群论分析，结合直积表示方法推导磁点群拉曼选择定则，并生成完整的拉曼张量数值表。

papers.title: Crystal Shape and Lattice Deformation in Powder Diffraction
papers.abstract: Accurate modelling of diffraction peak shapes is essential for extracting microstructural information from nanocrystalline materials. Common-volume functions are widely used to describe finite-size and shape broadening in powder diffraction, but analytical expressions are available only for a limited set of ideal geometries. Here, we introduce a generalized Fourier-based framework in which crystal-domain shape deformation, lattice deformation, and relative shape-lattice misorientation are treated as independently refinable tensor operations within a unified formalism. The approach enables continuous affine transformations of both crystal shape and lattice base while preserving analytical evaluation of directional Fourier coefficients. As a result, complex particle shapes, anisotropic deformations, and arbitrary relative orientations between shape and lattice can be modelled within a single reciprocal- and real-space framework, including coupled shape-lattice transformations not accessible using conventional powder diffraction line-profile methods. The formalism can be applied to individual diffraction peaks, full powder patterns, and total-scattering shape corrections. Validation against virtual scattering experiment data demonstrates that crystal size, shape, lattice deformation, and relative shape-lattice orientation can be simultaneously recovered with high accuracy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提出“generalized Fourier-based framework”（广义傅里叶框架）和“unified formalism”（统一形式体系），属于理论建模方法。；研究对象：粉末衍射中纳米晶材料的晶体形状、晶格变形以及形状-晶格相对取向对衍射峰形的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一个统一的傅里叶框架，能够将晶体形状变形、晶格变形以及形状-晶格相对取向作为独立可精修的张量操作进行处理，从而实现对复杂粒子形状、各向异性变形及任意相对取向的精确建模。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一个统一的傅里叶框架，能够将晶体形状变形、晶格变形以及形状-晶格相对取向作为独立可精修的张量操作进行处理，从而实现对复杂粒子形状、各向异性变形及任意相对取向的精确建模。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 广义傅里叶框架方法。通过连续仿射变换处理晶体形状和晶格基矢，保持方向傅里叶系数的解析可计算性，并应用于单个衍射峰、全粉末图谱及全散射形状校正。通过虚拟散射实验数据进行验证。

papers.title: Control transition in a temporally random classical spin chain
papers.abstract: We theoretically explore a phase transition between controlled and chaotic dynamics in a classical spin chain model subject to chaotic Hamiltonian dynamics and a contractive "control map", which alternate in time. The control map drives the system toward a target configuration that is an unstable fixed point under the chaotic dynamics. When the control is strong enough, the target configuration is the globally attracting stable fixed point of the dynamics; for weaker control, the many-body dynamics remains chaotic for almost all initial states. The phase transition between controlled and chaotic phases has a mixed character: As the transition is approached from the chaotic phase, the fraction of the spins that are far from the target configuration goes continuously to zero, and there are diverging spatial and temporal correlation lengths; however, the leading Lyapunov exponent is discontinuous across the transition, jumping from a positive value in the chaotic phase to a negative value in the controlled phase. We present evidence that this transition is in the same universality class as directed percolation in the presence of temporal randomness, a universality class for which we obtain results that are consistent with the dynamical Harris criterion but do not saturate the bound.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“theoretically explore”、“model”、“universality class”。；研究对象：经典自旋链模型中的控制-混沌相变，具体为受时间随机交替的混沌哈密顿动力学与收缩性“控制映射”驱动的自旋链系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该相变具有混合特征：从混沌相趋近相变点时，远离目标构型的自旋比例连续趋于零，且存在发散的空间和时间关联长度；但主导李雅普诺夫指数在相变点处不连续，从混沌相的正值跳变为控制相的负值。该相变与存在时间随机性的有向逾渗属于同一普适类。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该相变具有混合特征：从混沌相趋近相变点时，远离目标构型的自旋比例连续趋于零，且存在发散的空间和时间关联长度；但主导李雅普诺夫指数在相变点处不连续，从混沌相的正值跳变为控制相的负值。该相变与存在时间随机性的有向逾渗属于同一普适类。；创新点：揭示了控制-混沌相变中序参量连续变化与李雅普诺夫指数不连续共存的混合特征，并首次将该相变与时间随机性下的有向逾渗普适类建立联系，且验证了动力学Harris判据但未饱和其边界。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值模拟相结合。通过构建交替施加混沌哈密顿动力学和收缩性控制映射的经典自旋链模型，分析控制强度变化下的动力学相变，并利用有限尺寸标度、关联长度及李雅普诺夫指数等工具判定普适类。

papers.title: Unconventional incommensurate epitaxy of superconducting FeSe films on SrTiO$_3$
papers.abstract: We present a combined X-ray diffraction and transmission electron microscopy study of superconducting FeSe/FeTe multilayers grown by molecular beam epitaxy on SrTiO$_3$(001) substrates. While X-ray diffraction confirms perfect in-plane epitaxial alignment between FeSe, FeTe, and the substrate, scanning transmission electron microscopy reveals a surprising lack of atomic registry at the FeSe/SrTiO$_3$ interface. Instead of adapting to the substrate lattice, FeSe retains its own in-plane lattice spacing. A periodic lateral shift between the atomic positions of FeSe and SrTiO$_3$ is observed, with a registry recurrence length that matches the lattice mismatch determined by X-ray diffraction. No misfit dislocations or other relaxation features are detected at the interface. This coexistence of directional alignment and registry-free growth suggests an unconventional regime of epitaxy in which crystallographic orientation is maintained without atomic matching. The findings offer insight into strain accommodation in layered systems and may have implications for interface engineering in Fe-based superconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：X-ray diffraction（X射线衍射）、transmission electron microscopy（透射电子显微镜）、molecular beam epitaxy（分子束外延）。；研究对象：在SrTiO₃(001)衬底上通过分子束外延生长的超导FeSe/FeTe多层膜，具体关注FeSe薄膜与SrTiO₃衬底之间的界面结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: FeSe薄膜与SrTiO₃衬底之间实现了方向性对齐（定向外延）但缺乏原子级晶格匹配，即存在一种非常规的非公度外延模式：FeSe保持自身面内晶格常数，与衬底之间出现周期性横向位移，且界面处未观察到失配位错。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：FeSe薄膜与SrTiO₃衬底之间实现了方向性对齐（定向外延）但缺乏原子级晶格匹配，即存在一种非常规的非公度外延模式：FeSe保持自身面内晶格常数，与衬底之间出现周期性横向位移，且界面处未观察到失配位错。；创新点：首次报道了FeSe/SrTiO₃界面处“方向对齐但无原子匹配”的非常规外延态，即晶格取向保持但无原子级注册，且无失配位错等弛豫特征，这不同于传统外延理论中的共格或半共格生长模式。
papers.method_zh: 结合X射线衍射（XRD）和扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）对分子束外延（MBE）生长的FeSe/FeTe多层膜进行结构表征。

papers.title: Layer-parity-defined surface polarization in Nb$_3$Cl$_8$ for excitonic modulation at van der Waals interfaces
papers.abstract: The intrinsic symmetry breaking in the breathing kagome lattice of layered Nb$_3$Cl$_8$ provides a unique mechanism for realizing electrically polar surfaces. In each monolayer, the trimerization of Nb atoms breaks inversion and mirror symmetries, generating an out-of-plane electric dipole. The AB-stacked $α$ phase arranges adjacent layer dipoles antiferroelectrically, leaving the uncompensated surface polarization strictly governed by layer parity. Here, using atomic force microscopy operated in Kelvin probe force microscopy mode, we directly visualize layer-dependent polarization states in exfoliated Nb$_3$Cl$_8$ flakes and resolve a pronounced odd-even oscillation of the surface electrostatic potential. Beyond this parity-locked antiferroelectric order, we further identify intralayer polar domains in which local atomic reconstructions of the breathing kagome network reverse the out-of-plane dipole of the surface layer, producing ferroelectric-like stacking configurations. By interfacing monolayer MoSe$_2$ with Nb$_3$Cl$_8$, we demonstrate that these surface-polarization textures effectively modulate adjacent excitonic emission through domain-dependent interfacial band alignment and charge transfer. Our findings establish Nb$_3$Cl$_8$ as an intrinsic layer-polarized van der Waals platform and show that layer parity provides powerful structural degree of freedom for programming excitonic and optoelectronic responses at van der Waals interfaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“使用原子力显微镜（KPFM模式）直接观察”、“将单层MoSe₂与Nb₃Cl₈界面结合”等实验手段。；研究对象：层状呼吸笼目晶格材料Nb₃Cl₈及其表面极化现象，以及该极化对范德华界面激子发射的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Nb₃Cl₈的表面极化严格由层数奇偶性决定，呈现奇偶振荡的表面静电势；同时发现层内极化畴可通过原子重构反转表面层偶极，形成类铁电堆叠构型，并有效调控界面激子发射。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Nb₃Cl₈的表面极化严格由层数奇偶性决定，呈现奇偶振荡的表面静电势；同时发现层内极化畴可通过原子重构反转表面层偶极，形成类铁电堆叠构型，并有效调控界面激子发射。；创新点：首次在实验上直接可视化层数奇偶性决定的表面极化振荡，并揭示层内极化畴对表面偶极的反转机制，将Nb₃Cl₈确立为一种本征层极化范德华平台，利用层奇偶性作为结构自由度编程界面激子与光电子响应。
papers.method_zh: 开尔文探针力显微镜（KPFM）直接测量表面静电势；机械剥离制备薄片；构建Nb₃Cl₈/MoSe₂异质结进行光学表征。

papers.title: Non-Bloch band theory of boundary-controlled magnon edge modes in an antiferromagnetic chain
papers.abstract: We define a winding number within the Non-Bloch band theory framework that captures the emergence of magnon edge modes in a one-dimensional antiferromagnetic spin chain, even when the conventional Bloch winding number is trivial. Within linear spin-wave theory, magnon excitations are governed by a non-Hermitian dynamic matrix, despite the underlying Hamiltonian being Hermitian. The symmetry classification of this matrix yields a trivial bulk invariant, however, finite systems exhibit boundary-localized modes, signaling a breakdown of the conventional bulk-boundary correspondence. We further show that these edge modes can be controlled via boundary perturbations. By tuning the boundary potential, the modes can be driven into or out of the bulk spectrum. To resolve the bulk-boundary mismatch, we develop a non-Bloch framework based on a generalized Brillouin zone and a winding number that correctly predicts the presence of edge states. Our results establish boundary-controlled topological transitions that are experimentally accessible through local Zeeman fields or modified edge anisotropy in antiferromagnetic van der Waals nanostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中主要进行理论框架构建（Non-Bloch band theory）、对称性分类和拓扑不变量（winding number）计算，未提及任何实验数据或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：一维反铁磁自旋链中的磁振子边缘态，具体为边界可控的磁振子边缘模式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在常规布洛赫能带理论下拓扑平庸的反铁磁自旋链中，通过非布洛赫能带理论定义的绕数可以正确预测磁振子边缘态的存在，且这些边缘态可通过边界微扰（如局域塞曼场或边缘各向异性）进行调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在常规布洛赫能带理论下拓扑平庸的反铁磁自旋链中，通过非布洛赫能带理论定义的绕数可以正确预测磁振子边缘态的存在，且这些边缘态可通过边界微扰（如局域塞曼场或边缘各向异性）进行调控。；创新点：揭示了在哈密顿量本身为厄米的情况下，其线性自旋波动力学矩阵的非厄米性导致了传统体-边对应关系的失效，并为此建立了非布洛赫能带理论框架来恢复体-边对应，从而解释了边界可控的拓扑相变。
papers.method_zh: 线性自旋波理论（Linear spin-wave theory）、非厄米动力学矩阵分析、非布洛赫能带理论（Non-Bloch band theory）、广义布里渊区（generalized Brillouin zone）方法。

papers.title: Curvature-guided topology and self-assembly in chiral nematics and liquid-crystal colloids
papers.abstract: In soft condensed matter, curvature does more than simply distort an ordered medium: it helps select defect structures, redistribute elastic stress, bias chirality, and guide self-assembly. This review examines how curved, multiply connected, and knotted boundaries in liquid-crystal colloids and confined nematics generate topological defects and localized solitonic textures, and how these structures mediate interactions between mesoscale building blocks. We introduce a unifying framework based on genus, Euler characteristic, anchoring, and chirality, and use it to discuss spherical, handlebody, and boundary-bearing colloids, together with droplets and polymer-dispersed nematics of nontrivial topology. Particular emphasis is placed on the interplay of geometry and topology in determining boojums, disclination loops, hedgehog charges, and linked and knotted defect structures. We then turn to chiral systems hosting skyrmions, torons, hopfions, and related localized textures, highlighting how chirality and confinement stabilize three-dimensional topological states. Finally, we discuss how these concepts translate into design principles for controlled self-assembly, templating, and functional composite materials. More broadly, we argue that liquid-crystal colloids and confined nematics provide experimentally accessible model systems in which curvature, topology, and chirality can be harnessed as programmable tools for designing organized soft matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/综述文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“This review examines...”，属于综述性理论框架讨论，未涉及具体实验或计算数据。；研究对象：手性向列相液晶及液晶胶体中的拓扑缺陷、局域孤子结构（如skyrmions、torons、hopfions），以及曲面几何与拓扑对自组装行为的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 曲面、多连通及打结边界能够引导液晶中拓扑缺陷和孤子结构的生成，并调控介观构筑块之间的相互作用；手性与限域效应可稳定三维拓扑态，为设计可控自组装和功能复合材料提供原理。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：曲面、多连通及打结边界能够引导液晶中拓扑缺陷和孤子结构的生成，并调控介观构筑块之间的相互作用；手性与限域效应可稳定三维拓扑态，为设计可控自组装和功能复合材料提供原理。；创新点：摘要未突出说明具体创新点，但整体上提出将曲率、拓扑和手性作为可编程工具来设计有序软物质，并系统总结了从缺陷结构到自组装设计原则的跨尺度关联。
papers.method_zh: 基于亏格（genus）、欧拉示性数、锚定条件和手性参数建立统一理论框架，分析球形、手柄形及含边界胶体、液滴和聚合物分散向列相中的几何与拓扑耦合效应。

papers.title: The impact of interfacial chemistry on the band offset of GaAs/Ga$_2$O$_3$ heterostructures
papers.abstract: Ga$_2$O$_3$/GaAs heterojunctions are emerging as promising candidates for next-generation power electronics, photonics, and energy devices, leveraging the high breakdown voltage and thermal stability of Ga$_2$O$_3$ alongside the mature technology, high hole mobility, and higher refractive index of GaAs. The efficiency of these devices depends strongly on the band alignment between the two materials, however both type-I and type-II alignment have been reported in the literature for these heterostructures. To address this ambiguity, we use hybrid density functional theory to systematically investigate the band alignment at GaAs/Ga$_2$O$_3$ interfaces, focusing on the role of interface chemistry. By considering Ga-O-, As-, and As-O-rich interfaces both in amorphous and crystalline Ga$_2$O$_3$ phases, we demonstrate that interface stoichiometry determines the alignment type: Ga-O-rich interfaces exhibit type-II alignment with large valence band offsets (~3.1 eV), while As-rich and As-O-rich interfaces favor type-I alignment with reduced offsets (~2.3-2.6 eV). These trends are attributed to interface dipole formation driven by bonding configuration. Our findings provide insight into the relationship between chemistry and band alignment in GaAs/Ga$_2$O$_3$ heterostructures, enabling targeted optimization for specific device applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用 hybrid density functional theory（混合密度泛函理论）进行系统计算研究。；研究对象：GaAs/Ga₂O₃ 异质结的界面化学与能带对齐（band alignment）之间的关系，具体关注 Ga-O 富集、As 富集和 As-O 富集界面，以及非晶与晶态 Ga₂O₃ 相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 界面化学计量比决定了能带对齐类型：Ga-O 富集界面呈现 II 型对齐，价带偏移约 3.1 eV；As 富集和 As-O 富集界面呈现 I 型对齐，价带偏移约 2.3–2.6 eV。这些趋势由界面成键构型驱动的偶极子形成所致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：界面化学计量比决定了能带对齐类型：Ga-O 富集界面呈现 II 型对齐，价带偏移约 3.1 eV；As 富集和 As-O 富集界面呈现 I 型对齐，价带偏移约 2.3–2.6 eV。这些趋势由界面成键构型驱动的偶极子形成所致。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用混合密度泛函理论（hybrid DFT）进行第一性原理计算，系统研究不同界面化学计量比（Ga-O、As、As-O 富集）及不同 Ga₂O₃ 相（非晶与晶态）下的能带对齐。

papers.title: Correlation enhanced resistance hysteresis near half filling in MoS2/WSe2 heterobilayer
papers.abstract: Ferroelectricity, typically arising from ionic displacements in noncentrosymmetric lattices, enabling applications in memory devices and sensors. Recent advances in two-dimensional materials and van der Waals heterostructures have revealed novel ferroelectric phenomena, including sliding ferroelectricity and correlation-driven ferroelectricity in moire superlattices. In this work, we fabricate and study a MoS2/WSe2 moire superlattice device exhibiting a high field-effect mobility of 17,650 $cm^2V^{-1}s^{-1}$. Electrical transport measurements reveal correlated insulating states accompanied by a prominent and reproducible resistance hysteresis near half filling. Temperature and displacement field dependence further confirms the correlation-enhanced nature of the hysteresis. Our analysis suggests that displacement field-induced metal-to-insulator transition at correlated insulating state coupled with interfacial dipoles enables the observed resistance hysteresis. These results establish correlation enhanced resistance hysteresis near half filling in a MoS2/WSe2 heterobilayer, offering opportunities for exploring emergent quantum phases and device functionalities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“fabricate”、“Electrical transport measurements”、“Temperature and displacement field dependence”。；研究对象：MoS₂/WSe₂ 莫尔超晶格异质双层结构，具体研究其半填充（half filling）附近的电阻回滞现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 MoS₂/WSe₂ 异质双层中，半填充附近观测到与关联绝缘态伴随的显著且可重复的电阻回滞，且该回滞被关联效应增强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 MoS₂/WSe₂ 异质双层中，半填充附近观测到与关联绝缘态伴随的显著且可重复的电阻回滞，且该回滞被关联效应增强。；创新点：在 MoS₂/WSe₂ 异质双层中首次建立了半填充附近关联增强的电阻回滞现象，并指出该回滞源于位移场诱导的金属-绝缘体转变与界面偶极子的耦合。
papers.method_zh: 器件制备（MoS₂/WSe₂ 莫尔超晶格器件）、电输运测量（高场效应迁移率17,650 cm²V⁻¹s⁻¹）、温度与位移场依赖关系测量。

papers.title: Strain-Induced Tuning of Third-Harmonic Generation in Monolayer Black Phosphorene
papers.abstract: Based on the tight-binding model and the semiconductor Bloch equations, this work systematically reveals the microscopic mechanism of strain engineering in turning of third-harmonic generation (THG) in monolayer black phosphorene (BP). % The results show that under strain-free conditions, monolayer BP exhibits significant in-plane anisotropy, and its dominant susceptibility component reaches a maximum of $χ^{(3);xxxx} = 1.8 \times 10^{-17} \, \text{m}^2/\text{V}^2$, agreeing well with the experimental results. % By applying uniaxial and biaxial strains along the armchair ($x$), zigzag ($y$), and out-of-plane ($z$) directions, we find that the THG response presents strong direction dependence and unique spectral shifting behaviors: in-plane compressive strain and out-of-plane tensile strain both significantly enhance the THG conductivity and induce a redshift, whereas in-plane tensile strain and out-of-plane compression lead to suppression and a blueshift, with the tuning efficiency following the order of $z > y > x$. The microscopic origin of these phenomena is identified as the synergistic modulation of the bandgap and Berry connection by strain. % Furthermore, the synergistic or competitive effects of biaxial strain further enrich the manipulation of THG signals. % Strain engineering can serve as an effective strategy for dynamically controlling nonlinear optical processes in two-dimensional materials, and it also lays a theoretical foundation for the development of high-performance reconfigurable infrared photonic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：基于紧束缚模型和半导体布洛赫方程进行理论计算，未涉及实验数据采集。；研究对象：单层黑磷烯（monolayer black phosphorene, BP）中应变调控的第三次谐波产生（THG）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过沿不同方向施加单轴或双轴应变，可显著调控单层黑磷烯的THG响应：面内压缩应变和面外拉伸应变增强THG并导致红移，面内拉伸应变和面外压缩则抑制THG并导致蓝移，调控效率遵循z > y > x的顺序。该现象的微观机制源于应变对带隙和贝里联系的协同调制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过沿不同方向施加单轴或双轴应变，可显著调控单层黑磷烯的THG响应：面内压缩应变和面外拉伸应变增强THG并导致红移，面内拉伸应变和面外压缩则抑制THG并导致蓝移，调控效率遵循z > y > x的顺序。该现象的微观机制源于应变对带隙和贝里联系的协同调制。；创新点：系统揭示了应变工程对单层黑磷烯THG响应的微观调控机制，特别是发现了不同方向应变（面内/面外、拉伸/压缩）对THG信号截然不同的增强/抑制及光谱移动行为，并指出应变可作为动态调控二维材料非线性光学过程的有效策略。
papers.method_zh: 紧束缚模型（tight-binding model）结合半导体布洛赫方程（semiconductor Bloch equations）进行理论计算。

papers.title: Evaluation of nonlinear optical coefficients in uniformly aligned dioxane-based ferroelectric nematic liquid crystals using second harmonic generation
papers.abstract: Ferroelectric nematic liquid crystals (FNLCs) are promising soft platforms for nonlinear optics, but quantitative determination of their second-order nonlinear optical coefficients has been hindered by limited alignment control. Here, polarization-resolved second-harmonic generation (SHG) measurements on a uniformly aligned dioxane-based FNLC, combined with Jones-matrix simulations, enable determination of all principal tensor components. The resulting tensor is consistent with the expected $C_{\infty v}$ and Kleinman symmetries, while the measured coefficients cannot be explained by a simple sum of molecular first hyperpolarizabilities. These results provide a quantitative basis for understanding nonlinear optical responses and guiding the design of FNLC-based nonlinear optical materials and devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：polarization-resolved second-harmonic generation (SHG) measurements、Jones-matrix simulations。；研究对象：均匀排列的二氧六环基铁电向列液晶（dioxane-based ferroelectric nematic liquid crystal, FNLC）的非线性光学系数。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过偏振分辨二次谐波测量与琼斯矩阵模拟，首次定量确定了均匀排列FNLC的所有二阶非线性光学张量主分量，发现其张量符合预期的C∞v和Kleinman对称性，但测量系数无法用分子第一超极化率的简单求和来解释。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过偏振分辨二次谐波测量与琼斯矩阵模拟，首次定量确定了均匀排列FNLC的所有二阶非线性光学张量主分量，发现其张量符合预期的C∞v和Kleinman对称性，但测量系数无法用分子第一超极化率的简单求和来解释。；创新点：解决了以往因排列控制不足而无法定量确定铁电向列液晶二阶非线性光学系数的问题，并揭示了其非线性响应不能简单归因于分子超极化率的加和。
papers.method_zh: 偏振分辨二次谐波（SHG）测量实验，结合琼斯矩阵（Jones-matrix）模拟进行数据分析。

papers.title: Order parameters and ground-state phase diagram of the interacting topological Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model with extended-range hoppings
papers.abstract: Topological insulators have attracted numerous attentions recent years, where the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) model is one of the most studied models. While the interacting version of it has been explored recently, the interplay between interactions and long-range hoppings merit further investigations. In this work, we uncover a rich phase diagram of the interacting SSH model with extended-range hoppings, in which it consists of several topological phases, two novel superconducting-like (SC-like) phases and five distinct charge-density-wave (CDW) phases. We substantiate that the SC-like and two CDW phases are direct consequences of imbalanced interactions and extended-range hoppings. We derive the order parameters (OPs) for each of the phases and verify them in large-system simulations, finding consistency with the entanglement entropy and the fidelity in capturing the phase transitions. In contrast to the non-interacting case where the favored hoppings are unidirectional in the topological phases, the derived OPs suggest non-unidirectional hoppings are possible under the influence of interactions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：phase diagram（相图）、order parameters（序参量）、large-system simulations（大系统模拟）。；研究对象：具有扩展范围跳跃的相互作用Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）模型，具体研究其基态相图与序参量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型存在丰富的相图，包含多个拓扑相、两个新型类超导（SC-like）相以及五种不同的电荷密度波（CDW）相。类超导相和两种CDW相是不平衡相互作用与扩展范围跳跃的直接结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型存在丰富的相图，包含多个拓扑相、两个新型类超导（SC-like）相以及五种不同的电荷密度波（CDW）相。类超导相和两种CDW相是不平衡相互作用与扩展范围跳跃的直接结果。；创新点：揭示了相互作用与扩展范围跳跃的协同效应，发现了非相互作用情况下不存在的非单向跳跃可能性，并首次系统定义了各相的序参量。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导序参量，并结合大系统模拟（具体方法如DMRG等摘要未明确说明）进行验证，同时利用纠缠熵和保真度捕捉相变。

papers.title: Metal Halide Perovskite/Chalcohalide Heterojunctions for the Photoinduced Oxidative Coupling of p-substituted Thiophenols
papers.abstract: The introduction of a semiconductor-semiconductor junction is an effective strategy to enhance the photocatalytic performance of perovskite nanocrystal-based systems. Herein, we optimized the synthesis of CsPbX3/Pb4S3X2 (X= Cl, Br, I) perovskites-chalcohalides heterostructures, whose band alignment can be tuned by halide composition. As a proof-of-concept, we evaluated the photooxidative coupling of p-substituted thiophenols at room temperature, under visible-light, air, and without sacrificial electron donor. Notably, CsPbBr3/Pb4S3Br2 achieved up to 94 % selectivity toward disulfide (p-OCH3 thiophenol with a turnover number of 14300) highlighting the crucial role of the type-II heterojunction to promote charge separation and efficient electron delocalization across the junction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“优化了合成”“评估了光氧化偶联反应”“实现了94%选择性”等实验操作与性能表征。；研究对象：CsPbX₃/Pb₄S₃X₂（X=Cl, Br, I）钙钛矿-硫卤化物异质结，用于光催化对位取代苯硫酚的氧化偶联反应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CsPbBr₃/Pb₄S₃Br₂异质结在可见光、空气、无牺牲电子给体条件下，对二硫化物产物实现了高达94%的选择性（对甲氧基苯硫酚的转化数达14300），表明II型异质结有效促进了电荷分离和电子离域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CsPbBr₃/Pb₄S₃Br₂异质结在可见光、空气、无牺牲电子给体条件下，对二硫化物产物实现了高达94%的选择性（对甲氧基苯硫酚的转化数达14300），表明II型异质结有效促进了电荷分离和电子离域。；创新点：首次将钙钛矿/硫卤化物异质结应用于光催化氧化偶联反应，并展示了通过卤素组分调控能带对齐来优化光催化性能的策略。
papers.method_zh: 通过卤素组分调控合成CsPbX₃/Pb₄S₃X₂异质结构，并评估其在室温可见光下催化对位取代苯硫酚光氧化偶联反应的性能。

papers.title: Quantitative measurement of fluid inertial effects in confined Brownian motion
papers.abstract: The hydrodynamic response of Brownian particles in liquids is fundamentally altered by inertial forces arising from unsteady momentum transport in the surrounding fluid. These forces are of two distinct types\,: the added mass and the history effect. While both are well understood in bulk and weakly-confined geometries, under deterministic driving, their respective behaviours under strong confinement and thermal fluctuations remain scarcely addressed, unclear and often entangled together. The goal of the present study is thus to fill this fundamental gap. The behaviours of the two distinct inertial contributions are quantitatively investigated in the vicinity of a flat, rigid wall, using a combination of broadrange thermal colloidal-probe atomic-force-microscopy experiments, advanced numerical simulations and theory. The separation of the added-mass and history-force contributions is achieved through their different frequency-scaling signatures within the measured high-resolution thermal spectra. Our results establish a complete picture of Brownian motion at interfaces, in the lubrication regime, with direct relevance to nanofluidics and interfacial biophysics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+数值模拟+理论）。判断依据关键词：thermal colloidal-probe atomic-force-microscopy experiments, advanced numerical simulations, theory。；研究对象：受限布朗运动中流体惯性效应（附加质量效应与历史效应）的定量测量，具体体系为平坦刚性壁面附近的胶体颗粒热运动。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过高频热谱中两种惯性贡献的不同频率标度特征，成功分离了附加质量效应与历史效应，建立了润滑区间内界面布朗运动的完整图像。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过高频热谱中两种惯性贡献的不同频率标度特征，成功分离了附加质量效应与历史效应，建立了润滑区间内界面布朗运动的完整图像。；创新点：首次在强受限几何条件下，定量区分并研究了热涨落中附加质量效应与历史效应的各自行为，填补了该领域在强受限与热涨落下惯性效应相互纠缠的空白。
papers.method_zh: 实验采用宽频热胶体探针原子力显微镜（thermal colloidal-probe atomic-force-microscopy）；结合先进数值模拟与理论分析；通过测量高分辨率热谱中不同频率标度特征来分离两种惯性贡献。

papers.title: BSE+ calculations for 2D materials: a unified description of excitons and plasmons
papers.abstract: The Bethe-Salpeter equation (BSE) accurately describes low-energy optical spectra in materials with strong excitonic effects, but its high computational cost limits the number of electron-hole transitions that can be included. Neglecting high-energy transitions leads to an underestimation of the real part of the dielectric function, often producing a spurious plasmon peak in the BSE electron energy loss spectrum (EELS). The recently introduced BSE+ method addresses this by combining a four-point BSE-like equation for the irreducible polarisability with a two-point Dyson equation that includes the high-energy transitions at the Random Phase Approximation (RPA) level. Here, we present a detailed account of the method, extend it to two-dimensional materials, and apply it to a set of transition metal dichalcogenide monolayers. BSE+ preserves the excitonic features of the BSE at low energies while reproducing the plasmonic structure of the RPA at higher energies, yielding good agreement with experimental EELS data across the full energy range and strongly suppressing the spurious plasmon. BSE+ converges much faster than BSE with respect to the electron-hole basis size, at a comparable computational cost, and is implemented in the GPAW code.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：Bethe-Salpeter equation (BSE)、Random Phase Approximation (RPA)、GPAW code（第一性原理计算代码）。；研究对象：二维材料，具体为过渡金属二硫族化物（TMD）单层中的激子（excitons）和等离激元（plasmons）的电子能量损失谱（EELS）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: BSE+方法能够在低能区保留BSE方法对激子特征的准确描述，同时在高能区复现RPA方法的等离激元结构，有效抑制了传统BSE方法中因忽略高能跃迁而产生的虚假等离激元峰，且与实验EELS数据在全能量范围内吻合良好。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：BSE+方法能够在低能区保留BSE方法对激子特征的准确描述，同时在高能区复现RPA方法的等离激元结构，有效抑制了传统BSE方法中因忽略高能跃迁而产生的虚假等离激元峰，且与实验EELS数据在全能量范围内吻合良好。；创新点：将BSE+方法从三维体系扩展至二维材料，解决了传统BSE方法在计算二维材料EELS时因截断电子-空穴基组而产生的虚假等离激元问题，实现了对激子和等离激元的统一描述，且计算收敛速度更快。
papers.method_zh: 理论计算方法。具体为：将四点BSE类方程（用于不可极化率）与包含高能跃迁（在RPA水平）的两点戴森方程相结合的BSE+方法，并扩展应用于二维材料，在GPAW代码中实现。

papers.title: Designing electronic magnetoelectric matter with organic quantum spin trimers
papers.abstract: Magnetoelectric (ME) phenomena are commonly driven by spin-lattice coupling. Here we demonstrate a different route based on frustrated quantum spin trimers that intrinsically intertwine magnetic moments and electric dipoles. Using molecular design principles, we realize a weakly coupled lattice of equilateral $S=1/2$ spin trimers in the organic radical crystal TNN$\cdot$CH$_3$CN. In this material, correlated electronic fluctuations within each trimer generate electric dipoles, while geometrically frustrated intertrimer interactions organize them into collective ME states. Magnetization, thermodynamic, and dielectric measurements reveal multiple magnetic-field-induced phases, including the $1/3$-magnetization plateau marked by pronounced dielectric anomalies. Effective low-energy theories and numerical simulations show that these phenomena are driven by electronically generated trimer dipoles whose collective order is stabilized by frustration relief of the intertrimer interactions, establishing a direct connection between geometric frustration and emergent magnetoelectricity. Our results identify quantum spin trimers as multifunctional building blocks, providing a bottom-up route for designing correlated ME materials from electronically active quantum spin clusters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：Magnetization, thermodynamic, and dielectric measurements；有机自由基晶体TNN·CH₃CN的合成与表征；结合低能有效理论和数值模拟）；研究对象：基于有机量子自旋三聚体（equilateral S=1/2 spin trimers）的电子型磁电材料，具体为有机自由基晶体TNN·CH₃CN。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在有机自由基晶体TNN·CH₃CN中，通过几何阻挫的量子自旋三聚体实现了电子起源的磁电耦合，观察到磁场诱导的1/3磁化平台及伴随的显著介电异常，建立了几何阻挫与涌现磁电性之间的直接联系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在有机自由基晶体TNN·CH₃CN中，通过几何阻挫的量子自旋三聚体实现了电子起源的磁电耦合，观察到磁场诱导的1/3磁化平台及伴随的显著介电异常，建立了几何阻挫与涌现磁电性之间的直接联系。；创新点：提出并实验实现了基于阻挫量子自旋三聚体的电子型磁电耦合机制，区别于传统的自旋-晶格耦合驱动磁电效应，将量子自旋三聚体作为多功能构筑单元，为从电子活性量子自旋簇自下而上设计关联磁电材料提供了新路径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上：磁化测量、热力学测量、介电测量；理论上：低能有效理论、数值模拟（摘要未明确具体计算方法如DMRG或精确对角化等细节）。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence for Instability in Inorganic Perovskites: From Mechanism Discovery to Engineering Strategies
papers.abstract: Three-dimensional all-inorganic halide perovskites, represented by CsPbX$_3$ (X = Cl, Br, I), have attracted broad interest in photovoltaics, photodetectors, and light-emitting devices because of their outstanding optoelectronic properties. Their practical deployment, however, remains limited by instability under thermal, chemical, optical, and electrical stress. Conventional studies have established important experimental and theoretical foundations, but they still struggle with multimodal data, coupled degradation pathways, protocol dependence, sparse statistics, and uncertainty quantification. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers a practical route to address these limitations. This review summarizes recent progress in AI-assisted studies of instability in 3D CsPbX$_3$ and organizes the discussion around four linked tasks, including stability discrimination and diagnosis, microscopic mechanism analysis, consequence and reliability modeling, and engineering stability enhancement. We further discuss the main limitations of current methods, especially in data quality, protocol consistency, benchmark design, interpretability, and transferability across domains. Finally, we outline future directions for the field, including standardized data infrastructures, interpretable cross-scale models, and tighter integration of AI with automated experiments and physics-based modeling. The aim of this review is to provide a coherent and practically useful framework for researchers seeking to use AI to understand, predict, and mitigate instability in inorganic perovskites.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述文章（Review）。关键词：review, summarizes recent progress, organize the discussion。；研究对象：三维全无机卤化物钙钛矿（3D all-inorganic halide perovskites），具体为CsPbX₃（X = Cl, Br, I）的不稳定性问题，包括热、化学、光、电应力下的降解机制与工程策略。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 人工智能（AI）能够有效克服传统研究在处理多模态数据、耦合降解路径、协议依赖性、稀疏统计和不确定性量化等方面的局限，为理解、预测和缓解无机钙钛矿的不稳定性提供系统性框架。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：人工智能（AI）能够有效克服传统研究在处理多模态数据、耦合降解路径、协议依赖性、稀疏统计和不确定性量化等方面的局限，为理解、预测和缓解无机钙钛矿的不稳定性提供系统性框架。；创新点：首次将AI应用于无机钙钛矿不稳定性研究的四个关键任务进行系统梳理，并指出当前方法在数据质量、协议一致性、基准设计、可解释性和跨领域迁移性方面的主要局限，提出未来标准化数据基础设施、可解释跨尺度模型及AI与自动化实验/物理建模深度融合的方向。
papers.method_zh: 该综述总结了AI辅助研究方法，涵盖稳定性判别与诊断、微观机制分析、后果与可靠性建模、工程稳定性增强四个关联任务。具体方法包括机器学习、数据驱动建模等，但摘要未明确列出具体算法或实验手段。

papers.title: Molecular dynamic simulation of multicomponent CoCrFeNiMn high-entropy alloy thin film deposition
papers.abstract: The deposition and growth of a thin CoCrFeMnNi high-entropy alloy film on an Al(100) substrate were investigated by molecular dynamics simulation. Interatomic interactions were described using a calibrated set of Morse potentials combined with mixing rules for regular solutions. During a 100 ns simulation, 50,000 atoms with an incident energy of 10 eV were deposited, producing a film of about 6.1 nm thickness. The resulting film contains face-centred cubic (FCC), body-centred cubic (BCC), hexagonal close-packed (HCP), and amorphous regions. Analysis of the radial distribution function (RDF) was used to determine nearest-neighbour distances and estimate lattice parameters for the crystalline phases. The simulated phase composition and structural parameters are in good agreement with available experimental data.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：molecular dynamics simulation（分子动力学模拟）。；研究对象：多组分CoCrFeNiMn高熵合金薄膜在Al(100)衬底上的沉积与生长过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 模拟沉积得到的薄膜包含面心立方（FCC）、体心立方（BCC）、六方密排（HCP）和非晶区域，其相组成和结构参数与已有实验数据吻合良好。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：模拟沉积得到的薄膜包含面心立方（FCC）、体心立方（BCC）、六方密排（HCP）和非晶区域，其相组成和结构参数与已有实验数据吻合良好。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用分子动力学（MD）模拟，原子间相互作用通过一套校准的Morse势函数结合正规溶液的混合规则描述。模拟沉积了50,000个原子（入射能量10 eV），沉积时间100 ns，生成约6.1 nm厚的薄膜，并通过径向分布函数（RDF）分析确定最近邻距离和晶格参数。

papers.title: Symmetry-Breaking Induced Spin Transport and Magneto-Optical Regulation in 2D Altermagnet Ru2MoSe4
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) altermagnets (AMs) offer a compelling paradigm for advanced spintronics, yet their fully compensated macroscopic spin currents inherently limit practical device integration. In this work, using first-principles calculations and theoretical analysis, we demonstrate that the 2D material Ru2MoSe4 hosts AM ground state protected by S4zT symmetry. Using uniaxial strain modulation and stacking configuration, we show that the monolayer and the AC-stacking bilayer Ru2MoSe4 host fully spin-polarized currents, piezomagnetically induced net magnetization, and the magneto-optical Kerr effect. Our findings establish Ru2MoSe4 as a tunable platform, offering a feasible mechanism to simultaneously trigger electrical spin transport signals and amplify optical readout signatures for next-generation spintronics and valleytronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论文章。判断依据：关键词“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）和“theoretical analysis”（理论分析）。；研究对象：二维材料 Ru₂MoSe₄ 中的交变磁（altermagnet, AM）基态及其在单层和AC堆叠双层构型下的自旋输运和磁光性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过单轴应变调控和堆叠构型设计，二维交变磁体 Ru₂MoSe₄ 的单层和AC堆叠双层可以产生完全自旋极化的电流、压磁诱导的净磁化以及磁光克尔效应，从而同时实现电学自旋输运信号和光学读出信号的调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过单轴应变调控和堆叠构型设计，二维交变磁体 Ru₂MoSe₄ 的单层和AC堆叠双层可以产生完全自旋极化的电流、压磁诱导的净磁化以及磁光克尔效应，从而同时实现电学自旋输运信号和光学读出信号的调控。；创新点：该工作首次在二维材料 Ru₂MoSe₄ 中提出了一种可行的机制，能够同时触发电学自旋输运信号并增强光学读出信号（磁光克尔效应），从而克服了传统二维交变磁体因宏观自旋流完全补偿而限制实际器件集成的难题。摘要未突出说明与具体已有材料的性能对比。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）结合理论分析。具体包括：利用对称性分析（S₄zT 对称性）确认交变磁基态；通过施加单轴应变（uniaxial strain modulation）和改变堆叠构型（stacking configuration）来研究物理性质的变化。

papers.title: Dynamic scaling and Family-Vicsek universality in the Hubbard model at infinite temperature
papers.abstract: We study Family-Vicsek scaling of charge, spin, and energy fluctuations in the one-dimensional Hubbard model at infinite temperature. Using a quantum generating function approach, we compute time-dependent cumulants of transferred conserved quantities and analyze how the corresponding roughness depends on subsystem size and time. We start by focusing on a single interface at half the chain and determine the transport exponents. Then we turn to fluctuations of a small finite interval and study the Family-Vicsek universality of fluctuations over an extended timescale. We find that the long-time scaling behavior is controlled by integrability. In the free limit, charge, spin, and energy all display ballistic transport. In the interacting integrable Hubbard chain, charge and spin cross over to a KPZ scaling regime, while the energy sector remains ballistic. Once integrability is broken by a next-nearest-neighbor density interaction, the long-time dynamics becomes diffusive in all sectors. In every case we also observe a short-time microscopic regime with apparently universal ballistic growth before the hydrodynamic scaling window sets in. The Family-Vicsek setup allows us to determine the growth, the saturation as well as the dynamical exponents.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：quantum generating function approach、scaling、universality。；研究对象：无限温度下一维Hubbard模型中的电荷、自旋和能量涨落，以及其Family-Vicsek标度行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无限温度下，一维Hubbard模型的长时间标度行为受可积性控制：自由极限下所有扇区均为弹道输运；可积相互作用下电荷和自旋交叉到KPZ标度区，而能量仍为弹道输运；破坏可积性后所有扇区变为扩散输运。所有情况下均存在一个短时微观弹道增长区。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无限温度下，一维Hubbard模型的长时间标度行为受可积性控制：自由极限下所有扇区均为弹道输运；可积相互作用下电荷和自旋交叉到KPZ标度区，而能量仍为弹道输运；破坏可积性后所有扇区变为扩散输运。所有情况下均存在一个短时微观弹道增长区。；创新点：将Family-Vicsek标度框架系统应用于无限温度下Hubbard模型的电荷、自旋和能量涨落，揭示了可积性对输运标度行为的控制作用，并区分了短时微观弹道增长与长时流体动力学标度窗口。
papers.method_zh: 采用量子生成函数方法计算转移守恒量的时间依赖累积量，分析粗糙度随子系统大小和时间的依赖关系，并提取生长、饱和及动力学指数。

papers.title: Precipitate phase selection and grain boundary morphology in Cu-Ni-Si-Mn alloys: A machine-learning interatomic potential study
papers.abstract: Alloys inevitably contain interphase boundaries, whose energetics govern nucleation processes and precipitate morphology. In Cu-Ni-Si alloys, Mn addition markedly changes grain boundary (GB) precipitation behavior. While GB precipitation of stable Ni$_2$Si in Mn-free alloys is associated with degraded mechanical properties, Mn addition instead promotes film-shaped Mn$_6$Ni$_{16}$Si$_7$ (G-phase) precipitation, which is correlated improved mechanical properties. However, the atomic origin of the contrasting GB phase selection and morphology remains unclear. Here we perform machine-learning interatomic potential (MLIP) calculations to investigate the effect of interphase-boundary atomic structure on GB precipitates in Cu-Ni-Si alloys with and without Mn. The MLIP calculations reliably reproduce DFT-level energetics for interfacial bonding and microstructural configurations, and further predict that Mn addition favors GB precipitation of Mn$_6$Ni$_{16}$Si$_7$ rather than Ni$_2$Si. Experimentally, Mn-free alloys are observed to exhibit irregularly-shaped Ni$_2$Si precipitates with open-boundary-like Cu/Ni$_2$Si interfaces, whereas Mn-added alloys exhibit film-like G-phase at GBs. Large-scale atomistic interface calculations reveal that the coherent interface structure between Cu and Ni$_2$Si favors the formation of plate-like strained Ni$_2$Si precipitates in the matrix. Upon coarsening and stress release, an out-of-phase coherent-like interface can form at GBs, generating a local repulsive region that gives rise to surface-like open-boundary structures and explains the irregular morphology of GB stable Ni$_2$Si precipitates. In contrast, Cu/Mn$_6$Ni$_{16}$Si$_7$ interfaces remain predominantly incoherent with moderate boundary energies and no pronounced repulsive regime, thereby stabilizing continuous interfacial contact and explaining film-shaped GB precipitation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：machine-learning interatomic potential (MLIP) calculations、atomistic interface calculations、DFT-level energetics。；研究对象：Cu-Ni-Si-Mn合金中晶界析出相的相选择与形貌，具体涉及Mn元素添加对Ni₂Si与Mn₆Ni₁₆Si₇（G相）析出行为的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Mn添加有利于晶界析出Mn₆Ni₁₆Si₇（G相）而非Ni₂Si；Cu/Ni₂Si界面形成相干结构导致局部排斥区，从而产生不规则形貌，而Cu/Mn₆Ni₁₆Si₇界面以非相干结构为主，边界能适中，有利于形成连续薄膜状析出相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Mn添加有利于晶界析出Mn₆Ni₁₆Si₇（G相）而非Ni₂Si；Cu/Ni₂Si界面形成相干结构导致局部排斥区，从而产生不规则形貌，而Cu/Mn₆Ni₁₆Si₇界面以非相干结构为主，边界能适中，有利于形成连续薄膜状析出相。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 机器学习原子间势（MLIP）计算，结合大规模原子尺度界面模拟，并利用DFT级精度验证界面键合与微观结构构型的能量。

papers.title: Superconducting diode effect in magnetic superconductors realized by nonreciprocal domain-wall dynamics
papers.abstract: A superconducting diode effect is shown to arise in ferromagnetic superconductors through the nonreciprocal dynamics of magnetic domain walls. Specifically, we show that current-driven dynamics of a magnetic domain wall under a certain external field can exhibit a nonreciprocal Walker breakdown, possessing two distinct direction-dependent critical currents beyond which the domain wall precesses continuously. In ferromagnetic superconductors, the constant rotation of a domain wall is shown to give rise to phase slips, opening up dissipation channels, whereby the nonreciprocal Walker breakdown is mapped to the superconducting diode effect. For the nonreciprocal Walker breakdown of a magnetic domain wall, we analytically examine its dependence on the magnetic field and the Gilbert damping and verify the theoretical results with micromagnetic simulations. We then extend the analysis to ferromagnetic superconductors by considering additional effects from the superconductivity and identify criteria for experimental conditions to realize the predicted superconducting diode effect. Our work demonstrates that topological defects, such as domain walls, in magnetic superconductors can serve as an intrinsic nanoscale platform for nonlinear nonreciprocal superconducting functionalities within a single homogeneous material, circumventing the need for complicated engineered heterostructures and thereby enabling the miniaturization of superconducting devices down to the nanometer scale that is challenging to achieve with conventional Josephson junctions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟）。判断依据：关键词“analytically examine”、“micromagnetic simulations”、“extend the analysis”。；研究对象：铁磁超导体中磁畴壁的非互易动力学及其导致的超导二极管效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在铁磁超导体中，磁畴壁在外场驱动下的非互易Walker击穿（具有两个方向依赖的临界电流）可映射为超导二极管效应，从而在单一均匀材料中实现非互易超导功能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在铁磁超导体中，磁畴壁在外场驱动下的非互易Walker击穿（具有两个方向依赖的临界电流）可映射为超导二极管效应，从而在单一均匀材料中实现非互易超导功能。；创新点：提出利用磁超导体中固有的拓扑缺陷（如畴壁）作为内在纳米尺度平台，实现无需复杂人工异质结的非线性非互易超导功能，有望将超导器件微型化至传统约瑟夫森结难以达到的纳米尺度。
papers.method_zh: 解析分析（考察磁场和Gilbert阻尼对非互易Walker击穿的影响）结合微磁学模拟（验证理论结果），并进一步考虑超导电性带来的额外效应以确定实验条件。

papers.title: Valley Engineering in Bilayer WSe$_2$ Gate-All-Around Transistors
papers.abstract: In bilayer WSe$_2$, interlayer coupling reduces the K--$Γ$ valley splitting to $Δ_{KΓ} \approx k_BT$ at room temperature, placing two hole-transport channels of markedly different effective mass in near-thermal equilibrium. We combine density functional theory (DFT) with spin--orbit coupling and an analytical two-valley device model to quantify how this near-degeneracy governs hole transport in gate-all-around (GAA) field-effect transistors. Three main results are obtained: (i)~the subthreshold swing is protected near $60$~mV~dec$^{-1}$ by quantum-capacitance screening independently of layer number; (ii)~the effective mobility is set by the K-to-$Γ$ valley occupation ratio and decreases monotonically with layer number; and (iii)~in the bilayer, compressive biaxial strain \emph{simultaneously} enhances the on-current, suppresses the off-current, and improves the on/off ratio from ${\approx}69$ to ${\approx}156$, while the subthreshold swing remains near the thermionic limit. This decoupling of on-state performance from switching slope is inaccessible through conventional mobility engineering and establishes a concrete design principle: \emph{valley-engineering sensitivity is maximized when $Δ_{KΓ} \approx k_BT$}, the condition most naturally satisfied by bilayer WSe$_2$ at room temperature and zero strain, making it the optimal channel for valley-engineered GAA transistors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。判断依据：结合密度泛函理论（DFT）与自旋-轨道耦合计算，以及解析的两谷器件模型。；研究对象：双层WSe₂中的谷工程，具体研究其在全环绕栅极（GAA）场效应晶体管中的空穴输运行为，重点关注K谷与Γ谷之间的能级分裂及其对器件性能的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当K-Γ谷分裂Δ_{KΓ} ≈ k_BT（室温下）时，谷工程灵敏度最大化，双层WSe₂天然满足此条件，可同时提升导通电流、抑制关断电流并改善开关比，同时保持亚阈值摆幅接近热离子极限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当K-Γ谷分裂Δ_{KΓ} ≈ k_BT（室温下）时，谷工程灵敏度最大化，双层WSe₂天然满足此条件，可同时提升导通电流、抑制关断电流并改善开关比，同时保持亚阈值摆幅接近热离子极限。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体差异，但核心新意在于：提出当Δ_{KΓ} ≈ k_BT时谷工程灵敏度最大化的设计原则，并证明双层WSe₂在零应变下天然满足此条件，从而将导通性能与开关斜率解耦，超越了传统迁移率工程。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）结合自旋-轨道耦合，以及解析的两谷器件模型。

papers.title: Chemical tuning of magnetic ordering and cryogenic magnetocaloric response in zircon-type Gd1-xErxVO4
papers.abstract: Chemical substitution offers an effective route to tune magnetic ordering and magnetocaloric performance in rare-earth oxides for cryogenic refrigeration. Here we investigate the structural evo lution, magnetic properties, and magnetocaloric effect of polycrystalline zircon-type Gd1-xErxVO4 (x=0, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, and 0.75). Powder X-ray diffraction confirms that all samples crystallize in the tetragonal zircon structure without detectable impurity phases. Substitution of Gd3+ by the smaller Er3+ ion produces a systematic lattice contraction and modifies the magnetic behavior of the rare-earth sublattice. In particular, the magnetic ordering temperature is suppressed from 3.65(2) K in GdVO4 to 2.76(2) K in Gd0.9Er0.1VO4 , accompanied by a weakening of the spin-flop-like field-induced anomaly observed in the parent compound. A low Er concentration correspondingly improves the low-temperature magnetocaloric performance, with Gd0.9Er0.1VO4 exhibiting a max imum magnetic entropy change of 45.1 J kg-1 K-1 for mu_0 Delta H=7T. These results demonstrate that weak Er substitution effectively tunes the competition among exchange interactions, dipolar coupling, and magnetic anisotropy, optimizing the balance between magnetic ordering and available spin entropy in zircon-type rare-earth vanadates, which is crucial for developing efficient cryogenic refrigeration materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Powder X-ray diffraction confirms”“investigate the structural evolution, magnetic properties, and magnetocaloric effect”，涉及样品制备、结构表征和物性测量。；研究对象：锆石型稀土钒酸盐固溶体Gd₁₋ₓErₓVO₄（x=0, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75）的磁有序和低温磁热效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过少量Er³⁺替代Gd³⁺，可有效抑制磁有序温度（从3.65 K降至2.76 K）并削弱自旋翻转场致异常，同时优化低温磁热性能，其中Gd₀.₉Er₀.₁VO₄在7 T磁场下最大磁熵变达45.1 J kg⁻¹ K⁻¹。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过少量Er³⁺替代Gd³⁺，可有效抑制磁有序温度（从3.65 K降至2.76 K）并削弱自旋翻转场致异常，同时优化低温磁热性能，其中Gd₀.₉Er₀.₁VO₄在7 T磁场下最大磁熵变达45.1 J kg⁻¹ K⁻¹。；创新点：系统揭示了弱Er替代对锆石型稀土钒酸盐中交换相互作用、偶极耦合和磁各向异性之间竞争的调控作用，为优化低温制冷材料的磁有序与自旋熵平衡提供了化学调控途径。
papers.method_zh: 采用多晶样品合成、粉末X射线衍射（PXRD）进行结构表征，通过磁化率、磁化强度等测量研究磁性质和磁热效应。

papers.title: Local electronic structure and dynamics of hydrogen in $\text{CeO}_2$
papers.abstract: The local electronic states of muon (Mu) as an isotope of hydrogen (H) in high-quality single-crystalline ceria (CeO$_2$) are investigated using muon spin rotation/relaxation ($μ\text{SR}$) and first-principles density functional theory (DFT) calculations. Upon positive muon implantation, both paramagnetic (Mu$^0$) and diamagnetic (Mu$^*$) states are observed below $\approx$10 K. Magnetic field dependence of the Mu$^0$ signals combined with DFT results provides evidence for the formation of a polaron state, consisting of Mu bonded to a ligand oxygen and a $4f$ electron localized on a nearby Ce site. The crystal-orientation dependence of the Mu$^0$ signal suggests strong anisotropy of the $4f$ electron due to the spin-orbit coupling with lifted degeneracy. Furthermore, the Mu$^0$ state exhibits transition to the Mu$^*$ state that corresponds to another Mu$^0$ state (exhibiting a diamagnetic response due to fast spin/charge fluctuations) at temperatures above $\approx$10 K, before disappearing above $\approx$30 K. These findings suggest rapid diffusive motion of the $4f$ electrons and/or Mu (as well as H) at higher temperatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。关键词：muon spin rotation/relaxation (μSR)、first-principles density functional theory (DFT) calculations。；研究对象：氢（H）在二氧化铈（CeO₂）单晶中的局域电子结构与动力学行为，以正μ子（Mu）作为氢的同位素探针。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在低温（≈10 K以下）观测到两种μ子态：顺磁态（Mu⁰）和抗磁态（Mu*）。Mu⁰态由μ子与配位氧成键并在邻近Ce位点局域化一个4f电子形成极化子，且该4f电子因自旋-轨道耦合呈现强各向异性。温度升高后，Mu⁰态转变为另一种表现为抗磁响应的Mu⁰态（Mu*），并在约30 K以上消失，表明4f电子和/或μ子（及氢）在高温下发生快速扩散运动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在低温（≈10 K以下）观测到两种μ子态：顺磁态（Mu⁰）和抗磁态（Mu*）。Mu⁰态由μ子与配位氧成键并在邻近Ce位点局域化一个4f电子形成极化子，且该4f电子因自旋-轨道耦合呈现强各向异性。温度升高后，Mu⁰态转变为另一种表现为抗磁响应的Mu⁰态（Mu*），并在约30 K以上消失，表明4f电子和/或μ子（及氢）在高温下发生快速扩散运动。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用μ子自旋旋转/弛豫（μSR）技术，并结合第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算进行电子结构分析。

papers.title: Topological invariant responsible for the integer QHE and non-commutative geometry
papers.abstract: We consider a wide class of $2D$ tight - binding models of solid state physics. These models are, in the most general case, non - homogeneous. The topological invariant ${\cal N}_3$ responsible for the quantization of the Hall conductivity, for the specific case of the integer quantum Hall effect in $2D$, is expressed through the Wigner transformation of the two-point electron Matsubara Green function. We express this invariant as a pairing of the element of the $K^{-1}$ group (generated by the Green function) with the specific element of the cyclic cohomology group $HC^3$. According to a set of local index theorems the values of ${\cal N}_3$ can be shown to be integer for a limited class of tight - binding models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：拓扑不变量、非对易几何、K理论、循环上同调、局域指标定理。；研究对象：二维紧束缚模型体系，特别是非均匀的固体物理模型，以及整数量子霍尔效应（IQHE）中的霍尔电导量子化现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文将负责整数量子霍尔效应中霍尔电导量子化的拓扑不变量 \( \mathcal{N}_3 \) 通过电子马祖巴格林函数的Wigner变换表达出来，并证明该不变量是K^{-1}群元素与循环上同调群 \( HC^3 \) 中特定元素的配对，且对于一类紧束缚模型，该不变量为整数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文将负责整数量子霍尔效应中霍尔电导量子化的拓扑不变量 \( \mathcal{N}_3 \) 通过电子马祖巴格林函数的Wigner变换表达出来，并证明该不变量是K^{-1}群元素与循环上同调群 \( HC^3 \) 中特定元素的配对，且对于一类紧束缚模型，该不变量为整数。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用非对易几何框架，具体运用了Wigner变换、K理论（K^{-1}群）、循环上同调（\( HC^3 \)）以及局域指标定理等数学工具，从理论上分析格林函数的拓扑性质。

papers.title: Time Evolution of Heat Conduction in a Generalized Model of Brownian Motion
papers.abstract: We investigate the properties of heat conduction in a network of harmonic oscillators interacting with heat baths, described by a generalized model of Brownian motion. This model includes noise and dissipation terms in both the momentum and position equations. This generalization is motivated by the requirement of consistency with the Gorini-Kossakowski-Sudarshan-Lindblad (GKSL) equation. Because standard definitions of heat current based on velocity become mathematically inconsistent in this framework, we derive an analytical expression for the steady-state heat flow based on an extended framework of stochastic energetics. We confirm that Fourier's law (linear thermal response) is satisfied and that the model naturally captures microscopic thermal boundary resistance, analogous to Kapitza resistance. This demonstrates that our generalized model functions as a valid phenomenological framework for simulating non-equilibrium processes, marking a crucial step toward a unified formulation of stochastic and quantum thermodynamics. Furthermore, we analyze the time evolution of heat conduction by numerically solving the corresponding differential equations for the correlation functions. Unlike standard Brownian motion, the generalized model generates continuous and nowhere differentiable trajectories for both momentum and position (as is characteristic of overdamped dynamics). Finally, we show that the heat current exhibits characteristic transient behavior when the inter-particle interaction is switched on. Specifically, an instantaneous heat flow emerges, whose direction is strictly governed by whether the interaction is attractive or repulsive, significantly differing from the predictions of the standard model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：generalized model、analytical expression、numerically solving、stochastic energetics。；研究对象：谐振子网络中的热传导现象，具体为广义布朗运动模型下的热流时间演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该广义模型满足傅里叶定律，自然捕捉到微观热边界电阻（类似卡皮查热阻），且当粒子间相互作用开启时，热流表现出由相互作用吸引/排斥性严格决定的瞬时方向性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该广义模型满足傅里叶定律，自然捕捉到微观热边界电阻（类似卡皮查热阻），且当粒子间相互作用开启时，热流表现出由相互作用吸引/排斥性严格决定的瞬时方向性。；创新点：提出了与GKSL方程一致的广义布朗运动模型（在动量和位置方程中均包含噪声与耗散项），并在此框架下解决了标准速度定义热流导致的数学不一致问题，揭示了与标准模型显著不同的瞬时热流方向行为。
papers.method_zh: 基于随机能量学扩展框架推导稳态热流解析表达式；通过数值求解相关函数的微分方程分析热传导的时间演化。

papers.title: Chiral Surface Phonons
papers.abstract: We use symmetry arguments combined with density functional theory to demonstrate that all surfaces of crystalline materials host surface phonons that are chiral. As model system, we study slabs of highly symmetric AB rocksalt compounds, and find surface-localized phonons whose atomic displacements exhibit chiral motion. We further show that these chiral surface phonons generate sheets of in-plane magnetism at the surface. Our results reveal that chiral phonons can emerge in all crystalline materials as a result of reduced symmetry at surfaces or interfaces. These findings establish surfaces as a previously overlooked source of chiral phonons and their associated magnetic moments, which could play a role in a broad range of surface-sensitive measurements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。判断依据：使用对称性论证（symmetry arguments）结合密度泛函理论（density functional theory）进行研究。；研究对象：晶体材料表面的手性声子（chiral surface phonons），以高对称性AB型岩盐结构化合物（AB rocksalt compounds）的薄板（slabs）作为模型体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 所有晶体材料的表面都存在手性表面声子，这些声子的原子位移呈现手性运动，并且会在表面产生面内磁性（in-plane magnetism）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：所有晶体材料的表面都存在手性表面声子，这些声子的原子位移呈现手性运动，并且会在表面产生面内磁性（in-plane magnetism）。；创新点：揭示了表面或界面因对称性降低而成为此前被忽视的手性声子及其关联磁矩的来源，表明手性声子可在所有晶体材料中普遍存在。
papers.method_zh: 对称性分析（symmetry arguments）结合密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，以AB型岩盐结构化合物的薄板为模型系统进行模拟。

papers.title: Predictable Mean-Field Chaos in Random Recurrent Networks
papers.abstract: Dynamical mean-field theory recasts deterministic chaos in random recurrent networks as an effective stochastic process. We show that for analytic nonlinearities with sufficiently fast Fourier decay, this stochasticity is only apparent: the continuous past of a realized mean-field trajectory uniquely determines its future. The mean-field theory is therefore not merely an ensemble description, but a conditional prediction theory for individual trajectories. Unfolding the power spectrum into a Krylov state space exposes how this latent determinism is organized across an infinite hierarchy of temporal modes. The associated Krylov growth rate sets the complexity of finite-resolution prediction and upper-bounds the largest Lyapunov exponent in this class of networks. Thus, microscopic sensitivity and predictive complexity are distinct aspects of mean-field chaos. Our results extend Krylov growth ideas developed for Hamiltonian chaotic dynamics to classical dissipative systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“dynamical mean-field theory”“Krylov state space”“Lyapunov exponent”等理论框架和概念，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：随机循环网络（random recurrent networks）中的确定性混沌现象，属于经典耗散系统的动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于具有足够快傅里叶衰减的解析非线性函数，随机循环网络中的平均场混沌实际上是确定性的：一条已实现平均场轨迹的连续过去唯一决定了其未来。因此，平均场理论不仅是系综描述，更是对单个轨迹的条件预测理论。
