papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于具有足够快傅里叶衰减的解析非线性函数，随机循环网络中的平均场混沌实际上是确定性的：一条已实现平均场轨迹的连续过去唯一决定了其未来。因此，平均场理论不仅是系综描述，更是对单个轨迹的条件预测理论。；创新点：将原本用于哈密顿混沌动力学的Krylov增长思想推广到经典耗散系统，并揭示了微观敏感性与预测复杂度是平均场混沌的两个不同方面。摘要未突出说明与已有随机循环网络研究的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 动力学平均场理论（dynamical mean-field theory）；将功率谱展开到Krylov态空间（Krylov state space）以揭示时间模态的层级结构；利用Krylov增长速率（Krylov growth rate）分析有限分辨率预测的复杂度，并与最大Lyapunov指数建立上界关系。

papers.title: Fluctuation-stable generalized entropy probes of spectral heterogeneity
papers.abstract: Generalized entropy measures are widely used to characterize localization and multifractality, and the regime \(q>1\) is often empirically found to exhibit improved numerical stability and cleaner scaling behavior. Here, we develop a fluctuation-stability framework for generalized entropy diagnostics and show that weak-amplitude spectral fluctuations are amplified for \(q<1\) and suppressed for \(q>1\), thereby providing a theoretical basis for the physically robust \(q>1\) regime. A thermodynamic scaling analysis further identifies an asymptotically stable regime beyond a critical threshold. As an application, we introduce the entropy-gradient susceptibility \(χ_q\) as a coarse-grained probe of spectral heterogeneity. Using the Aubry-André and generalized Aubry-André models, we demonstrate that \(χ_q\) sharply distinguishes homogeneous localization transitions from mobility-edge coexistence regimes. Our results establish fluctuation stability as a guiding principle for generalized entropy diagnostics in quasiperiodic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：develop a fluctuation-stability framework、thermodynamic scaling analysis、introduce the entropy-gradient susceptibility）；研究对象：准周期系统中的广义熵诊断方法，具体以Aubry-André模型和广义Aubry-André模型为例，研究谱异质性（spectral heterogeneity）的探测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 弱振幅谱涨落在q<1时被放大、在q>1时被抑制，从而为广义熵诊断中q>1区间的物理稳健性提供了理论基础；引入的熵梯度磁化率χ_q能清晰区分均匀局域化转变与迁移率边共存区。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：弱振幅谱涨落在q<1时被放大、在q>1时被抑制，从而为广义熵诊断中q>1区间的物理稳健性提供了理论基础；引入的熵梯度磁化率χ_q能清晰区分均匀局域化转变与迁移率边共存区。；创新点：首次从涨落稳定性角度为广义熵诊断中q>1区间的优越性提供理论依据，并提出了熵梯度磁化率χ_q作为谱异质性的粗粒化探针。
papers.method_zh: 发展了一个涨落稳定性理论框架，结合热力学标度分析，并利用Aubry-André模型和广义Aubry-André模型进行数值演示。

papers.title: Energy Barriers for Reversible Chain Scission and Healing under Tension with Displacement Control
papers.abstract: Polymer chain scission is a key mechanism for fracture of soft materials. It is well known from single-molecule force spectroscopy experiments that the critical condition for chain scission depends on the loading rate and other environmental effects (e.g., temperature and solvent). Common approaches to describing the kinetics of chain scission often assume force-controlled conditions, that is, when a polymer chain is stretched by a prescribed force. As a result of this assumption, chain scission is irreversible, excluding the possibility of healing. In many soft materials, however, self-healing has been observed after fracture, suggesting possibly reversible chain scission. Here, we show that reversible chain scission is possible under displacement-controlled conditions, that is, when a polymer chain is stretched with a prescribed end-to-end distance. We present a breakable freely-jointed chain model, assuming that a polymer chain breaks when one of its links breaks while the other links remain nearly rigid. At a prescribed end-to-end distance, the free energy of the chain has two local minima and a local maximum (the transition state), giving rise to energy barriers for chain scission and healing. As the prescribed displacement increases, the energy barrier decreases for scission but increases for healing, depending on the chain length (number of links) and the potential energy of the link. With the energy barriers, we adopt a kinetic approach to predict the statistics and kinetics of a single polymer chain under tension, first by integrating the rate equation and then by kinetic Monte Carlo simulations. Notably, the present model predicts rate-dependent chain scission, with a lower bound for the rupture force that could be several orders of magnitude lower than the upper bound (which is close to the theoretical strength of the covalent bonds).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“提出模型”“采用动力学方法”“进行动力学蒙特卡洛模拟”，属于理论建模与计算分析。；研究对象：聚合物链在拉伸条件下的可逆断裂与自愈合行为，具体为位移控制（而非力控制）下聚合物链的断裂与愈合能垒。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在位移控制条件下，聚合物链的断裂是可逆的，存在断裂与愈合两个能垒；断裂力具有速率依赖性，其下限可能比上限低数个数量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在位移控制条件下，聚合物链的断裂是可逆的，存在断裂与愈合两个能垒；断裂力具有速率依赖性，其下限可能比上限低数个数量级。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 提出了可断裂的自由连接链模型，假设链断裂发生在某一键上而其他键保持刚性；通过自由能景观分析得到两个局部极小值和一个过渡态（局部极大值），从而定义断裂与愈合的能垒；采用速率方程积分和动力学蒙特卡洛模拟预测单链在拉伸下的统计与动力学行为。

papers.title: Chiral-Angle-Controlled Altermagnetic Spin Splitting in Nanotubes
papers.abstract: Altermagnets exhibit momentum-dependent spin splitting despite having zero net magnetization. Here, we show that rolling a two-dimensional (2D) $d$-wave altermagnet into a nanotube transforms this momentum-dependent spin splitting into chiral-angle-controlled one-dimensional (1D) spin splitting through dimensional projection. Using a minimal tight-binding model and first-principles calculations, we demonstrate that the nanotube spin splitting follows a characteristic $\cos(2θ)$ dependence, vanishing for nodal orientations and reaching extrema for antinodal orientations. The mechanism remains robust across a broad class of nanotubes derived from 2D altermagnets. Our results establish dimensional projection as a general route for transferring momentum-dependent altermagnetic spin splitting into 1D systems and provide a framework for engineering spin-split quantum states in low-dimensional magnetic materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：tight-binding model, first-principles calculations。；研究对象：将二维d波交变磁体卷曲成纳米管后，其动量依赖的自旋劈裂转化为手性角依赖的一维自旋劈裂现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 纳米管中的自旋劈裂遵循特征性的cos(2θ)依赖关系，在节线方向消失，在反节线方向达到极值，且该机制在多种二维交变磁体衍生的纳米管中普遍成立。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：纳米管中的自旋劈裂遵循特征性的cos(2θ)依赖关系，在节线方向消失，在反节线方向达到极值，且该机制在多种二维交变磁体衍生的纳米管中普遍成立。；创新点：提出“维度投影”（dimensional projection）作为一种通用途径，将动量依赖的交变磁自旋劈裂转移到一维系统中，为在低维磁性材料中工程化自旋劈裂量子态提供了框架。
papers.method_zh: 采用最小紧束缚模型和第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）进行理论分析与数值模拟。

papers.title: Wave Resistance for Stochastic Motion at Interfaces
papers.abstract: Wave resistance is the drag generated by the wave radiation that a source moving at a fluid interface sustains. Under stochastic trajectories, the mean drag is controlled by the ensemble-averaged surface profile built from the trajectory history. We show that the result is a finite resistance below the deterministic radiation threshold and a regularization of the singular response at the minimum phase velocity of the capillary-gravity waves. We derive explicit scaling laws for drifted Brownian trajectories, including a universal high-diffusivity decay. For drifted Lévy flight, we find the mean wave resistance in closed-form, extending wave-drag theory to non-Gaussian trajectories.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“We show”“We derive”“We find”等理论推导表述，涉及解析标度律和闭式解，无实验或计算模拟描述。；研究对象：流体界面（如毛细-重力波）上随机运动物体所受的波阻（wave resistance）现象，具体研究布朗运动与Lévy飞行等随机轨迹下的平均阻力行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在随机运动轨迹下，波阻在确定性辐射阈值以下仍为有限值，且在毛细-重力波最小相速度处的奇异响应被正则化。对于漂移布朗运动，推导出普适的高扩散率衰减标度律；对于漂移Lévy飞行，得到了平均波阻的闭式解，将波阻理论推广至非高斯轨迹。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在随机运动轨迹下，波阻在确定性辐射阈值以下仍为有限值，且在毛细-重力波最小相速度处的奇异响应被正则化。对于漂移布朗运动，推导出普适的高扩散率衰减标度律；对于漂移Lévy飞行，得到了平均波阻的闭式解，将波阻理论推广至非高斯轨迹。；创新点：首次将波阻理论从确定性运动扩展至随机（非高斯）轨迹，揭示了随机性对波阻的有限化与正则化效应，并给出了普适的扩散衰减行为。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于随机轨迹历史构建系综平均表面轮廓，通过解析推导获得平均波阻的标度律与闭式解。具体针对漂移布朗运动与漂移Lévy飞行两种随机过程。

papers.title: Ultracold Amplification Proposal for Parity Violation in Chiral Molecules
papers.abstract: We propose a theoretical mechanism to indirectly detect the small parity-violating energy difference (PVED) between chiral enantiomers through a macroscopic enantiomeric excess observed in an ultracold gas. We consider that chiral molecules are formed resonantly via ultracold collisions of achiral diatomic molecules, with PVED inducing a slight asymmetry in the resonance energies of right- and left-handed configurations. After formation, chiral molecules evolve within a Bose-Einstein condensate (BEC), incorporating nonlinear interactions, tunneling between enantiomeric states, intrinsic PVED, and thermal conversion rates. These collective dynamics enable amplification of the microscopic bias into a global population imbalance. Using coupled rate equations, we show that, under realistic regimes, a complete enantiomeric excess can be achieved even for extremely small intrinsic asymmetries. We illustrate the model with concrete examples (HSOH, H$_2$Se$_2$, H$_2$Te$_2$), predicting observable enantiomeric excesses under plausible experimental conditions. We also consider non-PVED effects that could be amplified under the proposed mechanism, including electric and magnetic fields as well as thermal fluctuations, the latter being illustrated through the aforementioned molecular examples. Overall, our results suggest that ultracold physics could provide a new pathway to probe molecular parity violation, a fundamental weak effect that remains experimentally undetected.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose a theoretical mechanism、coupled rate equations、theoretical model。；研究对象：手性分子（chiral molecules）中由弱相互作用导致的宇称破缺能量差（PVED），以及超冷气体中手性对映体的宏观富集现象。具体分子示例包括HSOH、H₂Se₂、H₂Te₂。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种理论机制，通过超冷气体中手性分子的集体动力学（包括非线性相互作用、隧穿、宇称破缺能量差和热转换率），可将极微小的宇称破缺能量差放大为宏观的对映体过量，甚至实现完全的手性富集。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种理论机制，通过超冷气体中手性分子的集体动力学（包括非线性相互作用、隧穿、宇称破缺能量差和热转换率），可将极微小的宇称破缺能量差放大为宏观的对映体过量，甚至实现完全的手性富集。；创新点：提出利用超冷物理（如BEC）作为新途径，间接探测尚未被实验观测到的手性分子宇称破缺效应，通过集体动力学放大微观不对称性至宏观可观测水平。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与数值计算。具体采用耦合速率方程（coupled rate equations）描述手性分子在玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC）中的演化，并考虑非线性相互作用、对映体态间隧穿、本征宇称破缺能量差以及热转换率。

papers.title: Statistical Mechanics of Random Matrices
papers.abstract: These lecture notes are based on the lectures on \emph{Statistical Mechanics of Random Matrices} delivered at the Spring College on the Physics of Complex Systems, held at the Abdus Salam International Centre for Theoretical Physics, Trieste, Italy, from 19 February to 15 March 2024. Their aim is to present a statistical-mechanics route to the spectral theory of sparse and diluted random matrices, with emphasis on cavity and replica methods, resolvent techniques, population dynamics, typical spectral densities, spectral-count fluctuations and large deviations, conditioned spectra, and non-Hermitian extensions. The written form of the notes has been deliberately expanded beyond the material actually covered during the lectures. This is partly because a set of lecture notes can afford a more systematic development than a sequence of blackboard lectures, and partly because several natural continuations of the material become clearer once the central methods have been introduced. Consequently, not every topic discussed here was presented during the College. The additional material is included to give a more coherent account of the subject and to indicate directions that, hopefully, can be covered in greater detail in future lectures or schools. Since these are lecture notes rather than a state-of-the-art review, the choice of topics is necessarily selective and is naturally tilted towards the author's own work and collaborations on this subject. I have nevertheless tried, within the limits of this format, to place the material in contact with the broader literature and to represent the surrounding state of the art as fairly as possible. Inevitably, some relevant contributions may be missing or treated too briefly; such omissions are unintentional and reflect the pedagogical scope of the notes rather than a judgement on their importance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确说明是“lecture notes”（讲义），内容聚焦于“statistical-mechanics route”（统计力学路径）、“cavity and replica methods”（空腔法与复制法）等理论方法，且强调“pedagogical scope”（教学范围）而非实验或计算。；研究对象：稀疏与稀释随机矩阵的谱理论（spectral theory of sparse and diluted random matrices），具体包括典型谱密度、谱计数涨落与大偏差、条件谱、非厄米扩展等物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确给出单一物理结论，而是旨在通过统计力学方法（空腔法、复制法、解析技术等）系统阐述稀疏随机矩阵的谱性质，并展示该领域与更广泛文献的联系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确给出单一物理结论，而是旨在通过统计力学方法（空腔法、复制法、解析技术等）系统阐述稀疏随机矩阵的谱性质，并展示该领域与更广泛文献的联系。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。该讲义的主要特色在于以教学为导向，系统整合了作者自身与合作者的工作，并尝试在有限篇幅内与更广泛的文献及当前研究现状建立联系。
papers.method_zh: 统计力学方法，具体包括：空腔法（cavity method）、复制法（replica method）、解析技术（resolvent techniques）、种群动力学（population dynamics）。这些方法用于分析典型谱密度、谱计数涨落、大偏差及条件谱等。

papers.title: Discovering and decoding latent mean-field structure with variational autoencoders
papers.abstract: Generative models are increasingly used to capture correlations in many-body systems, but the representations they learn remain largely opaque to physical interpretation. Here, we establish an intuitive criterion that quantifies the capacity of a variational autoencoder (VAE) to faithfully reconstruct the joint probability distribution of a many body system. In a nutshell, a bound on the VAE capacity is obtained by comparing the rate of the latent channel to the bipartite mutual information of the data. Using this bound, we show that the conditionally independent decoder of any successful VAE is structurally identical to a finite-size mean-field factorization. Hence, a successful reconstruction is direct evidence for a latent mean-field theory and the microscopic parameters of that theory can be read off the trained decoder. We validate these conclusions on a hierarchy of solvable models with scalar (Curie-Weiss), vector (Hopfield) and tensor (Maier-Saupe) order parameters, recovering the full Hopfield pattern matrix from equilibrium samples alone. We find that, when applied to Salamander retinal recordings, a two-latent VAE reproduces the population statistics with only two effective collective variables allowing us to recover the `stored patterns' of the neural population and write a generalized Hopfield model which correctly models the experimental data.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要主要讨论变分自编码器（VAE）的容量判据、与平均场分解的结构等价性，以及从解码器读取微观参数的理论框架，属于理论分析。；研究对象：多体系统的联合概率分布，具体包括具有标量（Curie-Weiss）、矢量（Hopfield）和张量（Maier-Saupe）序参量的可解模型，以及视网膜神经群体的实验数据。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 成功训练的变分自编码器（VAE）的条件独立解码器在结构上与有限尺寸平均场分解等价，因此VAE的成功重构直接证明了存在一个潜在的平均场理论，且该理论的微观参数可以从训练后的解码器中直接读取。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：成功训练的变分自编码器（VAE）的条件独立解码器在结构上与有限尺寸平均场分解等价，因此VAE的成功重构直接证明了存在一个潜在的平均场理论，且该理论的微观参数可以从训练后的解码器中直接读取。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：通过比较潜在通道的速率与数据的二分互信息，建立VAE容量的界限；数值验证：在Curie-Weiss、Hopfield和Maier-Saupe等可解模型上验证结论；实验数据分析：将两潜在变量的VAE应用于蝾螈视网膜记录数据，恢复神经群体的“存储模式”并构建广义Hopfield模型。

papers.title: Dynamical cavity method for continuous-time complex systems on sparse random graphs
papers.abstract: Dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT) reduces dense high-dimensional disordered dynamics to a self-consistent effective stochastic process. For sparse and heterogeneous networks, however, local fields contain finitely many strong inputs, so the Gaussian closure mechanisms of dense DMFT need not apply. We develop a continuous-time cavity derivation of sparse-network DMFT at the level of path measures for stochastic dynamics with general pairwise interactions on sparse random graphs. The cavity equations are exact on trees and yield the finite-time thermodynamic description on locally tree-like graphs. They show explicitly how reciprocity changes dynamical closure: fully directed graphs recover the sparse directed path-probability equation, whereas reciprocal or bidirected edges require conditional path kernels driven by the imposed history of the receiving node. Ensemble averaging gives laws over path-probability messages, with barycenters and higher-message moments closing by multilinearity and independence of incoming branches. A causal discrete-time derivation yields the corresponding population-dynamics representation, distinguishing trajectory populations for directed graphs from conditional branch-law or finite-depth tree populations for reciprocal graphs. We also formulate finite-memory numerical closures and test them in an additive-input recurrent neural network specialization. Finally, high-connectivity limits are obtained as projections of the sparse path-measure theory, clarifying when dense drift, noise, and response channels reduce to standard low-dimensional DMFT and when path-level descriptions remain essential.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“cavity derivation”“path measures”“population-dynamics representation”等理论推导术语，未提及实验或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：稀疏随机图上的连续时间复杂动力学系统，具体包括有向图与互易（双向）图上的随机动力学，以及作为特例的加性输入递归神经网络。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在稀疏随机图上，连续时间动力学平均场理论（DMFT）的腔方程在树状图上精确成立，并揭示了互易性如何改变动力学封闭机制：有向图与双向图分别需要不同的路径概率方程和条件路径核。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在稀疏随机图上，连续时间动力学平均场理论（DMFT）的腔方程在树状图上精确成立，并揭示了互易性如何改变动力学封闭机制：有向图与双向图分别需要不同的路径概率方程和条件路径核。；创新点：将稀疏网络DMFT从离散时间推广到连续时间，并在路径测度层次上严格处理了互易边与有向边的不同封闭结构，澄清了高连接极限下何时可约化为标准低维DMFT、何时必须保留路径级描述。
papers.method_zh: 采用连续时间腔方法（dynamical cavity method），在路径测度（path measure）层次上推导稀疏网络DMFT；通过因果离散时间推导得到对应的群体动力学表示；并提出了有限记忆数值封闭方案。

papers.title: Information Entropy Based Crystal Structure Prediction of Chemically Disordered Alloys via Graph Convolutional Neural Networks
papers.abstract: The phase prediction of chemically disordered alloys poses a significant computational challenge due to the combinatorial complexity of such materials. The high-throughput compositional exploration of chemically disordered alloys, including high-entropy alloys, requires an approach to efficiently explore the potential energy landscape of such complex materials. Additionally, a metric to quantify the potential energy landscape explored for phase prediction of the compositions needs to be defined. We propose an information-theoretic approach to phase prediction in chemically disordered alloys in the present work. We demonstrate the applicability of alchemical Monte Carlo sampling using an efficient Graph Convolutional Neural Network-Based machine learning model. We additionally demonstrate the applicability and limitations of the Bond Disproportion Vector (BDV) as a low-computational-cost descriptor and benchmark it against the state-of-the-art Smooth Overlap of Atomic Positions (SOAP) descriptor. We show the applicability of an information entropy-based metric for the phase prediction of binary (CoNi, MoW, FeNi and TaW), ternary (CoCrNi, CrFeNi), quaternary (CoCrFeNi) and quinary ($\mathrm{Al_x(CoCrFeNi)_{1-x}}$) alloys. Information entropy-based phase prediction can be applicable in challenging cases where conventional approaches are not feasible.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“Graph Convolutional Neural Networks”、“Monte Carlo sampling”、“descriptor”等计算与机器学习方法，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：化学无序合金（包括高熵合金）的晶体结构相预测，具体涉及二元（CoNi, MoW, FeNi, TaW）、三元（CoCrNi, CrFeNi）、四元（CoCrFeNi）及五元（Al_x(CoCrFeNi)_{1-x}）合金体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于信息熵的度量方法，可有效用于化学无序合金的相预测，并在传统方法不可行的挑战性案例中具有适用性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于信息熵的度量方法，可有效用于化学无序合金的相预测，并在传统方法不可行的挑战性案例中具有适用性。；创新点：将信息熵概念引入化学无序合金的相预测，并验证了基于图卷积神经网络的炼金术蒙特卡洛采样在该问题中的有效性。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于图卷积神经网络的机器学习模型进行炼金术蒙特卡洛采样；使用键失衡向量（BDV）作为低计算成本描述符，并与当前最先进的平滑重叠原子位置（SOAP）描述符进行基准对比；引入信息熵作为相预测的度量指标。

papers.title: Coexistence of High Temperature Superconductivity and Antiferromagnetic Order in a Cuprate with Multiple Hole Fermi Pockets
papers.abstract: The intricate relationship between high temperature superconductivity and antiferromagnetic order in cuprates, and the fundamental origin of electron pairing remain open questions. By utilizing high-resolution laser-based spatially-resolved angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, we investigate the seven-layer $Bi_{2}Sr_{2}Ca_{6}Cu_{7}O_{18+δ}$ (Bi2267) and identify a cuprate system that consists of multiple hole Fermi pockets. The observed Fermi pockets exhibit pronounced momentum-, temperature- and Fermi surface-dependent energy gaps. Crucially, high temperature superconductivity with a critical temperature ($T_{\mathrm{c}}$) of $\sim$75 K emerges in a system with multiple Fermi pockets and the presence of strong antiferromagnetic order and correlations. In particular, substantial electron pairing is observed along the Fermi pocket with an energy gap up to $\sim$42 meV in lightly-doped CuO$_{2}$ planes ($p\sim$0.05). These findings challenge the conventional understanding of the roles of the nodal and antinodal electronic states in driving high-temperature superconductivity. They show that superconductivity and antiferromagnetism can coexist in a cuprate with multiple Fermi pockets, offering further insights into the pairing mechanism in cuprate superconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用了高分辨率激光基空间分辨角分辨光电子能谱（laser-based spatially-resolved ARPES）进行实验测量。；研究对象：七层铜氧化物超导体 Bi₂Sr₂Ca₆Cu₇O₁₈₊δ（Bi2267），具体研究其多空穴费米口袋、高温超导与反铁磁序共存现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在具有多个空穴费米口袋的铜氧化物体系中，高温超导（临界温度约75 K）与强反铁磁序及关联可以共存；在轻掺杂CuO₂面（掺杂浓度约0.05）的费米口袋上观测到高达约42 meV的显著电子配对能隙。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在具有多个空穴费米口袋的铜氧化物体系中，高温超导（临界温度约75 K）与强反铁磁序及关联可以共存；在轻掺杂CuO₂面（掺杂浓度约0.05）的费米口袋上观测到高达约42 meV的显著电子配对能隙。；创新点：首次在具有多个空穴费米口袋的铜氧化物中明确观测到高温超导与反铁磁序共存，挑战了传统上关于节点和反节点电子态在驱动高温超导中作用的认知。
papers.method_zh: 高分辨率激光基空间分辨角分辨光电子能谱（laser-based spatially-resolved ARPES），用于测量动量、温度和费米面依赖的能隙。

papers.title: Nonperturbative isotope effect on light-matter interaction in boron arsenide
papers.abstract: The interaction of light and matter under strong isotope disorder gives rise to unconventional physics that goes beyond the quantum perturbation theory. In boron arsenide, the large mass difference between the two stable boron isotopes presents a paradigmatic case where perturbation theory fails, yet a unified theoretical framework across the perturbative and nonperturbative regime has remained elusive. Here, we develop a nonperturbative approach to capture isotope-disorder effect in boron arsenide, which fundamentally alters light-matter interactions. We reveal that coherently mixed vibrations between two boron isotopes reshape the dielectric function in the nonperturbative regime. The nonperturbative isotope interactions dictate the properties of coupled surface phonon polaritons and near-field radiative heat transfer. Two-fold tuning of radiative heat flux is achieved by modulating the surface phonon polariton resonance via isotope engineering. This work establishes a unified framework connecting the perturbative and nonperturbative limits, enabling quantitative predictions across weak to strong disorder regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“develop a nonperturbative approach”（发展非微扰方法）、“establishes a unified framework”（建立统一框架），属于理论建模与计算研究。；研究对象：论文研究的具体材料是硼化砷（boron arsenide），具体物理现象是强同位素无序（isotope disorder）对光-物质相互作用（light-matter interaction）的影响，特别是对介电函数、表面声子极化激元（surface phonon polaritons）以及近场辐射热传递（near-field radiative heat transfer）的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在硼化砷中，两种稳定硼同位素之间巨大的质量差导致微扰理论失效，而该工作发展的非微扰方法揭示了同位素无序会从根本上改变光-物质相互作用。通过同位素工程调控表面声子极化激元共振，可以实现辐射热通量的两倍调节。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在硼化砷中，两种稳定硼同位素之间巨大的质量差导致微扰理论失效，而该工作发展的非微扰方法揭示了同位素无序会从根本上改变光-物质相互作用。通过同位素工程调控表面声子极化激元共振，可以实现辐射热通量的两倍调节。；创新点：该工作建立了一个连接微扰与非微扰极限的统一理论框架，使得在从弱到强的整个无序区间内进行定量预测成为可能，解决了此前该领域缺乏统一理论的问题。
papers.method_zh: 该工作发展了一种非微扰（nonperturbative）的理论方法，用于捕捉硼化砷中同位素无序的效应。该方法能够统一描述从弱无序（微扰区）到强无序（非微扰区）的物理行为。

papers.title: Novel 2D Altermagnetic Vanadium Oxide with a Buckled Lieb Structure
papers.abstract: Altermagnetism has recently emerged as a highly promising phase for spintronics, offering the combined advantages of both antiferromagnets and ferromagnets. Here, using a first-principles analysis based on density functional theory (DFT), we identify a monolayer V$_2$O crystal in a buckled Lieb lattice as a promising two-dimensional altermagnetic material. The structural and thermal stability of V$_2$O is verified through calculations of the crystal's formation energy, phonon structure, room-temperature ab initio molecular dynamics, and stiffness matrix. The system is found to exhibit auxetic behavior with a negative Poisson's ratio. Our calculations indicate an antiferromagnetic ground state with a local magnetic moment of $2.79\,μ_{\mathrm{B}}$ per V atom and a magnetocrystalline anisotropy that favors an out-of-plane easy axis. The electronic structure exhibits a momentum-dependent spin splitting of 1.2 eV, which is a characteristic of altermagnets. Inclusion of spin-orbit coupling breaks the symmetry of the quadratic band crossing near the Fermi level, resulting in a large Berry curvature and significant intrinsic spin Hall conductivity around $40\,(\hbar/e)\,\mathrm{S\,cm^{-1}}$. The results demonstrate that monolayer V$_2$O serves as a robust room-temperature altermagnetic platform, exhibiting magnetic anisotropy and spin-dependent transport responses.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的第一性原理分析（first-principles analysis）。；研究对象：单层V₂O晶体，具体为一种具有翘曲Lieb晶格结构的二维交变磁性材料（monolayer V₂O crystal in a buckled Lieb lattice）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单层V₂O是一种稳健的室温交变磁体，具有面外磁各向异性、高达1.2 eV的动量依赖自旋劈裂以及显著的约40 (ℏ/e) S cm⁻¹的本征自旋霍尔电导率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单层V₂O是一种稳健的室温交变磁体，具有面外磁各向异性、高达1.2 eV的动量依赖自旋劈裂以及显著的约40 (ℏ/e) S cm⁻¹的本征自旋霍尔电导率。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容，其创新点在于首次通过第一性原理预测了具有翘曲Lieb结构的单层V₂O是一种二维交变磁性材料，并系统展示了其负泊松比、强磁晶各向异性、大自旋劈裂以及显著的自旋霍尔效应等综合物性。
papers.method_zh: 基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的第一性原理计算。具体包括：形成能计算、声子谱计算、室温从头算分子动力学（AIMD）模拟、刚度矩阵计算（用于验证稳定性），以及自旋轨道耦合（SOC）效应的计算。

papers.title: Inhomogeneous Coulomb Models Without Defects are Sick: Domain Wall Energies Scaling as Volume (not Boundary Area)
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“show”、“present examples”、“by example”等理论推导和模型分析用语，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：具有库仑约束（即粗粒化场满足 \(\nabla\cdot\langle\mathbf{B}\rangle=0\)）的晶格系统，具体包括：正方晶格六顶点模型、量子二聚体模型、以及外加磁场下的经典自旋冰。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在没有缺陷（即 \(\nabla\cdot\mathbf{B}\neq0\) 的局域结构）的情况下，库仑模型中的畴壁能量会随系统体积（而非边界面积）增长，导致系统“病态”；同时，即使系统边界满足净通量为零的条件，仍会对亥姆霍兹自由能产生与系统尺寸成正比的额外代价。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在没有缺陷（即 \(\nabla\cdot\mathbf{B}\neq0\) 的局域结构）的情况下，库仑模型中的畴壁能量会随系统体积（而非边界面积）增长，导致系统“病态”；同时，即使系统边界满足净通量为零的条件，仍会对亥姆霍兹自由能产生与系统尺寸成正比的额外代价。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，通过构造不同边界条件下畴壁的伪磁场通量不匹配条件（\((\langle\mathbf{B}_R\rangle-\langle\mathbf{B}_L\rangle)\cdot\mathbf{n}\neq0\)），并利用正方晶格六顶点模型、量子二聚体模型和经典自旋冰等具体例子进行论证。

papers.title: Divergent Coherent Phonon Responses Across the Metal-Insulator Crossover
papers.abstract: Ultrafast laser control of material properties hinges on understanding light-matter interactions. We use two experimentally accessible response functions, laser fluence induced phonon softening and the amplitude of coherent reflectance oscillations, to compare how strongly different materials respond to ultrafast photoexcitation. Comparing a diverse set of materials, we find that only a narrow class, including Sb, GeTe, and Bi2Te3, shows exceptional responses such as pronounced phonon softening and a giant increase of reflectance oscillations with increasing fluence. These response functions peak in an intermediate conductivity regime of about 102 - 104 S/cm, at the crossover between localized and delocalized electronic states. The corresponding class of solids also shows other unconventional properties including high dielectric constants, enhanced Born effective charges, coordination numbers exceeding the 8-N rule and uncommon bond rupture. This suggests that these materials employ a unique bonding mechanism, coined metavalent bonding. Frozen-phonon DFT calculations show that the strong fluence dependence arises from Peierls-like instabilities, leading to large deformation potentials and anharmonic double-well potentials. These findings identify metavalent bonding as a design principle for enhanced coherent phonon control and provide a quantitative framework for identifying materials with exceptional ultrafast responses.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。判断依据：摘要中提及“使用两种实验可测量的响应函数”进行实验比较，并进行了“冻结声子DFT计算”进行理论分析。；研究对象：金属-绝缘体交叉（Metal-Insulator Crossover）区域中，不同材料（特别是Sb、GeTe、Bi2Te3等）在超快光激发下的相干声子响应行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在电导率约为10² - 10⁴ S/cm的中间态（即局域与退局域电子态的交叉区域），材料表现出最强的相干声子响应（如显著的声子软化、反射率振荡幅度剧增）。这种异常响应源于一种被称为“金属价键”的独特成键机制，该机制导致类Peierls不稳定性，从而产生大的形变势和双势阱非谐性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在电导率约为10² - 10⁴ S/cm的中间态（即局域与退局域电子态的交叉区域），材料表现出最强的相干声子响应（如显著的声子软化、反射率振荡幅度剧增）。这种异常响应源于一种被称为“金属价键”的独特成键机制，该机制导致类Peierls不稳定性，从而产生大的形变势和双势阱非谐性。；创新点：该工作首次将“金属价键”这一独特的成键机制，与增强的相干声子控制能力联系起来，并建立了一个基于电导率的定量框架，用于识别具有异常超快响应的材料。摘要未突出说明与具体某一篇前人工作的对比。
papers.method_zh: 1.  **实验方法**：利用两种响应函数——激光通量诱导的声子软化（phonon softening）和相干反射率振荡的振幅（amplitude of coherent reflectance oscillations），来比较不同材料对超快光激发的响应强度。

papers.title: V-Doped Niobate Nanosheets for Enhanced Photocatalytic Activity
papers.abstract: V-doped [Ca$_{2}$Nb$_{3-x}$V$_{x}$O$_{10}$]$^{-}$ (x = 0, 0.15, 0.3, 0.6, 0.75) nanosheets were produced by solid state reaction followed by protonation and exfoliation by tetrabutylammonium ions. 2D nanosheets have improved photocatalytic activity due to their small thickness that reduces electron-hole recombination, larger surface area that increases photocatalytic sites, and decreased band gap from added V. V-doping has caused the wide band gap of 3.54 eV of undoped nanosheets to decrease to 2.60-2.88 eV range. 10 vol% methanol was used as a hole scavenger in the hydrogen evolution reactions, and 3 wt% Pt was deposited on nanosheets as a co-catalyst. Under a full-spectrum Xe light, [Ca$_{2}$Nb$_{2.7}$V$_{0.3}$O$_{10}$]$^{-}$ has produced 4.7 times the H$_{2}$ yield as undoped nanosheets with a 11.3 mmol/g/h production rate, [Ca$_{2}$Nb$_{2.7}$V$_{0.3}$O$_{10}$]$^{-}$ with Pt co-catalyst has produced 2.9 times the H$_{2}$ yield as undoped Pt-loaded nanosheets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：solid state reaction（固相反应）、protonation（质子化）、exfoliation（剥离）、photocatalytic activity（光催化活性）、hydrogen evolution（析氢反应）。；研究对象：V掺杂的铌酸盐纳米片，具体为V-doped [Ca₂Nb₃₋ₓVₓO₁₀]⁻（x = 0, 0.15, 0.3, 0.6, 0.75）二维纳米片体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: V掺杂使未掺杂纳米片的宽带隙（3.54 eV）降低至2.60–2.88 eV，显著提升了光催化产氢性能。其中[Ca₂Nb₂.₇V₀.₃O₁₀]⁻纳米片在全光谱氙灯下的产氢速率达到11.3 mmol/g/h，是未掺杂样品的4.7倍；负载Pt助催化剂后，产氢量是未掺杂Pt负载样品的2.9倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：V掺杂使未掺杂纳米片的宽带隙（3.54 eV）降低至2.60–2.88 eV，显著提升了光催化产氢性能。其中[Ca₂Nb₂.₇V₀.₃O₁₀]⁻纳米片在全光谱氙灯下的产氢速率达到11.3 mmol/g/h，是未掺杂样品的4.7倍；负载Pt助催化剂后，产氢量是未掺杂Pt负载样品的2.9倍。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用固相反应合成前驱体，随后通过质子化和四丁基铵离子插层剥离获得二维纳米片。使用10 vol%甲醇作为空穴牺牲剂，3 wt% Pt作为助催化剂沉积在纳米片上，在全光谱氙灯下进行光催化析氢反应测试。

papers.title: Microscopic universal theory of symmetry-enriched topological quantum spin liquids
papers.abstract: An ultimate theory of a phase of matter should describe all its universal properties via quantities that are measurable numerically and experimentally. In this work, we present a microscopic universal theory of symmetry-enriched topological quantum spin liquids (TQSLs) in two spatial dimensions, which directly utilizes microscopically measurable quantities to describe the universal properties. This theory applies to generic TQSLs, which can be Abelian or non-Abelian, chiral or non-chiral. The symmetries are also general, which can include both internal and lattice symmetries, unitary and anti-unitary symmetries, and discrete and continuous symmetries. There can be spin-orbit coupling, the microscopic degrees of freedom may transform linearly or projectively under the symmetries, and the symmetries can permute anyons. The input of the theory is some microscopic states with anyons, operators that control the dynamics of anyons, and symmetry actions in the TQSL, and its output is a set of data characterizing the universal properties, whose underlying mathematical structure is a generalization of category theory. Based on this theory, we find an explicit bijective map between the universal data characterizing a TQSL with a symmetry described by a group $G$, where the symmetry actions may include both lattice and internal symmetries, and the corresponding universal data for a TQSL with only an internal symmetry group $G$, and thus establish a precise crystalline equivalence principle. We demonstrate our theory in symmetry-enriched TQSLs realized on quantum processors based on superconducting qubits, trapped ions, and Rydberg atoms, and in each example we verify the Lieb-Schultz-Mattis anomaly matching condition. Our theory provides a solid basis for identifying and manipulating symmetry-enriched TQSLs, which further paves the way for fault-tolerant quantum computation based on these systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：microscopic universal theory、category theory、crystalline equivalence principle。；研究对象：二维空间中的对称性富集拓扑量子自旋液体（symmetry-enriched topological quantum spin liquids, TQSLs），包括阿贝尔/非阿贝尔、手性/非手性体系，以及包含内部对称性、晶格对称性、幺正/反幺正对称性、离散/连续对称性的一般对称性情形。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于微观可测量量的普适理论，能够直接描述对称性富集拓扑量子自旋液体的全部普适性质；并建立了对称性富集TQSL与仅含内部对称性群G的TQSL之间的精确晶体等价原理（crystalline equivalence principle）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于微观可测量量的普适理论，能够直接描述对称性富集拓扑量子自旋液体的全部普适性质；并建立了对称性富集TQSL与仅含内部对称性群G的TQSL之间的精确晶体等价原理（crystalline equivalence principle）。；创新点：首次从微观可测量量出发构建了对称性富集拓扑量子自旋液体的普适理论，并严格证明了晶体等价原理（将晶格对称性与内部对称性统一映射），为基于此类系统的容错量子计算提供了理论基础。摘要未突出说明与已有范畴论方法的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用范畴论（category theory）的推广作为数学结构，以微观态（含任意子）、控制任意子动力学的算符以及对称性作用作为输入，输出表征普适性质的数据集。理论框架适用于存在自旋-轨道耦合、微观自由度在对称性下线性或投影变换、以及对称性可置换任意子的一般情形。

papers.title: Dimensionality-Driven Charge Stabilization of Group-IV Color Centers in Diamond Ultrathin Films
papers.abstract: Neutral group-IV vacancy (XV, X = Si, Ge, Sn, and Pb) centers in diamond are emerging solid-state spin-photon interfaces because of their favorable spin coherence and inversion symmetry-protected optical transitions. However, stabilizing their neutral charge state typically requires stringent Fermi-level engineering in high purity boron-doped diamond, which poses significant materials-growth challenges. Here, we demonstrate that dimensional confinement in diamane provides an alternative route to charge-state stabilization without intentional doping. Using first-principles calculations, we show that quantum confinement and surface termination cooperatively tune the host band gap and shift the occupied defect states upward from the valence-band edge, thereby enlarging the thermodynamic stability window of the neutral charge state and suppressing valence-band assisted excitation pathways. We further reveal that the thickness and surface termination of diamane enable systematic tuning of the electronic structure, zero-field splitting, and spin-orbit coupling of XV centers while largely preserving their optical transition energies. Among the structures considered, hydrogenated diamane offers the most favorable balance between charge-state stability and magneto-optical performance. More broadly, our findings establish dimensional confinement as a general strategy for engineering the charge, optical, and spin properties of solid-state quantum defects.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：金刚石超薄膜（diamane）中第IV族空位色心（XV，X = Si, Ge, Sn, Pb）的电荷态稳定性及其电子、光学和自旋性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 研究发现，通过维度限制（即使用金刚石超薄膜）可以替代传统的掺杂方法，稳定第IV族空位色心的中性电荷态。量子限域效应和表面终止共同作用，扩大了中性电荷态的热力学稳定窗口，并抑制了价带辅助的激发路径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：研究发现，通过维度限制（即使用金刚石超薄膜）可以替代传统的掺杂方法，稳定第IV族空位色心的中性电荷态。量子限域效应和表面终止共同作用，扩大了中性电荷态的热力学稳定窗口，并抑制了价带辅助的激发路径。；创新点：提出并验证了利用维度限制（而非传统掺杂）作为调控固态量子缺陷电荷、光学和自旋性质的一般性策略。具体揭示了金刚石超薄膜的厚度和表面终止可以系统性地调控色心的电子结构、零场分裂和自旋轨道耦合。摘要未突出说明与具体实验结果的对比或对现有实验瓶颈的突破细节。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）。

papers.title: On the correlation lengths of confined spheres in a cylindrical pore
papers.abstract: We investigate the structural correlations of hard spheres confined within a narrow cylindrical pore in the quasi-one-dimensional regime, where interactions are restricted to nearest neighbors. Using a Laplace-space formulation of the radial distribution function (RDF), we determine the correlation lengths and oscillation frequencies associated with its long-distance decay. In addition to the global RDF, we analyze transverse-resolved RDFs that account for the positions of particle pairs across the pore cross section. While these observables are associated with the same underlying pole spectrum, their residues depend on the transverse configuration and can vanish due to symmetry. As a result, different particle-pair configurations may be governed by different leading poles and display different correlation lengths and oscillation frequencies. In particular, the global RDF does not always reflect the longest-ranged correlations found in transverse-resolved observables. We examine how this behavior depends on density and confinement. In the strong-confinement limit, the system approaches the Tonks-gas behavior at finite pressure, and the differences between the RDFs disappear.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Laplace-space formulation、radial distribution function (RDF)、pole spectrum。；研究对象：准一维圆柱形孔隙中受限硬球系统的结构关联，特别是粒子间相互作用仅限于最近邻的准一维体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 全局径向分布函数（RDF）并不总是反映体系中最长程的关联；不同横向分辨的粒子对构型可能由不同的主导极点支配，从而表现出不同的关联长度和振荡频率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：全局径向分布函数（RDF）并不总是反映体系中最长程的关联；不同横向分辨的粒子对构型可能由不同的主导极点支配，从而表现出不同的关联长度和振荡频率。；创新点：揭示了全局RDF与横向分辨RDF在主导关联长度上的差异，指出全局RDF可能掩盖某些横向构型中更长的关联，并系统研究了密度和受限强度对这一行为的影响。
papers.method_zh: 采用径向分布函数的拉普拉斯空间形式，通过分析其长程衰减对应的极点谱，计算关联长度和振荡频率；同时引入横向分辨的RDF以考虑粒子对在孔隙截面上的位置分布。

papers.title: Shear Banding in Amorphous Solids as a Nonlinear Screened Soft Mode Instability
papers.abstract: Shear banding is a well-known and widespread instability in strained solids: under external strain, the deformation localizes along a line in two dimensions or a plane in three dimensions. Developing a proper theoretical description of this phenomenon is key to understanding mechanical failure in solid materials. Very recently, a nonlinear theory extending classical elasticity to include plastic deformations as topological charges was proposed, offering detailed predictions on the nature and consequences of the shear-banding instability. The theory derives a Hessian operator whose lowest eigenvalue vanishes at the onset of instability, and the corresponding critical eigenmode describes the displacement field across the shear band. The resulting soft mode possesses the selected localization scale and subsequently saturates into a finite-width shear band. The aim of this Letter is to examine this theory numerically, establishing the role of topological screening and nonlinear instability as the mechanisms governing shear banding during athermal quasistatic deformation. We show that the displacement profile around the shear band is directly determined by the screening parameter and the nonlinear coefficient, thereby quantitatively verifying the theoretical predictions. Our results demonstrate that shear banding differs fundamentally from fracture: it arises from a nonlinear instability of an elastic field screened by plastic deformations. This establishes topological screening as the essential mechanism governing shear banding in amorphous solids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（结合数值计算验证）。判断依据：提出非线性理论扩展经典弹性力学，并通过数值模拟验证理论预测。；研究对象：非晶态固体中的剪切带失稳现象（amorphous solids under athermal quasistatic deformation）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 剪切带起源于由塑性变形屏蔽的弹性场的非线性失稳，其位移轮廓由屏蔽参数和非线性系数直接决定，与断裂有本质区别。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：剪切带起源于由塑性变形屏蔽的弹性场的非线性失稳，其位移轮廓由屏蔽参数和非线性系数直接决定，与断裂有本质区别。；创新点：首次将拓扑屏蔽（topological screening）确立为非晶态固体剪切带形成的核心机制，并揭示其与断裂的非线性失稳本质差异。
papers.method_zh: 基于将塑性变形视为拓扑电荷的非线性弹性理论，推导Hessian算符并分析其本征值及临界本征模；通过数值模拟（athermal quasistatic deformation）定量验证理论预测。

papers.title: Topological bound states in the continuum with controllable multiplicity
papers.abstract: Bound states in the continuum (BICs) are spatially localized states embedded in the continuous spectrum without hybridizing with extended bulk modes. Recent advances in topological band theory have greatly enriched the understanding of BICs, which gives rise to boundary-localized topological BICs with extremely high robustness against disorders. However, there remains a challenge in realizing corner-localized topological BICs in a three-dimensional system due to the absence of both realistic theoretical models and effective topological characterization schemes. In particular, how to engineer a controllable number of corner-localized topological BIC is still an open question. Here, we propose that the corner-localized topological BICs can emerge in a class of generalized breathing pyrochlore lattice with general inter-cell hoppings. We further show that the number of BICs at each corner can be arbitrarily adjusted by changing the parameters of inter-cell hoppings. Remarkably, although these corner-localized topological BICs are intertwined with a substantial number of bulk modes, we can accurately characterize them through the polarized topological charges, which are nodal points with topological properties in Brillouin zone and are measurable in experiments. We also reveal three types of topological phase transitions of corner-localized BICs, which are associated with the different ways of closing the bulk energy gap and can be intuitively captured by the polarized topological charges. This work not only promotes the theoretical research of corner-localized topological BICs, but also opens an avenue for their experimental observation in the future.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提出理论模型（generalized breathing pyrochlore lattice）、拓扑表征方案（polarized topological charges），并讨论拓扑相变，未提及实验数据或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：三维广义呼吸型烧绿石晶格（generalized breathing pyrochlore lattice）中的角局域拓扑连续谱束缚态（corner-localized topological BICs）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在三维广义呼吸型烧绿石晶格中，通过调节胞间跳跃参数，可以在每个角上实现数量可控的拓扑连续谱束缚态，并利用极化拓扑电荷（polarized topological charges）对其进行精确表征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在三维广义呼吸型烧绿石晶格中，通过调节胞间跳跃参数，可以在每个角上实现数量可控的拓扑连续谱束缚态，并利用极化拓扑电荷（polarized topological charges）对其进行精确表征。；创新点：首次在三维系统中实现角局域拓扑连续谱束缚态，并证明其数量可通过胞间跳跃参数任意调控；提出极化拓扑电荷作为实验可测量的拓扑表征方案，克服了三维系统中缺乏有效拓扑表征的难题。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模：构建具有一般胞间跳跃的广义呼吸型烧绿石晶格模型；拓扑表征：利用布里渊区中具有拓扑性质的节点（nodal points）即极化拓扑电荷来刻画角局域BICs；相变分析：通过体能隙闭合的不同方式揭示三种类型的拓扑相变。

papers.title: What Is a Pattern in Statistical Mechanics? Formalizing Structure and Patterns in One-Dimensional Spin Lattice Models with Computational Mechanics
papers.abstract: This work formalizes the notions of structure and pattern for three distinct one-dimensional spin-lattice models (finite-range Ising, solid-on-solid, and three-body), using information-theoretic and computation-theoretic methods. We begin by presenting a novel derivation of the Boltzmann distribution for finite one-dimensional spin configurations embedded in infinite ones. We next recast this distribution as a stochastic process, thereby enabling us to analyze each spin-lattice model within the theory of computational mechanics. In this framework, the process's structure is quantified by excess entropy (predictable information) and statistical complexity (stored information), and the process's structure-generating mechanism is specified by its epsilon-machine. To assess compatibility with statistical mechanics, we compare the configurations jointly determined by the information measures and epsilon-machines to typical configurations drawn from the Boltzmann distribution, and we find agreement. We also include a self-contained primer on computational mechanics and provide code implementing the information measures and spin-model distributions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：formalizes（形式化）、information-theoretic and computation-theoretic methods（信息论与计算理论方法）、derivation（推导）、epsilon-machine（ε-机）。；研究对象：一维自旋晶格模型，具体包括有限程伊辛模型（finite-range Ising）、固体-固体模型（solid-on-solid）和三体相互作用模型（three-body）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用信息论和计算理论方法，可以形式化地量化一维自旋晶格模型中的“结构”和“模式”，并且由信息度量（过剩熵、统计复杂度）和ε-机所确定的构型与玻尔兹曼分布下的典型构型一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用信息论和计算理论方法，可以形式化地量化一维自旋晶格模型中的“结构”和“模式”，并且由信息度量（过剩熵、统计复杂度）和ε-机所确定的构型与玻尔兹曼分布下的典型构型一致。；创新点：首次将计算力学的形式化工具系统应用于一维自旋晶格模型，为统计力学中的“结构”和“模式”概念提供了严格的信息论定义，并验证了其与标准统计力学结果的兼容性。
papers.method_zh: 采用计算力学（computational mechanics）理论框架，将玻尔兹曼分布重新表述为随机过程，进而用过剩熵（excess entropy）量化可预测信息，用统计复杂度（statistical complexity）量化存储信息，并用ε-机（epsilon-machine）描述结构生成机制。论文还提供了自包含的计算力学入门介绍及实现代码。

papers.title: First-Principles Investigation of Electron--Phonon Coupling and Intrinsic Two-Gap Superconductivity in Hexagonal BAs3 Monolayer
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional superconductors with multiband electronic structures provide an ideal platform for exploring anisotropic and multigap superconductivity in the reduced-dimensionality limit. Here, we investigate the structural, electronic, vibrational, and superconducting properties of a hexagonal BAs$_3$ monolayer using first-principles calculations combined with density functional perturbation theory and fully anisotropic Migdal--Eliashberg theory. The optimized structure is found to be dynamically and thermally stable, as confirmed by phonon calculations and ab initio molecular dynamics simulations. Electronic structure calculations reveal an intrinsic metallic state with multiple bands crossing the Fermi level and several disconnected Fermi-surface sheets derived primarily from hybridized B-$p$ and As-$p$ orbitals. The electron--phonon interaction is dominated by low-frequency As-derived phonon modes, yielding a total electron--phonon coupling constant of $λ=0.75$. Solving the anisotropic Eliashberg equations predicts a superconducting critical temperature of $T_c=3.4$ K. The momentum-resolved superconducting gap exhibits a pronounced two-gap character with gap magnitudes of $Δ_1=0.75$ meV and $Δ_2=0.51$ meV at $T=1$ K. The superconducting gaps remain finite over the entire Fermi surface, demonstrating a fully gapped nodeless superconducting state. Analysis of the momentum-dependent electron--phonon coupling reveals that the two-gap superconductivity originates from sheet-dependent pairing interactions associated with distinct Fermi-surface sheets. Our results establish monolayer BAs$_3$ as an intrinsic anisotropic two-gap superconductor and expand the growing family of boron-based two-dimensional superconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）、“density functional perturbation theory”（密度泛函微扰理论）、“fully anisotropic Migdal--Eliashberg theory”（全各向异性Migdal-Eliashberg理论）。；研究对象：六方BAs₃单层（hexagonal BAs₃ monolayer）的超导性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 六方BAs₃单层是一种本征的各向异性双能隙超导体，其超导临界温度约为3.4 K，两个超导能隙分别为0.75 meV和0.51 meV，且在整个费米面上均为完全打开的无节点超导态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：六方BAs₃单层是一种本征的各向异性双能隙超导体，其超导临界温度约为3.4 K，两个超导能隙分别为0.75 meV和0.51 meV，且在整个费米面上均为完全打开的无节点超导态。；创新点：首次通过理论计算预言了六方BAs₃单层是一种本征的双能隙超导体，并揭示了其双能隙超导电性源于不同费米面片（Fermi-surface sheets）上依赖片层的配对相互作用，从而扩展了硼基二维超导体的家族。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理计算，结合密度泛函微扰理论和全各向异性Migdal-Eliashberg理论。具体包括：声子计算和从头算分子动力学模拟（用于验证稳定性）、电子结构计算、电子-声子耦合分析以及各向异性Eliashberg方程求解。

papers.title: First-Principles Insights into Surface and Ligand Effects in Stoichiometric HgTe Quantum Dots
papers.abstract: HgTe quantum dots are promising mid-infrared nanomaterials owing to their exceptional bandgap tunability, yet their electronic structure is strongly influenced by surface coordination and ligand passivation at ultrasmall sizes. Here, we employ atomistic simulations to systematically investigate stoichiometric HgTe nanoclusters with sizes 0.86 to 1.85 nm. The in silico exploration uncovers a transition from confinement-dominated electronic structures with delocalized frontier states in small self-passivated clusters to surface influenced characteristics in larger nanoclusters. Increased coordination and bond-length inhomogeneity in the larger nanoclusters generate localized near-gap states centered on undercoordinated surface atoms. At intermediate sizes, the band edge states become spatially separated on different regions of the cluster without forming deep gap states, marking the onset of surface induced electronic asymmetry. In larger clusters (1.8 nm), common neutral ligands like amines, thiols, phosphines, and alcohols effectively eliminate surface-derived localized states by restoring local coordination and altering the band edge electronic structure through ligand surface hybridization. The sensitivity of the bandgap to ligand identity and binding site underscores the interplay between surface coordination and ligand chemistry in shaping the electronic structure of these nanoclusters. These insights provide an atomistic understanding of size-dependent electronic structures in ultrasmall HgTe clusters. The study further establishes neutral ligands as powerful chemical handles for engineering frontier electronic states relevant to infrared optoelectronic functionality.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：atomistic simulations、in silico exploration、First-Principles Insights。；研究对象：化学计量比的HgTe量子点（纳米团簇），尺寸范围为0.86至1.85 nm，以及表面配体（胺、硫醇、膦、醇）对其电子结构的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在超小HgTe量子点中，电子结构随尺寸增大从量子限域主导（前沿态离域）转变为表面效应主导（产生局域化近隙态）；中性配体可通过恢复表面配位和杂化作用有效消除表面诱导的局域态，从而调控带边电子结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在超小HgTe量子点中，电子结构随尺寸增大从量子限域主导（前沿态离域）转变为表面效应主导（产生局域化近隙态）；中性配体可通过恢复表面配位和杂化作用有效消除表面诱导的局域态，从而调控带边电子结构。；创新点：系统揭示了超小HgTe量子点中从限域主导到表面主导的电子结构转变，并明确了中性配体（如胺、硫醇等）作为化学手段消除表面局域态、调控红外光电子功能前沿态的原子尺度机制。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理原子模拟（atomistic simulations），具体为基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的计算，用于研究不同尺寸和配体覆盖下的HgTe纳米团簇。

papers.title: Thermal Processing Limits in Oxide-Channel Ferroelectric Field Effect Transistors
papers.abstract: In this work, we report a systematic study of the impact of high-temperature post-capping thermal annealing on the memory characteristics of Oxide-semiconductor channel ferroelectric field-effect transistors (OS-FeFETs). Using an identical engineered ferroelectric gate stack 8nm Hf0.5Zr0.5O2 (HZO) / 3 nm Al2O3 / 8 nm HZO (8/3/8) and a hybrid capping layer (3 nm HfO2 + 3 nm Al2O3), 10 percent Ga doped InO (IGO) channel and 4 percent W doped InO (IWO) channel FeFETs remain functional after annealing at temperatures up to 650 C for durations of up to 30 min and 10 min, respectively; further annealing results in irreversible loss of conduction and device failure. Detailed electrical analysis reveals that the MW enhancement originates from a preferential positive shift in the erased-state threshold voltage, while the programmed-state threshold voltage remains comparatively stable. Grazing-incidence X-ray diffraction measurements further indicate structural evolution in the IWO and IGO oxide channels with increasing annealing temperature, supporting the observed electrical trends.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词包括“systematic study”、“electrical analysis”、“Grazing-incidence X-ray diffraction measurements”。；研究对象：氧化物沟道铁电场效应晶体管（OS-FeFETs），具体材料体系为基于Hf0.5Zr0.5O2（HZO）铁电栅叠层、IGO（10% Ga掺杂InO）和IWO（4% W掺杂InO）沟道的器件。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: IGO和IWO沟道FeFET在高温退火（最高650°C）后仍能保持功能，但超过一定时间（IGO: 30分钟，IWO: 10分钟）会导致不可逆的导电性丧失和器件失效；存储窗口（MW）增强主要源于擦除态阈值电压的正向偏移，而编程态阈值电压相对稳定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：IGO和IWO沟道FeFET在高温退火（最高650°C）后仍能保持功能，但超过一定时间（IGO: 30分钟，IWO: 10分钟）会导致不可逆的导电性丧失和器件失效；存储窗口（MW）增强主要源于擦除态阈值电压的正向偏移，而编程态阈值电压相对稳定。；创新点：系统揭示了氧化物沟道FeFET在高温退火下的热加工极限，并阐明了存储窗口增强的物理机制（擦除态阈值电压选择性偏移）与沟道材料结构演化的关联。
papers.method_zh: 采用高温退火处理（post-capping thermal annealing），结合电学特性分析（阈值电压、存储窗口）和掠入射X射线衍射（GIXRD）表征沟道结构演变。

papers.title: A spectral model of power-law decay in natural and engineered systems
papers.abstract: We present a first-principles spectral mechanism for the emergence of nonextensive $q$-exponential dilution and power-law relaxation in non-ideal transport systems. By modeling an incompletely mixed reactor as a layered diffusion matrix with an absorbing boundary, we demonstrate that macroscopic power-law tails depend on the geometric interaction between the initial tracer placement and the domain's boundary configuration. For a one-dimensional system, an asymmetric, volumetrically distributed initial concentration profile projects onto the low-wavenumber eigenmodes, generating an emergent Gamma distribution of relaxation rates; at an infinitesimal boundary layer thickness ($Δz \to 0$), this profile yields the nonextensive $q$-exponential decay function exactly across the entire temporal domain with $q = 5/3$. Extended to $d$ dimensions under a highly localized, boundary-adjacent singular initial condition, the resulting scaling exponents and corresponding $q$ values depend explicitly on the spatial configuration of the absorbing boundaries. However, in the one-dimensional limit ($d=1$), these distinct initial states and boundary formulations intersect, rendering the $q=5/3$ exponent geometrically invariant. Our approach establishes a clear connection between linear diffusion transport and nonextensive statistical mechanics, showing how heavy-tailed transport can be derived from boundary geometry and spectral dimensionality.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“first-principles spectral mechanism”“modeling”“demonstrate”等理论推导与建模关键词，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：非理想输运系统中幂律衰减现象的物理机制，具体为不完全混合反应器中的稀释与弛豫过程，以及边界几何与初始浓度分布对输运行为的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 宏观幂律衰减尾部的出现取决于初始示踪物放置与边界构型之间的几何相互作用；在一维系统中，特定初始浓度分布可精确导出非广延q-指数衰减函数，其中q=5/3，且该指数在多种初始状态与边界条件下具有几何不变性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：宏观幂律衰减尾部的出现取决于初始示踪物放置与边界构型之间的几何相互作用；在一维系统中，特定初始浓度分布可精确导出非广延q-指数衰减函数，其中q=5/3，且该指数在多种初始状态与边界条件下具有几何不变性。；创新点：建立了线性扩散输运与非广延统计力学之间的直接联系，揭示了幂律衰减的起源可归结为边界几何与谱维度，而非传统上认为的非线性或反常扩散机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用分层扩散矩阵模型，将不完全混合反应器建模为具有吸收边界的扩散系统；通过分析一维与d维空间中的本征模投影、Gamma分布弛豫率以及边界层厚度趋近于零的极限，推导出非广延统计力学中的q-指数函数。

papers.title: Enhanced dumbbell diffusion in a periodic potential by the elevator effect
papers.abstract: We present molecular dynamics simulations of the random walk of a dumbbell - two beads connected by a spring - in a one-dimensional periodic potential and compare our results in limiting cases to theoretical analytical equations. The relevant parameters in this system are the spring constant, the equilibrium distance of the spring (relative to the periodicity of the potential), and the amplitude of the potential. Dumbbells with equilibrium distances incommensurate with the potential periodicity and with a sufficiently large spring constant exhibit enhanced diffusion. The diffusion constant can exceed that of a single bead in the same potential landscape. In this case, the dumbbell resembles a traction elevator, with the two connected beads acting as the elevator car and counterweight: the ''elevator effect''.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：molecular dynamics simulations（分子动力学模拟）。；研究对象：一维周期势场中由弹簧连接的双珠子（哑铃）的随机行走与扩散现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当哑铃的平衡距离与势场周期不可公度且弹簧常数足够大时，哑铃的扩散常数可以超过单个珠子在同一势场中的扩散常数，该增强扩散机制被称为“电梯效应”。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当哑铃的平衡距离与势场周期不可公度且弹簧常数足够大时，哑铃的扩散常数可以超过单个珠子在同一势场中的扩散常数，该增强扩散机制被称为“电梯效应”。；创新点：首次提出并命名了“电梯效应”——将哑铃的两个珠子类比为电梯轿厢和对重，通过弹簧连接实现协同运动，从而在周期势中实现增强扩散。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学模拟，并与极限情况下的理论解析方程进行对比。

papers.title: Nearly ballistic transport and high magnetic-field sensitivity in a $\text{Bi}_4\text{Br}_4$ topological Josephson weak link
papers.abstract: Superconducting weak links with high transparency offer an appealing approach for designing compact magnetic-field sensors, as their phase-dependent Andreev bound-state (ABS) spectrum produces a strong flux-to-signal response with minimal dissipation. One way to achieve ballistic transport in the weak link is to use the edge states of topological insulators, since these states resist backscattering and provide a unique path to developing topological insulator-based weak-link devices for highly efficient magnetic-field sensing. Building on this, we propose a weak-link device using superconducting Nb electrodes and a nanoribbon of $\text{Bi}_4\text{Br}_4$ as the normal region, forming a Nb-1D (one-dimensional) $\text{Bi}_4\text{Br}_4$-Nb Josephson junction. We develop first-principles tight-binding Hamiltonians and orbital-resolved interface couplings in the Wannier basis, including spin-orbit coupling, based on density functional theory (DFT) calculations. The Eliashberg spectral function of bulk Nb, obtained via density functional perturbation theory (DFPT), indicates an electron-phonon coupling strength of 1.19 and a transition temperature of about 9 K, aligning well with conventional superconductivity in Nb. The subgap conductance is primarily influenced by Andreev processes. The ABS spectrum leads to a non-sinusoidal current-phase relation (CPR) with high forward skewness ($+$1.74) and phase sensitivity to the magnetic field. Overall, our findings suggest that the Nb-1D $\text{Bi}_4\text{Br}_4$-Nb weak link is a promising platform for on-chip superconducting magnetic sensors, compatible with scalable nanofabrication and broader development of topological-superconductor hybrid electronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论文章。关键词：first-principles tight-binding Hamiltonians、density functional theory (DFT) calculations、density functional perturbation theory (DFPT)、propose（提出器件设计）。；研究对象：基于拓扑绝缘体 Bi₄Br₄ 纳米带与超导 Nb 电极构成的 Nb-1D Bi₄Br₄-Nb 约瑟夫森弱连接器件，以及其近弹道输运特性和磁传感性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该弱连接器件具有高度前倾的非正弦电流-相位关系（前倾因子 +1.74），并展现出对磁场的强相位敏感性，表明其是实现片上超导磁传感器的有前景平台。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该弱连接器件具有高度前倾的非正弦电流-相位关系（前倾因子 +1.74），并展现出对磁场的强相位敏感性，表明其是实现片上超导磁传感器的有前景平台。；创新点：首次提出将 Bi₄Br₄ 拓扑绝缘体的一维边缘态用于构建近弹道输运的约瑟夫森弱连接，并基于第一性原理计算系统评估其作为高灵敏度磁传感器的潜力。摘要未突出说明与已有拓扑弱连接器件（如基于 HgTe、Bi₂Se₃ 等）的具体性能对比。
papers.method_zh: 基于密度泛函理论（DFT）计算构建第一性原理紧束缚哈密顿量和瓦尼尔基下的轨道分辨界面耦合（含自旋轨道耦合）；利用密度泛函微扰理论（DFPT）计算体相 Nb 的 Eliashberg 谱函数，得到电子-声子耦合强度（1.19）和超导转变温度（约 9 K）；通过分析 Andreev 束缚态（ABS）谱和亚隙电导，推导电流-相位关系（CPR）。

papers.title: Fidelity susceptibility and geometric response in flux-tuned Dirac systems: exact results from a low-energy two-level reduction
papers.abstract: We study the parametric sensitivity of two-dimensional massive Dirac fermions subject to Aharonov-Bohm flux insertion, using the Bures metric (fidelity susceptibility) as the central statistical-mechanical response function. Near integer values of the reduced flux, the low-energy spectrum undergoes a flux-induced avoided crossing whose structure is controlled by the Dirac mass. Through a controlled low-energy projection of the full Dirac=Aharonov-Bohm operator onto an effective two-level subspace, valid near integer flux, we derive an exact closed-form expression for the ground-state Bures metric, which takes a universal Lorentzian profile centered at integer flux with width set by the mass parameter. The peak value scales as $g^{\max}_{λλ}\sim m^{-2}$, diverging in the chiral limit in direct analogy with the divergence of thermodynamic susceptibilities near critical points. We introduce an integrated geometric susceptibility $χ(m) = π/(8m)$, whose inverse-mass scaling is the information-geometric counterpart of power-law critical behavior, with the Dirac mass playing the role of a relevant coupling controlling the distance from the chiral fixed point. The Lorentzian profile is shown to arise from the curvature of the ground-state manifold on the Bloch sphere, requiring no dynamical input beyond the spectral structure. Importantly, this geometric response is independent of Berry curvature and topological invariants, emerging instead from a universal local spectral mechanism. Through its spectral representation, the Bures metric is identified as the geometric (paramagnetic) contribution to the persistent current susceptibility, encoding the sensitivity of persistent currents and orbital magnetization to flux variations and connecting information geometry to measurable response functions in mesoscopic Dirac systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：低能投影、解析表达式、信息几何。；研究对象：二维有质量狄拉克费米子在阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆（Aharonov-Bohm）通量插入下的参数敏感性，具体为通量调谐的狄拉克系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基态Bures度规（保真度磁化率）在约化通量为整数附近呈现由狄拉克质量控制的洛伦兹线型，其峰值与质量的平方成反比，在手征极限下发散。该几何响应独立于贝里曲率和拓扑不变量，源于一种普适的局域谱机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基态Bures度规（保真度磁化率）在约化通量为整数附近呈现由狄拉克质量控制的洛伦兹线型，其峰值与质量的平方成反比，在手征极限下发散。该几何响应独立于贝里曲率和拓扑不变量，源于一种普适的局域谱机制。；创新点：揭示了通量调谐狄拉克系统中保真度磁化率的普适洛伦兹线型及其与质量参数的精确标度关系，并将其识别为持续电流磁化率中的几何（顺磁）贡献，建立了信息几何与可观测响应函数之间的联系。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对比。
papers.method_zh: 通过将完整的狄拉克-阿哈罗诺夫玻姆算符在整数通量附近低能投影到一个有效的两能级子空间，推导出基态Bures度规的精确闭式表达式。引入了积分几何磁化率χ(m) = π/(8m) 来表征其临界行为。

papers.title: Simultaneous nanoscale imaging of local conductivity and chemical potential in a quantum Hall isospin ferromagnet
papers.abstract: Quantum Hall isospin ferromagnetism in multilayer graphene offers a versatile playground for exploring flat band correlated physics, driven by the intricate coupling of spin, valley, orbital, and layer degrees of freedom. However, a nanoscale probe capable of simultaneously mapping local conductivity and chemical potential in these exotic phases has yet to be realized. Here, we introduce scanning conductivity and chemical potential microscopy (SCCM), a technique integrating scanning microwave impedance microscopy and Kelvin probe force microscopy. We demonstrate SCCM by probing the quantum Hall states and many-body Landau level energy spectrum in bilayer graphene. Applied to marginally twisted double bilayer graphene, SCCM then reveals a cascade of quantum Hall isospin ferromagnetic states with unexpected re-emergence behaviors. Significantly, experimental many-body Landau level energy spectrum further uncovers the intricate connections of these complex phenomena to inter-subband Landau level crossings and Landau level single-particle wavefunctions. These insights enable the construction of a comprehensive quantum Hall phase diagram. Our results demonstrate SCCM's capability in decoding complex quantum phenomena, establishing it as a versatile nanoscale probe for electron correlation and topology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：scanning conductivity and chemical potential microscopy (SCCM)、probing、demonstrate、reveals。；研究对象：多层石墨烯（特别是双层石墨烯和轻微扭转的双层石墨烯）中的量子霍尔同位旋铁磁态，以及相关的多体朗道能级能谱和量子霍尔相图。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: SCCM技术成功实现了对量子霍尔同位旋铁磁态中局域电导率和化学势的同时纳米级成像，并揭示了这些复杂相中意想不到的重新出现行为，以及它们与子带间朗道能级交叉和单粒子波函数的关联。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：SCCM技术成功实现了对量子霍尔同位旋铁磁态中局域电导率和化学势的同时纳米级成像，并揭示了这些复杂相中意想不到的重新出现行为，以及它们与子带间朗道能级交叉和单粒子波函数的关联。；创新点：首次实现了一种能够在纳米尺度上同时测绘量子霍尔同位旋铁磁相中局域电导率和化学势的探针技术（SCCM），并利用该技术揭示了轻微扭转双层石墨烯中量子霍尔同位旋铁磁态级联的复杂行为及其与朗道能级结构的关联。
papers.method_zh: 扫描电导率和化学势显微镜（SCCM），该技术集成了扫描微波阻抗显微镜和开尔文探针力显微镜。

papers.title: Correlated $\mathcal{PT}$-Symmetric Antiferromagnetic Topological Insulators with Giant Nonlinear Anomalous Thermoelectrics
papers.abstract: Topological states in antiferromagnets (AFMs) offer a promising platform for exploring novel physical phenomena and advancing the applications of AFM spintronics. The AFM topological insulator (TI) state stands out as one of the most representative and prominent cases. Unlike the previously proposed AFM-TI states in noninteracting systems, here we employ an extended Kane-Mele-Hubbard model to demonstrate that electron correlations can give rise to a $\mathcal{PT}$-symmetric AFM-TI state. This state breaks both spatial inversion symmetry $\mathcal{P}$ and time-reversal symmetry $\mathcal{T}$, and enables intrinsic topological nonlinear responses to dominate the leading-order dynamics of the system. The competition between electron correlations and spin-orbit coupling drives the system across a topological phase transition, where the closure of the bulk band gap induces singular behaviors in higher-order quantum geometric tensors. Such microscopic singular characteristics manifest macroscopically as pronounced enhancements in thermoelectric performance, charge conductivity, and thermal conductivity. These giant tunable transport signatures, which can be effectively modulated by mechanical strain and electrostatic gating, provide a feasible experimental route to probe and understand correlated topological materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：demonstrate、model、theoretical framework（基于扩展Kane-Mele-Hubbard模型的理论分析）。；研究对象：反铁磁拓扑绝缘体中的关联电子态，具体为$\mathcal{PT}$对称的反铁磁拓扑绝缘体及其非线性反常热电输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电子关联可以驱动产生同时破缺空间反演对称性$\mathcal{P}$和时间反演对称性$\mathcal{T}$的$\mathcal{PT}$对称反铁磁拓扑绝缘体态，该态的本征拓扑非线性响应主导系统动力学，并在拓扑相变点附近产生巨大的热电、电导和热导增强效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电子关联可以驱动产生同时破缺空间反演对称性$\mathcal{P}$和时间反演对称性$\mathcal{T}$的$\mathcal{PT}$对称反铁磁拓扑绝缘体态，该态的本征拓扑非线性响应主导系统动力学，并在拓扑相变点附近产生巨大的热电、电导和热导增强效应。；创新点：首次在关联电子体系中提出$\mathcal{PT}$对称的反铁磁拓扑绝缘体态，区别于以往非相互作用系统中的反铁磁拓扑绝缘体，并揭示了该关联态下非线性拓扑响应导致的巨大可调输运信号。
papers.method_zh: 采用扩展Kane-Mele-Hubbard模型进行理论计算，分析电子关联与自旋-轨道耦合的竞争，研究高阶量子几何张量的奇异性，并计算热电性能、电荷电导率和热导率随应变和静电门控的调制响应。

papers.title: Microscopic mechanism of high-temperature superconductivity revealed by ab initio studies on hole-doped multilayer cuprates HgBa$_2$Ca$_2$Cu$_3$O$_8$ under pressure
papers.abstract: Triple-layer cuprate superconductor $\mathrm{HgBa_2Ca_2Cu_3O_8}$ (Hg1223) keeps the record of the highest superconducting (SC) critical temperature $T_{c}\sim 134$K among all the existing materials at ambient pressure. $T_{c}$ further increases under pressure up to $T_{c}\sim 160$K. However, its microscopic mechanism remains to be elucidated. We solve {\it ab initio} Hamiltonians for Hg1223 using a variational solver supplemented by a neural network. The pressure dependence of the $d$-wave SC order parameter and estimated $T_{c}$ show a dome-like structure in essential agreement with the experimental indications. The origin of the strong SC amplitude at ambient pressure is identified as strong local Coulomb repulsion $U$ attributed to poor screening. Further increase in $T_{c}$ under pressure is understood from interplay of three elements, namely increased electron hopping $t$, decreased $U$ and more importantly, strongly reduced offsite Coulomb repulsion $V$ with increasing pressure. Pairing mechanism is identified as the emergent local attraction counterintuitively generated from the originally strong local repulsion $U$. The emergent attraction is interpreted from ``attraction from reduced repulsion'', originating from the release of the fluctuating doubly-occupied sites characterized from the ``false vacuum'' in the Mott insulator to the double-occupation-free $d$-wave SC states upon carrier doping. This instantaneous attraction is in contrast with the conventional BCS SC mediated by bosonic glues. The local attraction is consistent with the electron fractionalization supported in experimental analyses. The coexistence of the SC and antiferromagnetic order is also demonstrated as a characteristic feature of the multi-layer system. The microscopic understanding of Hg1223 offers a new route explicitly using this emergent attraction to design and optimize SC materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：ab initio Hamiltonians、variational solver、neural network）；研究对象：三层铜氧化物超导体HgBa₂Ca₂Cu₃O₈（Hg1223）在常压和压力下的高温超导微观机制
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了Hg1223中高温超导的微观机制：常压下强超导振幅源于强局域库仑排斥U（因屏蔽不良），压力下Tc升高源于电子跳跃t增大、U减小以及更重要的非局域库仑排斥V显著减小；配对机制是局域强排斥U反直觉地产生出局域吸引，即“来自减弱的排斥的吸引”。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了Hg1223中高温超导的微观机制：常压下强超导振幅源于强局域库仑排斥U（因屏蔽不良），压力下Tc升高源于电子跳跃t增大、U减小以及更重要的非局域库仑排斥V显著减小；配对机制是局域强排斥U反直觉地产生出局域吸引，即“来自减弱的排斥的吸引”。；创新点：摘要未突出说明
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理（ab initio）构建哈密顿量，采用变分求解器（variational solver）辅以神经网络（neural network）进行求解

papers.title: The fluid-lattice gas isomorphism with application to liquid-vapor equilibrium in physisorbed monolayers
papers.abstract: Liquid-gas equilibrium for a simple molecular fluid is considered in view of the existence of the order parameter, in terms of which the symmetry of the binodal is restored not only in the vicinity of the critical point (critical isomorphism) but also globally in the whole coexistence region. This leads to the mapping between fluid and lattice gas (Ising model). We test this approach against the data on the liquid-gas binodal of a two-dimensional Lennard-Jones fluid and monolayers of molecular fluids. The obtained results allow us to speculate about the analog of the Kramers-Wannier duality in such systems and provide the theoretical estimate for $dp/dT$ on the saturation curve at the critical point. The microscopic grounds of the proposed approach are also discussed, and the transition from the continuous fluid model Hamiltonian to the effective quasi-spin lattice model is outlined.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中主要讨论理论映射（mapping）、对称性恢复、模型哈密顿量转换等，未提及具体实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：简单分子流体的液-气平衡，特别是物理吸附单分子层中的液-气共存现象。具体体系包括二维Lennard-Jones流体和分子流体的单分子层。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入一个序参量，可以在整个共存区域内（而不仅仅是临界点附近）恢复双节线的对称性，从而建立流体与晶格气体（Ising模型）之间的全局映射。该映射可用于推测此类系统中的Kramers-Wannier对偶性，并提供临界点饱和曲线斜率dp/dT的理论估计。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入一个序参量，可以在整个共存区域内（而不仅仅是临界点附近）恢复双节线的对称性，从而建立流体与晶格气体（Ising模型）之间的全局映射。该映射可用于推测此类系统中的Kramers-Wannier对偶性，并提供临界点饱和曲线斜率dp/dT的理论估计。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可看出其创新在于将通常仅在临界点附近成立的“临界同构性”推广到整个液-气共存区域，从而实现了流体与晶格气体模型的全局映射，并探讨了该映射在Kramers-Wannier对偶性方面的潜在意义。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。基于序参量的对称性恢复思想，建立了连续流体模型哈密顿量与有效准自旋晶格模型之间的映射关系，并利用二维Lennard-Jones流体及分子流体单分子层的液-气双节线数据对该方法进行了检验。

papers.title: Inverse design of bespoke interatomic potentials via active learning by information-matching
papers.abstract: Interatomic potentials (IPs) enable large-scale atomistic simulations beyond the reach of first-principles methods, but their predictive reliability depends critically on the selection of training data, quantified uncertainty, and model expressiveness. Active learning (AL) provides a principled framework for constructing efficient and accurate IPs, yet most strategies reduce parameter uncertainty without explicitly accounting for the specific material properties being predicted. The information-matching (IM) approach addresses this limitation by requiring that the selected training data provide at least as much parameter space information as needed to achieve prescribed uncertainty targets for selected quantities of interest (QoIs). Here, we apply IM to develop bespoke IPs specifically tailored for predicting plastic strength in metals. Due to the high computational cost of simulating plastic strength, we employ an indirect IM strategy that targets inexpensive intermediate QoIs that correlate with strength. The IM method enables precise parameter constraints with minimal training data, yielding precise predictions for both the intermediate QoIs and plastic strength. Yet, model error remains a key limitation, and a post hoc uncertainty inflation correction provides a viable means to mitigate this limitation. These findings illustrate both the promise and limits of uncertainty-aware AL for predicting complex material properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“interatomic potentials (IPs)”、“active learning (AL)”、“information-matching (IM) approach”等计算方法与理论框架，并涉及模拟（simulating）和预测（predicting）材料性质。；研究对象：金属材料中的塑性强度（plastic strength）。具体而言，论文旨在开发针对金属塑性强度预测的定制化原子间势（bespoke IPs）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 信息匹配（IM）主动学习方法能够通过最少的训练数据精确约束模型参数，从而实现对金属塑性强度及其相关中间量的精确预测。但模型误差仍是主要限制，后验不确定性膨胀校正是缓解该问题的可行手段。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：信息匹配（IM）主动学习方法能够通过最少的训练数据精确约束模型参数，从而实现对金属塑性强度及其相关中间量的精确预测。但模型误差仍是主要限制，后验不确定性膨胀校正是缓解该问题的可行手段。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新点在于将信息匹配（IM）主动学习框架应用于定制化原子间势的逆向设计，并特别针对预测复杂材料性质（如塑性强度）时的不确定性进行了量化与处理。
papers.method_zh: 信息匹配（IM）主动学习策略。该方法要求所选训练数据提供的参数空间信息量，至少足以达到对特定关注量（QoIs）的预设不确定性目标。由于直接模拟塑性强度计算成本高，论文采用了间接IM策略，即针对与强度相关的、计算成本较低的中间QoIs进行优化。

papers.title: Steering Selective Formation and 2D Crystallization of [4]Radialenes on Au(111) via [1+1+1+1] Cycloaddition of Isocyanides and Enantioselective Molecular Recognition
papers.abstract: Conjugated carbon rings are fundamental skeletons of organic functional materials, and their selective formation is of paramount importance in molecular materials engineering. However, steering the formation and 2D crystallization of conjugated carbon rings on the surface with high chemo- and stereoselectivities remains a great challenge. Here, we report a highly chemoselective [1+1+1+1] cycloaddition of isocyanides on the Au(111) surface, which affords the stereospecific tetraaza[4]radialene products and further enables their long-range-ordered 2D crystallization via enantioselective molecular recognition. Using the progressive annealing method, we found that at room temperature, isocyanides undergo a coordination reaction with Au adatoms to form two-fold symmetric isocyanide-Au-isocyanide complexes. In contrast, gradually increasing the annealing temperature induces the transformation of these complexes and subsequent covalent polymerization, leading to the selective generation of tetraaza[4]radialenes with homotactic configurations. The tetraaza[4]radialenes further assemble into 2D homochiral molecular crystals through enantioselective molecular recognition driven by multiple C-H -- Cl hydrogen-bonding interactions. By combining scanning tunneling microscopy/spectroscopy and non-contact atomic force microscopy, we determined the atomic structure and molecular orbitals of tetraaza[4]radialene, confirming that its four-membered ring adopts a planar geometry with a localized lowest unoccupied molecular orbital. Density functional theory calculations suggest that the [1+1+1+1] cycloaddition process involves stepwise formation of C-C bonds and its high selectivity arises from the spatial steric hindrance. Our findings provide new insights into the selective formation of conjugated rings on surfaces and have implications for engineering 2D homochiral molecular crystallization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：scanning tunneling microscopy/spectroscopy, non-contact atomic force microscopy, 实验发现与表征）；研究对象：在Au(111)表面上通过异腈的[1+1+1+1]环加成反应选择性生成四氮杂[4]轮烯（tetraaza[4]radialene）及其二维结晶行为，涉及表面化学反应、分子识别与手性结晶。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过逐步退火方法，实现了异腈在Au(111)表面上的高化学选择性[1+1+1+1]环加成反应，立体专一性地生成四氮杂[4]轮烯产物，并进一步通过对映选择性分子识别驱动其形成长程有序的二维同手性分子晶体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过逐步退火方法，实现了异腈在Au(111)表面上的高化学选择性[1+1+1+1]环加成反应，立体专一性地生成四氮杂[4]轮烯产物，并进一步通过对映选择性分子识别驱动其形成长程有序的二维同手性分子晶体。；创新点：首次在表面上实现异腈的高化学选择性[1+1+1+1]环加成反应，获得立体专一的四氮杂[4]轮烯，并利用多重C-H···Cl氢键相互作用驱动的对映选择性分子识别实现二维同手性分子结晶。
papers.method_zh: 扫描隧道显微镜/谱学（STM/STS）、非接触原子力显微镜（nc-AFM）用于原子结构与分子轨道表征；密度泛函理论（DFT）计算用于揭示[1+1+1+1]环加成反应路径及高选择性的空间位阻机制；逐步退火方法用于调控反应进程。

papers.title: Exact spectrum and anomalous relaxation in the open disorder-free Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev system
papers.abstract: We study a disorder-free variant of the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model with dissipation within the Gorini-Kossakowski-Sudarshan-Lindblad formalism. By utilizing the integrability of the clean SYK model, we derive an exact solution in a spectrum-resolved form, i.e., the eigenvalues and corresponding projection superoperators of the Liouvillian for arbitrary system size $N$. We determine the scaling of the gap that governs the long-time decay of the two-point correlation functions. Importantly, the gap does not vanish in the dissipationless limit when the thermodynamic limit is taken first, despite the integrability of the model. This phenomenon, known as anomalous relaxation, suggests a possible connection with chaotic dynamics and quantum Ruelle-Pollicott resonances. We also find several spectral features, such as transitions in the Liouvillian spectrum from complex to real eigenvalues with increasing dissipation strength, as well as the convergence of the dissipative form factor to the spectral form factor in the dissipationless limit. These findings indicate that the present model offers a useful platform for exploring nontrivial open dynamics of many-body quantum systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“Gorini-Kossakowski-Sudarshan-Lindblad formalism”和“Liouvillian”等理论框架，并推导精确解和谱特征，未涉及实验或数值计算。；研究对象：无序自由的Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev（SYK）模型在开放系统中的耗散动力学，具体为带有耗散的无序自由SYK变体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在热力学极限下，即使耗散强度趋近于零，Liouvillian的能隙也不消失，导致反常弛豫现象；同时观察到Liouvillian谱从复数到实数的转变，以及耗散形状因子在无耗散极限下收敛于谱形状因子。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在热力学极限下，即使耗散强度趋近于零，Liouvillian的能隙也不消失，导致反常弛豫现象；同时观察到Liouvillian谱从复数到实数的转变，以及耗散形状因子在无耗散极限下收敛于谱形状因子。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 利用清洁SYK模型的可积性，在Gorini-Kossakowski-Sudarshan-Lindblad（GKSL）框架下推导出Liouvillian的精确谱分解形式（包括本征值和投影超算符），并分析能隙标度与关联函数长时间衰减的关系。

papers.title: Non-magnetic ground state in A$_2$WCl$_6$ (A = Cs, Rb, K): A face-centered cubic system of spin-orbit-entangled $J$ = 2 states
papers.abstract: Heavy transition metal compounds with strong spin-orbit coupling appeared as a platform for $d$-electron multipolar physics. We report the electronic, magnetic, and structural properties of antifluorite-type tungsten chloride A$_2$WCl$_6$ (A = Cs, Rb, and K), comprising a face-centered cubic lattice of W$^{4+}$ ions. The 5$d^2$ configuration of W$^{4+}$ ions in a cubic environment yields a spin-orbit-entangled $J$ = 2 state, which has been discussed to give rise to multipolar ordering such as charge quadrupolar or magnetic octupolar ordering. We found that K$_2$WCl$_6$ undergoes a cubic-to-tetragonal structural transition which lifts the degeneracy of the $J$ = 2 state, leading to a non-magnetic singlet ground state. By contrast, Rb$_2$WCl$_6$ and Cs$_2$WCl$_6$ show no signs of phase transition and remain non-magnetic down to the lowest temperature measured. At low temperatures, signatures of weak structural anomalies were revealed, which may point to the presence of local distortions of the WCl$_6$ octahedra. We argue that the subtle structural distortion arises from the local quadrupolar component of the $J$ = 2 state but the frustrated quadrupolar interaction, together with chemical disorder, inhibits the formation of long-range quadrupolar ordering.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：report the electronic, magnetic, and structural properties；measurements；structural transition；low-temperature signatures）；研究对象：反萤石型钨氯化物 A₂WCl₆（A = Cs, Rb, K），其中 W⁴⁺ 离子构成面心立方晶格，具有自旋-轨道纠缠的 J = 2 态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: K₂WCl₆ 发生立方到四方结构相变，导致 J = 2 态简并解除，形成非磁性单重态基态；而 Rb₂WCl₆ 和 Cs₂WCl₆ 在最低测量温度下保持非磁性且无相变，仅存在微弱结构异常，可能源于局域四极矩分量，但受阻的四极相互作用和化学无序抑制了长程四极序的形成。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：K₂WCl₆ 发生立方到四方结构相变，导致 J = 2 态简并解除，形成非磁性单重态基态；而 Rb₂WCl₆ 和 Cs₂WCl₆ 在最低测量温度下保持非磁性且无相变，仅存在微弱结构异常，可能源于局域四极矩分量，但受阻的四极相互作用和化学无序抑制了长程四极序的形成。；创新点：首次报道了 A₂WCl₆ 体系中 J = 2 态在立方环境下的基态行为，揭示了结构相变与非磁性单重态之间的关联，并指出局域四极矩分量与受阻相互作用对长程有序的抑制。
papers.method_zh: 通过电子、磁性和结构性质测量（具体实验手段摘要未明确说明，如磁化率、比热、X射线衍射等），结合对 J = 2 态的多极序理论分析。

papers.title: DC conductivity of tilted Dirac Fermions across the Lifshitz Transition: short- versus long-range impurities
papers.abstract: We theoretically investigate the DC conductivity of two-dimensional tilted Dirac systems subject to short- and long-range impurity scattering. Using the Kubo formalism, we systematically study transport across the subcritical (Type I), critical, and overcritical (Type II) tilt regimes. In the subcritical phase, short-range impurities yield a frequency-independent conductivity that decreases monotonically with tilt. Conversely, long-range Coulomb scattering results in a strongly energy-dependent conductivity governed by a tilt-independent scattering rate. At the Lifshitz transition ($t = 1$), the transport signatures of these impurities diverge fundamentally: the van Hove singularity in the density of states induces a localized conductivity dip for short-range disorder, but a pronounced macroscopic peak for Coulomb impurities. In the overcritical regime, an ultraviolet momentum cutoff is required to regularize the open Fermi surface, leading to distinct behaviors for each impurity type. Notably, the conductivity perpendicular to the tilt direction ($σ_{xx}$) exhibits a cutoff-dependent, non-monotonic peak near $t = \sqrt{2}$ for short-range defects, while it decays monotonically with increasing tilt for long-range scattering. For both potentials, the conductivity along the tilt axis ($σ_{yy}$) increases without bound, revealing extreme transport anisotropy. For long-range impurities, the energy dependence of the conductivity becomes nearly quadratic and linear for Type I and II, respectively. Furthermore, vertex corrections vanish identically at the Lifshitz transition for both impurity types. Finally, we provide a unified geometric framework for these phenomena, establishing the tilt parameter as a powerful knob for engineering macroscopic transport in Dirac materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“theoretically investigate”、“Kubo formalism”、“systematically study”。；研究对象：二维倾斜狄拉克费米子体系在 Lifshitz 相变（从 Type I 到 Type II 倾斜）过程中的直流电导率，特别关注短程与长程杂质散射的影响。
