papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 Lifshitz 相变点（t=1），短程与长程杂质导致截然不同的输运特征：短程无序产生局域电导率谷，而库仑杂质产生显著宏观电导率峰。在过临界（Type II）区，垂直于倾斜方向的电导率（σ_xx）对短程缺陷呈现非单调峰，而沿倾斜方向的电导率（σ_yy）则无界增长，表现出极端输运各向异性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 Lifshitz 相变点（t=1），短程与长程杂质导致截然不同的输运特征：短程无序产生局域电导率谷，而库仑杂质产生显著宏观电导率峰。在过临界（Type II）区，垂直于倾斜方向的电导率（σ_xx）对短程缺陷呈现非单调峰，而沿倾斜方向的电导率（σ_yy）则无界增长，表现出极端输运各向异性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用 Kubo 形式主义（Kubo formalism）系统计算直流电导率，分别处理短程杂质散射和长程库仑散射，并分析顶点修正（vertex corrections）的贡献。

papers.title: Tracking metastable phases by complex Lee-Yang zeros
papers.abstract: Metastable phases (MPs) are energetically unfavorable states typically suppressed in equilibrium phase diagrams. Rather than remaining ''hidden'', we show that they exist in the complex plane of thermal fields, as regions delineated by Lee-Yang zeros (LYZs). We demonstrate this numerically in a toy model with a tunable density of states featuring three Gaussian peaks and in a more realistic periodically driven system. In both cases, as artificial parameters or drive amplitudes increase, the LYZs bounding the MP approach the real axis and split into separated branches, signaling the emergence and stabilization of the MP within the enlarged gap between two adjacent stable phases. In the driven system, the imaginary part of LYZs correlates with drive strength, linking Lee-Yang theory to terahertz matter manipulation. These findings provide a scheme to describe MPs in phase diagram analysis. By viewing periodic drives as complex thermal fields, it also offers a new perspective for understanding and engineering non-equilibrium collective states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：Lee-Yang zeros、complex plane、toy model、numerically demonstrate）；研究对象：亚稳相（metastable phases）在热场复平面中的存在与表征，以及周期性驱动系统中的非平衡态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 亚稳相并非“隐藏”，而是存在于热场复平面中由Lee-Yang零点界定的区域；随着人工参数或驱动强度的增加，这些零点向实轴靠近并分裂，标志着亚稳相在相邻稳定相之间的能隙中涌现并稳定化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：亚稳相并非“隐藏”，而是存在于热场复平面中由Lee-Yang零点界定的区域；随着人工参数或驱动强度的增加，这些零点向实轴靠近并分裂，标志着亚稳相在相邻稳定相之间的能隙中涌现并稳定化。；创新点：将Lee-Yang零点理论拓展到亚稳相的描述，并建立周期性驱动与复热场之间的对应关系，为理解非平衡集体态提供了新视角。
papers.method_zh: 采用具有可调态密度的玩具模型（三个高斯峰）以及一个更现实的周期性驱动系统，通过数值计算Lee-Yang零点的轨迹来追踪亚稳相。

papers.title: Equilibrium spin currents in altermagnet junctions: Josephson-like and anomalous transport
papers.abstract: Altermagnets (AMs) offer a compelling platform for exploring novel spin-dependent phenomena in materials with zero net macroscopic magnetization. In this work, we theoretically investigate the emergence of equilibrium spin currents (ESCs) in two-dimensional AM heterostructures using a tight-binding lattice model. We first study an AM-normal metal-AM (AM-NM-AM) junction and demonstrate that the $σ_y$-polarized ESC exhibits a characteristic Josephson-like behavior, fundamentally governed by the relative angle ($θ$) between the Néel vectors of the two AMs pointing in $xz$-plane. Crucially, we show that replacing the central normal metal with a $p$-wave magnet (PM) induces an anomalous ESC. Analogous to the anomalous Josephson effect, the breaking of spatial inversion symmetry by the PM allows a finite, dissipationless spin current to flow even when the Néel vectors are perfectly aligned ($θ=0$). We establish that this anomalous transport is driven by an asymmetry in the quantum phases accumulated by right- and left-moving electrons undergoing spin-flip reflections. Finally, we show that the critical ESC exhibits pronounced fluctuations as a function of band filling, which we attribute to mesoscopic quantum size effects, including transverse subband quantization and longitudinal Fabry-Pérot resonances. Our findings highlight the potential of altermagnet junctions for designing dissipationless, phase-tunable spintronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“theoretically investigate”、“tight-binding lattice model”。；研究对象：二维交错磁体（altermagnet, AM）异质结中的平衡自旋电流（equilibrium spin currents, ESCs），具体包括AM-正常金属-AM（AM-NM-AM）结和AM-p波磁体-AM（AM-PM-AM）结。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在AM-NM-AM结中，σ_y极化的平衡自旋电流表现出类似约瑟夫森的行为，其大小由两个AM的奈尔矢量之间的相对夹角θ决定；在AM-PM-AM结中，由于p波磁体破坏了空间反演对称性，即使奈尔矢量完全对齐（θ=0），也能产生非零的无耗散自旋电流（反常平衡自旋电流）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在AM-NM-AM结中，σ_y极化的平衡自旋电流表现出类似约瑟夫森的行为，其大小由两个AM的奈尔矢量之间的相对夹角θ决定；在AM-PM-AM结中，由于p波磁体破坏了空间反演对称性，即使奈尔矢量完全对齐（θ=0），也能产生非零的无耗散自旋电流（反常平衡自旋电流）。；创新点：首次在交错磁体异质结中预言了平衡自旋电流的约瑟夫森类行为，并发现通过引入p波磁体可实现类似反常约瑟夫森效应的无耗散自旋输运，揭示了该反常输运源于左右移动电子在自旋翻转反射中积累的量子相位不对称性。
papers.method_zh: 采用紧束缚晶格模型进行理论计算与分析。

papers.title: Wafer-scale Demonstration of High-voltage beta-Ga2O3 MOSFETs with Excellent Uniformity and over 3kV Breakdown Voltages
papers.abstract: This study demonstrates a wafer-scale growth of a 2-inch Si-doped $β$-Ga2O3 (100) epitaxial wafer and the realization of uniform, high-voltage lateral $β$-Ga2O3 MOSFET arrays. The 2-inch homoepitaxial $β$-Ga2O3 (100) film grown by MOCVD exhibit excellent crystalline uniformity with an average rocking curve FWHM of ~27.0 arcsec and a low surface roughness less than 1 nm, alongside a uniform net doping concentration on the value of 4.60 $\times$ 1E17 cm-3. The fabricated MOSFETs deliver a threshold voltage of -31.75 V, a drain-current on/off ratio over 1E9, a specific on-resistance of 126.52 mohm$\cdot$cm2 and breakdown voltage exceeding 3 kV. Statistical analysis across the entire wafer presents good device uniformity, with threshold voltages ranging from -28 V to -36 V, output current densities of 60-75 mA/mm, and a breakdown voltage over 3 kV. These results provide the demonstration using the 2-inch $β$-Ga2O3 epitaxial wafer to realize high-voltage $β$-Ga2O3 MOSFETs with wafer-scale performance uniformity for next-generation power device application.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确描述了材料生长（MOCVD）、器件制备（MOSFET）及电学性能测试（阈值电压、击穿电压等）等实验过程。；研究对象：β-Ga₂O₃（100）同质外延薄膜及其制备的高压横向MOSFET器件阵列。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在2英寸β-Ga₂O₃（100）外延片上成功制备了击穿电压超过3 kV、性能均匀性优异的高压MOSFET阵列，展示了该材料在下一代功率器件中的应用潜力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在2英寸β-Ga₂O₃（100）外延片上成功制备了击穿电压超过3 kV、性能均匀性优异的高压MOSFET阵列，展示了该材料在下一代功率器件中的应用潜力。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断：首次在2英寸晶圆尺度上实现了β-Ga₂O₃ MOSFET的高压（>3 kV）性能与优异均匀性，为大规模功率器件应用提供了实验验证。
papers.method_zh: 采用MOCVD（金属有机化学气相沉积）方法在2英寸β-Ga₂O₃（100）衬底上进行同质外延生长，并制备横向MOSFET器件。通过X射线摇摆曲线、原子力显微镜等表征晶体质量和表面形貌，通过电学测试统计器件性能均匀性。

papers.title: Translationally Covariant Modulated Symmetries: Classification and Goldstone
papers.abstract: Modulated symmetries are global symmetries with a spatially dependent unit of charge, such as the dipole symmetry and the exponential symmetry. We give the generic condition for a modulated symmetry to be compatible with translationally symmetric Hamiltonians, which we define as a translationally covariant modulated symmetry (TCMS). For Abelian TCMSs, we prove that their units of charge can only contain multipole, exponential and harmonic components. Particularly, we classify all the one-dimensional TCMSs by real Jordan normal form blocks. We further derive the generic Goldstone action for SSB phases of continuous TCMSs, by which we show that a broken multipole symmetry gives higher-order gapless Goldstone modes, a broken harmonic symmetry gives gapless Goldstone modes at finite momenta, and a broken exponential symmetry gives no gapless Goldstone modes, modifying the conventional Goldstone theorem.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：classification（分类）、Goldstone theorem（戈德斯通定理）、symmetry（对称性）。；研究对象：凝聚态物理中具有空间依赖电荷单位的全局对称性，即“调制对称性”（modulated symmetries），具体包括多极对称性（dipole symmetry）、指数对称性（exponential symmetry）以及谐波对称性（harmonic symmetry）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 给出了与平移对称性兼容的调制对称性（即“平移协变调制对称性”，TCMS）的一般条件；证明了阿贝尔TCMS的电荷单位只能包含多极、指数和谐波三种成分；揭示了不同TCMS破缺时会产生不同性质的戈德斯通模式：多极对称性破缺产生高阶无能隙模式，谐波对称性破缺产生有限动量处的无能隙模式，而指数对称性破缺不产生无能隙模式，从而修正了传统戈德斯通定理。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：给出了与平移对称性兼容的调制对称性（即“平移协变调制对称性”，TCMS）的一般条件；证明了阿贝尔TCMS的电荷单位只能包含多极、指数和谐波三种成分；揭示了不同TCMS破缺时会产生不同性质的戈德斯通模式：多极对称性破缺产生高阶无能隙模式，谐波对称性破缺产生有限动量处的无能隙模式，而指数对称性破缺不产生无能隙模式，从而修正了传统戈德斯通定理。；创新点：首次系统定义了“平移协变调制对称性”并给出其分类，特别是发现了指数对称性破缺不产生无能隙戈德斯通模式这一违反传统戈德斯通定理的行为。
papers.method_zh: 采用群论与对称性分析，通过实若尔当标准型（real Jordan normal form）对一维TCMS进行了完整分类；利用有效场论方法推导了连续TCMS自发对称破缺（SSB）相的通用戈德斯通作用量。

papers.title: Fragile electron-phonon superconductivity in MnB4 under pressure
papers.abstract: The origin of pressure-induced superconductivity in MnB4 remains unclear. Here we show that it can be explained by electron-phonon coupling once the structural space is mapped using both volume and the Mn dimer distance as key structural parameters under compression. Minor changes in the dimer distance significantly affect electronic and phonon properties, bringing the calculated Tc into agreement with experiment. Our results suggest that MnB4 is a highly responsive system, providing a platform for probing the subtle interplay between structural instability, superconductivity and magnetism.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：electron-phonon coupling（电声耦合）、structural space mapped（结构空间映射）、calculated Tc（计算得到的超导转变温度）。；研究对象：MnB4在压力下的超导电性，具体关注其结构参数（体积和Mn二聚体距离）对超导性质的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: MnB4在压力下的超导电性可由电声耦合机制解释，且Mn二聚体距离的微小变化会显著影响电子和声子性质，使计算Tc与实验吻合。MnB4是一个高度响应的体系，可用于研究结构不稳定性、超导电性与磁性之间的微妙相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：MnB4在压力下的超导电性可由电声耦合机制解释，且Mn二聚体距离的微小变化会显著影响电子和声子性质，使计算Tc与实验吻合。MnB4是一个高度响应的体系，可用于研究结构不稳定性、超导电性与磁性之间的微妙相互作用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过将体积和Mn二聚体距离作为关键结构参数，对压缩下的结构空间进行系统映射，并基于电声耦合理论计算超导转变温度。

papers.title: A Finite-Lattice Model from a Reciprocal Cost Action: Spectral and Reflection-Positivity Properties
papers.abstract: We study the finite-lattice statistical-mechanical model whose nearest-neighbor bond potential is the reciprocal cost $J(e^\varepsilon)=\cosh\varepsilon-1$, selected by the d'Alembert functional equation under the stated regularity and calibration assumptions. The structural inputs are stated explicitly; once they are fixed, the analysis is rigorous mathematics about the bond action $V(Δφ)=\cosh(Δφ)-1$ on finite boxes in $\mathbb Z^3\times\mathbb Z/8\mathbb Z$. Our main result pairs a negative and a positive statement about reflection positivity. For the continuous noncompact model the natural temporal kernel $K(u)=\exp[-(\cosh u-1)]$ fails the Bochner positive-definiteness test: an interval-certified quadrature gives $\widetilde K(3)<0$. Thus the standard Bochner route to Osterwalder-Schrader reflection positivity is obstructed. For a finite-alphabet variant, with field values restricted to a finite symmetric set $Φ=v_0\{-N,\ldots,N\}$, reflection positivity holds whenever the finite crossing-bond Toeplitz matrix $(K_{Φ(v_0,N)})_{a,b}:=K(b-a), a,b\inΦ$, is positive semidefinite. For $v_0\in\{1.2,1.5,2.5\}$, this is discharged by a rigorous diagonal-dominance certificate uniform in $N$, and the associated one-step transfer operator is then positive and self-adjoint in an explicit reflection-positivity inner product. These finite-volume results do not provide a continuum Wightman theory, Osterwalder-Schrader reconstruction, LSZ scattering, or a continuum mass gap.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：统计力学模型、数学分析、反射正性、传递算子。；研究对象：有限格点统计力学模型，其最近邻键势为倒数成本函数 \( J(e^\varepsilon)=\cosh\varepsilon-1 \)，定义在 \( \mathbb Z^3\times\mathbb Z/8\mathbb Z \) 的有限盒子上，场变量为连续非紧致或有限字母集（对称集 \( \Phi=v_0\{-N,\ldots,N\} \)）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于连续非紧致模型，自然时间核 \( K(u)=\exp[-(\cosh u-1)] \) 不满足 Bochner 正定性，因此无法通过标准 Bochner 途径获得 Osterwalder-Schrader 反射正性；对于有限字母变体，当交叉键 Toeplitz 矩阵正半定时，反射正性成立，且在特定 \( v_0 \) 值下可通过对角占优准则统一证明。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于连续非紧致模型，自然时间核 \( K(u)=\exp[-(\cosh u-1)] \) 不满足 Bochner 正定性，因此无法通过标准 Bochner 途径获得 Osterwalder-Schrader 反射正性；对于有限字母变体，当交叉键 Toeplitz 矩阵正半定时，反射正性成立，且在特定 \( v_0 \) 值下可通过对角占优准则统一证明。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用 d’Alembert 泛函方程选择键势，结合正则性和标定假设；通过 Bochner 正定性检验（区间认证求积）分析连续模型；对有限字母模型，利用 Toeplitz 矩阵正半定性条件及对角占优证书，构造反射正性内积并证明传递算子的正自伴性。

papers.title: Coherent control of chirality in Weyl semimetals
papers.abstract: Weyl fermions in inversion-symmetric Weyl semimetals occur in pairs of opposite chirality, leading to symmetric optical responses under circularly-polarised light and a vanishing net photocurrent. Here, we show that tailored two-colour light fields break this symmetry and enable selective excitation of individual Weyl nodes. The interference between a circularly-polarised $ω$ field and a phase-locked linearly-polarised $2ω$ field generates a chirality-dependent redistribution of carriers in momentum space, resulting in a nonzero controllable photocurrent. We demonstrate that both the magnitude and sign of the photocurrent can be tuned via the relative phase and field strength of the two colours, and identify an optimal regime in which chiral selectivity is maximised. Our results establish a general route to optically-controlled chiral charge dynamics in Weyl semimetals using polarisation-structured light.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“we show”“we demonstrate”“identify”等理论推导和预测性表述，未提及实验数据或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：Weyl半金属中的手性（chirality）载流子动力学，具体为利用偏振结构光场对相反手性Weyl节点的选择性激发与光电流控制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将圆偏振的ω光场与相位锁定的线偏振2ω光场干涉，可打破Weyl半金属中相反手性节点的对称性，实现对手性依赖的载流子动量空间再分布，从而产生大小和符号均可调的非零光电流。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将圆偏振的ω光场与相位锁定的线偏振2ω光场干涉，可打破Weyl半金属中相反手性节点的对称性，实现对手性依赖的载流子动量空间再分布，从而产生大小和符号均可调的非零光电流。；创新点：提出利用偏振结构化的两色光场实现Weyl半金属中手性电荷动力学的光学相干控制，为无需外加磁场或静态对称性破缺即可操控手性光电流提供了普适路径。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于两色光场（圆偏振ω + 线偏振2ω）的相干干涉效应，通过相对相位和场强调控光电流，并识别出手性选择性最大化的最优参数区间。

papers.title: Superconductivity in the high-pressure tetragonal phase of UTe2
papers.abstract: Electrical transport and magnetic measurements have been made on UTe2 under pressure P up to approximately 16 GPa to determine the superconducting transition temperature Tc vs P phase diagram in the high-pressure tetragonal phase. Superconductivity emerges near 5 GPa, coincident with the orthorhombic to tetragonal phase transition; in the tetragonal phase, Tc reaches a maximum value of approximately 4 K at 6 GPa and then decreases with P and appears to vanish near 18 GPa. Tetragonal UTe2 has a relatively small upper critical field Hc2(0) $\approx$ 1.2 T at 5.3 GPa, smaller than the Pauli paramagnetic limit, and is orbitally limited with a coherence length $ξ$tetra $\approx$ 16.5 nm. This small value of Hc2(0) favors more conventional superconductivity; in contrast, the large values of Hc2(T) for orthorhombic UTe2 exceed the Pauli paramagnetic limit in all three crystallographic directions and have been attributed to unconventional superconductivity, widely believed to involve spin-triplet pairing. The temperature-pressure phase diagram of UTe2 shows a striking dichotomy: a narrow, fragile, unconventional superconducting region in the orthorhombic phase vs a broad, robust, and more conventional superconducting dome in the tetragonal phase. This dichotomy is consistent with the proposal that U-dimers, present (absent) in the orthorhombic (tetragonal) phase, may play a role in spin-triplet superconductivity of orthorhombic UTe2. In the tetragonal phase, the normal-state electrical resistivity $ρ$(T) exhibits metallic behavior with a knee between 200 and 240 K that depends weakly on P and most likely marks the onset of a transition to a magnetically ordered phase that coexists with superconductivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Electrical transport and magnetic measurements have been made”，即电输运和磁性测量。；研究对象：高压下四方相二碲化铀（UTe2）的超导电性，重点研究其超导转变温度Tc随压力P变化的相图。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在高压四方相UTe2中，超导电性在约5 GPa处随正交-四方结构相变出现，Tc在6 GPa达到最大值约4 K，随后随压力升高而下降，约18 GPa消失。该超导相的上临界场较小（约1.2 T），受轨道极限限制，表现为较常规的超导行为，与正交相中可能涉及自旋三重态配对的反常超导形成鲜明对比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在高压四方相UTe2中，超导电性在约5 GPa处随正交-四方结构相变出现，Tc在6 GPa达到最大值约4 K，随后随压力升高而下降，约18 GPa消失。该超导相的上临界场较小（约1.2 T），受轨道极限限制，表现为较常规的超导行为，与正交相中可能涉及自旋三重态配对的反常超导形成鲜明对比。；创新点：首次系统揭示了UTe2在高压四方相中的超导相图，并明确指出正交相与四方相中超导电性的显著二分性：正交相为窄而脆弱的非常规超导区，四方相为宽而稳健的更常规超导穹顶。这一二分性与U二聚体在正交相中存在、在四方相中缺失的提议一致，为理解自旋三重态超导的微观机制提供了关键实验证据。
papers.method_zh: 采用电输运测量和磁性测量，在高达约16 GPa的压力下系统研究UTe2的超导转变温度与压力的相图，并测量了上临界场Hc2(0)和相干长度ξtetra。

papers.title: Post Annealing Crystallization behavior of RF Sputtered Yttrium Iron Garnet thin films on Si/SiO2 patterned substrates
papers.abstract: Yttrium Iron Garnet YIG (Y3Fe5O12), is a commonly used material for magnonic devices due to its crystal and chemical structure, which makes the material highly ferromagnetic and enables long-range magnon propagation. Magnonic devices were fabricated by depositing a 390 nm thick thin film of YIG, using low vacuum RF sputtering, on Si substrates with a 240 nm buffer layer of SiO2. Two sets of devices were used to study the effect of the Si/SiO2 interface on the YIG. The first set features patterned hole pairs on the SiO2, which was created using fluorine etching. Patterned samples were used as seed nucleation points to study the crystallization behavior. The second set was a non-patterned Si/SiO2 with YIG deposited uniformly on the top. Post-deposition recrystallization of the YIG film was accomplished in a horizontal furnace under O2 atmosphere, between 750 degrees C and 850 degrees C. By patterning devices with a SiO2 buffer layer, depositing YIG via RF sputtering, and subsequently crystallizing the films in a furnace, we establish a fabrication route toward devices that can be suspended. Although further optimization of stoichiometry is required, achieving precise compositional control would enable the realization of fully suspended and released YIG devices that can be transferred onto alternative substrates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：RF sputtering、post-deposition recrystallization、furnace annealing。；研究对象：钇铁石榴石（YIG, Y₃Fe₅O₁₂）薄膜在Si/SiO₂图案化衬底上的结晶行为，以及Si/SiO₂界面对YIG结晶的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过在Si/SiO₂衬底上利用RF溅射沉积YIG薄膜，并在O₂气氛下进行750°C至850°C的后退火再结晶，可以建立一条制备可悬浮YIG器件的工艺路线；图案化SiO₂层上的孔洞可作为种子成核点，影响结晶行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过在Si/SiO₂衬底上利用RF溅射沉积YIG薄膜，并在O₂气氛下进行750°C至850°C的后退火再结晶，可以建立一条制备可悬浮YIG器件的工艺路线；图案化SiO₂层上的孔洞可作为种子成核点，影响结晶行为。；创新点：通过图案化SiO₂缓冲层上的孔洞作为成核点，研究Si/SiO₂界面对YIG结晶行为的影响，并建立了一条可实现YIG器件悬浮及转移至其他衬底的制备路线。摘要未突出说明与已有研究相比的具体性能提升或机制差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用低真空RF溅射在带有240 nm SiO₂缓冲层的Si衬底上沉积390 nm厚的YIG薄膜；通过氟基刻蚀在SiO₂上制备图案化孔洞；在水平管式炉中、O₂气氛下进行750°C至850°C的后退火再结晶。

papers.title: Elusive Exciton Insulator States in 1T-HfTe2: Exciton softening, and Symmetry Breaking by Ab Initio Methods
papers.abstract: Recent experiments have provided evidence for excitonic insulator (EI) states in 1T HfTe2. In this work, we investigate EI states in monolayer, bilayer, trilayer, and bulk 1T HfTe2 using advanced meta generalized gradient approximation (meta GGA) calculations and a model Bethe-Salpeter equation (BSE) approach, together with structural and electronic symmetry breaking analyses. Our results show that both the monolayer and bilayer exhibit negative exciton energies, leading to the spontaneous formation of bound excitons and EI states, whereas the trilayer and bulk display positive exciton energies and do not support EI states. Structural symmetry-breaking calculations show very small in-plane displacements of the Hf atoms from their symmetric positions in the monolayer and multilayers, consistent with experimental observations. Interestingly, electronic symmetry-breaking calculations for the monolayer, performed using a symmetric structure and a hybrid functional, show a pronounced unfolded valence-band feature at the M point and no unfolded conduction-band states near the Fermi level at Gamma, in good agreement with experimental results. Overall, our findings support the existence of EI states in low dimensional 1T HfTe2. The methodology developed here can be readily extended to investigate EI behavior in other related quantum material systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：meta GGA计算、Bethe-Salpeter方程（BSE）方法、对称性分析等第一性原理计算手段。；研究对象：1T-HfTe₂材料体系，具体研究其单层、双层、三层及块体中的激子绝缘体（EI）态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单层和双层1T-HfTe₂具有负激子能量，可自发形成束缚激子并进入激子绝缘体态；而三层和块体材料激子能量为正，不支持EI态。计算结果支持低维1T-HfTe₂中存在激子绝缘体态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单层和双层1T-HfTe₂具有负激子能量，可自发形成束缚激子并进入激子绝缘体态；而三层和块体材料激子能量为正，不支持EI态。计算结果支持低维1T-HfTe₂中存在激子绝缘体态。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用meta广义梯度近似（meta GGA）进行电子结构计算，结合模型Bethe-Salpeter方程（BSE）方法计算激子性质，并进行结构对称性破缺和电子对称性破缺分析。

papers.title: Crystallizing Substrates Drag Supported Nanoparticles
papers.abstract: When a solid support undergoes crystallization, the advancing amorphous-to-crystalline transformation front separates regions of distinct surface energy, creating a moving interfacial energy boundary. A supported nanoparticle straddling such a boundary experiences an asymmetric particle-substrate interfacial energy environment that constitutes a lateral thermodynamic driving force for migration. Here, using in situ transmission electron microscopy to track Pt nanoparticle motion statistically, paired with time-resolved diffraction and 4D-STEM analysis to characterize support crystallization, we demonstrate that propagating crystallization fronts in amorphous AlO$_x$ thin films actively drag supported Pt nanoparticles over long distances. Temporal correlation between the onsets of support crystallization and rapid particle migration, together with 4D-STEM virtual crystallinity maps, establishes that the front drives particle motion. Phase-field simulations confirm that particle-substrate interfacial energy contrast alone sustains particle drag, and identify curvature gradients along the particle surface as the mechanism by which the advancing front redistributes mass and displaces the particle. These results establish a general mechanism by which any propagating surface-energy boundary on a substrate can act as a deterministic driver of supported nanoparticle transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（含计算模拟）。判断依据：in situ transmission electron microscopy（原位透射电镜）、time-resolved diffraction（时间分辨衍射）、4D-STEM（四维扫描透射电镜）等实验手段，并辅以 phase-field simulations（相场模拟）。；研究对象：非晶 AlOₓ 薄膜结晶过程中，支撑在其表面的 Pt 纳米颗粒的迁移行为。具体物理现象为：结晶前沿（amorphous-to-crystalline transformation front）驱动支撑纳米颗粒的“拖拽”运动。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非晶 AlOₓ 薄膜的传播结晶前沿能够主动拖拽支撑在其表面的 Pt 纳米颗粒进行长距离迁移。颗粒-衬底界面能的非对称性是驱动这一运动的根本热力学驱动力，而颗粒表面的曲率梯度是实现质量重新分布和颗粒位移的微观机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非晶 AlOₓ 薄膜的传播结晶前沿能够主动拖拽支撑在其表面的 Pt 纳米颗粒进行长距离迁移。颗粒-衬底界面能的非对称性是驱动这一运动的根本热力学驱动力，而颗粒表面的曲率梯度是实现质量重新分布和颗粒位移的微观机制。；创新点：首次通过实验直接证明并系统阐明了“传播的结晶前沿”作为一种移动的表面能边界，可以主动拖拽支撑纳米颗粒这一普适性机制。摘要未突出说明与以往“颗粒在静态衬底上扩散”研究的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用原位透射电子显微镜（in situ TEM）统计追踪 Pt 纳米颗粒的运动；结合时间分辨衍射（time-resolved diffraction）和四维扫描透射电镜（4D-STEM）虚拟结晶度图来表征衬底结晶过程；并利用相场模拟（phase-field simulations）验证界面能对比度作为唯一驱动力时的拖拽机制。

papers.title: Phase Formation and Thermal Stability of Superconducting Platinum Silicide Thin Films on Silicon
papers.abstract: Platinum silicide (PtSi) thin films are promising for silicon-based superconducting quantum devices due to their compatibility with CMOS fabrication, air stability, and superconducting transition temperature near 1 K. We report a systematic study of PtSi phase formation, microstructure, and interface quality as a function of annealing temperature and duration, characterizing films using grazing-incidence X-ray diffraction, X-ray reflectivity, and electrical transport measurements. Phase-pure PtSi forms within minutes by rapid thermal processing at 600 °C and is stable under extended annealing, while 30 s anneals across 300-600 °C yield equivalent film quality with consistent microstructure and superconducting properties. X-ray reflectivity reveals that interfacial roughening is an intrinsic consequence of the Pt2Si-to-PtSi conversion step rather than a result of elevated temperature or prolonged annealing. These results establish a robust processing window for PtSi formation in silicon-based superconducting device fabrication flows.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“characterizing films using grazing-incidence X-ray diffraction, X-ray reflectivity, and electrical transport measurements”，属于典型的实验表征手段。；研究对象：硅基超导铂硅化物（PtSi）薄膜的相形成、微观结构、界面质量及其热稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在600°C下通过快速热处理可在数分钟内形成纯相PtSi，且该相在长时间退火下保持稳定；界面粗糙化是Pt₂Si向PtSi转化步骤的固有结果，而非高温或长时间退火所致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在600°C下通过快速热处理可在数分钟内形成纯相PtSi，且该相在长时间退火下保持稳定；界面粗糙化是Pt₂Si向PtSi转化步骤的固有结果，而非高温或长时间退火所致。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 掠入射X射线衍射（GIXRD）、X射线反射率（XRR）、电输运测量，以及不同温度（300–600°C）和不同时长（30秒至更长时间）的系统退火实验。

papers.title: Agentic multi-fidelity learning of quasiparticle and excitonic properties
papers.abstract: Many-body GW-Bethe-Salpeter equation calculations are essential for accurate simulations of electronic structure and optical properties in modern low-dimensional nanomaterials. However, these methods are computationally demanding and can exhibit localized numerical instabilities or convergence failures that are difficult to detect within high-throughput workflows. We introduce an agent-guided multi-fidelity framework for correcting GW-Bethe-Salpeter excited-state landscapes in strained MoS2-WS2 bilayers. Across stacking registries, strain branches and reciprocal-space samplings, the workflow identifies spike-like excursions, near-zero-gap collapse and cross-fidelity inconsistencies associated with fragile long-wavelength dielectric screening. A structural agent evaluates calculations by assigning confidence weights and selectively using a small number of high-accuracy reference points. Machine learning models then transfer information across related systems and apply Gaussian process corrections to recover improved quasiparticle gaps and exciton binding energies, with calibrated uncertainty estimates. The approach corrects numerically induced artifacts without erasing physical strain dependence and substantially improves agreement with higher-fidelity references relative to a no-agent baseline. These results show that reliable surrogate learning for excited-state materials requires explicit diagnosis of numerical fragility, not direct interpolation of raw first-principles data points. The proposed framework is readily transferable to other optoelectronic nanomaterials characterized by strong quantum confinement, such as quantum dots, nanoribbons, layered two-dimensional semiconductors, and hybrid perovskite nanostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：multi-fidelity framework、machine learning models、Gaussian process corrections、first-principles data points。；研究对象：应变MoS₂-WS₂双层异质结的准粒子能隙和激子结合能，以及相关的激发态性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种智能体引导的多保真度学习框架，能够识别并修正GW-BSE计算中由数值不稳定性（如尖峰状偏离、近零能隙塌缩）引起的伪影，同时保留真实的应变依赖性，显著提升与高保真参考数据的一致性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种智能体引导的多保真度学习框架，能够识别并修正GW-BSE计算中由数值不稳定性（如尖峰状偏离、近零能隙塌缩）引起的伪影，同时保留真实的应变依赖性，显著提升与高保真参考数据的一致性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但核心创新在于：明确诊断第一性原理计算中的数值脆弱性（而非直接插值原始数据点），并利用智能体引导的多保真度策略进行针对性修正，从而获得可靠的激发态代理学习模型。
papers.method_zh: 采用智能体（agent）引导的多保真度框架，结合结构智能体对计算进行置信度加权评估，并选择性使用少量高精度参考点；利用机器学习模型在相关系统间传递信息，并应用高斯过程回归进行修正，以恢复改进的准粒子能隙和激子结合能，同时提供校准的不确定性估计。

papers.title: Exact mean-field phase diagram for self-avoiding active particles in a lattice
papers.abstract: We investigate motility-induced phase separation in a lattice gas of self-propelled particles with hard-core exclusion, where an internal director biases particle hopping along the lattice coordination directions while undergoing rotational diffusion, together with a thermal-like translational diffusion. Rather than employing stochastic simulations, we adopt a master-equation formalism within a general mean-field approximation. By linearizing the mean-field master equation around the homogeneous stationary state and applying Bloch's theorem, the stability analysis is reduced to a $z$-dimensional tight-binding eigenvalue problem. A perturbation expansion in the wavenumber near $\vk = 0$ then yields the spinodal surface in closed analytical form for six Bravais lattices: linear, square, hexagonal, simple cubic, body-centered cubic, and face-centered cubic. The influence of lattice geometry is shown to enter exclusively through a single coefficient $\mathcal{A}$ which we evaluate exactly for each case. We further show that translational diffusion smooths the interface between the dense and dilute phases. Finally, we determine the rotational probability currents associated with the inhomogeneous stationary states, a distinctive signature of the broken detailed balance underlying active-system dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：master-equation formalism（主方程形式）、mean-field approximation（平均场近似）、stability analysis（稳定性分析）、analytical form（解析形式）。；研究对象：具有硬核排斥（hard-core exclusion）的自推进粒子（self-propelled particles）在晶格上的运动性诱导相分离（motility-induced phase separation, MIPS）。具体研究了六种布拉维晶格（线性、正方、六角、简立方、体心立方、面心立方）上的相图。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过平均场近似，推导出了自避行走活性粒子在六种布拉维晶格上发生相分离的旋节线曲面（spinodal surface）的闭合解析表达式。发现晶格几何的影响仅通过一个单一系数 $\mathcal{A}$ 体现，该系数可被精确计算。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过平均场近似，推导出了自避行走活性粒子在六种布拉维晶格上发生相分离的旋节线曲面（spinodal surface）的闭合解析表达式。发现晶格几何的影响仅通过一个单一系数 $\mathcal{A}$ 体现，该系数可被精确计算。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新点在于：1）为活性粒子相分离问题提供了严格的平均场解析解，而非依赖随机模拟；2）揭示了晶格几何对相图影响的普适性规律（仅通过单一系数 $\mathcal{A}$ 体现）；3）分析了平移扩散对相分离界面的平滑作用，并计算了非均匀稳态下的旋转概率流，这是活性系统破坏细致平衡（broken detailed balance）的独特标志。
papers.method_zh: 采用主方程形式（master-equation formalism）在一般平均场近似（general mean-field approximation）下进行理论分析。通过将平均场主方程在均匀稳态附近线性化，并应用布洛赫定理（Bloch’s theorem），将稳定性分析简化为一个 $z$ 维紧束缚本征值问题（tight-binding eigenvalue problem）。随后在波矢 $\mathbf{k}=0$ 附近进行微扰展开，得到旋节线曲面的解析形式。

papers.title: Redox-Active Halide Materials for Cathode Applications
papers.abstract: Electrochemically redox-active halide (eREAL) materials are an emerging class of materials that combine high Li-ion conductivity with transition-metal redox activity, making them promising candidates for cathode or catholyte applications. As a redox-active catholyte, they could significantly increase the energy density of solid-state batteries. In this work, we perform first-principles calculations on Li-M-Cl (M = 3d transition metals) ternaries to establish such a theoretical foundation for their stability and electrochemical activity. We map the phase stability of eREAL structures with varying metal-to-Cl ratio, transition-metal species, oxidation states, and anion frameworks, and compute cation and anion redox potentials. We find that the high ionicity of metal-Cl bonds elevates cation redox potentials above those of conventional oxide cathodes, but also will promote Cl oxidation and Cl-Cl dimerization at high voltages, which may limit the stability of these materials. Anion substitution effectively tunes both cation and anion redox potentials, with F substitution standing out as a viable route to extend the reversible voltage window. Beyond the anion redox issue, eREAL compounds generally exhibit flat voltage profiles, which potentially poses an electrochemical compatibility challenge when paired with active materials that operate at different voltage values or over wider voltage ranges. Collectively, our study provides a comprehensive analysis for redox behavior of eREAL materials, paving the way for their rational design and optimization in next-generation battery applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：论文研究的具体材料是Li-M-Cl（M = 3d过渡金属）三元卤化物，这类材料被称为电化学氧化还原活性卤化物（eREAL），主要研究其作为固态电池正极或正极电解质的应用潜力。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: eREAL材料中金属-氯键的高离子性会提升阳离子氧化还原电位，但也会在高电压下引发氯的氧化和Cl-Cl二聚化，从而限制材料稳定性。氟（F）替代是扩展可逆电压窗口的有效途径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：eREAL材料中金属-氯键的高离子性会提升阳离子氧化还原电位，但也会在高电压下引发氯的氧化和Cl-Cl二聚化，从而限制材料稳定性。氟（F）替代是扩展可逆电压窗口的有效途径。；创新点：该工作首次对eREAL材料（Li-M-Cl三元体系）的稳定性和电化学活性建立了系统的理论框架，全面分析了其阳离子和阴离子氧化还原行为，并指出了电压曲线平坦性带来的电化学兼容性挑战。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理计算（具体为DFT，摘要未明确说明是否使用+U等修正），系统计算了不同金属/氯比例、过渡金属种类、氧化态和阴离子框架下eREAL结构的相稳定性，并计算了阳离子和阴离子的氧化还原电位。

papers.title: Inverse supersymmetry in finite temperature Bose-Fermi mixtures
authors: Carlos A. R. Sá de Melo
papers.abstract: We investigate nearly degenerate Bose-Fermi mixtures and show that the breaking of generalized supersymmetry (gSUSY) between bosons and fermions, with up to two internal states, manifests itself through the emergence of fermionic Goldstino modes with up to four flavors. In particular, we draw a distinction between typical supersymmetry (SUSY), where bosons have pseudospin 0 and fermions have pseudospin 1/2, and inverse supersymmetry (iSUSY), where bosons have pseudospin 1/2 and fermions have pseudospin 0. In such systems, we highlight that the Goldstino pseudospin is carried by either its constituent fermion (SUSY) or boson (iSUSY). We then distinguish between these two cases by depicting their differing effects on the spectral functions of the bosonic and fermionic atomic species. Lastly, we propose radio-frequency- or microwave-spectroscopy experiments, analogous to momentum (angular) resolved photoemission in condensed matter physics, to measure the pseudospin-dependent spectral functions and detect the emergence of Goldstino modes in mixtures of $^{39}$K and $^{40}$K.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“investigate”、“show”、“draw a distinction”、“highlight”、“propose”等理论分析词汇，未提及实验数据或计算模拟。；研究对象：有限温度下近简并的玻色-费米混合体系，具体涉及具有最多两个内态（赝自旋）的玻色子和费米子，以及其中出现的广义超对称性（gSUSY）及其破缺产生的费米型Goldstino模。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在玻色-费米混合体系中，广义超对称性破缺会导致最多四味费米型Goldstino模的出现；并区分了常规超对称（SUSY，玻色子赝自旋0、费米子赝自旋1/2）与逆超对称（iSUSY，玻色子赝自旋1/2、费米子赝自旋0），指出Goldstino的赝自旋分别由费米子（SUSY）或玻色子（iSUSY）携带。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在玻色-费米混合体系中，广义超对称性破缺会导致最多四味费米型Goldstino模的出现；并区分了常规超对称（SUSY，玻色子赝自旋0、费米子赝自旋1/2）与逆超对称（iSUSY，玻色子赝自旋1/2、费米子赝自旋0），指出Goldstino的赝自旋分别由费米子（SUSY）或玻色子（iSUSY）携带。；创新点：首次明确区分了常规超对称与逆超对称（iSUSY）在玻色-费米混合体系中的不同表现，并指出Goldstino模的赝自旋来源差异可通过原子谱函数加以区分。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，包括广义超对称性（gSUSY）的构建与破缺分析、谱函数计算，以及提出类比于凝聚态物理中动量（角）分辨光电子能谱的射频/微波光谱学实验方案。

papers.title: Length-resolved Operator Growth and Path-Entropy Obstructions to Many-Body Localization
papers.abstract: For the disordered Ising chain with transverse and longitudinal fields, where couplings and fields are drawn from strictly positive distributions, Cao~\cite{Cao} has shown that the moments $μ_{2k} = \|[H,σ^z_0]^{(k)}\|_2^2$ grow almost factorially, $μ_{2k}^{1/(2k)}\sim k/\ln k$, and thus asymptotically at the maximal allowed rate. We generalize this result by resolving the operator norm in support length and show that the weight at length $\ell_k \sim k/\ln k$ already exhibits almost factorial growth, $\|[H,σ^z_0]^{(k)}_{\ell_k}\|_2 \gtrsim (k/\ln k)^k$. This implies maximal spatial delocalization of local operators and, in particular, rules out dynamical locality -- the strongest form of many-body localization -- at any disorder strength. We further establish rigorously a finite-size crossover scale $L\sim (W/J)^2$, where $W$ is the disorder and $J$ the coupling strength. For $L\lesssim (W/J)^2$ numerical studies only access a pre-asymptotic regime. Finally, we identify a structural path-entropy obstruction to perturbative LIOM constructions, based on the almost factorial branching of operator content and independent of resonance effects; the same mechanism strongly suggests ballistic real-time operator spreading, so sub-ballistic or localized dynamics would require a presently unidentified cancellation principle acting on almost factorially many disorder-dependent paths with random amplitudes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“证明”“建立”“识别”，涉及数学推导和理论分析，无实验或计算模拟描述。；研究对象：无序横纵场伊辛链（disordered Ising chain with transverse and longitudinal fields），具体研究其中局域算符的算符增长（operator growth）与多体局域化（many-body localization）的阻碍机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文证明，在无序伊辛链中，局域算符的权重在空间支持长度上呈现几乎阶乘增长，从而排除了最强形式的多体局域化（动力学局域性），并识别出一种基于路径熵的结构性阻碍，独立于共振效应，强烈暗示弹道式的实时算符扩展。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文证明，在无序伊辛链中，局域算符的权重在空间支持长度上呈现几乎阶乘增长，从而排除了最强形式的多体局域化（动力学局域性），并识别出一种基于路径熵的结构性阻碍，独立于共振效应，强烈暗示弹道式的实时算符扩展。；创新点：首次将算符增长的分析从整体矩推广到空间支持长度分辨，并证明最大空间离域化；首次识别出基于路径熵的、独立于共振效应的结构阻碍机制，用于解释微扰LIOM（局域积分运动量）构造的失败。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：通过解析算符范数在支持长度上的分解（length-resolved operator norm），计算高阶对易子（commutator）的矩，并利用严格不等式建立有限尺寸交叉标度 \( L \sim (W/J)^2 \)。

papers.title: Machine learning assisted molecular dynamics of charge-transfer mechanisms at Li/Ga-doped Li$_7$La$_3$Zr$_2$O$_{12}$ (LLZO) interfaces
papers.abstract: Interfacial charge transfer between solid electrolytes (SEs) and Li metal is a key factor limiting all-solid-state battery performance. Conventional density functional theory and nudged elastic band calculations neglect many-body correlations and finite-temperature effects, which can lead to inaccurate activation barriers. Here, we trained moment tensor potentials (MTPs) for garnet LLZO systems (t-LLZO, c-LLZO, and Ga-LLZO) and Li metal, enabling machine-learning molecular dynamics (MLMD) simulations of Li$^+$ diffusion in the bulk and at Li/SE interfaces. We also introduce a residence-time window method that filters out ion rattling and isolates genuine charge-transfer events. The resulting charge-transfer activation energies are low: 167 meV at the Li/Ga-LLZO interface and 200 meV in Ga-LLZO, corresponding to resistances of $\sim \, 10^{-5} \, Ω\,\mathrm{cm}^{2}$. These results indicate that intrinsic Li/Ga-LLZO charge transfer is not rate-limiting. Overall, our findings clarify the fast interfacial kinetics in Li/LLZO systems, and the proposed methodology can aid further interface optimization in solid-state batteries.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：训练了机器学习势（MTPs），进行了机器学习分子动力学（MLMD）模拟，并引入了新的数据分析方法（停留时间窗口法）。；研究对象：锂离子在石榴石型固态电解质LLZO（包括四方相t-LLZO、立方相c-LLZO和镓掺杂Ga-LLZO）体相以及Li/LLZO界面处的电荷转移机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Li/Ga-LLZO界面的本征电荷转移活化能很低（167 meV），对应的界面电阻极小（~10⁻⁵ Ω·cm²），表明该界面处的电荷转移过程并非全固态电池性能的限制步骤。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Li/Ga-LLZO界面的本征电荷转移活化能很低（167 meV），对应的界面电阻极小（~10⁻⁵ Ω·cm²），表明该界面处的电荷转移过程并非全固态电池性能的限制步骤。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新点在于：1）利用机器学习势（MTPs）进行分子动力学模拟，克服了传统DFT和NEB方法忽略多体关联和有限温度效应的局限；2）提出了“停留时间窗口”方法，更准确地从模拟轨迹中识别和量化电荷转移事件。
papers.method_zh: 训练了矩张量势（MTPs）用于LLZO体系和锂金属，并以此进行机器学习分子动力学（MLMD）模拟，研究体相和界面处的锂离子扩散。同时，引入了一种“停留时间窗口”方法，用于过滤掉离子的局域振动，从而分离出真正的电荷转移事件。

papers.title: Detecting Exciton Condensation through Charge Transport in Semiconductor Heterostructures
papers.abstract: Direct evidence of exciton condensation in semiconductor heterostructures remains elusive. Here we propose charge transport of doped carriers as a probe of exciton condensation in transition-metal dichalcogenide heterostructures and identify distinct experimental signatures. First, condensation suppresses the phase space for carrier scattering, leading to a reduction in resistivity, that provides a general diagnostic of exciton condensation. Second, in heterostructures with a tunable solid-state Feshbach resonance, condensate-induced hybridization between doped carriers and trion bound states qualitatively modifies transport. In particular, near resonance, this hybridization yields a negative effective mass and a corresponding sign reversal of the Hall resistivity. These results establish charge transport as a promising route for detecting and characterizing exciton condensation in semiconductor heterostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：propose、identify、yields、establish。；研究对象：过渡金属硫族化合物（TMD）异质结中的激子凝聚现象，以及通过掺杂载流子的电荷输运对其进行探测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 激子凝聚会抑制载流子散射相空间，导致电阻率降低，可作为激子凝聚的通用诊断手段；在具有可调固体Feshbach共振的异质结中，凝聚诱导的掺杂载流子与三子束缚态之间的杂化会改变输运性质，在共振附近产生负有效质量及霍尔电阻率的符号反转。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：激子凝聚会抑制载流子散射相空间，导致电阻率降低，可作为激子凝聚的通用诊断手段；在具有可调固体Feshbach共振的异质结中，凝聚诱导的掺杂载流子与三子束缚态之间的杂化会改变输运性质，在共振附近产生负有效质量及霍尔电阻率的符号反转。；创新点：提出利用掺杂载流子的电荷输运作为探测激子凝聚的探针，并识别出两种不同的实验特征（电阻率降低与霍尔电阻率符号反转），为在半导体异质结中检测激子凝聚提供了新的可行途径。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于激子凝聚对载流子散射相空间的抑制效应提出电阻率降低的诊断方法；结合固体Feshbach共振模型，分析掺杂载流子与三子束缚态之间的杂化对输运（包括有效质量与霍尔电阻率）的定性影响。

papers.title: Phase diagram of magnetic $S^3$ Skyrmions on three-dimensional lattices and the toroidal antiSkyrmion
papers.abstract: Magnetic Skyrmions are planar solitons stabilized by the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction (DMI) and realized in chiral magnets. We study their natural three-dimensional generalization: a sigma model from $\mathbb{R}^3$ to $S^3$ with a four-component magnetization vector, stabilized by a one-derivative term which is a generalized DMI. We utilize two SO(3)-invariant generalized DMIs discovered recently: an "$α$-term" supporting a spherically symmetric hedgehog Skyrmion and a "$β$-term" supporting an axially symmetric Skyrmion that splits into two half-Skyrmions connected by a magnetic string of negative tension, a phenomenon we call "anti-confinement". We derive a cubic-lattice discretization that reproduces both continuum theories at long wavelengths and use Monte Carlo simulations to map the finite-temperature phase diagram. We identify spin-spiral, magnetic-string-lattice, Skyrmion-lattice, and antiSkyrmion-lattice phases, as well as a mixed-topology regime with fractional $S^3$ charges localized at string bends. We find, for the first time in the literature to the best of our knowledge, a toroidal (anti-)soliton of unit charge. Our results establish a theoretical and computational framework for three-dimensional topological magnetic textures in systems whose order-parameter manifold is $S^3$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算模拟）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“利用蒙特卡洛模拟”、“推导立方晶格离散化”、“建立理论框架”，属于理论建模与数值计算结合的研究。；研究对象：三维磁性Skyrmion（斯格明子）的推广——从ℝ³到S³的sigma模型，具有四分量磁化矢量，由广义Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用（DMI）稳定。具体研究了两种SO(3)不变广义DMI（α项和β项）所支持的拓扑磁结构及其相图。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了三维磁性Skyrmion的多种相（自旋螺旋相、磁弦晶格相、Skyrmion晶格相、反Skyrmion晶格相）以及混合拓扑区域；首次报道了具有单位拓扑荷的环形（反）孤子。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了三维磁性Skyrmion的多种相（自旋螺旋相、磁弦晶格相、Skyrmion晶格相、反Skyrmion晶格相）以及混合拓扑区域；首次报道了具有单位拓扑荷的环形（反）孤子。；创新点：首次在文献中报道了三维环形（反）孤子（toroidal anti-soliton）这一新型拓扑磁结构；建立了S³序参量流形下三维拓扑磁结构的理论与计算框架。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导了两种SO(3)不变广义DMI（α项和β项）的连续模型；建立了在长波极限下复现连续理论的立方晶格离散化方案；使用蒙特卡洛模拟绘制有限温度相图。

papers.title: MatMind: A Structure-Activity Knowledge-Driven Generative Foundation Model for Materials Science
papers.abstract: Progress in AI-driven crystal materials science has so far been carried by narrow architectures purpose-built for individual tasks -- graph neural networks for property prediction, diffusion and flow-matching models for crystal generation -- each excelling within its niche yet unable to act as a shared backbone across the full spectrum of materials problems. Generative large language models offer a fundamentally different paradigm, in which structural representation, quantitative prediction, and structure-activity reasoning can be unified within one model, but the materials community has yet to see this paradigm realized at a level competitive with established narrow specialists. Here we present MatMind, a generative foundation model purpose-built for crystal materials science under this paradigm, developed through the coordinated activation of structure-activity knowledge and physics-informed feedback within a progressive training framework -- combining structure-activity knowledge injection, a dual-head architecture that jointly trains language reasoning and numerical regression in a shared representation space, and multi-objective physics-informed reinforcement learning over stability, novelty, and structural diversity. Across three task families, MatMind attains the lowest mean absolute error on energy above hull, bulk modulus, and band gap -- surpassing graph neural network predictors purpose-built for these tasks -- reaches an S.U.N. rate of 65.3% on unconditional crystal generation, and achieves a comparable multiplicative improvement on magnetization-density-conditioned generation, where only 21 positive samples exist within over 600000 training entries. By matching or surpassing narrow specialists on their own ground while operating within a single unified model, MatMind shows that the LLM-based paradigm can serve as a viable backbone for crystal materials science going forward.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（混合类型，包含机器学习模型构建与训练）。判断依据：generative foundation model、progressive training framework、physics-informed reinforcement learning。；研究对象：晶体材料科学中的结构-活性关系建模与生成。具体包括：晶体结构生成、性质预测（如能量高于凸包、体模量、带隙）、以及基于磁化密度条件的晶体生成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: MatMind模型在统一框架下，在性质预测、无条件晶体生成和条件生成三项任务上均达到或超越了专有窄架构模型（如图神经网络、扩散模型）的性能，证明了基于大语言模型的范式可作为晶体材料科学的核心骨干。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：MatMind模型在统一框架下，在性质预测、无条件晶体生成和条件生成三项任务上均达到或超越了专有窄架构模型（如图神经网络、扩散模型）的性能，证明了基于大语言模型的范式可作为晶体材料科学的核心骨干。；创新点：首次将大语言模型范式在晶体材料科学中实现与专有窄架构模型竞争的性能，通过统一模型同时完成结构表示、定量预测和结构-活性推理。摘要未突出说明具体模型架构细节或与其他大语言模型方法的对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用渐进式训练框架，结合结构-活性知识注入、双头架构（同时训练语言推理与数值回归于共享表示空间）、以及多目标物理信息强化学习（优化稳定性、新颖性和结构多样性）。

papers.title: Shear-Induced Structural Convergence but Formation-History-Dependent Yielding in Sequentially Gelled Binary Colloidal Networks
papers.abstract: Multicomponent colloidal gels can exhibit mechanical responses that depend not only on interaction strengths but also on the temporal pathway by which their networks form. Here, we use particle-based simulations to investigate the steady-shear deformation of binary colloidal gels assembled by sequential gelation with tunable delay time and dominant interspecies attractions. Although varying the gelation delay produces markedly different quiescent morphologies, ranging from well-mixed networks to coarse shell-core structures, steady shear drives the systems toward structurally convergent, mixed states as quantified by cluster, connected-component, and coordination analyses. This structural convergence, however, does not imply rheological equivalence. The transient stress response remains strongly dependent on gelation delay and interspecies attraction strength. For moderate interspecies attractions, increasing delay enhances the stress overshoot, particularly at high shear rates. For stronger interspecies attractions, initially heterogeneous gels exhibit two-step yielding at low shear rates, indicating distinct deformation and restructuring processes. These results show that sequential gelation can imprint a persistent rheological memory in binary colloidal gels, even when shear substantially erases differences in common structural descriptors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：particle-based simulations（基于粒子的模拟）。；研究对象：二元胶体凝胶网络，具体研究通过顺序凝胶化（sequential gelation）形成的、具有可调延迟时间和主导种间吸引力的体系在稳态剪切下的力学响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 稳态剪切能使不同初始形貌的二元胶体凝胶在结构上趋于收敛（混合态），但不会消除其流变学记忆——屈服行为仍强烈依赖于凝胶化延迟时间和种间吸引力强度，表现为应力过冲和两步屈服等历史依赖特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：稳态剪切能使不同初始形貌的二元胶体凝胶在结构上趋于收敛（混合态），但不会消除其流变学记忆——屈服行为仍强烈依赖于凝胶化延迟时间和种间吸引力强度，表现为应力过冲和两步屈服等历史依赖特征。；创新点：揭示了顺序凝胶化过程可在二元胶体凝胶中印刻持久的流变学记忆，即使剪切显著抹平了常见结构描述符的差异，屈服行为仍保留形成历史依赖性。
papers.method_zh: 基于粒子的计算机模拟（particle-based simulations），通过调节凝胶化延迟时间和种间吸引力强度构建顺序凝胶化二元胶体网络，并施加稳态剪切变形，结合聚类分析、连通分量分析和配位分析量化结构演化。

papers.title: Stability and thermodynamic properties of bound magnetic polarons in ferromagnetic semiconductors: Beyond the Gaussian approximation
papers.abstract: The formation of bound magnetic polarons (BMPs) is traditionally described using a Gaussian approximation for host magnetization fluctuations. While successful for diluted magnetic semiconductors, this approach fails for ferromagnetic semiconductors like GdN near their Curie temperature Tc, where diverging susceptibility yields unphysical instabilities. We extend the BMP theory beyond the Gaussian approximation by rigorously incorporating cubic and quartic fluctuations of the Ginzburg-Landau-Wilson functional. Two consistent extensions of the Dietl-Spalek framework are presented: (i) a non-local treatment valid for finite spin correlation lengths xi (to first order in lambda) and (ii) a non-perturbative resummation of dominant local fluctuations to a closed exponential form in the strict local limit xi to 0. The latter is justified by a novel polaronic Ginzburg criterion showing that constraint-induced non-localities are suppressed by O(1/N_eff) with N_eff >> 1. Crucially, the theory incorporates variational optimization of the donor orbital size, capturing magnetic self-trapping even above Tc. When applied to GdN (Tc = 55 K), the model eliminates the Gaussian divergence and predicts stable, ferromagnetically ordered BMPs with a non-zero spontaneous spin splitting Delta_0 deep into the paramagnetic phase. For a realistic exchange coupling Jc = 400 meV, the effective polaron ordering temperature reaches T* = 155-160 K. The model further suggests an optimal donor-concentration window near the metal-insulator transition where enhanced dielectric screening maximizes T*. These results establish a microscopic mechanism for persistent BMP-mediated ferromagnetism well above Tc.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Ginzburg-Landau-Wilson泛函、非微扰重求和、变分优化。；研究对象：铁磁半导体（如GdN）中束缚磁极化子（BMP）的稳定性与热力学性质，特别是居里温度Tc附近的临界行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过超越高斯近似的理论扩展，消除了传统BMP理论在Tc附近因磁化率发散导致的非物理不稳定性，预测在Tc以上仍存在稳定的自发自旋分裂，并给出了有效极化子有序温度T*可达155-160 K（以GdN为例）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过超越高斯近似的理论扩展，消除了传统BMP理论在Tc附近因磁化率发散导致的非物理不稳定性，预测在Tc以上仍存在稳定的自发自旋分裂，并给出了有效极化子有序温度T*可达155-160 K（以GdN为例）。；创新点：首次在BMP理论中超越高斯近似，通过引入极化子Ginzburg判据证明约束诱导的非局域性被O(1/N_eff)压制（N_eff>>1），从而在局域极限下获得非微扰封闭解；并揭示了介电屏蔽增强可优化施主浓度窗口以最大化T*。
papers.method_zh: 基于Ginzburg-Landau-Wilson泛函，严格纳入三次和四次涨落项，提出两种扩展Dietl-Spalek框架的方案：（i）有限自旋关联长度ξ下的非局域处理（至λ一阶）；（ii）严格局域极限（ξ→0）下将主导局域涨落非微扰重求和为闭合指数形式。同时引入变分优化施主轨道尺寸，实现磁自陷效应的描述。

papers.title: Polyethylene-based thermo-mechanically recyclable stretchable yarns for circular sustainable textiles
papers.abstract: Most high-performance elastic textiles rely on yarns composed of chemically dissimilar polymers, rendering them difficult to recycle. Here, we demonstrate fully thermo-mechanically recyclable stretchable yarns composed of polyethylene (PE) family materials. Inspired by structure-property relationships in natural materials, we engineer a library of melt-spun PE fibers spanning mechanical properties from elastomeric to functional by tuning polymer crystallinity and chain orientation. These fibers are assembled into core-sheath yarns comprising an olefin block copolymer elastic core and a high-strength PE sheath, forming a helical architecture. The resulting yarns exceed mechanical performance of commercial PET-spandex yarns while maintaining full recyclability. We further show that PE homopolymers and copolymers can be jointly melt-processed and recycled without phase separation or loss of performance. This approach enables stretchable recyclable textiles from fibers with previously demonstrated cooling, moisture-wicking and stain-resisting performance and provides a scalable pathway toward circular garments compatible with existing polyethylene recycling streams.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：demonstrate、engineer、melt-spun、assembled、show、melt-processed and recycled。；研究对象：基于聚乙烯（PE）家族材料的热机械可回收弹性纱线，用于可持续纺织品。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调控聚合物结晶度和链取向，可制备从弹性体到功能性的一系列熔纺聚乙烯纤维，并将其组装成芯鞘结构纱线，其机械性能超过商用PET-氨纶纱线，同时保持完全可回收性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调控聚合物结晶度和链取向，可制备从弹性体到功能性的一系列熔纺聚乙烯纤维，并将其组装成芯鞘结构纱线，其机械性能超过商用PET-氨纶纱线，同时保持完全可回收性。；创新点：首次实现了完全由聚乙烯家族材料组成的可拉伸纱线，该纱线兼具高性能和完全热机械可回收性，且能与现有聚乙烯回收流兼容，避免了传统弹性纱线因化学异质聚合物而难以回收的问题。
papers.method_zh: 熔融纺丝（melt-spun）制备PE纤维；通过调控结晶度和链取向设计纤维力学性能；将烯烃嵌段共聚物弹性芯与高强度PE鞘层组装成螺旋结构芯鞘纱线；进行热机械回收（jointly melt-processed and recycled）实验。

papers.title: Topological Melting of Magnetic Stripes and the Emergence of Macroscopic d-wave Superconductivity in the 2D Hubbard Model
papers.abstract: The exact ground state of the two-dimensional Hubbard model is critical for understanding cuprate superconductivity. Previous numerical studies on narrow cylinders found insulating, static stripes that inherently suppress superconductivity. Here, using constrained-path auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo on isotropic lattices up to $24 \times 24$ sites, we show static stripes are boundary artifacts. The true 2D thermodynamic limit yields a topologically melted fluid of dynamically fluctuating magnetic pockets. Furthermore, we reveal the microscopic real-space origin of cuprate particle-hole asymmetry. Hole doping actively melts the magnetic background, driving a Lifshitz transition that unleashes macroscopic $d_{x^2-y^2}$ phase coherence at an optimal $x \approx 0.150-0.200$. Conversely, electron doping preserves rigid antiferromagnetic domains, confining carriers to narrow fault lines that optimally saturate early at $x \approx 0.100$. By extracting the macroscopic off-diagonal long-range order across both regimes, we perfectly recover the skewed phenomenological superconducting dome. Our parameter-free theoretical curve aligns with empirical Uemura and Božović scaling relations, capturing the underdoped emergence, distinct optimal peaks, the 1/8 anomaly suppression, and overdoped collapse. These results prove that robust d-wave superconductivity is the intrinsic ground state of the pure Hubbard Hamiltonian.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：constrained-path auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo、数值研究、理论计算。；研究对象：二维Hubbard模型，以及其中磁条纹的拓扑熔化与宏观d波超导电性的涌现，旨在理解铜氧化物超导机理。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 二维Hubbard模型的真实热力学极限下，静态条纹是边界假象，实际存在拓扑熔化的动态涨落磁口袋；空穴掺杂驱动Lifshitz相变，在最优掺杂区间（x≈0.150-0.200）释放宏观d波相位相干，而电子掺杂则保持刚性反铁磁畴，最优掺杂更早（x≈0.100）。该模型无参数的理论曲线完美复现了实验中的超导穹顶及多种标度关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：二维Hubbard模型的真实热力学极限下，静态条纹是边界假象，实际存在拓扑熔化的动态涨落磁口袋；空穴掺杂驱动Lifshitz相变，在最优掺杂区间（x≈0.150-0.200）释放宏观d波相位相干，而电子掺杂则保持刚性反铁磁畴，最优掺杂更早（x≈0.100）。该模型无参数的理论曲线完美复现了实验中的超导穹顶及多种标度关系。；创新点：首次在足够大的各向同性二维晶格上证明静态条纹是边界效应，揭示了真实热力学极限下磁条纹的拓扑熔化行为，并直接从纯Hubbard哈密顿量出发，无参数地复现了铜氧化物超导穹顶的完整特征（包括1/8反常抑制等），建立了空穴/电子掺杂不对称性的微观实空间起源。
papers.method_zh: 约束路径辅助场量子蒙特卡洛（constrained-path auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo），在各向同性晶格上计算，最大尺寸为24×24格点。

papers.title: Finite-temperature formation of magnetic plateaus and simplex liquid states on the frustrated ruby lattice
papers.abstract: Geometric frustration in quantum systems can stabilize unconventional phases of matter that avoid traditional magnetic ordering at low temperatures. Here, we observe this phenomenon while mapping out the finite temperature phase diagram of the spin-1/2 Heisenberg antiferromagnet on the ruby lattice with next-nearest-neighbor interactions. Using an infinite tensor network state (iTNS) optimized and measured with belief propagation (BP) and corrections to BP, we observe the low temperature formation of stable magnetic plateaus at various magnetic field strengths. We find these plateaus host a novel `simplex liquid state' -- a disordered phase involving strongly paired spin simplices that retains non-zero residual entropy due to an exponentially large subspace of crystalline configurations. We accurately quantify the energy gap associated with these states and show that, as the temperature of the system is lowered, it does not go through a phase transition to reach them: the heat capacity remains finite and continuous at all observed temperatures. Our work demonstrates how BP-based tensor network techniques provide a powerful route to understanding frustrated quantum magnets at finite temperature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：infinite tensor network state (iTNS)、belief propagation (BP)、有限温度相图计算。；研究对象：自旋-1/2海森堡反铁磁体在红宝石晶格（ruby lattice）上，并考虑次近邻相互作用，在有限温度下的磁相行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在低温下，不同磁场强度下会形成稳定的磁化平台，这些平台对应一种新型的“单纯形液态”（simplex liquid state）——一种无序相，其中自旋形成强配对单纯形，并因存在指数级多的晶格构型而保留非零残余熵。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在低温下，不同磁场强度下会形成稳定的磁化平台，这些平台对应一种新型的“单纯形液态”（simplex liquid state）——一种无序相，其中自旋形成强配对单纯形，并因存在指数级多的晶格构型而保留非零残余熵。；创新点：首次在红宝石晶格上通过有限温度张量网络计算，发现并定量表征了“单纯形液态”这一新型无序相，并证明系统在降温过程中不经历相变即可进入该态（热容在所有观测温度下均有限且连续）。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于置信传播（belief propagation）及其修正的无限张量网络态（iTNS）方法，对系统进行有限温度下的优化与测量。

papers.title: Certified spectral functions from lattice Monte Carlo data
papers.abstract: The Monte Carlo method, applied to lattice quantum field theory, gives access to Euclidean correlation functions with well-understood error bars. Recovering the observables one cares about, such as the spectral density, requires solving an ill-posed inverse problem, usually tackled with heuristics that lose rigorous control of the error. Instead of trying to find the ``best'' spectral density $ρ(ω)$, we ask how small or large linear functionals $\int_{\mathbb{R}^+} G(ω) ρ(ω) \mathrm{d} ω$ of it can be, given the Monte Carlo data and the reflection positivity of the lattice action. This is a convex but infinite-dimensional problem. We show how its dual can be rigorously relaxed into a hierarchy of finite semidefinite programs, solvable with standard solvers and enjoying strong convergence guarantees. The resulting bounds are rigorous even when the relaxation is not tight, and converge quickly to the regime where the error is entirely dominated by Monte Carlo statistics. The method also flags implausible Monte Carlo data, for instance underestimated error bars, through an infeasibility certificate. We demonstrate it on lattice $φ^4$ theory in two dimensions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：论文聚焦于从格点蒙特卡洛数据中恢复谱函数的数学方法（凸优化、半定规划），属于理论框架与算法开发，并辅以二维φ⁴理论的数值演示。；研究对象：格点量子场论中的谱函数（spectral density）恢复问题。具体体系为二维φ⁴理论。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种严格方法，能从格点蒙特卡洛数据中给出谱函数线性泛函的上下界，且误差完全由蒙特卡洛统计误差主导，同时能通过不可行性证书识别数据中的问题（如低估的误差棒）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种严格方法，能从格点蒙特卡洛数据中给出谱函数线性泛函的上下界，且误差完全由蒙特卡洛统计误差主导，同时能通过不可行性证书识别数据中的问题（如低估的误差棒）。；创新点：不试图寻找“最佳”谱密度，而是给出其线性泛函的严格可证边界，且松弛过程具有强收敛保证，即使松弛不紧时边界仍保持严格性。此外，该方法能自动检测不可靠的蒙特卡洛数据。
papers.method_zh: 将谱函数恢复问题转化为凸优化问题，并通过其对偶问题严格松弛为有限维半定规划（semidefinite programs），使用标准求解器求解。该方法利用了格点作用的反射正性（reflection positivity）作为约束。

papers.title: Perturbative Contrastive Physical Learning
papers.abstract: Responses to perturbations are key to understanding physical systems. The ability to contrast such responses by comparing how a system reacts under slightly different conditions provides a mechanism for learning. Here, we introduce Perturbative Contrastive Physical Learning (PCPL), a general framework in which learning emerges from measurable contrasts between physical states produced by controlled changes to inputs, boundary conditions, parameters, or interpreter functions. PCPL unifies and extends prior approaches: Equilibrium Propagation is rooted in contrasts between free and nudged equilibria in energy-based systems, while Frequency Propagation corresponds to contrasts extracted from sinusoidally driven, frequency-demodulated responses. We show that contrast-driven updates can reflect either local sensitivities or global inverse-problem structure, yet do not require centralized gradient computation. Instead, effective learning geometry emerges implicitly from the system's own physical response, allowing learning behavior to arise without an external processor or explicit backpropagation. We demonstrate PCPL in two platforms: (i) spring networks that update bond stiffness using measured displacements and forces, and (ii) continuous-variable photonic circuits trained via x quadrature measurements and finite-difference estimates of the Jacobian. Both platforms successfully learn classification tasks. We further show that a continuous-variable photonic circuit can be trained to implement analog multiplication, illustrating a step toward more autonomous physical learning systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有实验演示）。判断依据：提出通用框架（general framework），并在弹簧网络和光子电路两种平台上进行实验演示（demonstrate in two platforms）。；研究对象：物理学习系统，具体包括弹簧网络（spring networks）和连续变量光子电路（continuous-variable photonic circuits），用于分类任务和模拟乘法（analog multiplication）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种名为“微扰对比物理学习”（PCPL）的通用框架，该框架通过测量物理系统在不同输入、边界条件或参数下的响应对比来实现学习，无需外部处理器或显式反向传播，学习几何由系统自身的物理响应隐式涌现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种名为“微扰对比物理学习”（PCPL）的通用框架，该框架通过测量物理系统在不同输入、边界条件或参数下的响应对比来实现学习，无需外部处理器或显式反向传播，学习几何由系统自身的物理响应隐式涌现。；创新点：PCPL统一并扩展了已有的平衡传播和频率传播方法，提出对比驱动更新可反映局部敏感性或全局逆问题结构，且无需集中梯度计算，学习行为从系统自身的物理响应中隐式涌现。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于微扰响应对比的物理学习机制，统一了平衡传播（Equilibrium Propagation）和频率传播（Frequency Propagation）。实验平台：(i) 弹簧网络：通过测量位移和力来更新键刚度；(ii) 连续变量光子电路：通过x正交测量和雅可比矩阵的有限差分估计进行训练。

papers.title: Learning Dynamics Reveal a Hierarchy of Weight-Induced Layerwise Gram Metrics
papers.abstract: We study feed-forward ReLU networks with fixed readout and quadratic loss. The aim is to rewrite gradient descent not primarily as a dynamics in weight space, but as a collective dynamics closed in terms of fields defined on the training-set space. For a single hidden layer, the weight variables can be eliminated from the activation dynamics, yielding a closed equation for the residuals governed by a collective kernel that factorizes into an input-geometric matrix and a dynamical co-activation matrix. For deeper networks, the residual dynamics retains a clean layer-wise kernel structure. However, from depth three onward, closure requires a hierarchy of weight-induced Gram operators that mediate information transport across layers. Moreover, the conjugate-field dynamics is governed by operators satisfying a backward pullback recursion, of which the weight-induced Gram operators are the first nontrivial instances.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“we study”“rewrite gradient descent”“yielding a closed equation”等表述，属于理论推导与分析，未涉及实验或数值计算。；研究对象：前馈ReLU神经网络在固定读出层和二次损失函数下的学习动力学，具体关注权重诱导的层间Gram度量结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 从深度三层开始，残差动力学需要引入一个由权重诱导的Gram算子层级结构来实现闭合，该结构通过后向拉回递归控制共轭场动力学，揭示了深度网络中信息跨层传递的层级化机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：从深度三层开始，残差动力学需要引入一个由权重诱导的Gram算子层级结构来实现闭合，该结构通过后向拉回递归控制共轭场动力学，揭示了深度网络中信息跨层传递的层级化机制。；创新点：首次揭示了深度（≥3层）ReLU网络中，实现动力学闭合所需的权重诱导Gram算子层级结构，并指出该结构是后向拉回递归的第一个非平凡实例，从而将学习动力学与层间度量结构联系起来。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：通过将梯度下降重写为训练集空间上场的集体动力学，从单隐层到深层网络逐步推导残差与共轭场的闭合方程，并引入权重诱导的Gram算子及其后向递归关系。

papers.title: Sambe Approach to Floquet-Lindblad Open Quantum Systems
papers.abstract: We study driven and open quantum systems described by a time-periodic Lindblad master equation. In closed systems, the stroboscopic dynamics can always be described by an effective time-independent Floquet Hamiltonian; this idea is the basis of Floquet engineering. However, in the presence of dissipation, the existence of an effective time-independent Floquet Lindbladian is not guaranteed due to the non-unitary nature of the evolution. Using Floquet theory, we construct a well-defined time-independent Floquet Lindbladian in an extended Sambe-Liouville space, transforming the initial time-dependent problem to a static and non-Hermitian eigenvalue problem. For harmonic driving, we introduce a matrix continued fraction method to nonperturbatively resum multiphoton processes and construct an effective Floquet Lindbladian acting only on the physical Liouville space. Compared to other high-frequency expansions, this method has the advantage of providing the whole infinite series expansion at once. Using a resolvent formalism, we show how to obtain a spectral Floquet representation of correlation functions of an open quantum system. As an application, we consider a dissipating two-level system in a linearly polarized field and calculate its resonance fluorescence spectrum. Furthermore, we consider a parametrically driven quantum dot with pump and loss for which we calculate its spectral function and current-voltage characteristics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Floquet theory、Lindblad master equation、non-Hermitian eigenvalue problem、resolvent formalism。；研究对象：受时间周期驱动且存在耗散的开量子系统，具体包括：耗散的两能级系统（在偏振场中）、参数驱动的量子点（含泵浦和损耗）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过构造Sambe-Liouville空间中的时间无关Floquet Lindbladian，将含时周期Lindblad主方程转化为静态非厄米本征值问题，并利用矩阵连分式方法非微扰地求和多光子过程，从而获得仅作用于物理Liouville空间的有效Floquet Lindbladian。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过构造Sambe-Liouville空间中的时间无关Floquet Lindbladian，将含时周期Lindblad主方程转化为静态非厄米本征值问题，并利用矩阵连分式方法非微扰地求和多光子过程，从而获得仅作用于物理Liouville空间的有效Floquet Lindbladian。；创新点：提出了一种无需高频展开即可一次性获得完整无穷级数展开的有效Floquet Lindbladian构造方法，并建立了开量子系统关联函数的谱Floquet表示框架。
papers.method_zh: Floquet理论（Sambe空间扩展）、矩阵连分式方法（非微扰求和）、解析延拓（resolvent formalism）计算关联函数的谱Floquet表示。

papers.title: Long-term laser frequency stabilization with an FPGA-controlled scanning cavity
papers.abstract: We present an FPGA-based implementation of a scanning transfer cavity lock (STCL) for laser frequency stabilization, allowing for the simultaneous stabilization of multiple laser sources with respect to a single reference laser by means of a continuously scanned Fabry-Perot cavity. By exploiting the FPGA architecture to simultaneously perform cavity scanning, peak detection, and feedback actuation, we minimize latency and allow independent control loops for several lasers within a single device, offering direct scalability. The system performance is analyzed through heterodyne measurements from short ($<1\,$s) to long ($\sim20\,$hours) timescales. The end-to-end locking performance is validated through atomic spectroscopy of ytterbium atoms in a magneto-optical trap, demonstrating sub-MHz absolute frequency stability over several hours for the stability transfer across $\sim 150\,$nm in the visible-wavelength range. Importantly, we demonstrate a novel fast-scanning approach based on acousto-optic modulator (AOM) frequency modulation, enabled by the low detection latency of our FPGA implementation. This increases significantly the effective locking bandwidth and reduces the intrinsic noise of the system with respect to standard piezo-actuated scanning of the cavity length, allowing to reach sub-$100\,$kHz long-term stability and offering perspectives for laser-line narrowing. Owing to its modularity, low cost and ease of implementation within the open-source PyRPL firmware package for the STEMlab Red Pitaya platform, our architecture offers a compact and flexible alternative to existing STCL and locked-cavity implementations, providing a practical approach to the operation of a state-of-the-art cold-atom experiment without relying on any atomic references for laser stabilization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：FPGA-based implementation、heterodyne measurements、atomic spectroscopy、magneto-optical trap。；研究对象：激光频率稳定系统，具体为基于FPGA控制的扫描转移腔锁定（STCL）系统，用于同时稳定多台激光器，并通过镱原子磁光阱中的原子光谱进行验证。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该系统实现了在可见光波段跨约150 nm的频率稳定转移，达到亚MHz的绝对频率稳定性（持续数小时），并通过基于声光调制器（AOM）的快速扫描新方法将长期稳定性提升至亚100 kHz水平。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该系统实现了在可见光波段跨约150 nm的频率稳定转移，达到亚MHz的绝对频率稳定性（持续数小时），并通过基于声光调制器（AOM）的快速扫描新方法将长期稳定性提升至亚100 kHz水平。；创新点：1. 利用FPGA低延迟特性实现多激光器独立控制回路的直接可扩展性；2. 提出基于AOM频率调制的快速扫描方法，显著提高锁定带宽并降低系统本征噪声；3. 基于开源PyRPL固件包和STEMlab Red Pitaya平台，实现低成本、模块化、易实现的紧凑型替代方案，无需原子参考即可运行冷原子实验。
papers.method_zh: 采用FPGA架构实现扫描腔的连续扫描、峰值检测和反馈控制，结合外差测量（短至<1秒，长至~20小时）评估系统性能，并通过镱原子磁光阱中的原子光谱进行端到端锁定性能验证。创新性地使用AOM频率调制实现快速扫描，替代传统的压电陶瓷腔长扫描。

papers.title: When Do Local Score Models Extrapolate Across Size? A Diagnostic Theory and Benchmark
papers.abstract: Scientific generative modeling often requires size transfer, where models trained on small systems are evaluated on larger ones. While translation-invariant architectures enable this evaluation, we show that architectural locality alone does not guarantee stable size extrapolation. Instead, stable extrapolation is governed by the quasi-locality of the Gaussian-smoothed score. Through Tweedie's formula, far-away perturbations can influence local score components via posterior covariance, meaning a local model succeeds only if its receptive field covers the smoothed score's response range. We formalize this mechanism, proving a size-uniform comparison theorem for local marginals under reverse diffusion. We also introduce Finite-Depth Local Flow (FDLF), a white-box diagnostic benchmark with exact scores, densities, and controllable response ranges. Empirically, we validate the interplay between spatial mixing, smoothed-score quasi-locality, and model receptive fields. Under spatial mixing, the smoothed score remains quasi-local relative to the receptive field, enabling stable extrapolation. Conversely, when spatial mixing weakens, the score's locality rapidly degrades, causing size transfer to fail.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算/实验验证）。判断依据：提出了理论机制（formalize mechanism, proving theorem）、构建了诊断基准（diagnostic benchmark），并进行了实证验证（Empirically validate）。；研究对象：生成式模型（特别是科学领域的生成模型）在系统尺寸迁移（size transfer）任务中的行为。具体物理现象是：模型在从小系统训练后，能否稳定地推广到更大的系统上。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 生成式模型能否实现稳定的尺寸外推，并不取决于模型架构的局域性（locality），而是取决于高斯平滑后的得分函数（Gaussian-smoothed score）的准局域性（quasi-locality）。当空间混合（spatial mixing）存在时，平滑后的得分保持准局域性，尺寸迁移成功；反之则失败。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：生成式模型能否实现稳定的尺寸外推，并不取决于模型架构的局域性（locality），而是取决于高斯平滑后的得分函数（Gaussian-smoothed score）的准局域性（quasi-locality）。当空间混合（spatial mixing）存在时，平滑后的得分保持准局域性，尺寸迁移成功；反之则失败。；创新点：1. 揭示了“架构局域性”并非尺寸外推成功的充分条件，并首次将外推稳定性归因于“平滑得分的准局域性”这一更本质的物理量。2. 提出了一个可解析求解的白盒诊断基准（FDLF），用于精确测试和诊断模型在尺寸迁移中的表现，填补了该领域缺乏可控测试工具的空白。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：利用Tweedie公式将远距离扰动对局域得分分量的影响与后验协方差联系起来，并证明了反向扩散过程中局域边缘分布的大小一致比较定理（size-uniform comparison theorem）。基准构建：提出了有限深度局域流（FDLF, Finite-Depth Local Flow）这一白盒诊断基准，该基准具有精确的得分、密度和可控的响应范围。实证验证：通过数值实验验证了空间混合、平滑得分准局域性与模型感受野之间的相互作用。

papers.title: Revealing Wavelength- and Size-Dependent CO2 Reduction Selectivity via Operando Scanning Photo-Electrochemical Microscopy
papers.abstract: Controlling product selectivity in plasmonic catalysis, particularly in CO2 reduction (CO2R), remains a central unsolved challenge with direct implications for light-driven fuel and chemical synthesis. Here, we deploy quantitative operando scanning photoelectrochemical microscopy (photo-SECM) to provide a direct demonstration that tuning photon energy switches CO2R selectivity through an electronically driven pathway. On plasmonic Au/p-GaN photocathodes, interband excitation (460-560 nm) drives selective CO production while intraband excitation (640-800 nm) favors H2 evolution. By maintaining constant absorbed power across wavelengths and confirming linear power dependence, we isolate the role of hot-carrier energy from photonic and photothermal contributions. Density functional theory calculations reveal that higher-energy interband excitation progressively increases the overlap between hot-electron-accessible states and the CO-producing intermediate, selectively promoting CO over formate, in excellent agreement with experiment. We further show that selectivity is geometrically gated by hot-carrier transport: sub-100 nm nanostructures sustain CO2R activity, while ~300 nm nanodisks suffer transport losses that suppress it, consistent with ab initio hot-carrier transport calculations. Together, these results establish photon energy, carrier transport, and nanostructure geometry as coupled design parameters for plasmonic CO2R selectivity, resolve a longstanding debate on the origin of plasmon-driven selectivity effects, and position photo-SECM as a broadly applicable operando platform for photo(electro)catalysis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验为主，辅以计算）。判断依据：部署了定量原位扫描光电化学显微镜（photo-SECM）进行实验测量，并辅以密度泛函理论（DFT）计算和从头算热载流子输运计算。；研究对象：等离子体催化中的CO2还原反应（CO2R）选择性，具体研究体系为等离子体Au/p-GaN光电阴极。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调控光子能量（波长）可以切换CO2还原的选择性：带间激发（460-560 nm）驱动选择性生成CO，而带内激发（640-800 nm）则倾向于析氢反应（H2）。此外，选择性还受到纳米结构几何尺寸（热载流子输运）的调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调控光子能量（波长）可以切换CO2还原的选择性：带间激发（460-560 nm）驱动选择性生成CO，而带内激发（640-800 nm）则倾向于析氢反应（H2）。此外，选择性还受到纳米结构几何尺寸（热载流子输运）的调控。；创新点：1.  通过保持不同波长下吸收功率恒定并确认线性功率依赖性，首次直接证明了光子能量（而非光热效应）是驱动等离子体CO2R选择性切换的电子路径。
papers.method_zh: 1.  **实验方法**：定量原位扫描光电化学显微镜（photo-SECM）。

papers.title: Constraint residuals, graph posteriors, and determinant-corrected full-space targets in Bayesian inverse problems
papers.abstract: Bayesian inverse problems constrained by state equations are often sampled in a full parameter-state space by penalising the residual, rather than in a reduced space where the state is eliminated. We show that these formulations are not automatically equivalent as posterior measures. For finite-dimensional discretisations of equality-constrained inverse problems, assume the state equation \(c(θ,u)=0\) has a unique solution \(u=G(θ)\) and nonsingular state Jacobian \(\D_u c\). The reduced posterior, its graph lift, and the zero-noise residual posterior are then distinct. A local change of variables shows that an uncorrected Gaussian residual penalty converges, after marginalisation over \(u\), to the reduced density multiplied by \(\abs{\det \D_u c(θ,G(θ))}^{-1}\). Thus algebraically equivalent residuals can define the same feasible set but different limiting posteriors. We derive determinant corrections for unweighted, weighted, and rescaled residual penalties that have the graph-lifted reduced posterior as their hard-constraint limit. The result separates feasibility from posterior calibration: driving the residual to zero is not sufficient for exact sampling of the graph-lifted reduced posterior unless the sampling or correction step targets the corresponding corrected density.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Bayesian inverse problems、posterior measures、determinant corrections、hard-constraint limit。；研究对象：贝叶斯反问题中由状态方程约束的逆问题，具体研究在有限维离散化下，全参数-状态空间采样与约化空间采样之间的后验测度等价性问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于等式约束的贝叶斯反问题，约化后验、其图提升后验以及零噪声残差后验三者并不等价。未校正的高斯残差惩罚在边际化后收敛到约化密度乘以状态雅可比行列式绝对值的倒数，因此代数等价的残差可定义相同的可行集但不同的极限后验。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于等式约束的贝叶斯反问题，约化后验、其图提升后验以及零噪声残差后验三者并不等价。未校正的高斯残差惩罚在边际化后收敛到约化密度乘以状态雅可比行列式绝对值的倒数，因此代数等价的残差可定义相同的可行集但不同的极限后验。；创新点：严格证明了残差惩罚与图提升约化后验在硬约束极限下不等价，并给出了实现等价所需的行列式校正公式，从而将可行性与后验校准分离：仅将残差驱动为零不足以精确采样图提升约化后验，除非采样或校正步骤针对相应的校正密度。
papers.method_zh: 通过局部变量变换推导残差惩罚与约化后验之间的密度关系，并针对未加权、加权和重新缩放残差惩罚导出行列式校正项，使得校正后的残差惩罚在硬约束极限下收敛到图提升的约化后验。

papers.title: An Adaptive Coherent Interferometric Oscillator Based on an Optoelectronic Magnonic Parametric Oscillator
papers.abstract: We study a Mach-Zehnder interferometer (MZI)-based optoelectronic magnonic parametric oscillator (OEMPO) incorporating a YIG-loaded magnonic branch and a tunable phase-shifter branch, enabling systematic investigation of adaptive interferometric oscillator dynamics under distributed phase perturbations. Through analysis of nondegenerate OEPO mode pairs and frequency-pulling behavior, the loop free spectral range (FSR) and effective delay time were quantitatively extracted. Despite the nominally frequency-pinned parametric operation, weak frequency pulling and OEPO mode softening were observed, revealing an additional adaptive interferometric degree of freedom introduced by the MZI architecture. By comparing local and global sampling configurations, we demonstrate that the YIG branch behaves predominantly as a local dispersive resonant subsystem governed by the complex magnonic susceptibility, whereas the phase-shifter branch primarily controls the global interferometric redistribution geometry. Nevertheless, coherent recombination and adaptive regeneration within the loop produce finite cross-coupling between the two branches, resulting in partially synchronized interferometric dynamics and branch-dependent adaptive redistribution. Quantitative complex-Lorentzian analysis further reveals substantial phase-to-amplitude conversion and distinct differences between the OEO and OEPO regimes: the phase-pinned OEPO favors strongly dispersive local YIG response, while the frequency-adaptive OEO exhibits more mixed absorptive--dispersive behavior due to spectral relaxation through frequency pulling. Broadly, the present platform establishes a versatile framework for exploring adaptive nonlinear interferometric physics, coherent phase redistribution, and branch-dependent synchronization phenomena in hybrid magnonic-photonic oscillator systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：study（研究）、demonstrate（展示）、quantitative analysis（定量分析）、platform（平台）。；研究对象：基于马赫-曾德尔干涉仪（MZI）的光电-磁子参量振荡器（OEMPO），具体包含钇铁石榴石（YIG）负载的磁子支路和可调移相器支路，研究混合磁子-光子振荡器系统中的自适应干涉振荡动力学、相干相位重分布和支路依赖的同步现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在名义上频率锁定的参量振荡（OEPO）模式下，观察到弱频率牵引和OEPO模式软化，揭示了MZI架构引入的额外自适应干涉自由度。定量分析表明，相位锁定的OEPO倾向于强色散性的局域YIG响应，而频率自适应的OEO则表现出更混合的吸收-色散行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在名义上频率锁定的参量振荡（OEPO）模式下，观察到弱频率牵引和OEPO模式软化，揭示了MZI架构引入的额外自适应干涉自由度。定量分析表明，相位锁定的OEPO倾向于强色散性的局域YIG响应，而频率自适应的OEO则表现出更混合的吸收-色散行为。；创新点：建立了研究混合磁子-光子振荡系统中自适应非线性干涉物理、相干相位重分布和支路依赖同步现象的通用平台，揭示了MZI架构带来的额外自适应干涉自由度以及OEPO与OEO模式下不同的响应行为。
papers.method_zh: 实验构建了基于MZI的光电-磁子参量振荡器，通过YIG负载磁子支路和可调移相器支路实现分布式相位扰动下的自适应干涉振荡研究。采用非简并OEPO模式对和频率牵引行为分析提取环路自由光谱范围（FSR）和有效延迟时间，并运用复洛伦兹定量分析研究相位-幅度转换。

papers.title: Single plasmon transport in one dimensional nanowire
papers.abstract: We introduce a unified theoretical framework for single-plasmon transport in one-dimensional nanowires, bridging the quantized electromagnetic Green's tensor formalism with effective non-Hermitian Hamiltonian models. This approach naturally incorporates propagating surface plasmon polaritons, high-order modes dissipative channels, and intrinsic losses. We investigate both the stationary regime and the spatio-temporal dynamics of a single-plasmon pulse travelling through an atomic chain coupled to a dispersive nanowire. We analyze modal contributions to reflection and transmission spectra for quantum emitter coupled to a silver nanowire, a configuration proposed as a single-plasmon transistor, and we demonstrate that optimized multi-emitter systems offer significant advantages. In case of one quantum emitter coupled to a silver nanowire at telecom wavelengths, we predict a single-plasmon transmittivity down to 7\% under realistic conditions, and an atomic qubit population of 12\%. Extension to multi-emitter systems using a Löwdin orthogonalization procedure enables a consistent treatment of collective interactions. We show that optimized positioning with just five emitters enhances plasmon modulation, achieving a transmittivity of 2\% but also reduces coupling losses to one-third compared to the single-emitter case. Our results establish a robust foundation for analyzing and designing plasmonic waveguide quantum electrodynamics systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“引入统一理论框架”、“非厄米哈密顿量模型”、“分析”等关键词，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：一维纳米线中单等离激元的输运，具体包括：与色散纳米线耦合的原子链、银纳米线耦合量子发射器构成的单等离激元晶体管系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 优化多发射器系统可显著提升等离激元调制能力：在单发射器情况下，单等离激元透射率可低至7%；而通过优化五个发射器的位置，透射率可进一步降至2%，同时耦合损耗降低至单发射器情况的三分之一。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：优化多发射器系统可显著提升等离激元调制能力：在单发射器情况下，单等离激元透射率可低至7%；而通过优化五个发射器的位置，透射率可进一步降至2%，同时耦合损耗降低至单发射器情况的三分之一。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用量子化电磁格林张量形式与非厄米哈密顿量模型相结合的理论框架，自然包含传播型表面等离激元、高阶模式耗散通道及本征损耗。对多发射器系统使用Löwdin正交化程序处理集体相互作用。

papers.title: Percolation and clustering in ecological communities: A dynamical theory
papers.abstract: Ecological communities with structured interactions exhibit collective phenomena such as percolation and clustering of occupied sites. While these effects have been documented in experiments and simulations, systematic analytical understanding has remained limited. In this paper, we develop a dynamical theory of these phenomena for competitive ecological systems defined on random interaction graphs. We introduce a discrete version of the generalized Lotka-Volterra model that preserves key macroscopic features of continuous ecological dynamics while enabling analytical treatment. Within this framework, we characterize the emergence of percolating clusters and describe the spatial organization of surviving sites. Our analysis uncovers which equilibria can be reached by the dynamics and shows how this dynamical accessibility governs the onset of clustering and percolation. In doing so, our framework complements classical Lotka-Volterra theory by providing a dynamical perspective on the collective organization of structured communities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：dynamical theory、analytical treatment、theoretical framework。；研究对象：生态群落中的逾渗（percolation）与聚类（clustering）现象，具体为定义在随机相互作用图上的竞争性生态系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了动力学过程如何决定哪些平衡态可达，并由此控制聚类与逾渗的涌现，为结构化群落的集体组织提供了动力学视角。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了动力学过程如何决定哪些平衡态可达，并由此控制聚类与逾渗的涌现，为结构化群落的集体组织提供了动力学视角。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 引入广义Lotka-Volterra模型的离散版本，该版本保留连续生态动力学的关键宏观特征，同时允许解析处理；基于随机相互作用图构建理论框架。

papers.title: No need to stay positive: a practical approach to direct numerical simulations of elastic turbulence
papers.abstract: Successfully performing direct numerical simulations of polymeric flows remains a major challenge in computational fluid mechanics. In addition to the velocity field, such simulations must resolve polymeric degrees of freedom, often expressed via the conformation tensor, $\mathbf{c}$, which captures the local stretch of polymer molecules. A key difficulty here lies in maintaining the physical requirement $\mathrm{Tr}\, \mathbf{c}>3$, which is not explicitly enforced by the governing equations.
