Consequently, simulations initiated from physical conditions may silently drift into unphysical states with $\mathrm{Tr}\, \mathbf{c}<0$, indicating a loss of positive-definiteness of the conformation tensor. Existing numerical methods to prevent this are costly, making direct numerical simulations of chaotic polymer flows, such as elastic turbulence, heavily reliant on high-performance computing. Here, we ask whether simulations that violate $\mathrm{Tr}\, \mathbf{c}>3$ can still yield meaningful physical insight into the underlying dynamics. We simulate a model dilute polymer solution driven through a plane channel at low Reynolds number and observe the transition to elastic turbulence. Our simulations exhibit two threshold resolutions: below the first, they become numerically unstable and exhibit a finite-time blow-up; above the second, they maintain positive-definiteness. In between, simulations remain stable and chaotic despite local violations of $\mathrm{Tr}\, \mathbf{c}>3$. Surprisingly, these violations do not affect mid-plane statistics of velocity, its gradients, or polymer stretch, which match results from fully positive-definite simulations. This suggests that resolving flow structures or key flow statistics may not require the extreme resolutions needed to preserve positive-definiteness, potentially lowering computational barriers for studying elastic turbulence.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：direct numerical simulations（直接数值模拟）、simulate（模拟）、computational fluid mechanics（计算流体力学）。；研究对象：弹性湍流（elastic turbulence）中的稀聚合物溶液（dilute polymer solution），具体为在低雷诺数下通过平面通道（plane channel）驱动的聚合物流动。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在直接数值模拟弹性湍流时，即使局部违反构象张量正定性（Tr c > 3）的物理要求，模拟仍可保持稳定和混沌，且中平面（mid-plane）的速度、速度梯度及聚合物拉伸统计量与完全正定模拟结果一致。这表明研究弹性湍流可能不需要维持正定性所需的极高计算分辨率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在直接数值模拟弹性湍流时，即使局部违反构象张量正定性（Tr c > 3）的物理要求，模拟仍可保持稳定和混沌，且中平面（mid-plane）的速度、速度梯度及聚合物拉伸统计量与完全正定模拟结果一致。这表明研究弹性湍流可能不需要维持正定性所需的极高计算分辨率。；创新点：提出并验证了在弹性湍流的直接数值模拟中，允许局部违反构象张量正定性（Tr c > 3）仍可获得有意义的物理统计结果，从而可能大幅降低计算门槛，避免使用昂贵的高性能计算资源来维持正定性。
papers.method_zh: 采用直接数值模拟（direct numerical simulations）方法，模拟低雷诺数下稀聚合物溶液在平面通道中的流动，并观察其向弹性湍流的转变。通过调整分辨率，识别出两个阈值分辨率，分别对应数值不稳定（有限时间爆破）和维持正定性的临界点。

papers.title: High-Efficiency Broadband Mid-Infrared Absorption in Asymmetrically Matched Metallic Meanders: Development of Ti40V60 Alloy based LEKIDs for Mid-Far IR
papers.abstract: Fast, highly sensitive, and broadband detectors operating in the mid-to-far-infrared (MIR-FIR) spectral region are essential for applications ranging from astrophysics to time-resolved spectroscopy using laboratory-based sources and beamlines at Infrared Free-Electron Laser (IR-FEL) facilities. Conventional Lumped Element Kinetic Inductance Detectors (LEKID) achieve high optical efficiency using resonant quarter wavelength (λ/4) backshort cavities. However, this cavity-based approach is inherently narrowband and becomes optomechanically challenging at the mid to far infrared (MIR-FIR) wavelengths. Here, we present a completely backshort-free LEKID absorber architecture that achieves broadband absorption exceeding 50%. The meander absorbers were fabricated from a superconducting Ti-V alloy and characterized using IR radiation from the IR-FEL at RRCAT, India. By illuminating through the silicon substrate and matching the meander's sheet resistance to the silicon substrate's wave impedance, the front-side reflection is strongly suppressed. Simultaneously, the sub-wavelength periodicity of the dense meander inhibits propagating transmission into free space via evanescent wave confinement. This combined mechanism drives efficient Ohmic dissipation within the metallic meander, yielding an experimental absorption efficiency ranging from 50% to 90% across the 12.5-30 micrometer wavelength range. The cavity-free design greatly simplifies the fabrication of the focal plane array while providing the broadband response required for next-generation detectors. To assess the suitability of the Ti40V60 alloy as an active superconducting detector material, a test LEKID resonator was also designed, fabricated, and experimentally characterized.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确描述了器件制备（Ti-V合金）、实验表征（IR-FEL辐射测试）和吸收效率测量。；研究对象：基于Ti40V60超导合金的集总元件动力学电感探测器（LEKID），具体研究其在中远红外波段（12.5-30微米）的宽带吸收特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种无背腔的LEKID吸收器结构，通过匹配金属曲折线的方块电阻与硅衬底波阻抗抑制前表面反射，同时利用亚波长周期结构抑制透射，实现了12.5-30微米波段50%-90%的宽带吸收效率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种无背腔的LEKID吸收器结构，通过匹配金属曲折线的方块电阻与硅衬底波阻抗抑制前表面反射，同时利用亚波长周期结构抑制透射，实现了12.5-30微米波段50%-90%的宽带吸收效率。；创新点：完全摒弃了传统LEKID中依赖四分之一波长背腔的窄带吸收方案，提出无背腔的宽带吸收架构，大幅简化了焦平面阵列的制备工艺，同时实现了中远红外波段所需的宽带响应。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：采用Ti-V合金（Ti40V60）制备金属曲折线吸收器；利用印度RRCAT的红外自由电子激光（IR-FEL）作为辐射源进行光学表征；通过硅衬底背面照射方式测量吸收效率；设计并制备了测试用LEKID谐振器以评估合金的超导探测器性能。

papers.title: Energy Transport in Randomly Coupled Quantum Systems: A Perturbative Approach
papers.abstract: We study energy transport between two quantum systems coupled through a random interaction. The central feature of our approach is to model the coupling as a Gaussian random matrix, which enables a simple and systematic perturbative expansion. In the large-$N$ limit, we derive explicit expressions for the energy transfer rate and heat conductance up to second order in the coupling strength. Using spectral methods and diagrammatic expansions, we obtain the leading- and next-to-leading-order contributions to the energy transfer rate. We illustrate our results through explicit calculations for Gaussian, constant, semicircular, and Gamma densities of states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：perturbative approach（微扰方法）、Gaussian random matrix（高斯随机矩阵）、diagrammatic expansions（图解展开）。；研究对象：通过随机相互作用耦合的两个量子系统之间的能量输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在耦合强度为高斯随机矩阵的模型下，利用微扰展开推导出能量转移速率和热导率至二阶的显式表达式，并获得了能量转移速率的领头阶和次领头阶贡献。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在耦合强度为高斯随机矩阵的模型下，利用微扰展开推导出能量转移速率和热导率至二阶的显式表达式，并获得了能量转移速率的领头阶和次领头阶贡献。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 将耦合建模为高斯随机矩阵，采用微扰展开方法，结合谱方法与图解展开技术，在大N极限下进行解析计算。

papers.title: Helicity-Resolved Spatiotemporal Mapping of Chiral Plexcitons in Helicoids
papers.abstract: Plasmon-exciton hybrids, or plexcitons, offer deeply subwavelength light-matter interactions with versatile pathways for energy redistribution. Incorporating chirality into such systems is particularly compelling, enabling spin-sensitive optical functionality that can operate on ultrafast timescales and within ultracompact volumes. Despite recent progress in chiral plexcitonic systems, how structural chirality and plasmon-exciton coupling determine chiroptical spectra and ultrafast energy flow remains elusive. Here we realize chiral plexcitons by functionalizing intrinsically chiral gold helicoid nanoparticles with molecular J-aggregates. Within a non-Hermitian framework, we trace the microscopic origin of the helicoid chiroptical response and its coupling to the excitonic transition, revealing how the helicity of light selectively addresses distinct hybrid responses. At the spatiotemporal extreme, we find that the gap-localized response not only enhances polarization-sensitive contrast but also strengthens the local hybrid interaction, leading to accelerated ultrafast relaxation. Together, these space-, time-, and polarization-resolved measurements provide a physically grounded and experimentally benchmarked picture of chiral plexcitonic coupling, identifying chirality as a practical control parameter for selectively steering nanoscale energy pathways and dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：realize、measurements、experimentally benchmarked）；研究对象：手性等离激元-激子杂化体系（chiral plexcitons），具体为手性金螺旋纳米颗粒（gold helicoid nanoparticles）与分子J-聚集体（molecular J-aggregates）功能化形成的复合结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了结构手性与等离激元-激子耦合如何共同决定手性光学光谱和超快能量流，发现间隙局域响应不仅增强偏振敏感对比度，还加速了超快弛豫过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了结构手性与等离激元-激子耦合如何共同决定手性光学光谱和超快能量流，发现间隙局域响应不仅增强偏振敏感对比度，还加速了超快弛豫过程。；创新点：首次在空间、时间和偏振三个维度上系统解析了手性等离激元-激子耦合的微观起源，将手性确立为可实际调控纳米尺度能量路径和动力学的控制参数。
papers.method_zh: 非厄米框架（non-Hermitian framework）理论分析；空间、时间、偏振分辨的测量（spatiotemporal mapping, polarization-resolved measurements）。

papers.title: Natural Selection in the Wake of Catastrophe
papers.abstract: Living organisms, from bacteria to humans, are more likely to survive if their traits enhance fitness. In populations well adapted to their environmental niches, natural selection proceeds via rarely beneficial mutations. But when a catastrophe wipes out niche diversity, sudden adaptation often follows. Here, we present a data-validated theory of natural selection in the wake of catastrophe and unveil a simple law that emerges during recovery: the mean fitness relaxes inversely with time, with a prefactor proportional to the number of traits coupled to the post-catastrophe environment. We put our approach to test using experimental fitness landscapes measured following antibiotic administration to E. coli. The resulting mean trait adaptation is not described by gradient ascent on a fitness landscape, instead it follows an algorithm known as Levenberg-Marquardt optimization. Near fitness peaks, evolutionary trajectories are biased against greediness - from an optimization perspective, post-catastrophic selection is optimistic.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有实验验证）。判断依据：提出了一个“数据验证的理论”（data-validated theory），并用大肠杆菌实验数据进行了测试。；研究对象：生物进化中的自然选择过程，具体聚焦于环境剧变（灾难）后的适应性恢复动态。物理上可视为一个高维适应度景观上的优化问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 灾难后自然选择的恢复过程遵循一个简单规律：平均适应度随时间呈反比松弛，其比例系数与耦合到新环境的性状数量成正比。该过程并非梯度上升，而是遵循列文伯格-马夸尔特优化算法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：灾难后自然选择的恢复过程遵循一个简单规律：平均适应度随时间呈反比松弛，其比例系数与耦合到新环境的性状数量成正比。该过程并非梯度上升，而是遵循列文伯格-马夸尔特优化算法。；创新点：揭示了灾难后自然选择与经典梯度上升优化的本质区别，并首次将其与列文伯格-马夸尔特优化算法联系起来，提出了“后灾难选择是乐观的”这一新观点。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与实验数据验证相结合。理论框架为基于适应度景观的优化动力学；实验数据来自大肠杆菌在抗生素施用后的适应度景观测量。

papers.title: Impact of gate-voltage noise on silicon spin-qubit variational quantum eigensolvers
papers.abstract: Quantum computers offer a route to outperform classical methods in tasks such as molecular simulation, motivating hybrid algorithms like the Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) for near-term devices. Silicon spin qubits are a promising platform for scalable quantum computation, but their performance is limited by hardware imperfections -- most notably charge-noise-induced potential fluctuations and static miscalibration of gate-electrode voltages -- which degrade quantum gate fidelities and, ultimately, algorithmic accuracy. Here we develop a hardware-algorithm co-simulation framework for silicon quantum-dot processors that links 3D electrostatics to effective $g$-factors and exchange couplings, and propagates voltage-level noise through realistic control pulses. Using VQE for $\mathrm{H}_2$ ground-state energy estimation as a circuit-level testbed, we study both static scaling/offset errors on the gate-electrode voltages and stochastic fluctuations modeled as random-telegraph noise with tunable amplitudes and switching times. At the gate level, we show that exchange-based two-qubit gates are roughly an order of magnitude more sensitive to these types of noise than ESR-driven single-qubit rotations. Quantum process tomography and Kraus-operator analysis further distinguish coherent and incoherent contributions and quantify the fraction of error that is, in principle, correctable by a compensating unitary. Embedding these noise models into the VQE circuit, we identify regimes of miscalibration strength and noise switching time compatible with chemically accurate energy estimates, and discuss how statistical post-processing based on the full distribution of noisy energy estimates could further improve accuracy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章（关键词：hardware-algorithm co-simulation framework、quantum process tomography、Kraus-operator analysis、noise models）；研究对象：硅量子点自旋量子比特（silicon spin qubits）及其在变分量子本征求解器（VQE）中的表现，具体以H₂分子基态能量估计为测试体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于交换作用的两量子比特门对栅极电压噪声（静态校准误差和随机电报噪声）的敏感度比基于电子自旋共振（ESR）的单量子比特门高约一个数量级；通过噪声建模可识别出实现化学精度能量估计的噪声参数区间。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于交换作用的两量子比特门对栅极电压噪声（静态校准误差和随机电报噪声）的敏感度比基于电子自旋共振（ESR）的单量子比特门高约一个数量级；通过噪声建模可识别出实现化学精度能量估计的噪声参数区间。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用硬件-算法协同仿真框架，将三维静电学模拟与有效g因子、交换耦合计算相连接，并通过实际控制脉冲传播电压级噪声。使用量子过程层析成像和Kraus算符分析区分相干与非相干误差，并量化可通过补偿幺正变换修正的误差比例。

papers.title: Graph Neural Networks for Fast Operator Selection in Adaptive VQE
papers.abstract: Adaptive variational quantum algorithms like ADAPT-VQE construct tailored ansätze by iteratively selecting operators from a pool using gradient-based criteria. While this avoids oversized parameter spaces, repeatedly scanning the full pool incurs a classical cost that scales linearly with pool size-a major bottleneck for systems with long-range interactions or large operator sets. Here, we reformulate adaptive operator selection as a graph-based decision problem and introduce a graph neural network (GNN) policy that predicts the next entangling operator directly from the interaction graph and state-dependent observables. Training data are generated from exact simulations of disordered long-range spin chains, using gradient magnitudes as supervision signals. The learned policy accurately reproduces the dominant structure of the greedy gradient-based selection rule, significantly outperforming heuristics based solely on interaction strength. Integrated into a variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) workflow, this GNN-VQE approach achieves energy errors close to standard ADAPT-VQE while drastically reducing full-pool gradient evaluations. To test transferability beyond spin models, we evaluate the policy on small active-space molecular benchmarks (LiH and BeH_$2$). We find the GNN is highly effective as a shortlist generator: exact rescoring over just a few GNN-proposed candidates recovers near-oracle rollout behavior while searching only a small fraction of the pool. These results demonstrate that adaptive circuit construction contains learnable structure that can be exploited to accelerate variational quantum algorithms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“reformulate adaptive operator selection as a graph-based decision problem”、“introduce a graph neural network (GNN) policy”、“Training data are generated from exact simulations”等，核心为算法设计与数值模拟。；研究对象：自适应变分量子本征求解器（ADAPT-VQE）中的算子选择问题，具体测试体系包括无序长程自旋链（disordered long-range spin chains）以及小活性空间分子基准（LiH和BeH₂）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于图神经网络（GNN）的策略能够准确复现基于梯度贪心选择的算子选取规则，在保持接近标准ADAPT-VQE能量精度的同时，大幅减少全算子池的梯度评估次数；将GNN作为候选算子短列表生成器，仅对少量GNN推荐候选进行精确重评分即可恢复近于“先知”的展开行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于图神经网络（GNN）的策略能够准确复现基于梯度贪心选择的算子选取规则，在保持接近标准ADAPT-VQE能量精度的同时，大幅减少全算子池的梯度评估次数；将GNN作为候选算子短列表生成器，仅对少量GNN推荐候选进行精确重评分即可恢复近于“先知”的展开行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 将自适应算子选择重新表述为基于图的决策问题，引入图神经网络（GNN）策略，利用从无序长程自旋链精确模拟中生成的梯度大小作为监督信号进行训练；将训练好的GNN集成到变分量子本征求解器（VQE）工作流中形成GNN-VQE方法。

papers.title: Injection-rate effects on failure in a fluid-saturated granular fault gouge
papers.abstract: Fluid injection into the Earth's subsurface, performed for energy extraction, waste disposal, and resource development, is known to reactivate gouge-filled faults and induce seismicity, a key hazard in modern geotechnical operations. Nevertheless, the role of injection rate in controlling fault-gouge failure remains poorly understood. Here we present both an analytical theory and coupled fluid--granular (discrete element) numerical simulations to explain this rate dependence. Assuming a pre-stressed gouge-filled fault subject to fluid injection, we derive a pore-pressure diffusion equation with a dilative sink. Its solution predicts a rate-dependent failure criterion, arising from pressure heterogeneity within the layer: slow injection allows pressure to diffuse uniformly throughout the layer, promoting uniform weakening, whereas rapid injection produces strong gradients, leaving distal regions stronger. The numerical simulations confirm the theory and reproduce experimental observations not captured by classical, uniform-pressure effective-stress theory. The framework links grain-scale physics to fault-scale failure and provides quantitative guidance for the design of injection protocols in geotechnical operations involving granular geomaterials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章与计算文章混合类型。关键词：analytical theory, coupled fluid–granular (discrete element) numerical simulations。；研究对象：流体饱和颗粒断层泥（fluid-saturated granular fault gouge）在流体注入下的破坏行为，具体关注注入速率对断层活化与诱发地震的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 注入速率通过控制断层泥层内的孔隙压力不均匀性来影响破坏：慢速注入使压力均匀扩散，导致均匀弱化；快速注入产生强压力梯度，使远端区域保持强度，从而改变破坏判据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：注入速率通过控制断层泥层内的孔隙压力不均匀性来影响破坏：慢速注入使压力均匀扩散，导致均匀弱化；快速注入产生强压力梯度，使远端区域保持强度，从而改变破坏判据。；创新点：提出了一个基于压力不均匀性的速率依赖破坏判据，解释了经典均匀压力有效应力理论无法再现的实验观测，并将颗粒尺度物理与断层尺度破坏联系起来。
papers.method_zh: 推导了带有膨胀汇项（dilative sink）的孔隙压力扩散方程，并进行了耦合流体-颗粒离散元数值模拟（coupled fluid–granular discrete element simulations）。

papers.title: Quantum resource localizability transitions in deep thermalization
papers.abstract: We investigate how quantum resource constraints affect deep thermalization, the emergence of universal local wavefunction distributions from partial measurements of a quantum many-body state. Quantum resources, such as non-stabilizerness (magic), coherence, asymmetry, imaginarity, and non-Gaussianity, are essential for quantum information processing, and constraints on their global abundance can reshape these emergent distributions. To address this question, we develop a unified framework for deep thermalization within general quantum resource theories (QRTs). Our central result is that QRTs fall into two classes: ``smoothly localizable'' (SL) QRTs, where the resource content of local post-measurement states changes continuously with the global resource density, set by the initial state and measurement basis, yielding continuously tunable wavefunction distributions; and ``threshold localizable'' (TL) QRTs, where the local resource content jumps discontinuously from minimal to near-maximal past a critical global resource threshold, producing a sharp transition between a resourceless, ``deep-ergodicity breaking'' distribution and a resourceful, maximally random one. We trace this SL-TL dichotomy to an information-theoretic mechanism, block sharpening: by viewing each QRT as coherence between blocks in Hilbert space, we show that the local resource content depends on the measurement's ability to collapse an initial superposition into a single resourceless block. Our theory is analytically tractable and quantitatively predicts the phase boundaries across all studied QRTs, which we validate with extensive numerical simulations. Finally, we highlight two consequences: a novel magic transition in zero-rate quantum error-correcting codes--previously believed to occur only at finite rates--and new implications for quantum resource certification protocols based on post-measurement state ensembles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：quantum resource theories (QRTs)、information-theoretic mechanism、analytically tractable、numerical simulations。；研究对象：深度热化（deep thermalization）现象，即通过对量子多体态进行部分测量而涌现出的局域波函数分布，以及量子资源（如非稳定化子、相干性、不对称性、虚数性、非高斯性）约束对该分布的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 量子资源理论可分为两类：“平滑局域化”（SL）资源理论，其中局域后测量态的资源含量随全局资源密度连续变化；“阈值局域化”（TL）资源理论，其中局域资源含量在临界全局资源阈值处发生从最小到接近最大的不连续跳变，导致从“深度遍历性破缺”分布到资源丰富、最大随机分布的尖锐转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：量子资源理论可分为两类：“平滑局域化”（SL）资源理论，其中局域后测量态的资源含量随全局资源密度连续变化；“阈值局域化”（TL）资源理论，其中局域资源含量在临界全局资源阈值处发生从最小到接近最大的不连续跳变，导致从“深度遍历性破缺”分布到资源丰富、最大随机分布的尖锐转变。；创新点：揭示了SL-TL二分法及其背后的信息论机制（块锐化）；预测了零速率量子纠错码中一种新的魔法（magic）转变——此前被认为仅发生在有限速率下；为基于后测量态系综的量子资源认证协议提供了新启示。
papers.method_zh: 基于一般量子资源理论（QRTs）构建统一框架，通过将每个QRT视为希尔伯特空间中块之间的相干性，提出“块锐化”（block sharpening）这一信息论机制，并利用解析计算与大量数值模拟验证相边界。

papers.title: Protein Dynamics Beyond Structure Prediction
papers.abstract: The ability to predict protein three-dimensional structures from amino acid sequences is a landmark achievement in molecular biology, where recent deep learning approaches such as AlphaFold are the culmination of decades of work. Yet, the quantitative understanding of how protein sequences give rise to dynamic conformational changes and higher-order assemblies remains unsolved. Folding and conformational states are dynamic, stochastic processes, shaped by sequence, energy, co-translational constraints, chaperone machineries, and the physicochemical conditions of the cellular environment. Recent advances now position the field to move beyond static structural endpoints toward a mechanistic understanding of folding dynamics in living systems. Single-molecule techniques enable time-resolved observation of folding trajectories and intermediate states hitherto hidden by traditional structural biology approaches, while computational innovations and data-driven approaches offer new ways to integrate heterogeneous data across scales. In this Roadmap, we review the current conceptual landscape of protein folding, examine the experimental and theoretical gaps that remain, and discuss emerging strategies that integrate high-resolution measurements with multiscale modeling. We outline a roadmap toward a quantitative and predictive science of protein folding dynamics, conformational kinetics, and macromolecular self-assembly. Realizing this vision would transform our understanding of the dynamics of molecular self-organization, from the folding of individual polypeptides to the emergence of dynamic macromolecular complexes. This will enable rational control of folding and misfolding in health and disease, extend protein engineering principles beyond static structural design, and establish a mechanistic foundation for predictive and personalized interventions in proteostasis-related disorders.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（综述/路线图文章）。判断依据：关键词“Roadmap”、“review”、“discuss emerging strategies”。；研究对象：蛋白质折叠动力学、构象变化、高阶组装以及分子自组织的动态过程。具体包括从单个多肽链折叠到动态大分子复合物形成的物理机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明一个具体的物理结论或发现，而是指出当前领域正从预测静态蛋白质结构转向理解其在活细胞环境中的动态折叠机制，并提出了实现这一目标的路线图。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明一个具体的物理结论或发现，而是指出当前领域正从预测静态蛋白质结构转向理解其在活细胞环境中的动态折叠机制，并提出了实现这一目标的路线图。；创新点：本文并非报告单一新发现，而是作为一篇“路线图”文章，其创新点在于系统性地整合了当前实验（单分子技术）与计算（多尺度建模、数据驱动）的前沿进展，明确指出了从静态结构预测迈向动态机制理解的范式转变，并勾勒出实现蛋白质折叠动力学定量预测科学的具体路径。
papers.method_zh: 综合了多种方法：1）实验手段：单分子技术（用于时间分辨观测折叠轨迹和中间态）；2）计算方法：深度学习（如AlphaFold）、数据驱动方法、多尺度建模；3）理论框架：能量景观理论、随机过程（折叠和构象状态被视为动态随机过程）。

papers.title: Hidden Conformal Boundary Data in Finite-Temperature Stabilizer Entropy
papers.abstract: We study the finite-temperature stabilizer Rényi entropy of the open critical quantum spin chains. At Rényi index one half, this observable probes the distribution of thermal Pauli-string expectation values and can be written as a sum over absolute values of all square minors of a finite-temperature correlation matrix for the transverse-field Ising chain. We show that this exponentially large sum is exactly reducible to a single Pfaffian. The Pfaffian representation reveals a block Toeplitz--Hankel structure and allows us to extract the large-size scaling in several thermal regimes. In the crossover window where the inverse temperature is proportional to the system size, the stabilizer entropy factorizes into a saturated extensive contribution and a universal finite-size scaling function. We find that this scaling function is a level-eight eta quotient, rather than the ordinary free-boundary Majorana thermal factor. The deviation is exponentially hidden at low temperature but controls the high-temperature crossover, where it gives a Cardy-like asymptotic for the Pauli-string expectation-weight spectrum. These results show that finite-temperature stabilizer entropy reveals hidden defect-like conformal data invisible to ordinary thermodynamic probes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：研究、可写为、揭示、发现。；研究对象：有限温度下的开放临界量子自旋链，具体为横场伊辛链中的稳定子Rényi熵。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在温度与系统尺寸成反比的交叉窗口中，稳定子熵的标度函数是一个八级eta商，而非通常的自由边界马约拉纳热因子。这一隐藏的类缺陷共形数据在低温下指数级隐藏，但在高温交叉区控制着泡利弦期望值权重谱的Cardy-like渐近行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在温度与系统尺寸成反比的交叉窗口中，稳定子熵的标度函数是一个八级eta商，而非通常的自由边界马约拉纳热因子。这一隐藏的类缺陷共形数据在低温下指数级隐藏，但在高温交叉区控制着泡利弦期望值权重谱的Cardy-like渐近行为。；创新点：发现有限温度稳定子熵能够揭示普通热力学探针无法探测的、隐藏的类缺陷共形边界数据。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 通过将稳定子Rényi熵（Rényi指数为1/2）表示为有限温度关联矩阵所有平方子式的绝对值之和，并利用Pfaffian表示将该指数级大和精确约化。进一步分析该Pfaffian的块状Toeplitz-Hankel结构，提取不同热力学区间的大尺寸标度行为。

papers.title: Another Legacy of Andrzej Kossakowski: A Self-Contained Derivation of the GKLS Equation
papers.abstract: This note is written for the special issue of OSID dedicated to the 50th anniversary of the Gorini--Kossakowski--Lindblad--Sudarshan equation. Its purpose is not to give a comprehensive historical review, but rather to reconstruct, in a self-contained way, one logical route leading to the GKLS generator. The emphasis is placed on Kossakowski's structural insight: the combination of Markovianity, complete positivity, trace preservation, and the infinitesimal structure of quantum dynamical semigroups naturally leads to the celebrated form of the generator. I also include a few personal recollections of Andrzej Kossakowski, under whose guidance I spent one year as a postdoctoral researcher in 2003--2004.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：self-contained derivation（自包含推导）、logical route（逻辑路径）、infinitesimal structure（无穷小结构）。；研究对象：量子动力学半群（quantum dynamical semigroups）的生成元形式，具体为Gorini–Kossakowski–Lindblad–Sudarshan（GKLS）方程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过结合马尔可夫性、完全正定性、迹保持性以及量子动力学半群的无穷小结构，可以自然地推导出GKLS生成元的著名形式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过结合马尔可夫性、完全正定性、迹保持性以及量子动力学半群的无穷小结构，可以自然地推导出GKLS生成元的著名形式。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有综述或历史回顾相比的具体新意，但强调以自包含方式重构一条逻辑推导路线，并突出Kossakowski的结构性贡献。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与逻辑重构，基于Kossakowski的结构性洞察，采用自包含的数学推导路径，未涉及具体实验或数值计算。

papers.title: All-electron Dynamical Bethe-Salpeter Equation for Extended Systems with Atom-centered Orbital Basis Set
papers.abstract: Solving Bethe-Salpeter equation (BSE) for the two-particle Green's function is the most widely used approach for taking into account the particle-hole (exciton) interaction in electronic excitation in the context of the many-body theory based on Green's function. In BSE calculations, the static approximation to the screened Coulomb interaction kernel is commonly employed. However, when the excitonic character is significant as typically indicated by a large exciton binding energy, dynamical screening effects become non-negligible, rendering the static approximation questionable. Because of the large computational cost due to the dense Brillouin zone integration necessary for convergence, solving the dynamical BSE for extended systems remains a significant challenge, especially when combined with GW calculation for the calculation of quasi-particle energies. In this work, we formulate the plane-wave based effective dielectric function method [Zhang, et al., Phys. Rev. B 107, 235205 (2023)] for the dynamical BSE calculation using atom-centered orbitals as basis functions. We implement this approach in our recently developed all-electron numerical atom-centered orbital (NAO) implementation of BSE@GW [Zhou, et. al. J. Chem. Theory Comput. 21, 291 (2025)] for extended systems. We validate our all-electron NAO-based implementation of the dynamical BSE method, and we then discuss its realistic application to molecular crystal of naphthalene by performing the dynamical BSE@G0W0 calculation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：formulate、implement、validate、calculation。；研究对象：扩展体系（extended systems）中的电子激发，具体以萘分子晶体（molecular crystal of naphthalene）为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在原子中心轨道基组下实现了全电子动态Bethe-Salpeter方程（dynamical BSE）方法，并验证了其在扩展体系中的可行性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在原子中心轨道基组下实现了全电子动态Bethe-Salpeter方程（dynamical BSE）方法，并验证了其在扩展体系中的可行性。；创新点：将原本基于平面波的动态BSE有效介电函数方法推广到原子中心轨道基组，并在全电子NAO框架下实现，从而克服了传统静态近似在激子结合能较大时的局限性。
papers.method_zh: 基于全电子数值原子中心轨道（NAO）基组，结合GW方法（BSE@GW），并采用基于平面波的有效介电函数方法（effective dielectric function method）处理动态屏蔽效应。

papers.title: Mesh Graph Neural Network Framework for Accelerating Finite Element Simulation for Arbitrary Geometries
papers.abstract: Finite element analysis (FEA) is essential for structural design but remains computationally expensive, particularly when evaluating multiple design iterations or load scenarios. Machine learning surrogate models offer a promising alternative, yet most approaches struggle with a critical limitation: generalizing across varying geometries. This work presents a mesh graph network (MGN) for predicting von Mises stress fields in 2D structural components with arbitrary hole geometries. Unlike traditional machine learning approaches that use absolute node coordinates as features, the proposed model builds on existing MGN frameworks that encode node types (e.g., fixed boundary, free surface, hole edge), relative edge features (distance between neighbors), and global features (applied load). This architecture is inherently translation- and rotation-invariant, enabling generalization to unseen geometries without retraining. The MGN was trained on 11 plate geometries under 20 load conditions and evaluated on 7 unseen geometries and 3 unseen loads. In the most favorable case, the model achieves $R^2 \geq 0.97$ on an unseen geometry and unseen load, compared to $R^2 \approx 0.01$--$0.86$ for conventional models (Random Forest, Gradient Boosting , K-Nearest Neighbors) trained on identical data. However, even in less favorable cases, the MGN model still outperforms conventional models. This work extends the mesh-based simulation framework of Pfaff et al. (arXiv:2010.03409) to structural mechanics, demonstrating that graph neural networks can serve as efficient surrogates for finite element analysis across varying geometries.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“machine learning surrogate models”、“mesh graph network”、“finite element analysis”。；研究对象：二维结构部件中任意孔洞几何形状下的von Mises应力场预测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于网格图神经网络（MGN）的代理模型，能够在不重新训练的情况下，泛化到未见过的几何形状和载荷条件，在最优情况下对未见几何和载荷的预测R²达到0.97以上，显著优于传统机器学习模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于网格图神经网络（MGN）的代理模型，能够在不重新训练的情况下，泛化到未见过的几何形状和载荷条件，在最优情况下对未见几何和载荷的预测R²达到0.97以上，显著优于传统机器学习模型。；创新点：将Pfaff等人（arXiv:2010.03409）的基于网格的仿真框架扩展到结构力学领域，证明了图神经网络可作为跨几何形状的有限元分析高效代理模型。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用网格图神经网络（MGN）框架，编码节点类型（如固定边界、自由表面、孔洞边缘）、相对边特征（邻居间距离）和全局特征（施加的载荷），实现平移和旋转不变性。训练数据来自11种板几何形状在20种载荷条件下的有限元仿真结果，并在7种未见几何和3种未见载荷下进行测试。

papers.title: Collective dynamics in a one-dimensional Heisenberg ferromagnetic spin chain
papers.abstract: We investigate the different oscillatory modes, namely, complete synchronization, inphase synchronization, antiphase synchronization and desynchronization in a one-dimensional anisotropic Heisenberg ferromagnetic spin chain consisting of a large number of spins. By solving the associated Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert-Slonczewski equation for the spins we show the simultaneous existence of the above mentioned oscillatory modes in the spins. We observe that when the number of the spins is large the synchronization is lost between the spins; however, we identify that the field-like torque is able to induce synchronous oscillations of the spins in the chain again. We also confirm the agreement of the numerically obtained values of the frequency of the inphase synchronized oscillations with the analytically obtained values.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：求解Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert-Slonczewski方程、数值与解析结果对比。；研究对象：一维各向异性海森堡铁磁自旋链，由大量自旋组成，研究其集体振荡动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在大量自旋组成的链中，同步振荡会丧失，但场类扭矩可以重新诱导自旋链中的同步振荡；同时，同相同步振荡频率的数值结果与解析结果一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在大量自旋组成的链中，同步振荡会丧失，但场类扭矩可以重新诱导自旋链中的同步振荡；同时，同相同步振荡频率的数值结果与解析结果一致。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过求解与自旋相关的Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert-Slonczewski方程，进行数值模拟，并与解析频率值进行对比验证。

papers.title: Retarded Correlators of Charge Transport in a Magnetic Field
papers.abstract: We study charge transport in a magnetized relativistic plasma using kinetic theory within the relaxation-time approximation. By exactly solving the linearized Boltzmann equation in a uniform magnetic field, we obtain an analytic solution for the distribution function in terms of Bessel functions. Using this solution, we compute the full set of retarded current-current correlators and verify the Ward identities. In the hydrodynamic limit, we extract the charge diffusion modes, demonstrating that the transverse diffusion coefficient is strongly suppressed by the magnetic field, scaling as $1/B_0^2$ in the strong-field regime, while the longitudinal diffusion remains unaffected. Furthermore, we analyze the non-hydrodynamic branch cuts in the complex frequency plane, determining their kinematic thresholds and identifying the underlying wave-particle interactions as longitudinal Landau damping and transverse cyclotron damping.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：kinetic theory（动理学理论）、analytic solution（解析解）、Boltzmann equation（玻尔兹曼方程）。；研究对象：磁化相对论性等离子体中的电荷输运现象，具体关注在均匀磁场下电荷流-流关联函数的推迟形式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强磁场极限下，横向扩散系数被强烈抑制，标度行为为 $1/B_0^2$，而纵向扩散不受影响。此外，在复频率平面上识别出非流体力学支割线，其物理起源分别为纵向朗道阻尼和横向回旋阻尼。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强磁场极限下，横向扩散系数被强烈抑制，标度行为为 $1/B_0^2$，而纵向扩散不受影响。此外，在复频率平面上识别出非流体力学支割线，其物理起源分别为纵向朗道阻尼和横向回旋阻尼。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用弛豫时间近似下的动理学理论，通过精确求解均匀磁场中的线性化玻尔兹曼方程，得到了以贝塞尔函数形式表达的分布函数解析解，并以此计算了全套推迟电流-电流关联函数，验证了Ward恒等式。

papers.title: Machine-learning surrogate model for one-dimensional GaAs/Al$_{0.3}$Ga$_{0.7}$As distributed Bragg reflector spectra
papers.abstract: We present a Gaussian-process (GP) surrogate model for the normal-incidence reflectance spectrum of one-dimensional GaAs/Al$_{0.3}$Ga$_{0.7}$ distributed Bragg reflectors (DBRs). A Latin-hypercube dataset of 1500 transfer-matrix-method (TMM) simulations is used to train and evaluate the model. Principal component analysis reduces the spectral output to 26 components; one GP is fitted per component. On a held-out test set the GP achieves RMSE=0.085 and $R^2=0.276$, while a Random Forest baseline reaches RMSE=0.065 and $R^2=0.572$. GP inference is 4.4 ms per spectrum compared with ~308 ms for TMM, yielding a ~70x speedup. Uncertainty calibration shows that the GP 95% prediction band covers 98.9% of test residuals. These results establish a rapid surrogate for DBR design-space exploration.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：Gaussian-process surrogate model、transfer-matrix-method simulations、machine-learning。；研究对象：一维GaAs/Al₀.₃Ga₀.₇As分布式布拉格反射镜（DBR）的正入射反射光谱。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于高斯过程（GP）的代理模型能以约70倍的速度加速DBR光谱计算（4.4 ms vs 308 ms），但预测精度（R²=0.276）低于随机森林基线（R²=0.572）；GP的95%预测区间覆盖了98.9%的测试残差，表明不确定性校准良好。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于高斯过程（GP）的代理模型能以约70倍的速度加速DBR光谱计算（4.4 ms vs 308 ms），但预测精度（R²=0.276）低于随机森林基线（R²=0.572）；GP的95%预测区间覆盖了98.9%的测试残差，表明不确定性校准良好。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用拉丁超立方采样生成1500个转移矩阵法（TMM）模拟数据集；通过主成分分析（PCA）将光谱输出降维至26个主成分，并对每个主成分分别拟合一个高斯过程（GP）模型；同时以随机森林（Random Forest）作为基线对比。

papers.title: Pointwise Complexity for Gaussian Fields: Upper Envelopes, Algorithmic Lower Bounds, and Separation
papers.abstract: We prove a variance-aware pointwise majorizing-measure theorem for centered Gaussian processes. Classical generic chaining characterizes the scalar quantity $\mathbb E\sup_{x\in T}X_x$; the theorem here gives a simultaneous high-probability envelope for the entire field. For an ambient prior $μ$, the envelope at $x$ is governed by a pointwise Fernique-Talagrand functional \[Φ_μ(x):=\int_0^{4σ(x)}\sqrt{\log\frac{1}{μ(B_d(x,\varepsilon))}}\,d\varepsilon,\] together with the corresponding Gaussian tail term. The theorem provides a reusable field-level refinement of classical generic chaining and a Gaussian-process counterpart of pointwise empirical-process bounds for deep neural networks. We also record a Bayesian algorithmic lower envelope from the interactive Fano/data-processing principle. For a known prior $π$, an observation channel, and a concrete estimator $\widehat t(Y)$, the lower bound is expressed through the exact ghost small-ball mass $\mathbb E_{Y\sim Q}π(B_d(\widehat t(Y),Δ))$, rather than a worst-case covering number. In Gaussian location experiments, comparison decoders convert Bayes location error into lower bounds on decision-aligned Gaussian ranges. We then construct an elementary weighted-basis example separating the usual Fano relaxation for a fixed prior, the Bayesian algorithmic lower envelope, the pointwise Gaussian envelope on the selected subatlas, and the full-class minimax risk/global Gaussian scale. Together, these results show that algorithmic lower bounds provide local-geometric certificates of pointwise complexity for fixed estimators in overparameterized ambient classes, precisely in regimes where classical minimax theory becomes either too coarse or oracle-dependent.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：prove（证明）、theorem（定理）、characterizes（刻画）、bound（界）、principle（原理）。；研究对象：高斯随机过程（Gaussian processes）的逐点复杂度（pointwise complexity），具体涉及随机场的上包络（upper envelopes）、算法下界（algorithmic lower bounds）以及分离性（separation）。属于概率论与统计学习理论在凝聚态物理中随机场模型的应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了一个方差感知的逐点主测度定理（variance-aware pointwise majorizing-measure theorem），该定理为高斯过程提供了同时高概率的逐点包络，其形式由Fernique-Talagrand泛函给出。同时，通过交互式Fano/数据处理原理得到了贝叶斯算法下界，该下界通过精确的鬼小质量（ghost small-ball mass）表达，而非最坏情况覆盖数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了一个方差感知的逐点主测度定理（variance-aware pointwise majorizing-measure theorem），该定理为高斯过程提供了同时高概率的逐点包络，其形式由Fernique-Talagrand泛函给出。同时，通过交互式Fano/数据处理原理得到了贝叶斯算法下界，该下界通过精确的鬼小质量（ghost small-ball mass）表达，而非最坏情况覆盖数。；创新点：将经典泛函链从标量期望推广到同时高概率的逐点场包络，并建立了高斯过程与深度神经网络逐点经验过程界的对应关系。同时，提出了基于精确鬼小质量的贝叶斯算法下界，替代了传统基于最坏情况覆盖数的Fano下界，从而在过参数化环境中为固定估计器提供了局部几何的逐点复杂度证书。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导。主要框架包括：经典泛函链（generic chaining）的逐点精化、Fernique-Talagrand型泛函、交互式Fano/数据处理原理、以及基于比较解码器（comparison decoders）的贝叶斯位置误差下界转换。通过构造加权基（weighted-basis）示例，对比了Fano松弛、贝叶斯算法下界、逐点高斯包络和全局极小极大风险/高斯尺度。

papers.title: Mathematical crystal chemistry: A formal theory for crystal structure prediction by generalized disjunctive programming
papers.abstract: Inorganic structural chemistry leads naturally to a theory for crystal structure prediction formalized by a generalized disjunctive programming (GDP), which is formulated using continuous and Boolean variables to involve the algebraic equations, disjunctions, and logic propositions. Since the feasibilities of continuous variables change drastically depending on Boolean variables and vice versa, iterative optimization of continuous and Boolean variables efficiently transforms a randomly generated initial structure into an optimal solution. Boolean variables are introduced to elucidate the ``combinatorial backbone'' of the original continuous optimization problem, which corresponds to the graphs describing crystal structures with clear chemical meanings. Since many subgraphs are discovered in numerous graphs generated through structural optimizations, on-the-fly learning of the feasibilities of them accelerates the discovery of the optimal solutions. This theory enables designing a wide variety of crystal structures with small computations based on only the atomic radii and feasible coordination numbers of each atom.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：formal theory、generalized disjunctive programming (GDP)、continuous and Boolean variables、algebraic equations。；研究对象：晶体结构预测的形式化理论，不针对特定化合物，而是提出一种基于数学晶体化学的通用框架。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过广义析取规划（GDP）将晶体结构预测问题形式化为连续变量与布尔变量的联合优化，并利用布尔变量揭示晶体结构的“组合骨架”，从而仅基于原子半径和可行配位数即可高效设计多种晶体结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过广义析取规划（GDP）将晶体结构预测问题形式化为连续变量与布尔变量的联合优化，并利用布尔变量揭示晶体结构的“组合骨架”，从而仅基于原子半径和可行配位数即可高效设计多种晶体结构。；创新点：将晶体结构预测问题转化为GDP形式，引入布尔变量刻画晶体结构的化学意义明确的组合骨架，并通过在线学习子图可行性加速优化过程。摘要未突出说明与传统方法（如遗传算法、粒子群优化等）的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 广义析取规划（GDP）理论框架，结合连续变量与布尔变量的迭代优化，以及在线学习（on-the-fly learning）子图可行性以加速最优解发现。

papers.title: An ultra-wide-bandgap semiconductor photodetector for linear measurement of bright sub-bandgap light
papers.abstract: Semiconductor photodetectors are conventionally optimized for sensing weak optical signals, and they typically saturate at low-to-moderate light intensity. Here, we demonstrate sub-bandgap AlN photodetectors that exhibit non-saturating linear response to ultra-bright blue light exceeding 40 $\mathrm{W/cm^2}$. The photodetector further shows undistorted linear response at elevated temperature, up to at least 300 $\mathrm{^\circ C}$. This exceptional performance originates from photoresponse mediated by point defects with energy deep in the bandgap ("deep levels") at the metal-AlN Schottky junction. Through dopant design and contact engineering, we demonstrate that a narrow space charge region is essential for enabling ultra-bright light detection and accurate measurement. These results establish a strategy for engineering ultra-wide bandgap (UWBG) semiconductor devices for reliable operation in extreme conditions to meet emerging needs in industrial process control, thermal and nuclear power generation, and aeronautics and spaceflight.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了器件制备（“dopant design and contact engineering”）和性能测试（“demonstrate...photodetectors that exhibit...”），属于实验研究。；研究对象：基于氮化铝（AlN）的亚带隙光电探测器，具体研究其在高强度蓝光照射下的线性响应行为，以及点缺陷（深能级）和金属-AlN肖特基结的物理机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过利用金属-AlN肖特基结中深能级点缺陷介导的光电响应，并设计窄空间电荷区，实现了对超过40 W/cm²的超亮蓝光的非饱和线性测量，且在高达300°C的温度下仍保持无失真线性响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过利用金属-AlN肖特基结中深能级点缺陷介导的光电响应，并设计窄空间电荷区，实现了对超过40 W/cm²的超亮蓝光的非饱和线性测量，且在高达300°C的温度下仍保持无失真线性响应。；创新点：突破了传统半导体光电探测器在低至中等光强下饱和的限制，首次实现了超宽禁带半导体（UWBG）对超亮亚带隙光的线性测量，并验证了其在极端高温环境下的可靠性。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：掺杂设计（dopant design）、接触工程（contact engineering）以调控肖特基结空间电荷区宽度；器件性能测试（光电流响应随光强和温度的变化）。

papers.title: Floquet Entanglement Generation in Parametrically Driven Coupled Superconducting Qubits
papers.abstract: We investigate the dynamical generation of entanglement in a system of two superconducting qubits coupled through a parametrically driven longitudinal interaction. Using Floquet theory and exact numerical simulations, we analyze the time evolution of the system initialized in a separable ground state. Our results reveal a nontrivial mechanism for entanglement generation, fundamentally distinct from the conventional resonant excitation to an entangled eigenstate. We show that this mechanism emerges when two initially separable eigenstates are mixed by the periodic driving under multiphoton resonance conditions. Since the effect cannot be captured within a standard rotating-wave approximation, we employ generalized Van Vleck near-degenerate perturbation theory to derive an effective analytical description. Within this framework, we demonstrate that the sustained entanglement originates from the hybridization of the dominant Floquet states, namely those with the largest overlap with the initial ground state. Furthermore, the degree of entanglement can be efficiently controlled through the driving amplitude. In particular, for specific amplitudes, the entanglement is fully suppressed. We term this phenomenon as coherent destruction of entanglement.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：Floquet theory, exact numerical simulations, generalized Van Vleck near-degenerate perturbation theory, effective analytical description）；研究对象：两个通过参量驱动纵向相互作用耦合的超导量子比特系统中的纠缠动力学生成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了一种与常规共振激发到纠缠本征态截然不同的纠缠生成机制：在周期性驱动下，两个原本可分离的本征态在多光子共振条件下发生混合，从而产生持续纠缠；并且通过调节驱动振幅可有效控制纠缠度，甚至实现纠缠的完全抑制（相干破坏纠缠）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了一种与常规共振激发到纠缠本征态截然不同的纠缠生成机制：在周期性驱动下，两个原本可分离的本征态在多光子共振条件下发生混合，从而产生持续纠缠；并且通过调节驱动振幅可有效控制纠缠度，甚至实现纠缠的完全抑制（相干破坏纠缠）。；创新点：发现了在参量驱动超导量子比特中一种非共振激发的纠缠生成新机制，并首次提出“相干破坏纠缠”现象，即通过特定驱动振幅完全抑制纠缠。
papers.method_zh: 采用Floquet理论结合精确数值模拟分析系统的时间演化；使用广义Van Vleck近简并微扰理论推导有效的解析描述，以捕捉标准旋波近似无法描述的效应。

papers.title: REM universality and Poisson-Dirichlet Gibbs weights for linear random energy
papers.abstract: We study the Hamiltonian $H_n(h,σ)=\sum_{i=1}^n h_i(σ_i-m), $ where $(h_i)$ are i.i.d.\ real random variables and $(σ_i)$ are i.i.d.\ Ising spins. We consider the energy levels obtained after an independent thinning that retains an exponential number of configurations ($e^{O(n)}$). We prove that, after an $(h_i)$-dependent centering, the resulting point process converges in distribution to a Poisson point process with exponential intensity. Thus, the energy levels asymptotically has the one of the Random Energy Model (REM). Our results extend previous ones, where REM universality for this model was established only either for energy fluctuations of order $e^{-O(n)}$ or for $e^{o(\sqrt n)}$ randomly selected configurations. We also identify the limiting Gibbs weights, which converge to a Poisson--Dirichlet law, and the quenched free energy, which exhibits a freezing transition at $β=\tildeλ$. The proofs are presented here in compressed form; full details are given in the companion preprint.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“We prove”“converges in distribution”“identify the limiting Gibbs weights”等理论证明与极限分析术语，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：线性随机能量模型（linear random energy model），具体为哈密顿量 \( H_n(h,\sigma)=\sum_{i=1}^n h_i(\sigma_i-m) \)，其中 \( h_i \) 为独立同分布实随机变量，\( \sigma_i \) 为独立同分布伊辛自旋。研究其能级分布、吉布斯权重与淬火自由能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 经过与 \( h_i \) 相关的中心化处理后，对指数数量（\( e^{O(n)} \)）的随机构型进行独立稀疏化后，能级点过程在分布上收敛到具有指数强度的泊松点过程，即与随机能量模型（REM）的能级渐近一致。同时，极限吉布斯权重服从泊松-狄利克雷分布，淬火自由能在 \( \beta = \tilde{\lambda} \) 处出现冻结相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：经过与 \( h_i \) 相关的中心化处理后，对指数数量（\( e^{O(n)} \)）的随机构型进行独立稀疏化后，能级点过程在分布上收敛到具有指数强度的泊松点过程，即与随机能量模型（REM）的能级渐近一致。同时，极限吉布斯权重服从泊松-狄利克雷分布，淬火自由能在 \( \beta = \tilde{\lambda} \) 处出现冻结相变。；创新点：此前该模型的REM普适性仅对能级涨落为 \( e^{-O(n)} \) 或随机选取 \( e^{o(\sqrt n)} \) 个构型时成立，本文将其推广到指数数量（\( e^{O(n)} \)）的随机构型，并首次识别出极限吉布斯权重为泊松-狄利克雷分布。
papers.method_zh: 概率论与统计力学中的点过程极限理论，具体包括：对哈密顿量进行依赖于 \( h_i \) 的中心化处理，对构型进行独立稀疏化（保留指数数量），证明能级点过程分布收敛到泊松点过程，并推导吉布斯权重的泊松-狄利克雷极限分布与自由能的冻结相变。证明以压缩形式给出，完整细节见配套预印本。

papers.title: Exact metastability in a class of driven-dissipative quantum many-body systems
papers.abstract: Metastability in many-body quantum systems and its associated exponentially-long timescales have been the subject of considerable recent interest. Here, we focus on a class of driven-dissipative many-body open quantum systems described by a Lindbladian having hidden time-reversal symmetry (a form of quantum detailed balance). Examples include boundary-driven interacting spin chains, bosonic lattice models and driven-dissipative collective spin models. We suggest that for such systems, slow timescales in the vicinity of a dissipative first-order phase transition can be analytically predicted using a special purification of the non-equilibrium steady state. We show the accuracy of our conjecture through detailed studies of a dissipative transverse-field Ising model with collective and local decay, and a driven-dissipative nonlinear cavity model. Our results allow quantitative insights into metastability and slow dynamics for a range of systems, including cases where semiclassical or path-integral instanton approaches are intractable.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytically predicted、conjecture、quantitative insights。；研究对象：一类具有隐藏时间反演对称性（量子细致平衡形式）的驱动-耗散多体开放量子系统，包括边界驱动相互作用自旋链、玻色子晶格模型、驱动-耗散集体自旋模型，以及具体的耗散横场伊辛模型和驱动-耗散非线性腔模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在这类系统耗散一级相变附近，慢时间尺度（亚稳态）可以通过对非平衡稳态进行特殊纯化来解析预测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在这类系统耗散一级相变附近，慢时间尺度（亚稳态）可以通过对非平衡稳态进行特殊纯化来解析预测。；创新点：提出了一种解析预测驱动-耗散多体量子系统亚稳态及其指数级长时间尺度的方法，适用于半经典或路径积分瞬子方法难以处理的体系。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：利用隐藏时间反演对称性（量子细致平衡）对Lindblad主方程进行特殊纯化处理，并通过耗散横场伊辛模型（集体衰减和局域衰减）以及驱动-耗散非线性腔模型的详细研究验证猜想。

papers.title: Non-Abelian braiding in Abelian Fractional Quantum Hall Phases from realistic interactions
papers.abstract: We propose a method of realizing non-Abelian braiding of fractionalized quasiholes in the Laughlin fractional quantum Hall phase at $ν=1/3$ with realistic two-body interactions within the lowest Landau level. It is numerically shown that low-lying gapped excitations near $ν=1/3$ are contained almost entirely within the null space of the three-body Moore-Read model Hamiltonian. They are thus quantum fluids of non-Abelian quasiholes that are in principle physically accessible. In particular, Laughlin ground state can be described as a fluid of ``$ψ$-type" quasiholes formed by binding a magnetic flux with a Majorana fermion (MF), and the Laughlin quasiholes are described by the ``$1$-type'' quasiholes, which are magnetic fluxes without a MF attached. Within the Laughlin phase, Laughlin quasiholes can be locally fractionalized into non-Abelian quasiholes, when the strong attraction between them is overcome by properly designed one-body electronstatic trapping potentials. Extensive numerics with proper finite-size scaling corroborate this physical picture, and our study points to the possibility of realizing non-Abelian braiding within an Abelian topological phase in experiment without the need for fine-tuning realistic electron-electron interaction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。依据：摘要中明确提到“numerically shown”、“Extensive numerics with proper finite-size scaling”，表明主要采用数值计算方法进行验证。；研究对象：分数量子霍尔效应中的非阿贝尔编织。具体体系为Laughlin态（填充因子ν=1/3）中的准粒子激发。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在具有现实两体相互作用的Laughlin分数量子霍尔相中，通过设计单电子静电势阱，可以将阿贝尔的Laughlin准空穴局域地分裂成非阿贝尔准空穴，从而实现非阿贝尔编织。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在具有现实两体相互作用的Laughlin分数量子霍尔相中，通过设计单电子静电势阱，可以将阿贝尔的Laughlin准空穴局域地分裂成非阿贝尔准空穴，从而实现非阿贝尔编织。；创新点：提出了一种在阿贝尔拓扑相（Laughlin相）中，利用现实的两体相互作用（而非需要精细调节的三体相互作用）来实现非阿贝尔编织的可行方案，避免了在实验中精细调节电子-电子相互作用的困难。
papers.method_zh: 数值计算与有限尺寸标度分析。具体包括：1）将低能激发态投影到三体Moore-Read模型哈密顿量的零空间；2）通过设计单电子静电势阱来克服准粒子间的强吸引力；3）进行系统的有限尺寸标度分析来佐证物理图像。

papers.title: Bulk Superconductivity driven by Disorder-Induced Delocalization in 4Hb-Ta(S$_{1-x}$Se$_x$)$_2$
papers.abstract: The unconventional superconductor 4Hb-TaS$_2$ is a natural heterostructure that can be broadly understood as interleaving Mott-like and metallic layers. We study the properties of this material as a function of quenched disorder in the form of Se/S substitution and find that while disordered samples show bulk superconductivity, clean samples do not. We show that a disorder-driven delocalization of carriers in the Mott-like ($1T$-) layer forms a new Fermi surface that is absent in the cleanest samples. This suggests that one of the primary drivers for superconductivity is the fragility of the Mott state, whose delocalization brings to life a sea of strongly correlated electrons.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要提到“研究性质”“发现”“样品”等实验关键词，涉及对材料进行Se/S替代引入无序并测量超导性质。；研究对象：4Hb-Ta(S₁₋ₓSeₓ)₂，即通过Se/S替代引入无序的4Hb-TaS₂体系。该材料是一种天然异质结构，由类似Mott绝缘体的1T层和金属性层交替堆叠而成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 无序（Se/S替代）可以驱动4Hb-TaS₂中Mott-like层内的载流子退局域化，形成新的费米面，从而诱导出体超导电性；而清洁样品中不出现体超导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：无序（Se/S替代）可以驱动4Hb-TaS₂中Mott-like层内的载流子退局域化，形成新的费米面，从而诱导出体超导电性；而清洁样品中不出现体超导。；创新点：揭示了Mott态的脆弱性是驱动超导的关键因素：无序导致的退局域化激活了强关联电子海，从而产生超导。这一机制将超导的出现与Mott绝缘体的破坏直接联系起来。
papers.method_zh: 通过Se/S化学替代引入淬火无序，对比清洁样品与无序样品的超导性质，并结合对Mott-like层中载流子行为的分析（摘要未明确说明具体实验手段，如输运测量、磁化率、ARPES等）。

papers.title: Flow of deformable droplets: self-pinned glasses and string-like flow
papers.abstract: We investigate, through numerical simulations, the rheology of a dry suspension of deformable droplets under pressure-driven flow. The system exhibits two force-driven dynamical transitions. At low forcing, the suspension behaves as a yield-stress material: below a critical force, droplets remain arrested in an amorphous solid-like state. Our simulations suggest that yielding is controlled by droplet contacts and predict that the critical force strongly depends on deformability. Above yielding, the suspension does not flow steadily but rather enters an intermittent, stick-slip regime characterised by long-lived caging and non-Gaussian velocity fluctuations. This state can be interpreted as a "self-pinned'' glass, in which slowly evolving droplet overlaps generate an effective rugged energy landscape that dynamically traps droplets and produces intermittent rearrangements reminiscent of near-critical dynamics in depinning models. At larger forcing, droplets deform sufficiently to continuously exchange neighbours, progressively annealing the overlap structure and driving a dynamic transition to a string-like, flowing state. Our results identify the restructuring of overlap networks as a generic mechanism which controls flow in driven suspensions of deformable particles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：numerical simulations（数值模拟）。；研究对象：可变形液滴的干悬浮体在压力驱动流动下的流变学行为，具体关注其力驱动的动力学转变和玻璃态行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该体系存在两个力驱动的动力学转变：低驱动力下表现为屈服应力材料，屈服后进入间歇性“自钉扎”玻璃态；高驱动力下转变为类弦流动状态。重叠网络的重构是控制流动的通用机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该体系存在两个力驱动的动力学转变：低驱动力下表现为屈服应力材料，屈服后进入间歇性“自钉扎”玻璃态；高驱动力下转变为类弦流动状态。重叠网络的重构是控制流动的通用机制。；创新点：揭示了可变形液滴悬浮体中由液滴重叠形成的有效粗糙能量景观导致“自钉扎”玻璃态，并识别出重叠网络重构作为驱动流动的通用机制。摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟（numerical simulations），具体方法摘要未明确说明（如是否采用分子动力学、耗散粒子动力学等）。

papers.title: Fermion sign problem and the structure of Lee-Yang zeros. II. Finite temperature results for a model system without interactions
papers.abstract: Beyond the analysis of the Lee-Yang (LY) zero of $ξ$ at $0$ K presented by our previous work [He et. al. Phys. Rev. E 113, 24115 (2026)], it is important but intricate to understand how these zeros evolve with temperature ($T$). Here, we use an analytically solvable noninteracting one-dimensional particle-on-a-ring model to address this. We determine the trajectories of these zeros and analyze how their evolution with $T$ reshapes the analytic structure of the partition function. In particular, the zero originating from $ξ=-1$ at $T=0$ remains close to $-1$ at low $T$, where it governs the sign factor and strongly constrains continuation along the real $ξ$ axis. This explains why both direct extrapolation and implicit schemes such as contour-based fitting can fail in the low-$T$ regime, even at high fitting order, while becoming reasonable again once the relevant zeros move away at higher $T$s. Furthermore, based on the polynomial structure of the partition function, we propose a new fitting strategy for low-$T$ fermionic properties. The key is to first obtain reliable high-$T$ fermionic properties by continuing sign-problem-free data in $ξ\in[0,1]$ to $ξ=-1$, and then extend this information toward lower $T$ through $T$-fitting of the $ξ$-independent remainder $φ(β)=Z_{\text{F}}$. These results provide a solvable benchmark for diagnosing the validity of analytic continuation and suggest a possible route toward treating more realistic interacting fermionic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：使用解析可解模型（analytically solvable noninteracting one-dimensional particle-on-a-ring model）进行理论分析，并基于配分函数的解析结构提出新拟合策略。；研究对象：一维无相互作用的环上粒子模型（noninteracting one-dimensional particle-on-a-ring model），具体研究费米子符号问题与Lee-Yang零点随温度演化的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在低温下，源自ξ=-1的Lee-Yang零点仍靠近-1，导致沿实ξ轴的解析延拓（包括直接外推和基于轮廓的拟合）失效；而在高温下零点移开，延拓变得可行。基于此，提出一种先通过高温无符号问题数据延拓至ξ=-1，再通过温度拟合剩余项φ(β)=Z_F来获取低温费米子性质的新策略。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在低温下，源自ξ=-1的Lee-Yang零点仍靠近-1，导致沿实ξ轴的解析延拓（包括直接外推和基于轮廓的拟合）失效；而在高温下零点移开，延拓变得可行。基于此，提出一种先通过高温无符号问题数据延拓至ξ=-1，再通过温度拟合剩余项φ(β)=Z_F来获取低温费米子性质的新策略。；创新点：首次系统分析了无相互作用费米子体系中Lee-Yang零点随温度的演化如何导致解析延拓在低温下失效，并基于此提出一种分步拟合策略（先高温ξ延拓，再低温T拟合）来规避符号问题。
papers.method_zh: 解析求解无相互作用一维环上粒子模型的配分函数，分析Lee-Yang零点在复ξ平面上的轨迹随温度的变化，并基于配分函数的多项式结构提出新的拟合方法。

papers.title: Near-room-temperature magnetoelectric coupling engineered through inversion-breaking tilts in a bulk perovskite polytype
papers.abstract: Systematic strategies to design properties such as ferroelectricity or magnetoelectric coupling are well established in simple perovskite materials, but they remain scarce in more complex framework structures. Using a hexagonal polytype of the ternary manganite AMnO3 (A = Ba, Sr, Ca) as a model system, we introduce a symmetry-guided design principle in which an inversion-breaking rigid-unit mode (RUM) serves as a single structural instability generating both polar and ferromagnetic orders within a bulk material. Symmetry analysis and first-principles calculations reveal that co-operative tilts of the Mn2O9 bioctahedral dimers generate both a spontaneous polarization and a ferromagnetic moment. High-resolution diffraction and magnetic susceptibility measurements show the structural and magnetic orders persist as high as 450 K and 280 K, respectively, highlighting the untapped potential of framework structures which deviate from simple perovskite motifs to be designed to host useful ferroic properties. Our approach establishes a transferable symmetry-based framework to engineer ferroelectric and magnetoelectric states across chemically diverse framework architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算+理论）。判断依据：摘要中同时提及了“对称性分析”、“第一性原理计算”、“高分辨率衍射”和“磁化率测量”。；研究对象：以六方多型体三元锰氧化物AMnO₃（A = Ba, Sr, Ca）为模型体系，研究其近室温的磁电耦合效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入一种打破反演对称性的刚性单元模式（RUM），在块体材料中同时实现了自发极化和铁磁序，且这两种有序态分别可保持至450 K和280 K。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入一种打破反演对称性的刚性单元模式（RUM），在块体材料中同时实现了自发极化和铁磁序，且这两种有序态分别可保持至450 K和280 K。；创新点：提出了一种可转移的、基于对称性的设计框架，用于在偏离简单钙钛矿构型的复杂框架结构中工程化铁电和磁电状态。该工作揭示了利用框架结构（而非简单钙钛矿）中未被充分挖掘的潜力来设计有用铁性材料的途径。
papers.method_zh: 1.  **理论框架**：对称性引导的设计原则，基于刚性单元模式（RUM）的结构不稳定性分析。

papers.title: Scalable Prediction of Complex Surface Reconstructions under Operating Conditions via Harmony-Search-Based Global Optimization
papers.abstract: The dynamic structural evolution of catalyst surfaces under operating conditions dictates catalytic performance, yet capturing these reconstructions atomically remains challenging. Global optimization based on machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) is promising, but scaling to large-scale, low-symmetry operando systems is hindered by expansive search spaces and potential energy surface (PES) inaccuracies. Herein, we present Harmony-search-based Atomic Structural Global Optimization (HASGO), a framework integrating universal MLIPs with a harmony search algorithm. HASGO overcomes the problem of PES softening by incorporating a multi-head replay fine-tuning protocol. Moreover, the stochastic structural perturbation step in its algorithm offers a fault-tolerant strategy to enhance the robustness of global convergence. These enable HASGO to identify intricate surface oxide overlayers that align with atomic-resolution microscopy, thereby resolving the square-pyramidal subsurface O5 motif on Ag(100) during ethylene epoxidation. This scalable framework provides a robust approach for uncovering operando structures, accelerating the rational design of industrial catalysts.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词包括“global optimization based on machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs)”、“harmony search algorithm”、“multi-head replay fine-tuning protocol”等计算与算法术语。；研究对象：催化剂表面在操作条件下的复杂表面重构，具体以银(100)表面在乙烯环氧化反应中的表面氧化物覆盖层为研究对象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: HASGO框架能够识别出与原子分辨率显微镜一致的复杂表面氧化物覆盖层，并解析出银(100)表面在乙烯环氧化过程中存在的方锥形亚表面O5结构基元。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：HASGO框架能够识别出与原子分辨率显微镜一致的复杂表面氧化物覆盖层，并解析出银(100)表面在乙烯环氧化过程中存在的方锥形亚表面O5结构基元。；创新点：提出了一种可扩展的全局优化框架，通过引入和谐搜索算法与多头回放微调协议，解决了传统方法在搜索空间庞大、势能面不准确时难以处理大规模、低对称性操作条件下表面重构的难题。
papers.method_zh: 基于和谐搜索算法的原子结构全局优化框架（HASGO），集成了通用机器学习原子间势（MLIPs），并采用多头回放微调协议（multi-head replay fine-tuning protocol）来克服势能面软化问题，同时利用随机结构扰动步骤增强全局收敛的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Polar and quadratic magneto-optical Kerr effects in nonmagnetic/ferromagnet bilayers for spin-orbit torque measurements
papers.abstract: Recent studies have revealed that spin Hall magnetoresistance (SMR) contributes to both the anomalous and planar Hall resistances in nonmagnetic metal (NM)/ferromagnetic metal (FM) bilayers. This effect becomes pronounced when the NM layer exhibits a large spin Hall angle, as in W/CoFeB bilayers. In such systems, the ratio of planar to anomalous Hall resistances, normally small in single CoFeB layers, can approach unity. This unusually large ratio complicates the determination of spin-torque efficiency using harmonic Hall voltage measurements. To overcome this limitation, magneto-optical Kerr effect (MOKE) measurements have been proposed as an alternative approach. Here, we investigate the polar and quadratic MOKE components, which correspond to, respectively, the anomalous and planar Hall resistances in the low-frequency limit to clarify whether the MOKE measurements are suitable for characterizing the spin-torque efficiency. We find that the ratio of quadratic to polar MOKE signals in NM/FM bilayers is significantly smaller than the corresponding Hall resistance ratio, indicating that SMR contributes negligibly to the MOKE response in the visible range. Consequently, the spin-torque efficiency extracted from MOKE measurements agree well with those expected from the spin Hall angle of the NM layer. These results clarify the reason why MOKE measurements provide reliable determination of the spin-torque efficiency.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了“我们研究了（We investigate）”、“我们发现（We find）”等实验性动词，并涉及具体的测量（MOKE测量）和样品（W/CoFeB双层膜）。；研究对象：非磁性金属（NM）/铁磁金属（FM）双层膜（如W/CoFeB）中的自旋轨道转矩（SOT）测量，以及相关的极向和二次磁光克尔效应（MOKE）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在NM/FM双层膜中，二次MOKE信号与极向MOKE信号的比值远小于对应的平面霍尔电阻与反常霍尔电阻的比值，表明自旋霍尔磁电阻（SMR）在可见光波段对MOKE响应的贡献可忽略不计。因此，基于MOKE测量提取的自旋转矩效率与NM层的自旋霍尔角预期值吻合良好，是一种可靠的测量方法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在NM/FM双层膜中，二次MOKE信号与极向MOKE信号的比值远小于对应的平面霍尔电阻与反常霍尔电阻的比值，表明自旋霍尔磁电阻（SMR）在可见光波段对MOKE响应的贡献可忽略不计。因此，基于MOKE测量提取的自旋转矩效率与NM层的自旋霍尔角预期值吻合良好，是一种可靠的测量方法。；创新点：该工作澄清了为何MOKE测量能够可靠地确定自旋转矩效率的物理原因：即SMR对MOKE响应贡献极小，从而避免了在谐波霍尔电压测量中因SMR导致平面/反常霍尔电阻比值异常增大而带来的测量困难。
papers.method_zh: 实验上，通过测量非磁性/铁磁双层膜（如W/CoFeB）的极向和二次磁光克尔效应（MOKE）信号，并将其与低频极限下的反常霍尔电阻和平面霍尔电阻进行对比分析。具体手段为谐波霍尔电压测量和MOKE测量。

papers.title: Hydrogel mechanics below swelling equilibrium
papers.abstract: Hydrogels are versatile materials due to their softness and ability to undergo large changes in water content. Their mechanics, however, are complex, being a tight coupling between fluid flow and elastic deformations. We use experiments and theory to show that this coupling simplifies when hydrogels are not fully swollen. In this regime, polymer-water affinity controls local hydration, while the much weaker polymer network elasticity plays a secondary role, setting the resulting elastic shape. This observation enables a simplified model that accurately predicts stresses and deformations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与理论结合）。关键词：experiments and theory、coupling、simplified model。；研究对象：水凝胶在未完全溶胀状态下的力学行为，具体为聚合物-水亲和力与网络弹性之间的耦合机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当水凝胶未完全溶胀时，聚合物-水亲和力主导局部水合状态，而较弱的聚合物网络弹性仅决定最终的弹性形状，两者耦合简化，从而可用简化模型准确预测应力和变形。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当水凝胶未完全溶胀时，聚合物-水亲和力主导局部水合状态，而较弱的聚合物网络弹性仅决定最终的弹性形状，两者耦合简化，从而可用简化模型准确预测应力和变形。；创新点：揭示了水凝胶在非完全溶胀状态下聚合物-水亲和力与网络弹性的主次关系，并据此提出简化模型，避免了全耦合复杂处理。摘要未突出说明与已有模型的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 实验与理论结合：通过实验观测水凝胶在非溶胀平衡状态下的力学响应，并建立理论模型（摘要未明确说明具体实验手段或理论框架细节，如是否使用流变仪、光学显微镜或连续介质力学模型等）。

papers.title: Topologically Enforced Lifshitz Multicriticality in One Dimension
papers.abstract: Recent advances have revealed that topology can further enrich the universality classes of quantum phase transitions, thereby extending beyond the traditional paradigms of statistical and condensed matter physics. However, multicriticality between topologically distinct quantum critical lines remains insufficiently explored. In this Letter, we systematically construct and investigate a novel class of topologically enforced Lifshitz multicritical points in one dimensional chiral symmetric fermionic systems. Such multicriticality is driven solely by changes in the topology of neighboring critical lines, beyond previously recognized multicritical points that are typically induced by changes in critical exponents. More importantly, the topologically enforced multicriticality identified here can host robust topological degeneracies while surprisingly exhibiting a breakdown of the Li Haldane bulk boundary correspondence-a phenomenon we elucidate through a simple physical picture.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“systematically construct and investigate”（系统构建和研究）、“physical picture”（物理图像），未涉及实验或计算模拟方法。；研究对象：一维手性对称费米子体系中的拓扑强制Lifshitz多临界点（topologically enforced Lifshitz multicritical points）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了一类由相邻临界线拓扑变化单独驱动的新型多临界点，该多临界点具有鲁棒的拓扑简并性，但同时表现出Li-Haldane体边对应关系的破坏。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了一类由相邻临界线拓扑变化单独驱动的新型多临界点，该多临界点具有鲁棒的拓扑简并性，但同时表现出Li-Haldane体边对应关系的破坏。；创新点：首次系统构建并研究了由拓扑变化而非临界指数变化诱导的多临界点，并揭示了其破坏Li-Haldane体边对应关系的反常现象。
papers.method_zh: 理论构建与分析。摘要未明确说明具体理论框架（如场论、拓扑不变量计算等），仅提及“通过简单的物理图像阐明”。

papers.title: Resolving Light-Induced Structural Rearrangements in Responsive Microgels
papers.abstract: Optically-responsive microgels offer a versatile platform for designing adaptive soft materials with coupled light and thermal responsiveness. Control over the crosslinking degree is particularly appealing as it can regulate not only particle size but also stiffness, thereby enabling remote tuning of key material functionalities. However, the internal structural changes that couple molecular photoresponsive mechanisms to mesoscopic properties remain poorly resolved. Here, we investigate different light-responsive microgels containing covalently incorporated coumarin moieties, which impart optical sensitivity through UV-induced cycloaddition, by combining dynamic light scattering, small-angle neutron scattering, and molecular dynamics simulations. We show that light irradiation alters not only particle size but also the internal polymer density distribution and subsequent thermal response. Before irradiation, the microgels exhibit a star-like architecture with a dense core and extended polymeric arms. After irradiation, the network evolves toward a markedly more compact structure. This transformation cannot be rationalized simply as an equivalent to an increase in crosslinking density during synthesis, as observed in the thermal response, revealing light as a powerful tool to regulate microgel architecture and multifunctional responsiveness.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。判断依据：摘要中明确提及结合了“动态光散射”、“小角中子散射”等实验手段，以及“分子动力学模拟”这一计算方法。；研究对象：光响应性微凝胶。具体为共价结合了香豆素基团、通过紫外光诱导环加成反应实现光学响应的微凝胶体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 光照不仅改变了微凝胶的尺寸，还改变了其内部聚合物密度分布和后续的热响应行为。光照使微凝胶从星形结构（致密核心+伸展聚合物臂）转变为更紧凑的结构，这种转变不能简单等同于合成过程中交联密度的增加。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：光照不仅改变了微凝胶的尺寸，还改变了其内部聚合物密度分布和后续的热响应行为。光照使微凝胶从星形结构（致密核心+伸展聚合物臂）转变为更紧凑的结构，这种转变不能简单等同于合成过程中交联密度的增加。；创新点：揭示了光响应性微凝胶在光照下发生的内部结构重排（从星形到紧凑结构），并指出这种光诱导的结构变化与通过化学合成增加交联密度所产生的效果不同，从而将光确立为一种调控微凝胶结构和多功能响应性的独特工具。
papers.method_zh: 动态光散射、小角中子散射、分子动力学模拟。

papers.title: Direct High-Magnetic-Field Coupling to Stripe Order in a Cuprate Superconductor
papers.abstract: Superconductivity in cuprates emerges out of a complex normal state that hosts density waves, pseudogap physics, and strange metal properties. Here, we access this normal state by synchronizing free-electron laser x-rays with high-magnetic-field pulses up to 44 T. We observe a linear increase in charge order amplitude and correlation length that persists far above the vortex melting transition. This behavior is incompatible with standard phase competition between charge order and superconductivity. By means of conventional hard x-ray diffraction and magnetostriction, we show that applied fields also enhance monoclinic lattice distortions. However, this magnetoelastic response is weaker and an epiphenomenon of the stripe order enhancement. Combined with recent observations of field-linear spin freezing, our results point to a direct coupling between magnetic field and the spin component of stripe order in the high-field normal state -- a mechanism independent of superconductivity suppression that has so far remained hidden from scattering probes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词包括“同步自由电子激光X射线”、“硬X射线衍射”、“磁致伸缩”等具体实验手段。；研究对象：铜氧化物高温超导体中的条纹序（stripe order）及其在高磁场下的行为。具体涉及电荷序（charge order）和自旋序（spin component of stripe order）与磁场的直接耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在高磁场（高达44 T）下，铜氧化物超导体中的电荷序振幅和关联长度呈线性增加，且该行为远高于涡旋熔化转变温度。这表明磁场与条纹序的自旋分量存在直接耦合，而非通过抑制超导电性间接增强电荷序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在高磁场（高达44 T）下，铜氧化物超导体中的电荷序振幅和关联长度呈线性增加，且该行为远高于涡旋熔化转变温度。这表明磁场与条纹序的自旋分量存在直接耦合，而非通过抑制超导电性间接增强电荷序。；创新点：该工作揭示了磁场与条纹序自旋分量之间存在一种直接的耦合机制，这种机制独立于超导电性的抑制，并且此前一直未被散射探针所发现。摘要未突出说明与具体理论模型的对比。
papers.method_zh: 主要使用了两种实验技术：1）将自由电子激光X射线与高达44 T的高磁场脉冲同步，用于原位探测电荷序的演化；2）采用常规硬X射线衍射和磁致伸缩测量，研究磁场对单斜晶格畸变的影响。

papers.title: Six Open Questions in Machine-Learned Interatomic Potential Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have had a profound impact on molecular modelling in recent years, promising to resolve the long-standing tension between the scale and accuracy of simulations. There has been a proliferation of new models and designs, and recently the paradigm of ``foundational'' MLIPs has become prevalent. Broadly speaking, foundation models are trained on large diverse datasets and promise to work well for new systems with minimal updates required. However, in such a new and fast moving field, there are many unanswered questions. In this article, we set out to articulate and explore what we see as the most important among these questions. We start by developing a working definition for foundational MLIPs and use this definition to frame the subsequent open questions. Despite the rapid progress in the field of MLIP models, we believe that these are fundamental questions which will continue to define cutting edge research in MLIPs in the years to come.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/综述文章。关键词：articulate and explore（阐述与探讨）、open questions（开放性问题）、working definition（工作定义）。；研究对象：机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）的基础模型（foundation models），属于计算材料科学/分子建模领域的方法论研究，而非特定材料或物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 尽管MLIP基础模型在分子模拟中取得了显著进展，但该领域仍存在若干根本性未解问题，这些问题将定义未来数年的前沿研究方向。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：尽管MLIP基础模型在分子模拟中取得了显著进展，但该领域仍存在若干根本性未解问题，这些问题将定义未来数年的前沿研究方向。；创新点：摘要未突出说明具体创新点，主要贡献在于系统性地识别和表述了MLIP基础模型领域中最关键的六个未解决问题，并为该新兴概念提供了初步定义。
papers.method_zh: 通过提出并阐述六项开放性问题，并首先为“基础MLIP”建立工作定义，以此框架展开分析。未涉及具体实验或计算手段。

papers.title: How Similar Can Fractional Chern Insulators Be to Fractional Quantum Hall States? Moiré-Enhanced Gaps and Excitation-Spectrum Correspondence
papers.abstract: Fractional Chern insulators (FCIs) realize fractional quantum Hall topology in lattice bands, but their excitation spectra remain far less understood than their ground states. Here we establish a theoretical principle relating the periodic electron-density modulations of flat Chern bands to the many-body gap and excitation spectrum of FCIs. Contrary to the conventional view that such density modulations are detrimental to fractional topology, we show that different reciprocal-lattice Fourier components play sharply distinct roles: components at smaller reciprocal lattice vectors suppress the FCI gap, whereas components at larger reciprocal lattice vectors enhance it. By suppressing the harmful small-wave-vector components and amplifying the beneficial large-wave-vector components, the gap enhancement can, in principle, be made arbitrarily large within the projected flat-band theory. Moreover, the same enhancement factor rescales the full low-energy spectrum, making the FCI excitation spectrum predictable from the corresponding Landau-level problem. We further generalize this correspondence to non-Abelian states. Applying this principle to moiré Chern bands, we identify these reciprocal-lattice density components as practical diagnostics for robust FCIs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提出了“理论原理”（theoretical principle），并基于“投影平带理论”（projected flat-band theory）进行分析和推导，未提及任何实验或数值计算手段。；研究对象：分数陈绝缘体（FCIs）的激发谱及其与分数量子霍尔态（FQH states）的相似性，特别是莫尔超晶格体系中的平带。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 平带中周期性的电子密度调制对FCI的能隙和激发谱有双重作用：小波矢的傅里叶分量会压制FCI能隙，而大波矢的分量则会增强能隙。通过抑制有害分量、放大有益分量，原则上可以在投影平带理论中任意增大FCI能隙，并使整个低能激发谱与对应的朗道能级问题完全对应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：平带中周期性的电子密度调制对FCI的能隙和激发谱有双重作用：小波矢的傅里叶分量会压制FCI能隙，而大波矢的分量则会增强能隙。通过抑制有害分量、放大有益分量，原则上可以在投影平带理论中任意增大FCI能隙，并使整个低能激发谱与对应的朗道能级问题完全对应。；创新点：颠覆了“电子密度调制对分数拓扑有害”的传统观点，揭示了不同波矢分量的截然不同作用，并建立了FCI激发谱与朗道能级问题之间的定量对应关系。摘要未突出说明与具体实验或数值计算的对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。具体框架为：基于平带投影理论，分析倒格矢傅里叶分量对FCI多体能隙和激发谱的影响；将FCI激发谱与分数量子霍尔态（朗道能级问题）进行对应性研究，并推广至非阿贝尔态。

papers.title: Flexible PDMS/La$_{0.7}$Sr$_{0.3}$MnO$_3$/MWCNT Composite Thin Films for Multifunctional Temperature and Magnetic Sensing Electronic Skin
papers.abstract: The development of multifunctional electronic skin (e-skin) requires materials that combine mechanical flexibility with responsiveness to multiple stimuli. In this work, a flexible PDMS/La0.7Sr0.3MnO3 (LSMO)/MWCNT composite thin film was fabricated via solution casting, using LSMO powder synthesized by a solid-state reaction method. Structural and spectroscopic analyses confirm the formation of single-phase rhombohedral LSMO and successful incorporation of PDMS, LSMO, and MWCNT components. The composite exhibits a smooth and uniform surface morphology, along with significantly enhanced thermal stability, retaining ~70% mass at elevated temperatures. Electrical measurements reveal thermally activated resistivity behavior, enabling temperature sensing functionality. Additionally, the composite shows a notable decrease in resistance under an applied magnetic field, exhibiting magnetoresistance due to spin-dependent transport in the LSMO phase. Mechanical testing indicates elastomeric behavior with a maximum load of ~0.49 N and stretchability of ~26%, along with ductile deformation characteristics. The multifunctional sensing properties arise from the synergistic interaction between the conductive MWCNT network and magnetically active LSMO within the flexible PDMS matrix. Overall, the composite demonstrates a unique combination of thermal stability, mechanical flexibility, and dual sensing capability, making it a promising material for next-generation e-skin applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“fabricated via solution casting”、“synthesized by a solid-state reaction method”、“Structural and spectroscopic analyses”、“Electrical measurements”、“Mechanical testing”等实验制备与表征手段。；研究对象：柔性PDMS/La₀.₇Sr₀.₃MnO₃（LSMO）/多壁碳纳米管（MWCNT）复合薄膜，用于多功能温度与磁场传感的电子皮肤。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该复合薄膜在柔性PDMS基体中通过导电MWCNT网络与磁性LSMO的协同作用，同时实现了温度传感（热激活电阻行为）和磁场传感（磁电阻效应），并兼具良好的热稳定性（高温下保留~70%质量）和机械柔韧性（最大拉伸率~26%）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该复合薄膜在柔性PDMS基体中通过导电MWCNT网络与磁性LSMO的协同作用，同时实现了温度传感（热激活电阻行为）和磁场传感（磁电阻效应），并兼具良好的热稳定性（高温下保留~70%质量）和机械柔韧性（最大拉伸率~26%）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 溶液浇铸法制备复合薄膜；固态反应法合成LSMO粉末；结构表征（X射线衍射等）与光谱分析确认物相；电阻随温度与磁场变化的电学测量；力学拉伸测试。

papers.title: Microswimmers create bicontinuous emulsions in binary fluids
papers.abstract: We consider a generic case of neutrally wetting microswimmers in symmetric mixtures of two phase separating fluids, using hydrodynamic simulations. The swimmers spontaneously emulsify the two fluids into bicontinuous foam-like state. The two principal activity components: source dipole (self-propulsion) and force dipole (active mixing), create a twofold mechanism to stabilise the structures. When the self-propulsion is too strong, the swimmers cross the interfaces rapidly and the two fluids will phase separate. Below this threshold, the active stresses from the force dipoles, stabilise a dynamic and bicontinuous foam-like state. When the activity is turned off, the system relaxes into a kinetically trapped bicontinuous state, with particles permanently trapped at the interfaces. Our results provide a microscopic route to tunable active emulsions, with implications for bacterial suspensions and synthetic active matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：hydrodynamic simulations）；研究对象：二元相分离流体中的中性润湿微游泳体（microswimmers）体系，具体为微游泳体在对称混合流体中自发形成的双连续乳液（bicontinuous emulsion）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 微游泳体通过源偶极（自推进）和力偶极（主动混合）的双重活性机制，将二元流体自发乳化为动态稳定的双连续泡沫状结构；当自推进过强时，体系发生相分离；关闭活性后，体系弛豫至动力学捕获的双连续态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：微游泳体通过源偶极（自推进）和力偶极（主动混合）的双重活性机制，将二元流体自发乳化为动态稳定的双连续泡沫状结构；当自推进过强时，体系发生相分离；关闭活性后，体系弛豫至动力学捕获的双连续态。；创新点：揭示了微游泳体通过源偶极与力偶极协同作用稳定双连续乳液的两重机制，并发现关闭活性后体系可进入动力学捕获的双连续态，为可调活性乳液提供了微观路径。
papers.method_zh: 流体动力学模拟（hydrodynamic simulations），具体模拟了中性润湿微游泳体在对称混合相分离流体中的行为。

papers.title: Topological Anderson insulators and reentrant topological transitions in a quasiperiodic long-range Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model
papers.abstract: We study a one-dimensional long-range Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model with third-nearest-neighbor hopping and subject to quasiperiodic disorder. In the clean limit, the model hosts phases characterized by winding numbers $W=-1,0,1$ and $2$. The introduction of quasiperiodic disorder profoundly modifies the phase diagram and induces a series of topological phase transitions. Owing to the competition between topological dimerization and localization, topological Anderson insulating (TAI) phases with different winding numbers emerge and can persist even when the spectral gap becomes nearly closed in the strong-disorder regime. In addition, we uncover multiple reentrant topological phase transitions induced by varying either the quasiperiodic disorder strength or the hopping amplitudes. Remarkably, the system exhibits staircase-like topological Anderson transitions, where the real-space winding number evolves through successive quantized steps with increasing disorder strength. Our results demonstrate that the interplay between long-range hopping and quasiperiodic disorder generates a rich landscape of disorder-induced topological phases and reentrant topological transition phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：研究（study）、模型（model）、相图（phase diagram）、拓扑相变（topological phase transitions）。；研究对象：一维长程Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）模型，包含第三近邻跳跃项并受准周期无序作用，研究其拓扑安德森绝缘体相和重入拓扑相变现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 准周期无序可诱导出不同绕数的拓扑安德森绝缘体相，并在强无序区谱隙近乎闭合时仍能存在；系统随无序强度或跳跃振幅变化时出现多次重入拓扑相变，并呈现阶梯状拓扑安德森转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：准周期无序可诱导出不同绕数的拓扑安德森绝缘体相，并在强无序区谱隙近乎闭合时仍能存在；系统随无序强度或跳跃振幅变化时出现多次重入拓扑相变，并呈现阶梯状拓扑安德森转变。；创新点：揭示了长程跳跃与准周期无序的竞争可产生丰富的无序诱导拓扑相及重入拓扑相变现象，特别是发现了阶梯状拓扑安德森转变这一新行为。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：通过计算实空间绕数（real-space winding number）刻画拓扑相，研究准周期无序强度与跳跃振幅对相图的影响。

papers.title: Modelling time-irreversible avalanches
papers.abstract: We investigate the problem of the time reversal symmetry of fluctuations, as witnessed by the average shape of avalanches. This quantity has been measured in a variety of systems, ranging from magnetic materials to earthquakes. Although an asymmetric shape is often observed, which is a signature of a non-equilibrium dynamics, there is no general theoretical control of this feature. In this paper, we propose a non equilibrium extension of a paradigmatic model for ``crackling-noise'', the so called ABBM model. Our model is strictly related to the Brownian Gyrator, which has been previously introduced in stochastic thermodynamics as the simplest model for thermal anisotropy, but it can also be framed in the context of rate-and-state models. It reproduces the phenomenology observed in experiments on granular friction, and allows for a systematic theoretical study of the asymmetry. We manage to correlate a measure of asymmetry, that can be easily computed in experiments, with the entropy production rates of the dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose a non equilibrium extension、theoretical study、model。；研究对象：雪崩（avalanches）现象中的时间不可逆性，具体涉及磁性材料、地震、颗粒摩擦等系统中的雪崩形状不对称性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过提出一个非平衡扩展的ABBM模型（与布朗回转器相关），成功将雪崩形状的不对称性与动力学熵产生率关联起来，从而为实验观测到的非对称雪崩形状提供了理论控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过提出一个非平衡扩展的ABBM模型（与布朗回转器相关），成功将雪崩形状的不对称性与动力学熵产生率关联起来，从而为实验观测到的非对称雪崩形状提供了理论控制。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于随机热力学中的布朗回转器（Brownian Gyrator）概念，构建非平衡ABBM模型，并结合速率-状态（rate-and-state）模型框架进行理论分析。

papers.title: Peculiarities Of Phase States In N2O-CO2 Cryoalloys According To Electron Diffraction Data
papers.abstract: The structural characteristics of n2o-co2 alloys have been studied using transmission electron diffraction (THEED) across the entire range of their mutual concentrations at temperatures of 5 K and 65 K. The ranges in which regular solutions exist and intervals of alloy phase separation have been identified using the dependence of lattice parameters on composition and profile analysis of the diffraction pattern intensity distribution. It was found that maximum solubility values are up to 11 mol.% CO2 in the N2O matrix and up to 30 mol.% n2o in solid co2 at 65 K. The solubility limits for the components at 5 K are less 20 mol.% co2 in crystalline n2o and less than 35 mol.% n2o in a co2 crystal lattice.
